124512.en: Finally, the Wing Commander for this site arrives.

124513.en: Finally, the Wing Commander for this site arrives.

124514.en: Finally, the Wing Commander for this site arrives.

124515.en: Finally, the Wing Commander for this site arrives.

124516.en: Minedrill E518 Industrial : Why aren't we warping out of here?

124517.en: Minedrill E518 Industrial : The warp drives are blown. We're sitting ducks, sir.

124518.en: You won't be able to gain access to their warehouse until you take out the Ytiri Security Bunker. Take it out, and that should lower the warehouse's security systems enough for you to get close.

124519.en: Dread Pirate : Get back here, you dogs. We're not going to hurt you too much.

124520.en: Dread Pirate : I have this sector under control. We were supposed to kill everyone, right?

124521.en: Dread Pirate : Come here, little dogs. I've got a treat for you. It's right here in my rifle.

124522.en: Dread Pirate : Almost done here, chief. Just a few more rooms to go, and a lot more bodies.

124523.en: Dread Pirate : Stay away from this crate. This is my loot.

124524.en: Data Center 1 destroyed. The gate is now unlocked.

124525.en: Second Data Center destroyed. Final gate is unlocked.

124526.en:
I'm surprised you showed up.
I'd pretend you were under arrest, but we both know you'd resist. I'll just kill you a few dozen times.

124527.en: Keep killing the guards and proceed ahead to the next warehouse.

124528.en: Data Center 1 destroyed. The gate is now unlocked.

124529.en: Second Data Center destroyed. Final gate is unlocked.

124531.en:
See? They're completely unprepared. Look at that: entire groups of ships listless and barely manned. 

Take out the guards, then go for the Fuel Depots. By my estimations, those depots have enough raw energy in them to take out the surrounding ships. All we need is for you to start the fire.

124532.en:
I'm surprised that worked. The Navy must be getting dumber and more gullible each year. Seems that way, at least, since the start of Heth's rise. Good for business, bad for them.

We need that evidence of Kori's treason. It must be in that building behind the forcefield. Approach the bunker carefully and watch out for any Navy ships. Take out the forcefield, grab the evidence, and get out of there as fast as possible.

124533.en: Okay, get the hell out of there!

124534.en: Okay, get the hell out of there!

124535.en:
Excellent work. You're now inside the second area. You should see a container in the distance. Head towards it and recover a “Proof of Discovery: Ore” document to prove that you made it here. Don't forget it, pilot. You'll need one of those documents as physical proof that you discovered this site.

If someone else has already made it to this site before you then there may not be a document immediately available. If you find the container empty, wait a few seconds and a new one will be produced.

124536.en:
Greetings pilot, and good work finding your way here. My name is Rulie Isoryn, and I work with the Sisters of Eve as an advisor for capsuleers in training. Although I'll be offering you advice as you go along, don't forget that you need to report back to your own agent.

You've just arrived in the staging pocket of our training facility. Ahead of you is an acceleration gate. These powerful structures are able to fling your ship thousands of kilometers forward and deeper inside.

In order to operate them, you must be within 2,500 m and then activate the gate. Head on through to the next pocket by using it.

124537.en: You see a spacial rift in the distance: This is probably what the Blood Raiders have called the "Fountain Of Youth."  Perhaps it was usable at some point in the past, but your computer indicates it is currently so unstable that attempting to use it would mean certain death. You refrain from any thoughts of using it, for now.

124538.en: Cura Gigno: That's the spirit! Let's destroy that station!

124539.en: Cura Gigno: "Cura Gigno takes on the Blood Raiders." Yeah, I think I'll call my biography something like that. You can be my sidekick, maybe... the silent warrior by my side. Maybe they'll even give me a medal!

124540.en: Cura Gigno: Take this one off me. I'm tanking too many!

124541.en: Cura Gigno:  Take the next one. I will finish him off.

124542.en: Cura Gigno: I got your back! Keep it up!

124543.en: Cura Gigno: Wait! I'm still reloading!!

124544.en: Cura Gigno: Do you have any spare ammo? Please?

124545.en: Cura Gigno: I'm impressed. You seem almost as good as I'd be flying that ship of yours...

124546.en: Cura Gigno:  They started training years before I did. It's not fair!

124547.en: We've really caught them off guard. There's just a small group of ships and a couple of stasis towers guarding that gate. The frigates should be no problem, but you might want to go for the stasis towers first, as they will make you an easy target.

124548.en:
See? They're completely unprepared. Look at that: entire groups of ships listless and barely manned.

By my estimations, those depots have enough raw energy in them to take out the surrounding ships. All we need is for you to start the fire. Take out the fuel depot's quickly, before the battleships have a chance to escape, or worse; shoot back.

124549.en: Cura Gigno: I hope you will manage without me, but I am going to check the next and last target.  It is one of the Blood´s holy places, some Fountain of Youth thing, quite a splash!  We don't want them to get away. I will hold them busy till you arrive!

124550.en:
Welcome to the fray, egger.
I've ordered the fleet to hold its ground for the time being, but we're going to send you in to recover the hostages shortly. Move out to the next area where the pirates are. They're expecting a negotiator, but we're sending you instead.
You are not to engage unless I give the order. We need to maintain the appearance of peaceful negotiation until the safety of the hostages can be confirmed.

124551.en: Move in! Rescue the hostages! Go, go, go!

124552.en:
Alright, good work.
In a moment, we're going to request that the pirates relocate the hostages to the Prison facility you should see up ahead there, so that we can verify their safety. The moment they've done that, I want you to charge towards that Prison and get them out. Do not fire on anyone or anything. Your only objective is the safe rescue of the hostages. Once their recovery is confirmed we'll deal with these scumbags ourselves.
Sit tight and wait for the go order.

124553.en: Stand down! Your only objective is the hostages!

124554.en: Stand down! Your only objective is the hostages!

124555.en: Stand down! Your only objective is the hostages!

124556.en:
No! They killed the hostages and called in reinforcements!
Just leave, before you do any more harm!
Note: You will be able to attempt this mission again after the daily downtime.

124557.en:
No! They killed the hostages and called in reinforcements!
Just leave, before you do any more harm!
Note: You will be able to attempt this mission again after the daily downtime.

124558.en:
No! They killed the hostages and called in reinforcements!
Just leave, before you do any more harm!
Note: You will be able to attempt this mission again after the daily downtime.

124559.en: Nice job, we're moving in now. Report back to your agent with those hostages immediately!

124560.en: Facility Warden : Lock down the facility, do not let anyone in or out.

124561.en: Nice try, good-lookin'. You'll have to do better than that, I'm afraid. Catch you on the other side!

124562.en: Nice try, good-lookin'. You'll have to do better than that, I'm afraid. Catch you on the other side!

124563.en: Nice try, good-lookin'. You'll have to do better than that, I'm afraid. Catch you on the other side!

124564.en: Anire Scarlet flees through the acceleration gate.

124565.en: Anire Scarlet is captured, preventing her escape. Time to finish her off, and collect the bounty.

124566.en: Anire Scarlet is captured, preventing her escape. Time to finish her off, and collect the bounty.

124567.en: We are warning you, either return Zazzmatazz's DNA to us intact or face the consequences!

124568.en: We are warning you, either return Zazzmatazz's DNA to us intact or face the consequences!

124569.en: We will not allow the pirates to get their hands on Zazzmatazz's DNA!

124570.en: You have made your choice, now face the consequences!

124571.en: What is this? Bring it to us! To us!

124572.en: You have made your choice, now face the consequences!

124573.en: Despite past events, Consolidated Holdings, Inc., appreciates your return of Zazzmatazz's DNA. Bring it to us and place it in the container

124574.en: Are we glad to see you! We're dead and drifting toward the rift. Our engines blew and our engineer is dead. We got a distress call from a science vessel closer to the hole. We couldn't respond, but you could. Bring their survivors back to your agent. Hurry!

124575.en: Hailing unknown ship! SOS! Please! Our engines are engines down… Life support is failing. Please! Save us! We'll give you anything!

124576.en: "Listen pilot, as a reminder, you and that agent of yours are personally responsible for Zazz's safety!"

124577.en: “You are the pilot interfering with my prison? I look forward to dealing with you in person.”

124578.en: “Back out while you can, you may have the access key but our countermeasures take that eventuality into account.”

124579.en: “Our scanners indicate that your strike force is insufficient, unable to succeed. I urge you to stand down now and I might even be willing to negotiate a deal against whoever sent you here.”

124580.en: “Don't forget who's calling the shots here egger. One scratch on Zazz and you're dead!”

124581.en: “Our scanners indicate that your strike force is insufficient, unable to succeed. I urge you to stand down now and I might even be willing to negotiate a deal against whoever sent you here.”

124582.en: “Go on! Yeah, go on! Halfway through!”

124583.en: “Impressive work! I'm almost tempted not to kill you afterwards…”

124584.en: “One more to go. I swear if you foul this up I am going to do unspeakable things to your frozen corpse.”

124585.en: “If this affair wouldn't be this annoying I would congratulate you! Why aren't you already on my payroll?”

124586.en: Well, well. You're the one who's given my boys some trouble, I see. Don't worry – I'll make this as fast and painless as possible. Anire Scarlet is nothing if not merciful.

124587.en: “Damn it, damn it! Woo-hoo! Go go go!! He's there, right there you damn bastard, go fetch! Fetch!”

124588.en: “Listen pilot, you won't find what you expect. To tell you the truth it isn't what I thought I would be guarding.”

124589.en: “Hah, I just tracked your agent down! These guys need professional help to wipe their trail. However, I'm not going to grease him because we need to talk. Let's keep this professional and go through them.”

124590.en: Well, you don't give up, do you. Okay, we'll play this your way.

124591.en: You just don't give up, do you? I've had enough of this!

124592.en: Steon has ejected in a capsule from the Stasis Tower, moments before its destruction!

124593.en: You've done well. You are now inside a Cosmic Anomaly. Normally there would be hostile ships present, but our people have already cleared the area. All you need to do now is recover the Proof of Discovery document we left there. You can find one of them in the nearby Training Container. You only need a single document. It will serve as physical proof that you have passed this stage of the tutorial, so make sure to recover at least one. Once you have it, bring it back to me and we can move on to more advanced types of scanning.

124594.en: Come to me and I will eject a container; just place Zazz's remains into so I can verify the merchandise and close this deal.

124595.en: Back off, man!  You're no match for my custom rig, even with how messed up it is.  Either way, you'd better run before Mona - I mean Surenna - gets here.  She'll blast you!

124596.en: I'm glad you got my message.  Implanting triggered responses into the minds of our former captives is the easy part; the hard part is figuring out what to do with nosy capsuleers that interfere with our operation.  Listen, we're both capsuleers, so there's really no point in dueling out here in the middle of space, is there?  Here's my offer:  If you head over to those asteroids, you'll find a cargo container with some valuable odds and ends inside.  You don't have to tell anyone where you got them.

124598.en: Hey gang, it looks like the second string escort has finally arrived.  We're done with this transport, so we're going to get out of here.  Take out this new trash quickly so you can empty the rest of the convoy and catch up.

124599.en: How the hell did you find this place?  Never mind, it doesn't really matter.

124600.en: Thank you!  Thank you for your help!  But the only way we'll get out of here alive is to clear a path through the field.  Blast us a route through the asteroids and the drones and we will be able to get back to our base.  That is unless you could give us a lift.

124601.en: Crok Cokan:  Alright, that's it.  You barge in here uninvited, mess with my subordinates, and now you have the nerve to attack my shipyard!  I see I'll have to take care of our little problem myself ...

124602.en: Crok Cokan and his cohorts have exited the shipyard, ready for action.

124641.en:
Are you real? I turned off my radio because they keep trying to talk to us, I can hear them begging, pleading, scratching inside my head… look, I locked the gate behind us but now Fajah's trapped there, at their mercy, because of us. 
I'll open the gate so we can save her, but please, don't listen to the other voices, don't listen to anyone except Fajah.

124642.en: The gate's open now. Fajah stayed aboard The Paryi - I know it's not too late.

124645.en: He promised we would go to the beach on my birthday, so we went, even though it was raining, even though we didn't know where mom was again. I was collecting shells, and I found one that was perfect and round and smooth but then I looked back to the shore and saw him just standing there, the first time I'd ever seen him cry, and I wanted to say something but couldn't, just stood there, frozen, the shell crunching in my fist, and I looked down and my hand was bleeding but I didn't feel it at all.

124646.en: Don't bother attacking that thing it is just a waste of ammo, we tried firing everything we had at it and that did nothing.

124647.en: I wonder, are you familiar with the concept of hell? Even the most fervently spiritual Amarrians believe in heaven yet scorn the concept of hell as outdated - hell, my people believe, is a state of mind. I am coming to think that this may be true.

124648.en: I'll let them know we're coming and here to help them. Do keep moving and whatever you do avoid firing at them, they mean no harm as far as I know.

124650.en: There, look, they've stopped firing! You see that they can be reasoned with? You see that they're still human despite all that has been inflicted on them!

124651.en: The jump drive is still operational - they must have been draining The Paryi's power to recharge! No matter, my scanner will track them wherever they go. Let's return to the station - they'll surely give us the equipment we need to mount a full rescue now!

124755.en:
You're almost done, pilot. This is the last site. I'm glad to see you made it this far.

You're now inside the Gas site training area. Ahead of you, you should see another acceleration gate. To access the second room you will need to have the passkey that your agent placed inside your Item Hangar.

124756.en:
Excellent work. Now don't forget to recover the Proof of Discovery: Gas documents from the container. They will prove you made it out here.

If someone else has already made it to this site before you then there may not be a document immediately available. If you find the container empty, wait a few seconds and a new one will be produced.

124757.en:
Although the Sensor Overlay can find Cosmic Anomalies, it cannot get a good reading on Cosmic Signatures. Signatures are an entirely different class of hidden site. To be able to warp to them, you need to use scan probes. Scan Probes are deployed much like firing a missile; by fitting a Scan Probe Launcher, loading the Scan Probes, and then firing them into space.

Think of Scan Probes as little ships. They have built-in scanners just like yours, except these ones can reach out to 32 AU. You launch multiple probes at a time in a formation to maximize scan efficiency. They are even equipped with warp drives, so you can position them around a solar system without actually having to move yourself.

As you might imagine, using probes allows you to cover a much larger area of space in a faster time.

You will also find a couple of civilian modules in the supply crate - Civilian Data Analyzer and Civilian Relic Analyzer. You will need these modules in later missions when you learn about some of the things you can do in the sites you find. You should fit them to your ship at the same time you fit the probe launcher.

Take the probes and launcher, as well as the civilian analyzer modules, and head into the third pocket. This area will show you what a Data Cosmic Signature Site might look like.

124758.en: The probe establishes a remote communications channel with your ship, then transmits a single ‘beep' noise.

124759.en: Site Commander: This is it people, it's now or never!

124760.en: More reinforcements arrive and join the fray!

124762.en: It looks like the Caldari would rather die than have their plans go to the Gallente; return to your agent for further direction.

124770.en: Tahamar has ejected in a capsule from the Stasis Tower, moments before its destruction!

124805.en: A capsuleer all the way out here?   Let's get ‘em!

124806.en: What is this ancient probe doing all the way out here?

124807.en: Why is this shuttle floating around so close to the star?

124808.en: What is a Minmatar titan doing all the way out here in Caldari space?

124809.en: We think the Serpentis are sniffing around here. Our scouts have said that the outpost is clear, but we're not taking any chances with this convoy. Keep your eyes out for–

124810.en: We know what's in that convoy, capsuleer. We're not going to let the Federation Navy take over this colony by subversion. There's no need to smuggle marines into this peaceful outpost. No good can come of this operation, and we're here to stop it. Get out of our way, or we'll be forced to take you out.

124811.en: There is a faint signal emanating from the main mining colony. Be wary. I also detect signatures similar to those of Gallente-Caldari War era mines.

124812.en: We'll take it from here, pilot. This area is considered classified. In fact, it never existed. Thank you for your service, but please clear the area so we can finish this blanket operation.

124813.en: The refinery is about to go critical, everyone bail!

124814.en: How did you find me? Never mind. Nothing a little death couldn't fix.

124815.en: By my readings the next acceleration gate is missing a segment of its authentication mechanism. The part must be located on this side. Search the nearby wreckage.

124816.en: This gate leads to the acid cloud, which is VERY dangerous.

124817.en: This gate leads to the patrol area, where a large group of pirates will likely be waiting.

124818.en: You're supposed to be protecting the inhabitants, not attacking them.

124819.en: Warning: The virus has initiated contact with your onboard computer and is trying to bring your shields down. Without shields, your ship will be defenseless against the ambient debris of the asteroid field.

124820.en: Just drop those boys off at the observation deck. I'll make sure they're safe and sound while you deal with those pirate whelps. Good hunting!

124821.en: What do we have here, boys? Easy pickings!

124822.en: In the heat of battle, the manager left the station with the band and went through the acceleration gate. He's abducted the band!

124823.en: Right on time, just like he said. Well, this is what we're paid for, everyone. Weapons free!

124824.en: You made it? I can't believe it! Please don't kill me!

124825.en: Excellent! We're totally naming our next album after you! How does “Clone Three-Way” sound? Edgy enough?

124827.en: You hear faint voices whisper in your NeoCom, their soft pleas echoing throughout your pod.

124828.en: Hold them back, boys. The State's paying us too much for this operation, and we can't let them down.

124829.en: You incompetent mercenaries! Someone's discovered your operation. Well, we'll have to silence this intruder.

124830.en: Who's there? You're a Capsuleer? I have nothing to say to you. This is between me and these slaver sociopaths. Go be immortal somewhere else.

124831.en: Attention all non-Amarr pilots receiving this transmission. Due to reports of terrorist activities, all space flight is currently under emergency curfew. Dock immediately at the nearest station for inspection or you will be fired upon.

124832.en: We've prepared the prisoner for transfer. Proceed directly to Cell Block D.

124833.en: Caldari forces are attacking! All cell blocks have automatically locked down until the hostiles are eliminated.

124834.en: Operative, this is your agent speaking. I've just received word that we've established a diplomatic emergency communication with Amarr authorities in your area. Cease all combat and get back here immediately.

124835.en: Ah, you're here for the pick-up? Wait a minute – you're not with the Nation!

124836.en:
We're done with these live bodies for our experimentation. The project is nearly complete. You're free to use these specimens for your own devices. Don't bother explaining: We don't want to know what the Nation does with them.

There's an intruder! You've set us up, haven't you?

124837.en: Nation does not want us to waste our time with these slaves. Leave them to rot in freedom.

124838.en: Who the hell is that? Back off, pal; this is our find!

124839.en: Hostiles have been eliminated. Take the nearby gate to the first room and destroy the entry gate.

124840.en: Attention expeditionary force Beta. Hostile force detected at Alpha site. Please respond. Message repeats...

124841.en: In the heat of battle, the manager left the station with the band and went through the acceleration gate. He's abducted the band!

124842.en: These ships weren't destroyed here; they were brought here for a reason.

124843.en: While the drones circling the infested station seem to be on defensive alert, the ones circling each of the wrecks littering this area seem much more interested in working than fighting.

124844.en: This is the convoy escort squadron leader. Is there a problem?

124845.en: This is the convoy escort squadron leader. Is there a problem?

124846.en: This is the convoy escort squadron leader. Is there a problem?

124847.en: This is the convoy escort squadron leader. Is there a problem?

124848.en: They're onto us, attack!  Reinforcements inbound!

124849.en: They're onto us, attack!  Reinforcements inbound!

124850.en: They're onto us, attack!  Reinforcements inbound!

124851.en: They're onto us, attack!  Reinforcements inbound!

124855.en: Your mission is technically complete... but are there survivors within the wreckage of that carrier?

124856.en: Damn! There is someone investigating the site. Take him out, and make it look like an accident, too.

124857.en: Your screen is clear of hostiles. Return to me when you're ready.

124858.en: This navigational beacon isn't using standard New Eden codes; it's more like a binary message or some kind of computer network connection frequency.

124859.en: Warning lights and emergency signals begin pulsing throughout the base. It seems this entire place was setup to trick Sansha's Nation forces into opening invasion cyno fields here!

124860.en: The automated base defenses register that combat has ceased, uncloaking a nearby cache of valuables.

124861.en: The drug runner is spooked. Guristas ships inbound, likely his friends.

124862.en: Hey there, you must be the bounty hunter. Anire just boarded her ship. You should see her in the next area. To get inside you'll need to destroy their security guards and loot a passkey for the gate. We've just reported to them that you fired on our merchant convoy, so they'll be here shortly to respond. Good luck!

124863.en: I had hoped you were smarter than that. Let's waste some time and resources then. Here we go, boys!

124864.en: Hang on a second... Phenod has never been able to interface with anything without putting several dents in his own ship.  Who are you?  Get back here with that loot.

124865.en: You must save the preacher! The gate has been unlocked; go while we cover you, noble capsuleer!

124866.en:
Are we glad to see you! ORE is tearing this field apart. All this debris is their doing. They're chewing up rock and spitting it out. Impacts have battered our equipment and knocked out power.

But we can't cut out yet! We have a crew of scientists out there somewhere. We've lost contact. Find them before it's too late!

124867.en: <font color=#EE3B3B>Vast numbers of small asteroids in the field batter your ship.

124868.en: Thank you! Thank you for your help! But the only way we'll get out of here alive is if you clear the last of the drones out. Our lasers are down.

124869.en: We're clear! We're clear! Thank you! We'd all be dead without your help!

124870.en: Hailing unknown ship! SOS! Please! Our life support is failing and we need your help. Please! Save us!

124871.en: Please, get us to the mining outpost as fast as you can!

124872.en: You recovered our revered diplomat just in time. Please bring him to the Sisters of Eve ship in the first deadspace pocket.

124874.en: Be warned, the Scions of the Superior Gene are incoming. They're a militant splinter group that labled us heretics and will wipe out me, you, and every colonist here. If you help stop them, I'll come willingly.

124875.en: Greetings, pilot. Have you come to listen, or with violence in mind?

124877.en: Fool! Tolmak's gnats won't stop us!

124878.en: Greetings, my new friend. Thank you for aiding us. I will come peacefully.

124879.en: Praise be to God. The Empire is in your debt, Capsuleer.

124880.en: The Minmatar Republic is in your debt, Pilot.

124881.en: Our dead will be avenged, Capsuleer!

124882.en: You'll pay for saving the slavers while leaving Republic citizens to die!

124883.en: Careful, pilot. The site is increasingly unstable. The Minmatar and Amarr diplomats are at different ends of the site. You only have time to save one.

124884.en: The guard post is now exposed. Plant the Consolidated Holdings commander access key inside to unlock the next security gate.

124885.en: The guard post is now exposed. Plant the Consolidated Holdings commander access key inside to unlock the next security gate.

124886.en: The guard post is now exposed. Plant the Consolidated Holdings commander access key inside to unlock the next security gate.

124887.en: You cut it close, but our emissary lives! Please, return him to the Sisters of Eve ship in the first deadspace pocket.

124888.en: The madness that affects the crew of The Anomaly is too precise for it to merely be an accident. It's as if they jumped to a place humans were not meant to see.

124889.en:
I believe in Hell. I did not a month ago. I have heard it in the voices of those trapped aboard The Anomaly. I saw it in the eyes of my own research assistants. I watched it grow in everyone.

Save you.

124890.en: I know you've been told to deliver me to the rogue drone ship, but there's another option. Take me to the Anomaly one last time. I know it sounds dangerous, but I want to make one last attempt to save them.

124891.en: You've done the right thing. The ship has just enough energy left for one last jump. I swear by God that you will never hear us again.

124892.en: And here I am, playing my part, just as I always have. The ship will be gone shortly.

124893.en: So quiet. It seems I haven't been without their voices for so long. Perhaps it was for the best after all. Perhaps.

124894.en:
I prayed and God has rewarded my faith.  I thought I might die in this place, but I will live on to share my findings. 

It seems you've suffered no ill effects so far, but we need to leave at once.

124895.en: They called me to identify the body, and I told them she divorced me last year but they didn't care because she had no friends, no family on the planet at all. I went in and they pulled back the sheet and she was there beautiful like she was asleep, and my full name was carved delicately into her left arm like calligraphy, the blood dried like rust on parchment. Every time I closed my eyes for a full year after I saw that. I still miss her.

124896.en: I'm naked and I'm walking the blue-painted halls at military academy, and it's okay because everyone gets hazed like this and I'm in better shape than all of them so I'm not ashamed, except this means they can see the scars twining from my back and down to my knees like snakes, and what starts as laughter turns into confused whispering and sounds of pity as they realize how recently I was a slave, and I want to kill them slowly just like I did the man who gave me the scars, but I just walk on, seeing only red.

124897.en: "You have failed your family," he tells me with gentleness I know he's incapable of feeling. "You have dishonored us. You know what to do." And I know that the honorable thing is to fall on my sword like a good girl, so I take it out and push it through his chest and show him exactly what I think of his precious honor. I will never have to apologize again.

124898.en: Hello, hel... Capsuleer! Could you come and pick me up? I'm starting to run out of air in here.

124899.en: Just shoot down the debris and dead ships in the way - I think The Anomaly has been drawing things in from thousands of kilometers around. And be careful, they're going to explode when you hit them.

124900.en: We're still alive, though they've left a lot of us to die out in space. Please take us back to safety.

125044.en: Looks like they're still getting reinforcements. They even have a stolen Nidhoggur. Alright, I have all the information I need, good work. Get back to me before they realize you're there, and we can discuss what comes next.

125045.en:
Hey man, don't suppose you got any vitoc on you? I could really use a pick me up and I'm stuck on a regime right now. Can't take another hit for a while but I need just a little buzz right now. It sets me free to talk to the spirits, see. Shows me how beautiful everything is.

Thing is, it only works like that if you've got the death inside you; that little virus, curling around within and spreading poison as it courses through the blood. That's what makes the vitoc so right. You're just one shot... one tiny syringe away from death. But you take that dose and... man... All of life just floods into you. Everyone becomes beautiful and you love them, love them so much. Like a child with its mother. Everyone's a part of your family. Everyone's good to you. Makes you whole, man. You should try it sometime.

I was never a slave, you know. Republic, born and bred. So what if I got the virus and gave it to myself. Had to understand, you know, what they all go through. The first day, I let it run right down to the line... was shaking, being sick, couldn't breathe... didn't know where I was or what my name might be. Then I took the dose. Jabbed the needle right in and shot the vitoc into my arm. And the pain stopped.

At first I thought it was just relief. I wasn't dying anymore. And then I realised. All the pain was gone. All of it. All the grief and the loneliness and frustration... it just lifted right out of me, like exhaling. Most beautiful thing I've ever felt in my life.

If you can help me out with a score, I'd really appreciate it.

125046.en:
Saw you coming. I'm guessing Karsten sent you this way because you showed an interest. Good to see, pilot. There is a lot to learn.

They used to study Vitoxin here, before the Elders popped up, flashed a load of Insorum around and then vanished again, taking the cure with them. Huh? Oh, Insorum is the drug that cures vitoxin... well, any mutation-based disease, really. It was discovered by Dr. Ullia Hnolku, before the State murdered him.

Insorum reacts to mutagens in the body - viruses, radioactive particles, stuff like that. It binds onto them, stops them acting on human cells and holds them inert until they die or pass out of the body.

Insorum first became public knowledge back in YC 107, when Ullia Hnolku and his wife disappeared. They were working for the Caldari corporation Zainou Biotech at the time, developing a cure for the most wide-spread disease in the history of New Eden. They were going to sell their research. Yeah, selling medicine to the desperate and dying. Let that be a lesson to you about the Caldari.

Ullia Hnolku's wife was kidnapped by the Blood Raiders. They took her sample of Insorum and sprayed it over the Amarr planet of Mabnen II, making all the slaves there rise up and start killing their masters. So the Amarr butchered everyone on the planet to get back control. Dr Hnolku had been in hiding after she vanished, but after he heard they were torturing her, he came out and asked the Minmatar to help save her in return for the drug. He was killed by State loyalist capsuleers on his way to meet them. Let that be another lesson.

Seems to me all the wrong people are infected with Vitoxin. And all the wrong people had the cure until now. Anyhow, if you want to learn some more about all of this, head back over to the Research Archive next to the Forlorn Hope. Take as many copies of the papers as you like.

125047.en:
Greetings, pilot! Welcome to The Forlorn Hope! This was once a busy research center, and part of the Republic's most concerted, most dedicated research effort into finding a cure for vitoxin - the virus that kills slaves if they aren't given an antidote.

The scientists who once worked here were trying to study how the vitoxin virus mutates. It mutates regularly, you see, changing its form so often that the antidotes we come up with never last. The Amarr always seem to know in advance what form vitoxin will take next, so they can change their antidote drug - what we call "Vitoc". Vitoc only lasts for a day, and then you have to have another dose. This is how they control our brothers and sisters – they keep us coming back for more. So the scientists here, they built a machine to bounce anti-matter off the virus' DNA to try and find out how it used to be structured, before it mutated.

Someone sabotaged it though. The antimatter containment broke and the whole place literally began to violently disintegrate from the inside. No survivors. Don't ever forget it pilot; the Republic's sacrifices aren't only made on the front lines.

If you're interested in the details of the research, Agent Patrikia Noirild would be happy to provide you with some documents. She's over near the Tachyon Bombardment Array. Lastly, I would humbly request that you do not bother our brother Rohan. He is best left alone.

125157.en:
The next pocket is a busy place. I'm reading the engine wash signatures of Serpentis ships, but also private industrial and hauler firms. One trail has a 12 percent likelihood of belonging to a Federation Senator's luxury liner.

Luckily for the senator, we aren't the Scope.

125158.en: Big Boss presence confirmed. Remember, everyone here either is or works for a drug dealer, so we don't have to feel bad for popping them like technology-filled piñatas.

125159.en:
The Big Boss is down. The snakes are going to have a hard time keeping anyone busy without that bruiser of a ship.

Don't forget to check the wreckage for any goodies.

125160.en:
The Archduke is eliminated. In approximately 18 seconds, the Nation security key will attempt to cycle and the Nation signal will be rendered into junk data.

Now let's see if the Archduke dropped anything fun in its wreck.

125161.en: You have destroyed the Dark Blood Hunter. His wreck should prove quite profitable.

125162.en:
The Guristas CO has been destroyed. The local Gurista command structure should be in chaos while they scramble to emplace a new leader.

It appears that the Guristas aren't good at keeping leaders.

125163.en: Did You Know?: Rabbits are a common staple of Deteis cuisine.

125164.en: The last Angel Cartel Battleship sends out a distress signal before it goes down. Luckily your coms system has managed to decrypt the message and track it to it's final destination.

125165.en: The last Guristas Pirate Battleship sends out a distress signal before it goes down. Luckily your com systems have managed to decrypt the message and follow it to it's final destination.

125166.en: The last Serpentis Battleship sends out a distress signal before it goes down. Luckily your com systems have managed to decrypt the message and follow it to it's final destination.

125167.en:
Prison facility shutting down. Reclaiming the prison complex will cost the Blood Raiders billions in ISK.

Granted, failsafes in the attached prison cells executed all prisoners when the bastion fell, but what's a few thousand failed Amarr heretics when compared to the possibility of acquiring rare faction modules?

125168.en:
Bastion eliminated. All conversion research has been destroyed.

The souls trapped between free-willed human and True Slave have been released. I believe this qualifies as a bitter-sweet victory.

Let's get some loot.

125169.en:
Administration facility destroyed. With any luck, we will find advanced Serpentis tech in the wreckage.

Oh, and by the way, Serpentis booster production in this constellation will be slowed severely with these inmates still out of commission. So that's good. I guess.

125197.en: The Sansha raiders have been eliminated. Your assignment is complete.

125198.en: An additional group of enemy ships has arrived.

125199.en: How interesting. The crew is not attempting to communicate as before. Did you hear any of the awful things they said? The ramblings of people ceaselessly tormented by waking nightmares, of their own worst memories? Perhaps they gave up all hope of rescue once we left.

125200.en: The hostages must be in those holding cells. Get them to the rescue ship on the other side of that acceleration gate!

125201.en: Battlegroup Commander: Hold fast men, reinforcements are here!

125202.en: More reinforcements arrive and join the fray!

125203.en: Site Commander. This is it people, it's now or never!

125204.en: Observe - leaving the gate open means The Anomaly's gravitational effects are pulling in ships and debris from hundreds of kilometers around.  Tread carefully - the radiation will no doubt increase once we pass the gate.

125205.en: Confirmed, we have the hostages safely aboard.  We're warping out!

125206.en: Overseer:  Intruders!  They must be working for the Sansha, destroy them!

125207.en: Overseer:  Minions, we have intruders in our base, no doubt spies sent here by the filthy Angel Cartel.  Eliminate them immediately.

125208.en: Overseer:  Look!  The Guristas have sent in some mercenary goons to assassinate me!  They must be destroyed at all costs!

125210.en: Overseer:  Look!  The Blood Raiders have sent in some hired guns to attack our base.  Attack!

125212.en: Overseer:  Intruders!  They must be working for the Blood Raiders, get 'em!

125213.en: Overseer:  Kill the intruders!  They must be working for the Serpentis!

127450.en:
Agents working for Guristas recently managed to infiltrate one of our outposts in a nearby system.  We have reliable information that they did manage to find classified information about our various operations in the area.  Fortunately one of the officers at the outpost managed to slip a tracking device into one of their ships before they escaped.  We know they are located in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} at this very moment.  I would like you to fly over there and ambush them immediately.  Return to me once their ships have been turned to dust.  
But be careful, they are armed and dangerous.

127468.en: You took out their leader?  That should be enough, their members are nothing but freelance mercs in it for the gold.  Without the Seven's commanders their forces will wither up and die.

127469.en:
The Seven have showed their ugly faces again, in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. They've set up a prison facility where they keep captured personnel working for {[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.name} and random civilians for a ransom. The people that are put in there are rarely the same after they've been released. The Seven have somehow managed to get a hold on Sansha mind altering gadgets, which they use on those who they kidnap to erase their memory among other things. Rarely does this not have serious side effects ...

I want that place shut down, immediately. Do whatever it takes.

127470.en: Good work, {[character]player.name}.  With their commander out of the way, I don't expect any more incidents involving them for a while.

127484.en:
{[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name} recently sacked one of its employees after a routine inspection revealed a large amount of indecent pictures stored in his personal database.  Sadly, this ex-employee wasn't all too pleased with our 
decision, and has resorted to camping outside of our headquarters and harassing our customers.  Fortunately though, we dug up some old offenses this guy made and revealed them to the authorities, who promptly lowered his security rating quite a bit.  In effect, he's fair game.  Please warp over to the location on the bookmark I'm about to give you and squash this little pest.  I doubt he will survive for long, as some of our customers are 
heavily armed.  So hurry up and take him out if you want your reward.

127503.en: We have a bit of a problem on our hands with a recently fired employee of ours. He was working as a deep cover agent for us, and now he is threatening to release all the information to DED about what we have been doing. We cannot have this happen. If he does make it to the DED headquarters in Yulai, {[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name} will face serious repercussions. Eliminate this threat as soon as possible to ensure that he doesn't get the information to DED agents. I'll put into your way-points where he was last seen. Return here and let me know that he is dead.

127525.en: Well, you took too long to decide, {[character]player.name}, so I had to give the mission to another of my associates.  Sure you understand.  Come and see me again for another assignment if you ever need work.

127528.en:
We've been gathering information from our agents within the Cartel to prepare ourselves for a possible attack on our assets. So far, we've found out only that they are planning a major offensive against a target within {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}, possibly to occur today. While the target remains unknown to us, we've managed to discover the meeting point of some of their forces. I want you to gather whatever help you can muster, fly out to the meeting points, and deliver a devastating blow to their fleet. That should deter them from any attack inside {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} and send them a message they won't soon forget.

Just don't forget what you're up against. We have no idea how many ships are out there ― all we know is where five of their rendezvous points are. Destroy any and all targets you can find there, then report back to me. If there're too many of them out there, then get some help; I'm sure some of our other agents in the vicinity would be willing to give you a hand.

127539.en: As you probably know, the pirate profession is a risky business.  A pirate can only afford to make so many mistakes.  If you mess up too often, you're out, literally.  One such case happened recently, where an employee of {[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name} failed to accomplish a vital mission we had given him in time.  This was the 4th time he screwed up.  This particular failure cost us millions.  Unlike other businesses, we can't simply lay him off.  He knows too much.  I will give you a bookmark to his current location, jump over there and meet up with him and his ragtag band of renegades.  He knows what's coming for him, and will probably attack you on sight.  You know what to do.

127544.en:
A few years ago we kidnapped a few people on a remote planet that we raided. One of their relatives has been on our backs ever since. He keeps hiring bounty hunters to retrieve them and bring them back to their former home. Little does he know that most of them are already dead *chuckle*.

Anyway, get yourself ready for some action; The latest bounty hunter assigned on another one of those pathetic rescue attempts has been spotted in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. Take care of him.

127546.en:
We recently discovered a detective working for the Caldari State military snooping around {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. Usually we don't touch these guys, but it so happens that we have a bunch of contraband stashed nearby that we looted in Caldari State space. I want you to go out there and eliminate him before he finds the stash and reports his findings to the Caldari authorities; we certainly don't want them complicating our operations.

Be warned, though, those detectives are tough, and they usually have a scout or two backing them up. I wouldn't want you getting hurt, 'cause pilots like you aren't easy to come by!

127559.en:
A CONCORD scout drone was just spotted in this system by one of our men. As usual, these drones should always be eliminated before they cause any damage. I'm not sure why this lone drone has entered our territory. Might just be an accident, or maybe it's on some secret mission.

Either way, I'd like you to head out there and get rid of it before it manages to escape. Leave no trace of it behind. Don't be long!

127560.en:
Today is a sad day, {[character]player.name}. One of our freelancers, working on a simple reconnaissance job in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}, was brutally murdered by Guristas thugs while on duty. He was well liked in {[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name}, and we will miss his loyal service to us greatly.

Now, you might be thinking, "How does this affect me?" Well I'll tell you. We aren't letting this outrage go unpunished. I want the people behind this brutal murder taken care of immediately. I will supply you with a bookmark to their hideout, which is heavily guarded by Guristas fighters. Head out there and avenge your colleague by destroying their habitation module; it's the primary residence of their leaders. Leave no pirate survivors behind.

Oh, and one other thing: They have an asteroid colony out there which is used to house their workers, miners, and such. I suggest you leave them in one piece, for we have no quarrel with them. We'll send a personnel transport to pick them up shortly after you return, as long as you have eliminated all of the pirates.

127568.en:
Recent reports from the Federal Intelligence Office give us reason to believe that the UDI terrorist organization has begun setting up outposts in the names of front corporations at deadspace forward points within our sovereign space, with the intention of spying on Gallente corporations. I've just gotten word that there's one such suspected outpost in this system. The problem is that we cannot be fully sure whether the outpost in question is indeed a UDI hive. Obviously this means we can't go in flying our own banner, so non-contracted free agents such as yourself will be of paramount importance in the staging of preliminary operations. True, it is a harsh risk to take, attacking installations that haven't been absolutely proven to be hostile, but the UDI simply present too much of a threat for us to have the luxury of dilly-dallying.

Should you choose to accept this mission, I will upload this outpost's coordinates to your Neocom. Your primary target will be a subspace data miner thought to have been picking up on our communications frequencies. Once it is destroyed, report back to us and we will send in another team for the next stage of the operation.

You will probably encounter some mercenary resistance in the area. Orders are to kill on sight, and refrain from any and all communication that may uncover your involvement with us. Should you be captured, we will disavow any knowledge of your actions.

127571.en: Sounds a bit too, uh, underhanded for me. Think I'll pass.

127572.en: This is crap. Find someone else to do your clandestine dirty work. My hands are clean. Do you hear me?! CLEAN!

127573.en: Damn! Well, can't say I blame you, I guess, although I had hoped for more. I'll just have to find someone else.

127574.en:
Take it easy, there, pilot. I'll find someone else then.

Uhm, buh-bye.

...

Why are you still here? You can go now.

127575.en:
Your primary target will be a subspace UDI data miner thought to have been picking up on our communications frequencies. Once it is destroyed, report back to us and we will send in another team for the next stage of the operation.

You will probably encounter some mercenary resistance in the area. Orders are to kill on sight, and to refrain from any and all communication that may uncover your involvement with us. Should you be captured, we will disavow any knowledge of your actions.

127576.en:
Today is a sad day, {[character]player.name}. One of our freelancers, working on a simple reconnaissance job in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}, was brutally murdered by Serpentis thugs while on duty. He was well liked in {[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name}, and we will miss his loyal service to us greatly.

Now, you might be thinking, "How does this affect me?" Well I'll tell you. We aren't letting this outrage go unpunished. I want the people behind this brutal murder taken care of immediately. I will supply you with a bookmark to their hideout, which is heavily guarded by Serpentis fighters. Head out there and avenge your colleague by destroying their habitation module; it's the primary residence of their leaders. Leave no pirate survivors behind.

Oh, and one other thing: They have an asteroid colony out there which is used to house their workers, miners, and such. I suggest you leave them in one piece, for we have no quarrel with them. We'll send a personnel transport to pick them up shortly after you return, as long as you have eliminated all of the pirates.

127578.en:
A despicable crime was committed against us in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} yesterday, {[character]player.name}. One of our fighters was brutally murdered by DED pigs nosing around our operations. We will not let them waltz carelessly around our territory and get away with such offenses. They're on our turf now, and they'd better be ready for a fight.

Your job is pretty straightforward, {[character]player.name}. Find the DED drones who murdered your colleague, and put an end to their miserable existence.

127579.en:
A despicable crime was committed against us in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} yesterday, {[character]player.name}. They're on our turf now, and they'd better be ready for a fight.

Your job is pretty straightforward, {[character]player.name}. Find the DED drones who murdered your colleague, and put an end to their miserable existence. Just watch out for the CONCORD drones guarding the area.

127581.en:
Recent reports from the Federal Intelligence Office give us reason to believe that the UDI terrorist organization has begun setting up outposts in the names of front corporations at deadspace forward points within our sovereign space, with the intention of spying on Gallente corporations. We recently managed to confirm the existence of one such outpost in this system.

Operatives have already been sent in to cripple key outpost structures, and the UDI's response has been to call in a great deal of mercenary reinforcements, with our intel telling us more are on the way. We believe they may be planning a large-scale strike against this station sometime within the next 24 hours, so we need someone to go in there and put a dent in their current forces. This should delay their attack long enough for us to call in reinforcements of our own to take out the installation.

Should you accept, your mission would be to go in and take out every one of the mercenary ships you currently see at the installation. I would advise you to set up the most powerful combat fitting you possibly can, as according to our previous experience these people are not to be trifled with unless you know what you're doing. So what do you say?

127582.en: Can't say I blame you, though admittedly I had hoped for more from you.

127583.en: Glad to hear it.  Do us proud, soldier.

127584.en: I knew you'd come through.  Take this reward, and our gratitude.

127585.en: Can't say I blame you, though admittedly I had hoped for more from you.

127586.en: Very well. Thank you for letting us know in time.

127587.en: Sounds like a job for me.

127588.en: I've wiped out every last one of those terrorist slimeballs.

127589.en: UDI, you say?  I, uh, I have some pressing business to attend to elsewhere.

127590.en: On second thought, I don't really think I'm up for this. Sorry.

127591.en: I have dire news, {[character]player.name}.  One of our deadspace asteroid belts in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} has been infested by rogue drones!  We lost contact with the miners working there a few days ago, after they had reported sightings of mysterious craft nearby.  Our reconnaissance team then confirmed our suspicions, the entire belt has been infested with those pests.  Not only that but they have already erected a Drone Silo there, which the drones often use as the first building block for an actual Drone Hive.  We need to act fast before they manage to grow in numbers, {[character]player.name}.  Your job is to see to it that their silo is completely destroyed.  I'll send in ships later to clean up the mess.  However I warn you, the drones roaming the belt will no doubt all come to aid their silo once it is attacked, so it would be advisable to try and split them up and clear out the guards before you attempt to finish your objectives.

127593.en:
We just received an incoming transmission from one of our personnel convoys traveling through {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. They reported that they were under attack by unidentified craft which refused to reply to their attempts at communication. Soon afterwards the transmission was cut off, and we haven't heard from them since.

Normally I would send a reconnaissance mission to the last known location of the convoy and scout the area before attempting any further action, but this situation is different. The convoy that was destroyed was carrying a very valuable artifact which must be retrieved at all cost. It is sealed in a booby-trapped special delivery package. I require you to head out there and look for it, if fortune shines on us today then the attacker and our artifact will still be close by. Do this for me and you shall be rewarded, {[character]player.name}.

127594.en:
I have grave tidings this time, {[character]player.name}. One of the ancient station ruins out in the fringes of {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} has been reportedly infested with rogue drones. They have made it their hive, and are busily producing more and more rogue drones. From there they have been launching attacks on our convoys and outposts nearby, some of which have been totally overrun. I request that you fly to the station ruins and eliminate their hive.

Rogue drones are a constant menace to our assets. They have no allegiance to any nation that we know of and their only purpose seems to be expansion and destruction of anything in their path. Once they have started infesting a system, it is very hard to exterminate the infestation for good. But it is possible to reduce the threat they pose by destroying their hives, fortunately.

127595.en:
We've just been informed of an official complaint from the mining division working in one of the asteroid fields in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}, about their haulers being attacked on sight by roaming rogue drones in the area. At first it started with just a few unsuccessful attacks, but the situation has worsened greatly and the hauler pilots, along with the miners themselves, are on the verge of a strike. This is the perfect opportunity for someone like you to take care of business and earn your reward, {[character]player.name}. I'll supply you with a bookmark to the location of the asteroid belt, eliminate the rogue drone threat there and then report back to me.

Please note that this mission requires you to use acceleration gates. Please use them to get farther into the deadspace pocket to eliminate all of the drones.

127597.en: {[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.name} roamers in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} have been hit by a rogue drone attack, again.  This time it happened while they were inspecting one of the asteroid belts near here, for any sign of mining activity.  This of course calls for some serious drone busting, {[character]player.name}.  These drones are a menace to all of us, and such a threat must be neutralized.  Head out to the location where the last attack occurred and eliminate any Rogue Drones you can find there, then report back to me.

127603.en: We have reason to believe that the owner of a certain warehouse located in a remote area of space in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} is secretly collaborating with the Cartel.  We haven't been able to pin anything on him yet, but I have my orders to launch a full scale investigation.  I want you to personally see to it that his property is thoroughly searched from top to bottom.  Retrieve any suspicious looking goods that you find there and bring them back here.  If you see any Angel activity in the area, then I expect you to neutralize it immediately, let none escape.

127613.en:
We have reason to believe that equipment which was stolen from our storage silo near {[location]agentStationID.name} is going to be laundered through an unlicensed Merchants Hub in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. It is a privately owned trading outpost which is renowned for attracting criminal elements, and I wouldn't be the least bit surprised that such activity is going on there.

We believe the goods are being transported to the outpost as we speak, in an industrial, a Bestower to be exact. I want you to fly out there immediately and find the equipment and bring it back to us. It may still be located in the same sealed containers as when it was stolen.

You have full authority to shoot anything that threatens you near the outpost, {[character]player.name}. They might send some of their mercenary ships to intercept you, once they know what you're after. After all, if we can prove the tycoon who owns that place had anything to do with the theft, we'll have the perfect excuse to bring that scrapheap down for good.

127614.en: A small group of rogue drones have been reportedly roaming around {[location]agentConstellationID.name}, attacking civilian convoys and trade ships that happen to cross their path.  They were last spotted in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}.  Rogue drones are a threat to anything that is not controlled by their Hive, and therefore must be destroyed.  Once you have eliminated them, return to me for your reward.

127615.en: A couple of bold rascals working for the Angel Cartel just ambushed a heavily armed convoy of ours. They managed to escape the {[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.name} officers who arrived at the scene, and they're now lurking in an asteroid belt in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. I want you to go out there and destroy them, and then bring back the goods they looted from the convoy. I'll upload the approximate coordinates to your NeoCom if you accept this job.

127616.en: A couple of bold rascals working for the Angel Cartel just ambushed a heavily armed convoy of ours, completely wiping out the entire escort. They managed to fight off the {[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.name} officers who arrived at the scene, and they're now lurking in a deadspace pocket in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. I want you to go out there and destroy them, and then bring back the goods they looted from the convoy. I'll upload the approximate coordinates to your NeoCom if you accept this job.

127617.en: A couple of bold pirates working for the Serpentis just ambushed a heavily armed convoy of ours. They managed to escape the {[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.name} officers who arrived at the scene, but we did manage to trace their flight path to a deadspace pocket in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. I'll upload the coordinates of the deadspace pocket into your NeoCom. Your job is to enter it and take out the pirates. Hopefully they will still have the goods they looted from the convoy; return the stuff to me.

127618.en: A couple of Serpentis dogs just ambushed a heavily armed convoy of ours, completely wiping out the entire escort. They managed to fight off the {[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.name} officers who arrived at the scene, but we managed to trace them to a deadspace pocket in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. I want you to go out there and destroy them, and then bring back the goods they looted from the convoy. I'll upload the approximate coordinates to your NeoCom if you accept this job. I'm counting on you, {[character]player.name}.

127619.en: A couple of bold pirates working for the Blood Raiders just ambushed a heavily armed convoy of ours, overwhelming the escort ships in no time. The survivors were captured, and God knows what those crazy cultists did to them. The Raiders managed to fight off the {[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.name} officers who arrived at the scene, and are now lurking in an asteroid belt in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. I want you to go out there, destroy them, and bring back the goods they looted from the convoy; I'll upload the approximate coordinates to your NeoCom if you accept this job.

127620.en: A couple of extremely dangerous Blood Raider battleships just ambushed a heavily armed convoy of ours, wiping out the entire escort in moments. The survivors were captured, and God knows what they did to them. The Raiders managed to fight off the {[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.name} officers who arrived at the scene, but we managed to trace them to {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. I want you to go out there and destroy them, and then bring back the goods they looted from the convoy. I'll upload the approximate coordinates to your NeoCom if you accept this job.

127621.en:
Recent intelligence reports give us reason to believe that the UDI terrorist organization has begun setting up outposts in the names of front corporations at deadspace forward points within our sovereign space, with the intention of spying on Gallente corporations. We recently managed to confirm the existence of one such outpost in this system.

Operatives have already been sent in on two separate occasions and a good deal of the outpost's frontal defenses have been crippled or weakened. Our intelligence sources have reported, however, that the terrorists have another base hidden away in another location in system. It now appears that the first outpost was no more than a red herring which they intended us to expend resources finding and destroying, leaving us vulnerable to a full attack later on. Now, they don't know that we're aware of the real installation, and we believe they're calling in reinforcements to mount a large-scale offensive against this station within the next 24 hours. Currently they have only a few brass stationed there, guarding the premises. We need to nip this in the bud.

Should you accept, your mission will be to go in and neutralize every hostile you can find at the installation, then take out their armory. This should buy us the time we need to send in a demolitions force from HQ to destroy the outpost and fend off their coming reinforcements. Should you accept, I would advise you to pack as much firepower as you possibly can, as according to our previous experience these people are not to be trifled with unless you know what you're doing. So what do you say?

127622.en: Fine, I'll find someone else. Be gone from my sight, peon.

127623.en: I knew I could count on you.  Show those terrorists the price of messing with us.

127625.en: Very well, then.  It will be a tough task finding someone as talented as you to take this on, but oh well - that's my job, I suppose.

127626.en: Bring it on.  Oh yes, bring it on.

127627.en: Those guys were nothing. What's for dessert?

127628.en: UDI you say?  I, uh, I ... look behind you! A three-headed fedo!

127629.en: This is too much for me.  I'm sorry, but you'll just have to find someone of stronger moral fibre.

127630.en: I'd like something to kill, please.

127631.en: A couple of bold Guristas pirates just ambushed a convoy of ours, overwhelming the escort ships in no time. They managed to fight off the {[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.name} officers who arrived at the scene, and are now lurking in a deadspace pocket in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. I want you to go out there and destroy them; bring back the goods they looted from the convoy. I'll upload the approximate coordinates to your NeoCom if you accept this job. For the sake of those who died in the ambush, show them no mercy {[character]player.name}.

127632.en: A couple of bold and extremely dangerous Guristas just ambushed a heavily armed convoy of ours, wiping out the escort ships in no time. As usual, they left few survivors ― nothing but charred wreckage was left behind. The pirates managed to fight off the {[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.name} officers who arrived at the scene, but we managed to trace them to an asteroid belt in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. I want you to go out there and destroy them, and then bring back the goods they looted from the convoy. I'll upload the approximate coordinates to your NeoCom if you accept this job. For the sake of those who died in the ambush, show them no mercy {[character]player.name}.

127633.en: A couple of Sansha freaks just ambushed a heavily armed convoy of ours, overwhelming the escort ships in no time. As usual, they left few survivors and lots of charred wreckage behind. They managed to fight off the {[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.name} officers who responded to the distress signals and are now lurking in an asteroid belt in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. I want you to go out there and destroy them; then bring back the goods they looted from the convoy. I'll upload the approximate coordinates to your NeoCom if you accept this job. For the sake of those who died in the ambush, show these scum no mercy, {[character]player.name}.

127634.en: A couple of pilots of the Sansha's Nation just ambushed a heavily armed convoy of ours, wiping out the escort ships in no time. As usual, there were no survivors ― nothing but charred wreckage was left behind. The pirates managed to fight off the {[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.name} officers who arrived at the scene, but we managed to trace them to an asteroid belt in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. I want you to go out there and destroy them, and then bring back the goods they looted from the convoy. I'll upload the approximate coordinates to your NeoCom if you accept this job. For the sake of those who died in the ambush, show them no mercy {[character]player.name}.

127636.en:
As you well know, {[character]player.name}, we have an unfortunate amount of illegal Angel Cartel activity in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. Well I believe we have found a target that will cripple their operations here for quite some time.

After countless hours of investigation, our agents have finally discovered their primary armory facility. This is a storage facility for their ship modules and weaponry for ground troops, and would explain how quickly their lost equipment is replaced in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}.

We believe that if we strike hard and fast, and take out this armory before they know what hit 'em, then we stand a good chance of seriously damaging their supply of spare weaponry, which will greatly impede their operations in this sector. Of course you are the pilot that I feel is most suited for this job, {[character]player.name}. Just remember, we get one shot at this. If you fail, they will undoubtedly relocate their armory and be far more prepared for us next time. So don't screw this one up!

127637.en:
We've been wondering for some time now why the Guristas strikes on our convoys have been so well timed and coordinated, considering our people usually take the utmost caution when it comes to security and secrecy. But I think we've found the answer.

Some time ago our surveillance team stumbled across a hidden Guristas base located in a deadspace pocket not far from here. We didn't think much of it at first ... until we actually sent in one of our undercover agents to investigate. He did not return with his life, but we did manage to salvage his report from the wreckage of his ship. And from what he discovered, the area is being used to cover up a gigantic telescope, which the Guristas are apparently using to spy on our assets here in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. This telescope is so powerful that it's illegal to use in {[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.name} space without a permit, and those are hard to come by. The interference from the deadspace pocket hides it from our scanners, but it is still able to scan everything outside. An ingenious method of espionage, don't you think?

Your task is simple. Since we've located the base already, all we require you to do is warp over there and destroy it. But although it may sound simple, you should expect heavy resistance. They wouldn't leave such vital equipment lightly guarded. Good luck, {[character]player.name}.

127638.en:
I just received news of a grave incident that occurred in {[location]dungeonSolarSystemID.name} a few hours ago. A convoy carrying our esteemed CEO was ambushed by an unusually large and organized pirate strike force. But fortune shone on us tonight, for due to the extraordinary bravery of our CEO's valiant escort team, he managed to escape unharmed, although slightly traumatised as you might expect. We lost many good men in this unfortunate incident, including the commander of our escort team ... may he rest in peace.

Now, I'll get right to the point. We believe the pirates managed to capture some of the crew of the cruiser that was escorting our CEO, for we found the wreckage of their ship close by the encounter location, but there was no trace of the bodies of most of the crew. {[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.name} special forces have been called in and are scouring the area for any sign left behind by the pirates, who so far remain at large. We'd like you to help out in the investigation. We know of a popular pirate hideout in {[location]dungeonSolarSystemID.name}. I´ll upload the coordinates to your NeoCom: Please search the area for any clues, and if you take any prisoners, bring them back for interrogation.

127639.en:
I just received news of a grave incident that occurred in {[location]dungeonSolarSystemID.name} a few hours ago. A convoy carrying our esteemed CEO was ambushed by an unusually large and organized pirate strike force. But fortune shone on us tonight, for due to the extraordinary bravery of our CEO's valiant escort team, he managed to escape unharmed, although slightly traumatised as you might expect. We lost many good men in this unfortunate incident, including the commander of our escort team ... may he rest in peace.

Now, I'll get right to the point. We believe the pirates managed to capture some of the crew of the cruiser that was escorting our CEO, for we found the wreckage of their ship close by the encounter location, but there was no trace of the bodies of most of the crew. {[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.name} special forces have been called in and are scouring the area for any sign left behind by the pirates, who so far remain at large. We'd like you to help out in the investigation. We know of a popular pirate hideout in {[location]dungeonSolarSystemID.name}. I´ll upload the coordinates to your NeoCom: Please search the area for any clues, and if you take any prisoners, bring them back for interrogation.

127640.en: So what's this important stuff you keep yammering about?

127641.en: I will do my best, you can count on that.

127642.en: Good!  I'm sure we can count on you.

127643.en:
Well done, {[character]player.name}. I see that, since you managed to bring back the missing crew members, my theory was correct. After we've given them proper trauma counseling, we'll ask them about any leads they may have stumbled upon during their time in captivity.

And don't you leave just yet. I have another assignment waiting for you!

127644.en: Well, it is better to know up front that you are not up to the challenge.  Perhaps the next recruit will have the intestinal fortitude that we require.

127645.en: Did you really think a sissy like me could handle something like this?  Please.

127646.en: I am very disappointed.  And you came so highly recommended, too.

127647.en: Good, I knew I could count on you.  But just one other thing, I have a feeling that these mercs will fight for their leader, to the death.  Be prepared for a grueling fight.  If you fail, we might not get another chance at this, so do your very best.  That is all I expect of you, friend of {[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.nameWithArticle}.

127648.en:
I've heard good things about you, {[character]player.name}. They say you are a loyal servant of {[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.nameWithArticle}, and that you have served us well in the past. I hope that my information is correct, for our sake ... and for yours.

The reason I sent for you is simple, we have visitors, and we need someone to give them a 'warm' welcome. These particular visitors are up to something, but we don't know what yet. And that's where you come in.

Bring us their leader. We need him for interrogation ... and to discover the meaning behind their activities here. Your job is a simple one, and I expect the one we seek here in no less than a day.

They are hauled up in an asteroid belt not far from here, incidently in a deadspace pocket which is blocking our long-range scanners. I will supply you to a bookmark to the acceleration gate leading into it.

127649.en: Good work, {[character]player.name}, you have served us well as always.  We will begin the interrogation of our prisoner immediately.  I also presume you left the structure they were building intact, we'd like to investigate it.  Whatever they were building out there, it would almost certainly become a threat to our assets in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}.  And don't you leave just yet, I have another assignment waiting for you!

127650.en:
While we are interrogating the prisoner you captured, I'd like you to clear up the remnants of the merc forces you defeated in your last mission. I want you to enter the deadspace pocket from a different angle this time, using the other acceleration gate leading into it should put you right next to their base. It's a jumble of structures inside small asteroids connected to each other, which we call an asteroid colony. Destroy it and report back to me.

I'm sure the mercenaries still have a few ships left at their disposal, so be prepared for a fight. Their remaining forces, crippled from your last strike at them, should not cause you any serious problems.

127651.en:
While we are interrogating the prisoner you captured, I'd like you to clear up the remnants of the merc forces you defeated in your last mission. I want you to enter the deadspace pocket from a different angle this time, using the other acceleration gate leading into it should put you right next to their base. 127652.en:
We've finally finished with the interrogation of the prisoner you captured in a previous mission, and our suspicions were confirmed. It took some ... convincing, to extract the information we needed from the poor, misguided soul. Which is quite ordinary, considering him being an undercover operative of the Amarr Empire. And a high ranking one at that.

Now you might ask, how could we possibly know that he is high ranking? After all, the Empire is very thorough when it comes to purging all records of the people who join their intelligence agency, to keep it from falling into the 'wrong' hands. Agents such as these tend to 'vanish', as if they had never existed. Quite difficult to track down, I tell you.

But when a large group of Amarrian cruisers appears at our doorstep, demanding the release of a certain individual ... well it's not hard to put 2 and 2 together.

This small fleet of imperial ships was spotted entering the same deadspace pocket which we sent you into on your two previous missions. They are here to investigate the disappearance of their agent, and are most likely ready for a fight. And I expect you to make sure they leave our space, feet first.

We also have reason to believe that they have control over a small outpost inside the asteroid belt. On your last two trips there we gave you bookmarks to two acceleration gates into the vast deadspace area our enemy has been hiding in. Well there is a 3rd gate which we just recently discovered, and we suspect the imperial raid force is located in there, planning their next move. Our sources tell us that their leader brought with him documents detailing their orders from the Empress. We would very much like to get our hands on these documents. Destroy their ships if you can, but your primary objective is to retrieve the reports from their leader. They might be located with him on his ship, or inside their base. Find them and bring them to me, this will be your final assignment for a while.

127653.en: I have the reports you asked for, and I have taken care of the imperial scum.  Now I expect my reward.

127654.en: Excellent, {[character]player.name}.  Your success will not go unnoticed within {[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.nameWithArticle}.

127656.en:
I have some grave news, {[character]player.name}. A squadron of imperial ships just managed to lay waste to one of our supply depots in {[location]agentConstellationID.name}. This was a hit and run attack, aimed at our drug smuggling business into the Amarr territories. I can understand their attacks inside their own sovereign space, but this cowardly act must not go unpunished.

The squadron is still located in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. We managed to block off all exits leading out of the system, and our ships are just waiting for the order to attack. I want you to personally deal with them, {[character]player.name}, and save us from possible casualties. Do this and you shall be well rewarded.
