127664.en:
I need you for a simple courier mission, {[character]player.name}, as well as another job afterwards. It's fairly straight forward, nothing you wouldn't be able to handle.

Recently we acquired a heap load of sensitive Gallente Federation logs, which we want transferred to this station a.s.a.p.. We've made a deal with their government to return this data over to them, without breaking the seal covering the container which they came in, in exchange for a few million ISK. Now all we need is you to bring the stuff here, and then meet their agents at a rendezvous point for the payment.

127666.en: Now that we have the transaction logs here at {[location]agentStationID.name}, it's time to finish the deal.  We arranged for a meeting with some of their forces in a remote deadspace pocket in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}.  Meet them there and retrieve the payment they promised us, then report back to me.  If they try anything funny, then you have my permission to defend yourself.

127668.en:
The Gallente attacked you on sight? Interesting ... I expected as much, they have not been known to deal with us when their back is against the wall, so to speak. Well we have other uses for these logs anyway, blackmailing their citizens will fetch us a much better price.

You've done your job, take your reward and enjoy yourself.

127669.en:
I call upon you, {[character]player.name}, for an important task that I need accomplished. We have had numerous cases recently of rogue Minmatar miners exploiting our natural resources in the area. Our gangs have made sure most of them left our space feet first, but there is this one group of them that has caused us great pains. They have apparently brought with them a small group of highly skilled Minmatar Fleet pilots, who apparently will defend them with their lives. We can't afford to lose any more of our ships, so I ask you to do us a favor and eliminate the escort ships guarding the miners.

Once you have eliminated the Fleet vessels, my boys will come in and clean up the rest of the mess. Your objective is not to destroy the miners, but I won't hold it against you if you do.

127671.en:
I have some bad news, {[character]player.name}. The Republic wasn't all too pleased with our attack on the last batch of miners they sent here, which you took part in. Apparently they sent in some reinforcements to the area, to stage a counter-offensive. They must have been deployed nearby already, as it took them a very short time to get here.

I require you to take care of them. We can't afford to lose more ships in these never-ending skirmishes with their forces. Our lines are already thinning from constant battles with freelancers intent on exploiting our valuable resources.

Once you have eliminated the threat they pose, return to me for your reward.

127673.en: Excellent work, {[character]player.name}.  You've done us a great service by taking care of this business.  This won't be forgotten.

127674.en:
I have a very important and risky assignment for you, {[character]player.name}. Considering your reputation, I'm sure you can handle it.

A few weeks ago, we discovered that the Caldari State was up to something big inside {[location]agentConstellationID.name}, but we didn't know what. Even the officers we have on our payroll among their navy didn't know what was going on. Then, just recently, one of our patrols stumbled upon an encoded signal coming from an area inside {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. We traced the signal and sent a squadron of our best men to investigate, but we soon lost Comlink contact with them; they never came back.

We're almost positive that the State is building a massive military base where that signal came from, probably from where they intend on launching a major offensive against our positions here in {[location]agentConstellationID.name}. Now, I'd say we have the travel routes through the systems in {[location]agentConstellationID.name} covered pretty well, so this expedition of theirs must be costing them a fortune. If we strike hard and fast before they manage to complete the project, we might be able to convince them that such a foolhardy operation is not in their best interests.

But I'd like to reassure you of one thing, {[character]player.name}. I have no intention of sending you headfirst into the center of their operations ― that would be suicide even for someone with your skills. However, what I'd like you to do is take care of a heavily fortified outpost located on the outskirts of the territory in which their forces are located. They have a number of these outposts guarding their territory, and by removing some of them we hope to open up their defenses enough for us to launch a full-scale attack at their headquarters. Because it's located in the middle of a large deadspace pocket, we haven't been able to do so thus far.

Now, all you have to do is destroy the control tower at the center of the outpost. By doing that, you effectively render the outpost useless, at least till they manage to erect a new tower. By that time, though, our forces will have moved in for the final attack.

Luck be with you, {[character]player.name}.

127676.en: Excellent work! Our forces are gathering even as we speak in preparation for the final attack. And it's all thanks to your quick work on that control tower.

127677.en: Just make sure you remember to use all of the acceleration gates leading into the deadspace pocket to reach your target. There will probably be a couple defensive perimeters blocking your way to the control tower, so you will have to get by the Navy ships guarding those areas before you proceed to your target.

127678.en: After checking our logs, we noticed that only some of the prisoners you brought back were part of the crew that was captured after the pirate raid on our convoy. The rest apparently are former members of one of the pirate ships you destroyed, who managed to escape from the blast that destroyed their vessel. I need them transferred to some colleagues of mine at another station for further interrogation; hopefully the specialists there will be able to extract the information we need to track down who was behind the ambush on our CEO.

127679.en: I'll do it in no time. Now please update me on how the investigation is going.

127680.en: Unfortunately we only have a few vague leads at the moment, nothing I can disclose to you at this time.  Get back to me after you have finished your current mission and perhaps I'll have some information for you then.

127681.en: I won't argue with such logic.  I will find someone else, then.

127682.en: I cannot accept.  This matter is too important to be entrusted to one such as I.

127683.en: Great work once again, {[character]player.name}. But I need you back here urgently for another assignment; something terrible just happened. I'll get you posted once you are ready.

127684.en:
We urgently need help intercepting a group of kidnappers who just managed to snatch the niece of our CEO while she was visiting her uncle in this very system. We believe the perpetrators were a gang of mercenaries led by a felon working for an illegal organization called the Darkonnen. I'll fill you in on the details of that organization in the mission details in your Opportunities interface.

What I need you to do is capture this agent of theirs, alive if possible. We must have him here for interrogation, for we suspect he is the missing link between the kidnapping and those who are truly responsible for this heinous crime. We need to get to the bottom of which organization stands behind these grave assaults against our people. And it so happens that we know the whereabouts of a certain pirate who has had many dealings with a Darkonnen agent in the past; we hope this pirate will be able to lead you to the agent. The only catch is that he will most likely require a bit of "convincing" on your part before he parts with the needed information. I'll upload the bookmark to his location into your NeoCom; once you have extracted the information from the middleman, I expect you to find the Darkonnen agent and bring him back to me.

127687.en: Well, I did not say every job would be sunshine and pleasurehalls. Perhaps you are more suited for the garbage-hauling missions?

127688.en: No, this does not interest me.

127689.en:
Well done. We will proceed immediately to interrogating the prisoner, so expect some results soon. Our interrogators can be quite ... convincing.

And don't go anywhere: I have another assignment for you.

127691.en:
So good to see you, {[character]player.name}. I've been on a pretty tight schedule for the past two weeks, ever since we discovered the strange, and increasing, Sansha activity in the system. Our CEO demands an explanation, yet we still don't know enough about the situation to determine what's really going on. And that's where you come in.

Sanshas activity on this scale in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} is unheard of, and quite frankly we aren't well enough prepared at the moment to deal with any major conflict with the Nation. Not only that, but those damned zombies give us the creeps, and news of their appearance around here has sent parts of the populace into a state of panic. People are leaving this station already, making my superiors ... less than content if you know what I mean. We're losing good people because of this unacceptable situation and we need to put an end to it.

The first thing I want you to do is undertake a reconnaisance mission for us into an area where we have witnessed most of the Sanshas activity. We've already lost a few patrols that ventured into this area, so be careful. If you do find any Sanshas ships out there, eliminate them. We don't want any prisoners, interrogating the creatures won't do us any good. Report your findings to me a.s.a.p.

127693.en: Watch your back out there, {[character]player.name}.  And whatever you do, don't let them take you prisoner, I've heard some mighty frightening stories about what happens to people that are taken alive by those monsters...

127694.en: You showed some class out there, {[character]player.name}.  Take your pay and report for your next assignment.

127695.en: Because of your successful reconnaissance mission, we've managed to narrow down the location of the main Sanshas activity a bit.  The data that we extracted from your system scanner also revealed to us a few Sanshas ships that were not mentioned in your preliminary report.  It appears to be some sort of convoy, at least one of their ships was clearly an industrial.  Because of this we guess that it may be a routine shipment, meaning that they might get a convoy at regular intervals.  We'd like you to fly out there, preferably with a cloaking device, and lay in wait for any possible sign of another Sansha convoy.  If you do see one, destroy it and bring back the contents of the industrials to me for inspection.

127697.en: Construction blocks?  I was afraid of that.  This doesn't seem to be a mere smuggling operation, but something much more sinister.  But we still don't know what they are building ... And don't you leave just yet, I have another assignment waiting for you!

127698.en:
After reviewing the intel we received from the spy drones which you transferred for us in your last mission, we managed to pinpoint the location of a military outpost they are building in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. It appears to be a part of a defensive perimeter that they are setting up around their territory, which has elevated our fears that they have actually managed to erect a large colony inside our solarsystem.

But for now let's keep our sights on the current task, to breach a hole in their defensive wall. We believe that the outpost in question hasn't been fully built, and therefore will be a fairly easy target for you if it's defensive installations aren't complete. Contact with the spy drones was cut off before we could fully analyze the Sansha forces in the area. But one thing's for sure, there will most certainly be guards nearby, and they will have to be dealt with. You will receive a bookmark to the location of the outpost, and your instructions are simple, destroy the habitat of their construction workers. That should slow them down a bit. Good luck.

127700.en: Magnificent job, {[character]player.name}.  Those Sansha really put up a fight didn't they?  However I believe you've done as much for us as we can possibly expect of you, the Sansha data sheets you brought back with you have confirmed our worst fears, the Sansha's Nation has a fully functional colony inside {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}!  It will take a massive force to take it out, and we can't expect you to handle a mission like that yet.  Good luck on your future endeavors.

127701.en:
Now that we've established the general location of the Sanshas activity within {[location]agentSolarSystemID.name}, it's actually time to find out exactly what they are building. In your last mission you destroyed one of their construction block transports, but this brings us no closer to finding their base of operations. We've had no luck interrogating the mindless creatures before, and the surveillance teams we have sent to investigate the area have either found nothing or disappeared. This leaves us with very few options. But after brainstorming possible solutions to our problem, I came up with a devious plan.

We have in our possession so called 'spy drones', straight from our science labs, which attach themselves to a nearby ships hull and emits a low frequency signal which is picked up by one of our beacons which are strewn around {[location]agentSolarSystemID.name}, which in turn sends a high frequency signal to our control tower in {[location]agentStationID.name}.

Now we know that an agent of the Sansha's Nation regularly picks up shipments of Ectoplasm at a certain station near here. If we can place the spy drone into his next shipment, this might allow us to track his ship to its destination.

Our men have placed beacons throughout our constellation, so everything is in place. All you need to do is take these crates filled with ectoplasm, and our spy drones, to the station specified in the mission details, our agents there will take care of the rest. With luck we'll soon know the location of the Sansha base.

127707.en: Any news on the interrogation of the prisoner I brought to you?

127708.en:
Yes, the interrogation went well. We managed to find out who he was working for. Apparently he had been contacted by a Darkonnen agent and paid a vast sum of money to kidnap our CEO's niece. A foolhardy task, but he did manage to pull it off and transfer her into the hands of the criminals.

Also, the data disc you transported in your last mission has revealed even more to us. It contained the precise meeting points between the kidnappers and the Darkonnen agent for the past few weeks, as well as the exact coordinates for the next meeting, which is to take place very soon now. I'd like you to fly over there yourself and ambush the Darkonnen goons at that location. Be quick: I don't know how long they will wait for their contact to arrive.

127711.en: My ship is in need of some work, so I'm afraid I can't complete this in time.

127712.en: What?! Your incompetence has probably gotten our CEO's niece executed! Don't bother coming back!!

127713.en: What?! Your incompetence has probably gotten our CEO's niece executed! Don't bother coming back!!

127714.en:
Good work. I'm surprised, however, that you didn't find any survivors in the wreckage. Pirates usually don't fight to the death unless something big is at stake.

Oh, hey, don't you take off just yet. If you're willing, I have another assignment for you.

127715.en:
We've had a major influenza outbreak here on {[location]agentStationID.name}. Because of it, our antiviral drug supplies have grown thin, and we're afraid we'll run out soon. We have a lot of personnel here; given the current state of affairs, we wouldn't want half of them taking sick leave due to our lack of medicine. I've taken the liberty of ordering the purchase of some antiviral drugs at {[location]objectiveLocationID.name}; I need you to transport them here.

Please hurry ― our staff is depending on you.

127716.en: I'll get those antiviral drugs in no time.

127717.en: I just received an anonymous transmission asking me to send you specifically to a meeting place in {[location]dungeonSolarSystemID.name}. It also said that the person you are to meet there has information that could be vital to our investigation of the disappearance of our CEO's niece. I'm reluctant to send you, since this may be a trap, but I really have no choice. If I send someone else, though, I could be compromising the investigation. So I ask you, please head out to the bookmarked location which was given to me through the anonymous transmission. Be sure to record anything said to you and save it into your ship's database, and then return with it to me.

127719.en: Sounds too risky for me. Sorry, {[character]agentID.name}.

127720.en: Great. Just remember, do not attack anyone at the meeting point unless provoked. Hear them out first.

127721.en: Very interesting indeed. You've done us a great service, {[character]player.name}. Now let's just hope that these Blood Raider swine can give us the true location of our CEO's niece.

127722.en: A Blood Raider strike force entered this system earlier today and wiped out some of our patrol ships in a surprise assault! Now we've received a broken distress signal, only moments ago, from one of our civilian convoys traveling to a supply depot in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. I fear it has been attacked by these same pirate forces. Please undock immediately and get over there before it's too late! I'll supply you with a bookmark to their exact coordinates. Now hurry!

127724.en: Good job out there. Sadly, it seems that their attack on the civilian convoy was only a diversion; while the population here was in a state of panic, a few Blood Raider agents managed to break into the prison cell containing the captives you brought back on one of your previous missions. We must get those prisoners back, as we still don't know the location of their base! Let me know when you're ready for another assignment: I need you ASAP.

127725.en: As I've already mentioned, while we were scrambling to defend our convoys from the Blood Raiders, a few of their agents broke into our prison module and managed to escape with your prisoners. Our interrogation was not complete and we still don't know where their base is located, so we must get them back. We know where their ships are headed, though, and we need you to intercept them before they manage to jump out of this system. This might be our last chance of getting them before they vanish into deep space, so please hurry!

127727.en: Fantastic! You really showed some skill out there, {[character]player.name}. I'm proud to say I know you. And be sure to come see me again ― I have one more job for you!

127728.en:
Our intelligence team has just informed us of new evidence that apparently points to the girl being held in a Blood Raider stronghold in {[location]dungeonSolarSystemID.name}. According to our information, she is being held in their chapel and is going to be sacrificed in the near future in one of their bloody rituals. We must see that she is returned to her family safely before those despicable Blood Raider fanatics murder her.

There is a fundamental problem, however; the Blood Raiders are fully aware of our intention to free her and have sent in a fleet of their battleships to guard their outpost. Now, I certainly do not expect you to fight against such odds, but I firmly believe you capable of infiltrating their base, rescuing the girl, and escaping with your ship intact.

We have located a series of acceleration gates leading straight to the chapel. Once you arrive at the final room, all you have to do is destroy the chapel and retrieve the girl from the ejected safety capsule. (All of their chapels have this mechanism in place to save their priests from death should the structure be obliterated.) If we send in a fleet of ships, the Blood Raiders will simply kill her as soon as they realize they have lost. We need to hit them fast and hard, with a small force, before they know what hit them. That is the only chance we have of getting her out of there alive.

Now, if you do not find the girl alive after destroying the chapel, then active your warp drive immediately and get out of there! I wouldn't want to lose you needlessly, {[character]player.name}. But rest assured, should you fall, then I will personally make sure the Raider scum pay the price. Good luck.

127731.en: You expect me to go out alone against a virtual armada of battleships, all for some snotty little girl? I expected more of you, {[character]agentID.name}. Be realistic.

127732.en: You have some guts accepting this mission, {[character]player.name}, and for that I have the utmost respect.

127733.en:
Nice work. This victory of yours will undoubtedly be a serious blow to the Blood Raider leader responsible for the outpost's defenses. I'm sure he will be sacrificed in one of their rituals as punishment ― ha! A fitting end to one of those bloodthirsty maniacs.

I am also very pleased to inform you that our CEO's niece is now in our custody. We found her alive and well in a capsule floating around this very station. Apparently they drugged her, and she remembers hardly anything since her capture. But I can't help but wonder at how fortunately this all ended ... I have a nagging suspicion that someone else was behind all of this and played us like fools.

But enough of this, let us rejoice at a job well done. Our CEO sends his utmost gratitude, as well as a special bonus reward from his own coffers, which he hopes you will enjoy.

127734.en:
I just received news of a grave incident that occurred in {[location]dungeonSolarSystemID.name} a few hours ago. A convoy carrying our esteemed CEO was ambushed by an unusually large and organized pirate strike force. But fortune shone on us tonight, for due to the extraordinary bravery of our CEO's valiant escort team, he managed to escape unharmed, although slightly traumatised as you might expect. We lost many good men in this unfortunate incident, including the commander of our escort team ... may he rest in peace.

Now, I'll get right to the point. We believe the pirates managed to capture some of the crew of the cruiser that was escorting our CEO, for we found the wreckage of their ship close by the encounter location, but there was no trace of the bodies of most of the crew. {[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.name} special forces have been called in and are scouring the area for any sign left behind by the pirates, who so far remain at large. We'd like you to help out in the investigation. We know of a popular pirate hideout in {[location]dungeonSolarSystemID.name}. I´ll upload the coordinates to your NeoCom: Please search the area for any clues, and if you take any prisoners, bring them back for interrogation.

127737.en: I will do my best, you can count on that.

127738.en: Good!  I'm sure we can count on you.

127739.en:
Well done, {[character]player.name}. I see that my theory held merit, since you managed to bring back the missing crew members. After we've given them proper trauma counseling, we'll ask them about any leads they may have stumbled upon during their time in captivity.

And don't you leave just yet. I have another assignment waiting for you!

127740.en: Well, it is better to know up front that you are not up to the challenge.  Perhaps the next recruit will have the intestinal fortitude that we require.

127741.en: Did you really think a sissy like me could handle something like this?  Please.

127742.en: I am very disappointed.  And you came so highly recommended, too.

127743.en: After checking our logs, we noticed that only some of the prisoners you brought back were part of the crew that was captured after the pirate raid on our convoy. The rest apparently are former members of one of the pirate ships you destroyed, who managed to escape from the blast that destroyed their vessel. I need them transferred to some colleagues of mine at another station for further interrogation; hopefully the specialists there will be able to extract the information we need to track down who was behind the ambush on our CEO.

127744.en: I'll do it in no time. Now please update me on how the investigation is going.

127745.en: Unfortunately we only have a few vague leads at the moment, nothing I can disclose to you at this time.  Get back to me after you have finished your current mission and perhaps I'll have some information for you then.

127746.en: I won't argue with such logic.  I will find someone else, then.

127747.en: I cannot accept.  This matter is too important to be entrusted to one such as I.

127748.en: Great work once again, {[character]player.name}. But I need you back here urgently for another assignment; something terrible just happened. I'll get you posted once you are ready.

127749.en:
We urgently need help intercepting a group of kidnappers who just managed to snatch the granddaughter of our CEO while she was visiting him in this very system. We believe the perpetrators were a gang of mercenaries led by a felon working for an illegal organization calling themeselves the "Komni Corporation."

What I need you to do is capture this agent of theirs, alive if possible. We must have him here for interrogation, for we suspect he is the missing link between the kidnapping and those who are truly responsible for this heinous crime. We need to get to the bottom of which organization stands behind these grave assaults against our people. And it so happens that we know the whereabouts of a certain pirate who has had many dealings with this Komni agent in the past; we hope this pirate will be able to lead you to the agent. The only catch is that he will most likely require a bit of "convincing" on your part before he parts with the needed information. I'll upload the bookmark to his location into your NeoCom; once you have extracted the information from the middleman, I expect you to find the Komni agent and bring him back to me.

127773.en:
I'm glad you made your way here, {[character]player.name}. We had an amazing breach of security earlier today when a band of Blood Raider agents managed to infiltrate one of our shipyards and steal some very valuable equipment from its compounds. We've tracked them down to a Blood Raider supply depot in {[location]agentConstellationID.name}, where they have set up a defensive perimeter in preparation for an attack. I know this might be a difficult assignment for you, {[character]player.name}, but it's vital that we retrieve the stolen goods from those blood-sucking vermin.

Our spies tell us that the equipment we're looking for is located in one of their storage facilities in the depot, still in its sealed container. Don't hesitate to destroy the structure, in order to retrieve the goods. And you can keep anything extra you find there. Good luck.

Now we've received a broken distress signal, only moments ago, from one of our civilian convoys traveling to a supply depot in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. I fear it has been attacked by these same pirate forces. Please undock immediately and get over there before it's too late! I'll supply you with a bookmark to their exact coordinates. Now hurry!

127778.en: Good job out there. Sadly, it seems that their attack on the civilian convoy was only a diversion; while the population here was in a state of panic, a few Gurista scumbags managed to break into the prison cell containing the captives you brought back on one of your previous missions. We must get those prisoners back, as we still don't know the location of their base! Let me know when you're ready for another assignment: I need you ASAP.

127779.en: As I've already mentioned, while we were scrambling to defend our convoys from the Guristas, a few of them broke into our prison module and managed to escape with your prisoners. Our interrogation was not complete and we still don't know where their base is located, so we must get them back. We know where their ships are headed, though, and we need you to intercept them before they manage to jump out of this system. This might be our last chance of getting them before they vanish into deep space, so please hurry!

127781.en: Fantastic! You really showed some skill out there, {[character]player.name}. I'm proud to say I know you. And be sure to come see me again ― I have one more job for you!

127782.en:
Our intelligence team has just informed us of new evidence that apparently points to the girl being held in a Guristas stronghold in {[location]dungeonSolarSystemID.name}. According to our information, she is being held in their central control tower, to be executed if their demands are not met. We must see that she is returned to her family safely before those lunatics murder her.

There is a problem, however; the Guristas are fully aware of our intention to free her and have sent in a fleet of their battleships to guard their outpost. Now, I certainly do not expect you to fight against such odds, but I firmly believe you capable of infiltrating their base, rescuing the girl, and escaping with your ship intact.

We have located a series of acceleration gates leading straight to the chapel. Once you arrive at the final room, all you have to do is destroy the control tower and retrieve the girl from the ejected safety capsule. (All of their towers have this mechanism in place to save their ranking officers from death should the structure be obliterated.) If we send in a fleet of ships, the Guristas will simply kill her as soon as they realize they have lost. We need to hit them fast and hard, with a small force, before they know what hit them. That is the only chance we have of getting her out of there alive.

Now, if you do not find the girl alive after destroying the tower, then active your warp drive immediately and get out of there! I wouldn't want to lose you needlessly, {[character]player.name}. But rest assured, should you fall, then I will personally make sure those dirtbags pay the price. Good luck.

127786.en:
Nice work. This victory of yours will undoubtedly be a serious blow to the pirate leader responsible for the outpost's defenses. I'm sure he will be duly executed by his superiors.

I am also very pleased to inform you that our CEO's granddaughter is now back in our custody. We found her alive and well in a capsule floating around this very station. Apparently they drugged her, and she remembers hardly anything since her capture. But I can't help but wonder at how fortunately this all ended ... I have a nagging suspicion that someone else was behind all of this and played us like fools.

But enough of this, let us rejoice at a job well done. Our CEO sends his utmost gratitude, as well as a special bonus reward from his own coffers, which he hopes you will enjoy.

127787.en:
I'm glad you made your way here, {[character]player.name}. We had an amazing breach of security earlier today when a band of Guristas Pirate agents managed to infiltrate one of our shipyards and steal some very valuable equipment from its compounds. We've tracked them down to a Guristas supply depot in {[location]agentConstellationID.name}, where they have set up a defensive perimeter in preparation for an attack. I know this might be a difficult assignment for you, {[character]player.name}, but it's vital that we retrieve the stolen goods from those terrorist vermin.

Our spies tell us that the equipment we're looking for is located in one of their storage facilities in the depot, still in its sealed container. Don't hesitate to destroy the structure, in order to retrieve the goods. And you can keep anything extra you find there. Good luck.

127799.en: The Amarrians are taken care of ― now, about my reward!

127800.en:
High command asked me to pass this on to you ― they seem to think you're ideal for the job.

We've detected a small Amarrian reconnaissance outpost nearby and would like you to eliminate the threat as fast as possible. We can't allow these Amarrian scum to come near our homes unharassed. Make them pay.

127807.en:
I just received news of a very grave incident that just occured in the system {[location]dungeonSolarSystemID.name} a few hours ago. A convoy carrying our esteemed CEO was ambushed by an unusually large and organized pirate strike force. But fortune shone on us tonight, for due to the extraordinary bravery of our CEO's valiant escort team, he managed to escape unharmed, although slightly traumatised as you might expect. We lost many good men in this unfortunate incident, including the commander of our escort team ... may he rest in peace.

Now I'll get right to the point. We believe the pirates managed to capture some of the crew of the cruiser which was escorting our CEO, as we found the wreckage of their ship close by the encounter location, lacking the bodies of most of the crew. {[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.name} special forces have been called in and are scouring the area for any traces left behind by the pirates, which so far remain at large. We'd like you to help out in the investigation. We know of a popular pirate hideout in {[location]dungeonSolarSystemID.name}, please search the area for any clues which might help us, and bring any prisoners you manage to acquire back to us for interrogation.

127810.en: I will do my best, you can count on that.

127811.en: Good!  I'm sure we can count on you.

127812.en: Well done, {[character]player.name}.  I see that my theory held merit, since you managed to bring back the missing crew members.  After we've given them proper counceling and trauma relief we'll ask them about any leads they may have stumbled upon during their time in captivity.  And don't you leave just yet, I have another assignment waiting for you!

127813.en: Well, it is better to know up front that you are not up to the challenge.  Perhaps the next recruit will have the intestinal fortitude that we require.

127814.en: Did you really think a sissy like me could handle something like this?  Please.

127815.en: I am very disappointed.  And you came so highly recommended, too.

We received a distress signal, only moments ago, coming from one of our civilian convoys traveling towards a supply depot in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}, it has been attacked by these pirate forces.  Please undock immediately and fly to their rescue, before it's too late!  I'll supply you with a bookmark to their exact coordinates.  Now hurry!

127819.en: Any news on the interrogation of the prisoner I brought to you?

127820.en:
Yes, the interrogation went well. We managed to extract out of him who he was working for. Apparently he had been contacted by an agent from the Odamian Renegades, a criminal organization which has been making quite a name for itself recently in these parts, and paid a vast sum of money to kidnap our CEO's niece. A foolhardy task, but he did manage to pull it off and transfer her into the hands of the criminals.

Also the data disc you transported in your last mission has revealed even more to us. It contained the precise meeting points between the kidnappers and the Odamian agent for the past few weeks, as well as the exact coordinates for the next meeting which is to take place any minute now. I'd like you to fly over there yourself and ambush the Odamian goons at that location. Try to be quick, I don't know how long they will stay there waiting for their contact to arrive.

127823.en: My ship is in need of repairs, so I'm afraid I can't complete this in time.

127824.en: What?!  Your incompetence has probably gotten our CEOs niece executed!  Don't bother coming back!!

127825.en: What?!  Your incompetence has probably gotten our CEOs niece executed!  Don't bother coming back!!

127826.en: Good work.  Im surprised however that you didn't find any survivors in the wreckage, pirates usually don't fight to the death unless something big is at stake.  And don't you leave just yet, I have another assignment waiting for you!

We know where their ships are headed, and we request that you intercept them before they manage to jump out of this system.  This might be our last chance of getting them before they vanish into deep space, so please hurry!

127829.en: Awesome!  You really showed some great talent out there {[character]player.name}, I'm proud of you.  And don't you leave just yet, I have another assignment waiting for you!

127830.en:
Our intelligence team has just informed us of fresh new evidence, which apparently points to the girl being held in a Serpentis stronghold in {[location]dungeonSolarSystemID.name}. According to our sources she is being held in the Central Hub structure of the base, where she will be executed if their demands aren't met. It is our civic duty to see to it that she is returned to her family safely before those despicable Serpentis villains murder her.

There is a fundamental flaw with our plan however, the Serpentis are fully aware of our intention to free her and have sent in a fleet of their battleships to guard their outpost. Now I certainly do not expect you to fight against such odds, but I firmly believe you capable of infiltrating their base, rescuing the girl and escaping with your ship, and life, intact.

We have located a series of acceleration gates leading straight to the Central Control Hub. The Serpentis fleet guarding it will be expecting a large force of attackers, which will give you the advantage should you fly in there with a fast, agile ship, to avoid direct confrontation. Once you arrive at the final area, all you have to do is destroy the Central Control Hub and retrieve the girl from the ejected safety capsule, all of their Control Hubs have this mechanism to save their high-ranking personnel from death should the structure be obliterated. We hope that they consider the girl important enough to save in this way as well. If not ... well there is not much other choice. If we send in a fleet of ships they will simply kill her when they realize they have lost. We need to hit them fast and hard, before they know what hit them. That is the only chance we have of getting her out of there alive.

Now, if you do not find the girl alive after destroying the Central Control Hub, then active your warp drive immediately and get out of there! I wouldn't want to lose you needlessly, {[character]player.name}. But rest assured, should you fall then I will personally make sure the pirate scum pay the price. Good luck.

127834.en: You have some guts accepting this mission, {[character]player.name}, and for that I have the utmost respect for you.

127835.en:
Nice work. This will undoubtedly be a serious blow to the Serpentis leader responsible for the outpost's defenses. I'm sure he will be severely punished by Sarpati for failing in his duties.

I am also very pleased to inform you that our CEO's niece is now in our custody. We found her alive and well in a capsule floating around this very station. Apparently they drugged her, and she remembers hardly anything since she was captured. But I can't help but wonder at how fortunate this all ended ... 127836.en:
We need urgent help with intercepting a group of vile kidnappers who just managed to snatch the niece of our CEO while she was visiting her uncle in this very system. We believe the perpetrators were a gang of mercenaries led by a felon working for the illegal organization, the Odamian Renegades. I'll fill you in on the details of that organization in your mission details.

What I need you to do is capture this agent of theirs, alive if possible. We must have him here for interrogation, as we suspect he is the missing link between the kidnapping and those who are truly responsible for this heinous crime. We need to get to the bottom of which organization stands behind these grave assaults against our people. And it so happens that we know the whereabouts of a certain pirate who has had many dealings with this Odamian agent in the past, who we hope will be able to lead you to him. The only catch is he will most likely require a bit of 'convincing' on your part before he parts with the needed information. I'll upload the bookmark to his location into your NeoCom, once you have extracted the information from the middleman then I expect you to find the Odamian agent and bring him back to me.

127839.en: Well, I did not say every job would be pleasure planets and pie.  Perhaps you are more suited for the garbage-hauling missions?

127840.en: No, this does not interest me.

127841.en: Well done.  We will proceed immediately to interrogate the prisoner, expect some results soon.  Our interrogators can be quite ... convincing.

127842.en: The Odamian Renegades named themselves after the system where their organization was founded, in the Gallente controlled Placid region.  The founders themselves were mostly made up of adventurers traveling from the Gallente capital system, Luminaire, searching for fame and fortune in the frontier.  There they came into contact with Dakeur Hullan, a charismatic pirate veteran who had been working for the Serpentis organization until an unfortunate incident saw him outlawed from their territory, with a sizeable bounty on his head.  Despite his misfortunes, Dakeur still had numerous contacts throughout the criminal world, both inside Serpentis and Gallente controlled space.  With Dakeurs experience within the underworld of the Gallente Federation and his co-founders surprising piloting skills, the Odamian Renegades quickly garnered a reputation as a powerful and infamous drug smuggling syndicate within the Gallente territories.

127844.en: I just received an anonymous transmission asking me to send you specifically to a meeting place in {[location]dungeonSolarSystemID.name}.  It also said that the person you are to meet there has information that could be vital to our investigation of the disappearance of our CEO's niece.  I'm reluctant to send you, as this may be a trap, but I really have no choice.  If I send someone else I could be compromising the investigation.  So I ask you, please head out to the bookmarked location which was given to me through the anonymous transmission.  Upload anything said to you and save it into your ships database, return with it to me.

127846.en: Sounds too risky for me, sorry {[character]agentID.name}.

127847.en: Great. Just remember, do not attack anyone at the meeting point unless provoked. Hear them out first.

127848.en: Very interesting indeed.  You've done us a good service, {[character]player.name}.  Now let's just hope that these Serpentis scoundrels can reveal the true location of our CEO's niece.

127849.en: While we wait for the interrogation of the prisoner you captured in your last mission to finish, I'd like you to transport a data chip that we retrieved from his belongings to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}.  We'd like it decyphered and I know of the perfect man for the job, who is residing on that station.  We aren't sure if there is any incriminating evidence in the data, but we'd like to make sure nonetheless.  When you get back, then hopefully our interrogators will have found some more leads.

127851.en: Well then.  Perhaps you should seek employment with the Servant Sisters of Eve?

127852.en: We have a major flu outbreak here on {[location]agentStationID.name}.  Because of this our antiviral drug supplies have grown thin, and we're afraid we'll run out soon.  We have a lot of personnel here, we wouldn't want half of them taking sick leave due to our lack of medicines.  I ordered the purchase of some antiviral drugs at {[location]objectiveLocationID.name} and would like you to transport them here.  Please hurry, our staff is depending on you.

127853.en: I'll get those antiviral drugs in no time.

127854.en: After checking our logs we noticed that only some of the prisoners you brought back were part of the crew that was captured after the pirate raid on our convoy.  The rest apparently are former members of one of the pirate ships you destroyed, who managed to escape from the blast that destroyed their vessel.  I need them transfered to some colleagues of mine at another station for further interrogation, hopefully the specialists there will be able to extract out of them the information we need to track down who was behind the ambush on our CEO.

127855.en: I'll do it in no time.  Now please keep me updated on how the investigation is going.

127856.en: Unfortunately we only have a few vague leads at the moment, nothing I can disclose to you at this time.  Get back to me after you have finished your current mission and perhaps I'll have some information for you then.

127857.en: I won't argue with such logic.  I will find someone else, then.

127858.en: I cannot accept.  This matter is too important to be entrusted to one such as I.

127859.en: Great work, {[character]player.name}.  But I need you back here urgently for another assignment, something terrible just happened.  I'll get you posted once you are ready.

127860.en:
Okay, we have a situation here. A serious situation. A week ago, we detected a small Amarrian presence right next to the ruins of an old military station. Since then, they have been expanding in numbers; yesterday we found out that they have built an outpost. We believe they are trying to retrieve something from the station, something they could use against us.

Go, destroy the outpost and the ships protecting it. You will be well rewarded, I assure you.

127861.en: The outpost is destroyed and the infidels eliminated. You mentioned a reward?

127862.en: This mission is damn near impossible! I can't do it.

127863.en: Very well, then, pilot. I'll give this to somebody more competent.

127864.en:
I just received news of a grave incident that occurred in {[location]dungeonSolarSystemID.name} a few hours ago. A convoy carrying our esteemed CEO was ambushed by an unusually large and organized pirate strike force. But fortune shone on us tonight, for due to the extraordinary bravery of our CEO's valiant escort team, he managed to escape unharmed, although slightly traumatised as you might expect. We lost many good men in this unfortunate incident, including the commander of our escort team ... may he rest in peace.

Now, I'll get right to the point. We believe the pirates managed to capture some of the crew of the cruiser that was escorting our CEO, for we found the wreckage of their ship close by the encounter location, but there was no trace of the bodies of most of the crew. {[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.name} special forces have been called in and are scouring the area for any sign left behind by the pirates, who so far remain at large. We'd like you to help out in the investigation. We know of a popular pirate hideout in {[location]dungeonSolarSystemID.name}. I´ll upload the coordinates to your NeoCom: Please search the area for any clues, and if you take any prisoners, bring them back for interrogation.

127866.en: So what's this important stuff you keep yammering about?

127867.en: I will do my best, you can count on that.

127868.en: Good!  I'm sure we can count on you.

127869.en:
Well done, {[character]player.name}. I see that my theory held merit, since you managed to bring back the missing crew members. After we've given them proper trauma counseling, we'll ask them about any leads they may have stumbled upon during their time in captivity.

And don't you leave just yet. I have another assignment waiting for you!

127870.en: Well, it is better to know up front that you are not up to the challenge.  Perhaps the next recruit will have the intestinal fortitude that we require.

127871.en: Did you really think a sissy like me could handle something like this?  Please.

127872.en: I am very disappointed.  And you came so highly recommended, too.

127873.en: A Sansha strike force entered this system earlier today and wiped out some of our patrol ships in a surprise assault! Now we've received a broken distress signal, only moments ago, from one of our civilian convoys traveling to a supply depot in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. I fear it has been attacked by these same pirate forces. Please undock immediately and get over there before it's too late! I'll supply you with a bookmark to their exact coordinates. Now hurry!

127874.en: A Sansha strike force entered this system earlier today and wiped out some of our patrol ships in a surprise assault! Now we've received a broken distress signal, only moments ago, from one of our civilian convoys traveling to a supply depot in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. I fear it has been attacked by these same pirate forces. Please undock immediately and get over there before it's too late! I'll supply you with a bookmark to their exact coordinates. Now hurry!

127875.en: Good job out there. Sadly, it seems that their attack on the civilian convoy was only a diversion; while the population here was in a state of panic, a few Sansha zombies managed to break into the prison cell containing the captives you brought back on one of your previous missions. We must get those prisoners back, as we still don't know the location of their base! Let me know when you're ready for another assignment: I need you ASAP.

127876.en: Any news on the interrogation of the prisoner I brought to you?

127877.en:
Yes, the interrogation went well. We managed to find out who he was working for. Apparently he had been contacted by a Maru Rebel agent and paid a vast sum of money to kidnap our CEO's daughter. A foolhardy task, but he did manage to pull it off and transfer her into the hands of the criminals.

Also, the data disc you transported in your last mission has revealed even more to us. It contained the precise meeting points between the kidnappers and the Maru agent for the past few weeks, as well as the exact coordinates for the next meeting, which is to take place very soon now. I'd like you to fly over there yourself and ambush the Rebel goons at that location. Be quick: I don't know how long they will wait for their contact to arrive.

127879.en: I knew I could count on you, {[character]player.name}.

127880.en: Oh, dear! I've just remembered that I have a flan in the oven, so I'm afraid I can't complete this mission in time.

127881.en: What?! Coward!! Your incompetence has probably gotten our CEO's daughter executed! Don't ever show your face here again!!

127882.en: What?! Coward!! Your incompetence has probably gotten our CEO's daughter executed! Don't ever show your face here again!!

127883.en:
Good work. I'm surprised, however, that you didn't find any survivors in the wreckage. Pirates usually don't fight to the death unless something big is at stake.

Oh, hey, don't you take off just yet. If you're willing, I have another assignment for you.

127884.en: As I've already mentioned, while we were scrambling to defend our convoys from those Sansha's Nation pilots, a few of their assault troopers broke into our prison module and managed to escape with your prisoners. Our interrogation was not complete and we still don't know where their base is located, so we must get them back. We know where their ships are headed, though, and we need you to intercept them before they manage to jump out of this system. This might be our last chance of getting them before they vanish into deep space, so please hurry!

127885.en: As I've already mentioned, while we were scrambling to defend our convoys from those Sansha's Nation pilots, a few of their assault troopers broke into our prison module and managed to escape with your prisoners. Our interrogation was not complete and we still don't know where their base is located, so we must get them back. We know where their ships are headed, though, and we need you to intercept them before they manage to jump out of this system. This might be our last chance of getting them before they vanish into deep space, so please hurry!

127886.en: Fantastic! You really showed some skill out there, {[character]player.name}. I'm proud to say I know you. And be sure to come see me again ― I have one more job for you!

127887.en:
Our intelligence team has just informed us of new evidence that apparently points to our CEO's daughter being held in a Sansha stronghold in {[location]dungeonSolarSystemID.name}. According to our information, she is being held in the base's Central Communication Tower; they will execute her if their leaders' demands aren't met. We must see that she is returned to her family safely before those mindless zombies murder her.

There is a big problem, however; the Sansha leaders are fully aware of our intention to free her, so they've sent in a fleet of battleships to guard their outpost. Now, I certainly do not expect you to fight against such odds, but I firmly believe you capable of infiltrating their base, rescuing the young woman, and escaping with your ship intact.

We have located a series of acceleration gates leading straight to the Communication Tower. Once you arrive at the final room, all you have to do is destroy the tower and retrieve her from the ejected safety capsule. (All of their towers have this mechanism in place to save their leaders from death should the structure be obliterated.) If we send in a fleet of ships, they will simply kill her as soon as they realize they have lost. We need to hit them fast and hard, with a small force, before they know what hit them. That is the only chance we have of getting her out of there alive.

Now, if you do not find the woman alive after destroying the tower, then active your warp drive immediately and get out of there! I wouldn't want to lose you needlessly, {[character]player.name}. But rest assured, should you fall, then I will personally make sure the Raider scum pay the price. Good luck.

127890.en: You expect me to go out on a limb for some snotty oligarch's daughter? I mean, ISK is great, sure, but it's not much good if you're not alive to spend it, {[character]agentID.name}.

127891.en: You have some guts accepting this mission, {[character]player.name}, and for that I have the utmost respect for you.

127892.en:
Nice work. This will undoubtedly be a serious blow to the Sansha leader responsible for the outpost's defenses. I'm sure he will be severely punished by Sansha for failing in his duties. The Communication Tower also serves as a ‘mother-brain' of sorts for a large portion of the Sansha fleet, with it destroyed their forces will be paralyzed for some time to come.

I am also very pleased to inform you that our CEO's niece is now in our custody. We found her alive and well in a capsule floating around this very station. Apparently they drugged her, and she remembers hardly anything since she was captured. But I can't help but wonder at how fortunate this all ended ... I have a nagging suspicion that someone else was behind all of this and played us like fools.

But enough of this, let us rejoice at a job well done. Our CEO sends his utmost gratitude, as well as a special bonus reward from his own coffers which he hopes you will enjoy.

127893.en:
We urgently need help intercepting a group of kidnappers who just managed to snatch the daughter of our CEO while she was visiting her father in this very system. We believe the perpetrators were a gang of mercenaries led by a felon working for the Maru Rebels. I'll fill you in on the details of that organization in the mission details.

What I need you to do is capture this agent of theirs, alive if possible. We must have him here for interrogation, for we suspect he is the missing link between the kidnapping and those who are truly responsible for this heinous crime. We need to get to the bottom of which organization stands behind these grave assaults against our people. And it just so happens that we know the whereabouts of a certain pirate who has had many dealings with a Maru agent in the past; we hope he will be able to lead you to the agent. The only catch is that he will most likely require a bit of "convincing" on your part before he parts with the needed information. I'll upload the bookmark to his location into your NeoCom; once you have extracted the information from the middleman, I expect you to find the Maru agent and bring him back to me.

127896.en: Well, I did not say every job would be pleasure planets and sweetplum pie. Perhaps you are more suited for managing sewer drones?

127897.en: No, this does not interest me.

127898.en:
Well done. We will proceed immediately to interrogating the prisoner, so expect some results soon. Our interrogators can be quite ... convincing.

And don't go anywhere: I have another assignment for you.

127899.en: The Maru Rebels were once part of a gang of pirates who turned into a sinister terrorist network claiming to fight for Minmatar freedom. In fact, they're little more a ruthless gang of criminals dealing in the black market, smuggling, and extortion and blackmail, even sometimes working as hired assassins. Their official agenda is to murder as many citizens of the Amarr nations as possible ― i.e., Amarr Empire, Ammatar, and Khanid Kingdom ― hoping to force them to withdraw eventually from historically Minmatar systems currently under Amarr control. The Minmatar Republic leadership has denounced them as being cutthroats and criminals even though they support Republic goals, and has put up a sizable bounty on their leader's head. But even so, the Rebels do maintain some support within the Minmatar Republic, which has allowed them certain freedoms other criminal networks do not have.

127901.en: I just received an anonymous transmission asking me to send you specifically to a meeting place in {[location]dungeonSolarSystemID.name}. It also said that the person you are to meet there has information that could be vital to our investigation of the disappearance of our CEO's daughter. I'm reluctant to send you, since this may be a trap, but I really have no choice. If I send someone else, though, I could be compromising the investigation. So I ask you, please head out to the bookmarked location which was given to me through the anonymous transmission. Be sure to record anything said to you and save it into your ship's database, and then return with it to me.

127903.en: Sounds too risky for me, {[character]agentID.name}. I´m out.

127904.en: Great. Just remember, do not attack anyone at the meeting point unless provoked. Hear them out first.

127905.en: Very interesting indeed. Thanks for your good service, {[character]player.name}. Now let's just hope that these monsters will reveal the true location of our CEO's daughter.

127906.en: While we wait for the interrogation of the prisoner you captured, I'd like you to transport a data chip we retrieved from his belongings to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}. We need it deciphered, and I happen to know the perfect man for the job, who lives at that station. We aren't sure if there is any incriminating evidence in the data, but we'd like to make sure nonetheless. By the time you get back, I expect our interrogators will have found some more leads.

127908.en: Oh, fair enough. Perhaps kitchen duty would be more to your liking?

127909.en:
We've had a major influenza outbreak here on {[location]agentStationID.name}. Because of it, our antiviral drug supplies have grown thin, and we're afraid we'll run out soon. We have a lot of personnel here; given the current state of affairs, we wouldn't want half of them taking sick leave due to our lack of medicine. I've taken the liberty of ordering the purchase of some antiviral drugs at {[location]objectiveLocationID.name}; I need you to transport them here.

Please hurry ― our staff is depending on you.

127910.en: I'll get those antiviral drugs in no time.

127911.en: After checking our logs, we noticed that only some of the prisoners you brought back were part of the crew that was captured after the pirate raid on our convoy. The rest apparently are former members of one of the pirate ships you destroyed, who managed to escape from the blast that destroyed their vessel. I need them transferred to some colleagues of mine at another station for further interrogation; hopefully the specialists there will be able to extract the information we need to track down who was behind the ambush on our CEO.

127912.en: I'll do it in no time. Now please update me on how the investigation is going.

127915.en: I cannot accept.  This matter is too important to be entrusted to one such as I.

127916.en: Great work once again, {[character]player.name}. But I need you back here urgently for another assignment; something terrible just happened. I'll get you posted once you are ready.

127917.en:
I'm happy to announce that we just spotted a transport ship owned by the Archaeological Agency of Caille University not far from a stargate in this system. It is being escorted by some rather menacing Navy ships, and therefore we've been a bit wary to attack it. I'm sure it got lost and took a wrong jump somewhere along its travel route, no sane captain of a civilian transport ship would travel through these parts on purpose.

You probably guessed it but I'd like you to do the dirty work. Fly off to their current location and eliminate the escort. If the transport freighter puts up a fight then destroy it as well, but try to bring back as many of its passengers as you can. These civilian transport ships can be a goldmine for those in the kidnapping / ransom business, if you know what I mean. I'm sure the Gallenteans will pay a handsome amount of ISK for their precious archaeologists, if taken alive.

127921.en: Good work, {[character]player.name}.  I see you managed to bring back at least a few dozen of the passengers and crew members, now it's our turn to get them sorted out, to see who we sell to the slavers and who's worth keeping for ransom.  Ah what a fun job this is!  And don't you leave just yet, I have another assignment waiting for you!

127922.en: Did you really think a sissy like me could handle something like this?  Please.

127923.en:
This one was issued from high command, specifically to be assigned to you.

Recently we have been picking up signals from an old ship wreckage nearby. We send a scout to go check it out and he reported a large Serpentis presence, led by a high-ranking colonel. They seem to be looting the wreckage and creating some sort of modified Megathron battleship. If you could go and eliminate this threat, we will reward you nicely.

127927.en:
Welcome back {[character]player.name}. I'm excited here, we're pretty sure that the passengers you captured in a previous mission are of a very wealthy or important family. We can't say for certain yet, but there's something about them ...

Anyway, I'd like you to transfer a sample of their DNA to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}, where Zunbar Alefon, our expert on Gallentean internal affairs, is located. Hopefully he will be able to find a match for them in his gigantic DNA database and give us some information on their backgrounds. And don't tell ANYONE what you're up to, I'd rather keep a low profile on this for the time being, the fewer members of {[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name} that know about this the better.

127930.en: The morning prison guard shift met with a grisly scene.  All of the guards on the 5th deck on the last shift had been brutally murdered and some of the prison cells had been forcibly opened.  2 of the prisoners that you captured in a previous mission were missing.  We are quite certain that this was the work of a bounty hunter, as he obviously intended to rescue these specific prisoners.  We immediately banned all craft from leaving the station, but it was too late.  However we have compiled a list of those who left the station this morning and we've narrowed it down to 3 suspects.  We know the location of each of them, they haven't managed to leave the system yet.  I'll upload their locations one by one, do whatever it takes to bring back those prisoners!

127933.en: Well, I did not say every job would be pleasure planets and pie.  Perhaps you are more suited for the garbage-hauling missions?

127934.en: Tsk, tsk.  Very well, I shall have to find some other lackey to do my work for me.

127935.en: Well done.  I'll make sure the prisoners are kept at a more secure location this time, I've had enough of these screw ups.  And don't you leave just yet, I have another assignment waiting for you!

127936.en: Well then.  Perhaps you should seek employment with the Servant Sisters of Eve?

127937.en:
After you delivered the data chip in your last mission, I've been flooded with reports of Gallente Navy sightings in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. A number of our gangs have been wiped out, and it's not considered safe anymore for a pirate to venture too far out into space in these parts. I'm positive that this new offensive is the direct result of the data chip we sent falling into the hands of the Navy generals. They know what we're up to and it's only a matter of time before the Gallente media get a hold of the story.

I didn't expect the Navy to venture this close to our station, after all we've threatened to kill the prisoners. But they seem intent on keeping their distance, this is just a ploy of theirs to frighten us. But by disrupting our trade routes and ambushing our patrols in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}, all they accomplish is raising the price on our demands.

I want you to head out into the outer reaches of this system and eliminate 4 Navy groups. After we have given them the taste of defeat, then it will be time to deliver our new demands. Off you go.

127942.en: My ship is in need of repairs, so I'm afraid I can't complete this in time.

127943.en: Your attack on the Navy groups has had unforeseeable consequences.  Instead of backing off, they have taken their offensive to another level.  We've noticed an unusually large concentration of their ships at a location within {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}, and a construction freight or two heading their way.  We're quite sure they are planning on building something there, probably a military outpost from which they intend to launch a major offensive against this station.  We can't let them start building that outpost!  I want you to personally see to it that their convoy and all of the ships defending the area are destroyed immediately.

127945.en: Consider the building preparations for that outpost officially terminated.

127946.en: Your last strike against the Navy forces in {[location]agentSolarSystemID.name} sent them into a disarray.  That should keep them in check for a day or two.  Meanwhile, I'd like you to bring our new demands to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}.  This time they better comply, or we might just go through with all of our threats.  We've already decapitated one of the prisoners, which we believe to be a personal aid of Karzath.  The footage has been compiled into the data disk along with our demands.

127947.en: Your last strike against the Navy forces in {[location]agentSolarSystemID.name} sent them into a disarray.  That should keep them in check for a day or two.  Meanwhile, I'd like you to bring our new demands to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}.  This time they better comply, or we might just go through with all of our threats.  We've already decapitated one of the prisoners, which we believe to be a personal aid of Karzath.  The footage has been compiled into the data disk along with our demands.

127950.en: Nice job mate.  Now let's keep our fingers crossed and hope those bastards cave in to our threats.  And don't you leave just yet, I have another assignment waiting for you!

127951.en: I'm glad you're back {[character]player.name}.  The Gallente Navy have gone mad!  They've sent an entire fleet of ships to attack this station.  They must be utterly insane, if even one of them steps foot in here the prisoners heads will roll!  I need you to undock at once and meet the Navy head on before they get within firing range of the station, bring everyone you can, I suspect you'll need all the help you can get.  You'll be supplied with a bookmark of course, now get moving!

127952.en: I'm glad you're back {[character]player.name}.  The Gallente Navy have gone mad!  They've sent an entire fleet of ships to attack this station.  They must be utterly insane, if even one of them steps foot in here the prisoners heads will roll!  I need you to undock at once and meet the Navy head on before they get within firing range of the station, bring everyone you can, I suspect you'll need all the help you can get.  You'll be supplied with a bookmark of course, now get moving!

127953.en: Not bad, {[character]player.name}.  But this outrageous attack on our stronghold will not go unpunished.  I have personally ordered the execution of all of the prisoners save our prized possession, Karzath Pinazi.  The picture of the beheadings will be sent straight to the Gallente media.  This should teach them a lesson.  And don't you leave just yet, I have another assignment waiting for you!

127954.en:
Rejoice, {[character]player.name}, the Federation have finally caved in. They have vowed to meet our demands once the prisoner and his cargo have been transferred safely to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}, where their agents will pick it up. Ironically enough, we have no idea what cargo they were jammering about, everything that was on board the cargo ship containing the archeologists you captured originally was destroyed along with the ship. No wonder they were so adamant at retrieving whatever it was they were after. Karzath Nuoki was only a smokescreen, whatever he was transporting towards Gallente space was extremely valuable. It's unfortunate we will never find out what it was, as I'm sure you never saw anything suspicious in the wreckage of the cargo ship other than the stranded archeologists ... but just to be on the safe side, I had some of my men search your hangar just in case you have been less than honest with us. No hard feelings I hope.

And as you probably guessed, I want you to do the honors of transporting the prisoner to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}, where our agents will hand him along with a cargo container filled with various junk to our Gallente 'friends'. Once this final assignment has been completed, I ... err we will be able to enjoy the fruits of our hard work. In other words, I'll be rich!

127956.en: You have done well, {[character]player.name}.  {[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.nameWithArticle} will not forget this.  The piece of Neophite that I received in exchange for the prisoner will fetch me an absurd price on the black market.  And the look on the faces of the Gallente agents who picked him up, after they rummaged through the cargo container ... simply priceless!

127957.en: The Republic needs you! Communications have been down all day, I need you to go and get me today's status reports, I have a feeling something big is going to happen today.

127958.en: The Republic needs you! Communications have been down all day, I need you to go and get me today's status reports, I have a feeling something big is going to happen today.

127961.en: I'm sorry, it's too hard, I can't do it.

127962.en: Those reports you just delivered to me were of great importance, it seems as though the Amarrians have made a huge mistake and want us to correct it for them. Before I can tell you more I need you to pass this info on to a nearby agent.

127963.en:
Those messages you delivered were essential, thank you. The Amarrians screwed up and want us to clean up their mess, what a day.

One of their generals has gone crazy. He ignored orders, broke communications with his commanding officers and then disappeared into thin air. They believe he might be heading our way, apparently he thinks an all-out war has started and wants to be a part of it. Anyway I'll have someone take care of the rest, thank you.

127964.en: I want nothing to do with this.

127965.en: Any more news on the Amarr troubles?

127966.en: I will give this to somebody more competent.

127967.en: I'll fetch that data chip for you in no time.

127968.en: Seems like those Amarrians you took out were just scouts, we're not quite sure where this fugitive is hiding. What we do know is the presence of another similar nearby scout outpost. Perhaps if you went there you could get some information out of them as to the whereabouts of our target. We need to find him as soon as possible, before he is able to strike.

127969.en: You disappoint both me and the Republic, shame on you.

127971.en: I am proud of you, nice work.

127973.en: I can't do it, it's too hard!

127974.en: I don't care, give me something else.

127975.en:
I've got a lucrative mission for you this time, {[character]player.name}. I need a convoy taken out and looted in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. Sounds rather standard, but before you go running off I'd like to explain the situation a bit.

There is a merchant corporation near here, which is basically a small offshoot of the Caldari mega-corporation Sukuuvestaa, who own the vast majority of it's shares. These Sukuuvestaa merchants like to transport all sorts of goods throughout the {[location]agentRegionID.name} region, and regularly pay tribute to us for protection. But sadly sometimes their cargo is simply too enticing.

This convoy is loaded with Caldari consumer electronics, and only guarded with the standard Sukuuvestaa hired mercenary ships, as the Caldari Navy do not frequent these parts. You can't imagine how eager some of the people in these parts are at getting these things. And the price they are willing to pay ... well, it's something that we simply can't pass up so easily. For that reason I want the convoy destroyed and looted, and make sure you are discreet. I don't want any witnesses at the scene to survive, nor any equipment that might record what transpired. As long as the Caldari do not know who attacked their ships, the most they will probably do is send more combat ships with the next convoy.

127977.en:
Greetings, {[character]player.name}. Because of the success in your previous mission, my superiors have one extra task for you. The Sukuuvestaa seem to be completely oblivious as to who attacked their last convoy through this area, and have accepted their loss as merely a freak occurrence. A most fortunate turn of events for us, but there is just one more target that we simply cannot let pass through our grasp. Our cargo scanners in {[location]dungeonSolarSystemID.name} spotted some extremely expensive material in one of the latest Sukuuvestaa convoys traveling through {[location]agentConstellationID.name}. We simply must get our hands on that Neophyte, I don't care how many ships it takes. Just do it.

I'll supply you with a bookmark to the current location of the convoy. It seems to have stopped in a deadspace area in {[location]dungeonSolarSystemID.name}, perhaps for repairs. Strike it hard and fast with everything you got, and bring me that Neophyte! Don't bother showing your face back here before the task is complete!

127979.en: Interesting. This was all a trap set up by the Sukuuvestaa to find out who was behind the attack on the consumer electronics convoy earlier. Well, it was worth it. This piece of Neophyte will fetch us a fortune! And of course we have you, {[character]player.name}, to deal with any Caldari Navy threat that might materialize as a result. And don't you leave just yet, I have another assignment waiting for you!

127980.en:
Now that we have the Neophyte, I need it transported to {[location]objectiveDestinationID.name}. Don't ask why, just do it.

Watch out for any Navy vessels on the way. Now that they know who was behind the latest heist, they're bound to be on the lookout for any ship loyal to {[npcOrganization]agentFactionID.nameWithArticle}.

127981.en:
I have an urgent task for you this time, {[character]player.name}. The Caldari Navy have started a campaign of revenge attacks on our assets here in {[location]agentConstellationID.name}. They don't have the manpower to launch a full scale assault on us, but they do have various agents here and there setting up booby traps for our ships. This escapade is becoming a tad expensive, so we need to do something before it gets out of hand.

The first thing I want you to do is fly to one of our supply depots in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. The Caldari have set up a trap there for any incoming ships, which has already cost us a fortune. Destroy the Caldari forces manning the guns, then report back to me. And stay away from our supply depot, they don't take kindly to un-invited visitors, ally or not.

And stay away from our supply depot, they don't take kindly to un-invited visitors, ally or not.

127983.en: Good work, that should put a dent in their plans.  And don't you leave just yet, I have another assignment waiting for you!

127984.en:
The Caldari Navy continue to harass us. They are famous for overreacting when it comes to minor incidents involving their fellow corporations. But I'm confident this will die down after you have completed your next mission.

The Caldari have sent a high profile agent of theirs, Whelan Machorin into {[location]agentConstellationID.name} to conduct a campaign of terror against our people. He must be stopped, at all costs. Kill him and bring me his head, which I will have stuck on a stake for all our men to view at their pleasure.

127985.en:
The Caldari Navy continue to harass us. They are famous for overreacting when it comes to minor incidents involving their fellow corporations. But I'm confident this will die down after you have completed your next mission.

The Caldari have sent a high profile agent of theirs, Whelan Machorin into {[location]agentConstellationID.name} to conduct a campaign of terror against our people. He must be stopped, at all costs. Kill him and bring me his head, which I will have stuck on a stake for all our men to view at their pleasure.

127986.en:
From data we've collected, the Caldari Navy forces have set up some kind of constellation scanner in {[location]dungeonSolarSystemID.name} to monitor our activities in preparation for a sneak attack. We believe this is what has allowed them to use their small force in these areas so effectively. This also allows them to more effectively monitor the movements of the Caldari convoys flying through here and respond faster to any attacks.

I want you to destroy this high-tech telescope of theirs. It will be heavily guarded, so this is no small task for even you, {[character]player.name}. Once you have completed your mission, we will have dealt a devastating blow to the Caldari Navy plans in {[location]agentConstellationID.name}, which I doubt they will recover from anytime soon.

127987.en:
