139609.en:
All hell's broken loose out in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. The Amarrians have chosen to create an incident that they're hoping will escalate into war.

A group of Ammatar "nationals" in a small outpost out there claim that they were beaten up by our security guards and then arrested on trumped-up charges. The Empire has dispatched a fleet to blockade the outpost "in protest," they say, "on behalf of our friends and allies"; they are demanding that the prisoners be turned over to them.

We're in a no-win situation: If we hold the Nefantar, the Amarr fleet will bombard the station and force a confrontation, but if we turn them over it will be seen as a sign of weakness. We need to raise the blockade, while at the same time avoiding direct official intervention in the situation. That's why we need a capsuleer. We need you.

{[character]player.name}, please — fly to {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} and take out the fleet that is amassing there. It's a tough job, but from what we've heard you're up to it. What do you say?

139610.en: The prisoners should be safe to pick up now, {[character]agentID.name}. Oh, by the way, the Imperial Navy is also down a few warships.

139611.en: I shall do my best to serve the Federation's ideals.

139612.en: One of our patrols spotted a Mordu's Legion strike force not far from here.  We're not certain about their intentions, but we'd like you to take them out just incase.  Those damned Mordu's assassination squads have been known to murder our members in the past, so we keep a good eye on them.  We know their exact location this time, and I'd like you to take them out before they know what hit them.  I'm counting on you {[character]player.name}.

139613.en: One of our patrols spotted a Mordu's Legion strike force not far from here.  We're not certain about their intentions, but we'd like you to take them out just incase.  Those damned Mordu's assassination squads have been known to murder our members in the past, so we keep a good eye on them.  We know their exact location this time, and I'd like you to take them out before they know what hit them.  I'm counting on you {[character]player.name}.

139614.en:
Recently a thief stole some valuable documents from a high ranking officer and friend of mine in {[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name}.  These documents are very sensitive and we fear they were stolen by someone working for an enemy of ours.  
Fortunately, the information stored within the documents was encrypted using the very latest encryption software.  The thief probably did not expect this, and we believe the information has not yet been revealed to him or his 
employer.  Should it leak out however then the leader of {[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name} will be ... less than forgiving.  Would you please save my friends career?  I have been told by a reliable source of a shady 
person who docked here yesterday and was spotted near my friends apartment, and is most likely the thief of whom I speak.  This person has very recently left this station.  I will pay you {[numeric]rewardQuantity} 
{[item]rewardTypeID.name} if you intercept the thief, destroy his ship if he offers resistance and bring the documents back to me.  I know you probably do not want to harm someone who may not be guilty, but I assure you 
that this scoundrel has a history of criminal offenses within {[location]agentRegionID.name}.  The people of {[location]agentRegionID.name} will be glad to know of his demise.  You have only 24 hours to complete the mission, but 
he will most likely be located in this very constellation.

139615.en: Our counter-intelligence service has indicated that the Gallente Federal Intelligence Office has erected a covert listening post in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. While our communications are encrypted, the presence of Gallente intelligence operations in our space poses both an insult to Caldari sovereignty and an unacceptable risk to communications security.

139616.en: The Gallente FIO answers directly to the Gallente President. Its works are shrouded in secrecy and covert operations. Among their spying operations are the construction and operation of numerous small, covert listening posts designed to glean information from enemy signals and communications.

139618.en:
Our counter-intelligence service has indicated that the Gallente Federal Intelligence Office has erected a covert listening post in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. While I assure you our communications are encrypted, the presence of Gallente intelligence operations in our space poses both an insult to Caldari sovereignty and an unacceptable risk to communications security.

Your task is simple: go there, overwhelm whatever forces are defending the post, and destroy it. Can I count on you to see this through?

139619.en: Well, at least you tried. Good luck in your travels, {[character]player.name}

139620.en: Glad to hear it.  But be careful out there; you're not dealing with amateurs.

139621.en: Good work, {[character]player.name}! The agent who recommended you to me may not have praised you highly enough!

139622.en: So, what, we're just supposed to let the Gallente spy on us? I'll have to inform the agent who recommended you that you're less reliable than advertized. Get out of my sight.

139623.en: Perhaps I did not impress upon you the importance of the matter we discussed, but your delay in performing this simple task is unacceptable. I have taken the liberty of giving the job to someone who understands the importance of rooting out spies.

139624.en: Perhaps I did not impress upon you the importance of the matter we discussed, but your delay in replying to my offer is unacceptable. I have taken the liberty of giving the job to someone who understands the importance of rooting out spies.

139627.en: Of course you can count on me.

139628.en: The Gallente spies have been destroyed.

139629.en: This doesn't really sound like my kind of thing, sorry.

139630.en: I'm afraid I'm not going to be able to complete this job for you.

139631.en: I'm always ready to do my part. How can I help?

139632.en: In order to maximize the element of surprise for our raid, all enemy pickets and patrol ships must be destroyed. Go to the assigned location in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} and destroy all the ships you find there. Beware of enemy reinforcements!

139633.en:
The time has come to strike a blow against the arrogant Gallente. We're going to stage a raid deep into Gallente territory. In order to mask the movements of our forces, however, we first need to wipe out their pickets and patrols. We could do this with our own ships, of course, but that might alert the enemy to our plans. A lone, talented capsuleer, on the other hand, would make short work of them and raise less suspicion.

I've uploaded the coordinates of the stepping-off point of our raid into your nav-computer. I want you to go there and destroy all of the enemy ships you find. Be advised that they may try to bring in reinforcements, but that should be no problem for someone of your caliber. Are you up to the task?

139634.en: This is terrible! Our operations time-table is totally disrupted. I hold you personally responsible, {[character]player.name}

139635.en: Excellent. Get out there and make it happen. The sooner those enemy patrols are out of the way, the sooner we can launch the raid.

139636.en: Well done, {[character]player.name}. You'll no doubt be happy to hear that early reports indicate our raid has been a stunning success!

139637.en: Suit yourself, though I'd like to remind you that the details of our discussion are to be kept in the strictest of confidence. Operational security, you understand. If it gets back to me that you've been blabbing about this raid, there will be hell to pay. You are dismissed.

139638.en: Due to your inability to deal with this assignment in a timely fashion, the entire raid has been scrubbed. It may be quite some time before another opportunity this good arises. Whatever you were doing, I hope it was important.

139639.en: Based on your lack of response, I take it that this assignment did not interest you. Had you been considerate enough to simply tell us that up front, we could have gotten someone else. As it is, we've had to scrub the entire raid.

139643.en: All opposition has been swept away. Where's my reward?

139644.en: Hmm, this isn't really what I had in mind. Maybe next time.

139645.en: I'm afraid you're going to have to find someone else to deal with your problem. I have more important things to do.

139646.en: I hear you've got some important work to be done. How can I help?

139647.en:
Even in times of conflict with an external enemy we still find ourselves in competition with other “friendly” corporations. One such corporation is providing security for a repair outpost. They got that security contract by underbidding us. Go to the site, destroy their entire security force, then destroy the repair outpost. With such an abysmal failure on their record, they'll never get another security contract in this sector again.

And who knows, maybe we'll get the reconstruction contract for the replacement outpost as well.

139648.en:
As a matter of fact, I do. As I'm sure you're aware, even in times of conflict with an external enemy we still find ourselves in competition with other “friendly” corporations. One such corporation is providing security for a repair outpost in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. They got that security contract by underbidding us. I want you to head out there, destroy their entire security force, then destroy the repair outpost. With such an abysmal failure on their record, they'll never get another security contract in this sector again.

And who knows, maybe we'll get the reconstruction contract for the replacement outpost as well.

So what do you say? Do you think you can handle this job? I can make it worth your while.

139649.en: I knew you couldn't hack it. Maybe you should look for a different line of work.

139650.en: Good. Now get out there and wreck something.

139651.en: You really are a ruthless one, {[character]player.name}. {[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name} is always looking for pilots like you. Look me up again if you ever need work.

139652.en: Too bad. I guess I'll have to find someone with a stronger stomach or looser morals. You are dismissed.

139653.en: I take it from your inability to complete the job we discussed that you had second thoughts about it. I'm not paying you to grapple with your morals. Next time, just decline the job so that I can find someone with the guts to actually pull the trigger.

139654.en: When you didn't respond to my offer, I found someone willing to undertake the job. He did what we asked of him, but got caught in the process, implicating us in the attack. Amateur. I wish you'd been able to help us, because I know you'd have done the job right. Oh well, maybe next time.

139657.en: No problem. I'll do this job and sleep with a clear conscience.

139658.en: I've taken care of your little problem. Now pay up.

139659.en: I don't think I'm cut out for that kind of work, sorry.

139660.en: I've had second thoughts. I'm not going to do this job after all.

139661.en: Yes. Do you have an assignment for me?

139662.en: Head for your assigned patrol sector coordinates. Wait there and destroy any enemy ships that show up. Make sure none of them escape!

139663.en: As you may be aware, the Gallente Navy has been making increasingly bold reconnaissance patrols into Caldari space. This is unacceptable and must be stopped immediately. Unfortunately, given our own Navy's operational tempo, we don't have the forces to spare to cover every avenue of hostile approach. That's where you come in, {[character]player.name}. I want you to patrol an area where we've had reports of hostile recon patrols recently. Think you can handle that?

139664.en: Very disappointing, {[character]player.name}. A true patriot would have finished the task for the good of the State. Your unwillingness to perform when called upon will be noted in your permanent record, I assure you.

139665.en: Excellent! This will take some of the pressure off our forces and allow them to get down to the important work of striking at the enemy.

139666.en: I knew you could be counted upon, {[character]player.name}. Your sense of patriotism has been duly noted. Please accept this reward, and do not hesitate to contact me again in the future should you need work. {[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name} always has opportunities for enterprising pilots.

139667.en: As I suspected, talking to you was a waste of time. Be gone from my sight.

139668.en: Your laxness has cost the State dearly. While you were off haring about, a small enemy raiding force seems to have slipped through your assigned sector and destroyed three commerce vessels. I hope in the future you won't be so cavalier with the safety of sovereign Caldari territory.

139669.en: While the ability to strike out offensively at the enemy may not matter to you, rest assured it is of the utmost importance to us. Due to your lack of response, main-line Naval forces have been tasked with patrolling. While nothing catastrophic has come from you leaving us hanging this time, it has caused an inevitable delay in offensive operations.

139672.en: Well, it may not be glamorous, but for the good of the State I'll do it.

139673.en: The sector assigned to me is clear.  No enemy vessels escaped.

139674.en: Patrol work? Talk about wasting time.  I have no interest in your mission.

139675.en: I'm afraid something more pressing has come up.

139676.en: I've heard you have ample work for skilled pilots. Is that true, or are you wasting my time and money as well?

139677.en:
Recently a long-range reconnaissance patrol was sent out deep behind enemy lines. While trying to exfiltrate to friendly lines, our recon ship inadvertently jumped into the middle of a pitched battle. The ship and its cargo were lost. Go to the site of the battle, find the wreck of our reconnaissance ship, and salvage the data chips from the remains. This task will require the use of a Salvager module.

Beware that there may be other scavengers or interested parties in the area. Take whatever steps you feel are necessary to bring the data back safely.

139678.en:
For someone of your caliber? Always.

Recently a long-range reconnaissance patrol was sent out deep behind enemy lines. Everything went fine until the return trip. While trying to exfiltrate to friendly lines, our recon ship inadvertently jumped into the middle of a pitched battle in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. In the resulting confusion, the recon ship was destroyed and the vital intelligence it was carrying was lost. I want you to go out to the site of the battle, find the wreck of our reconnaissance ship, and salvage the data chips from the remains. This task will require the use of a Salvager module.

Beware that there may be other scavengers or interested parties in the area. Take whatever steps you feel are necessary to bring the data back safely. Do you think this is something you can handle?

139679.en: That is unfortunate, {[character]player.name}. I just hope that the data didn't fall into the wrong hands.

139680.en: Good.  Just be careful out there. You might not be the only scavenger picking through the wreckage.

139681.en: My thanks, {[character]player.name}. I'll get this to our intelligence analysts immediately.

139682.en: That's a shame. Ah, well, maybe next time.

139683.en: I can only assume from your lack of response that you were unable to recover the intelligence we discussed. No matter, I'm sure you made a valiant effort. I only hope that the data was destroyed and some battlefield scavenger friendly to the Gallente doesn't run across it.

139684.en: When you did not respond to my employment offer, I was forced to go with someone else. That pilot responded promptly and performed admirably. You would do well to follow her example in the future.

139687.en: No problem. I'll get on it right away.

139689.en: Sorry, that's not really something I can help you with right now.

139690.en: I've got bad news. I won't be able to recover your data.

139691.en: I'm looking for work. Have you got anything for me?

139692.en:
In recent days, we believe one of our repair and resupply depots has been under surveillance by suspected members of one of a terrorist group, and we think they're going to attempt some kind of sabotage. We could quadruple our security, but that might tip them off. Instead, I want you to go there and keep an eye out for them. If you see anything suspicious, you are authorized to destroy the vessel in question immediately. We don't want to take any chances.

Once you've destroyed the suspicious transport, recover any cargo and bring it to me. We might be able to use it as evidence of Gallente involvement.

139693.en:
A hefty reward, if you're successful.

For some time now there have been rumors of Caldari citizens who are unhappy with the way the State is run. Some of them are no doubt Gallente sympathizers, and we're certain the Gallente are giving them aid through third-parties. Either way, they're traitors to the State, and we must be vigilant to keep them from disrupting our operations.

In recent days, we believe one of our repair and resupply depots has been under surveillance by suspected members of one of these traitor groups, and we think they're going to attempt some kind of sabotage. We could quadruple our security, but that might tip them off. Instead, I want you to go there and keep an eye out for them. If you see anything suspicious, you are authorized to destroy the vessel in question immediately. We don't want to take any chances.

Once you've destroyed the suspicious transport, recover any cargo and bring it to me. We might be able to use it as evidence of Gallente involvement.

139694.en: Good. And be careful, these people will stop at nothing to accomplish their goals.

139695.en: You've done well, {[character]player.name}. Check back later for another assignment.

139696.en: You won't be needed for that job after all. Several hours ago, we started receiving reports of people dying from a bizarre sickness, and already the death toll has risen sharply. Apparently the terrorists were successful in their plot. In addition to the human cost, we've had to scramble to set up quarantine and shift our resupply operations elsewhere. Dozens of vessels have come and gone from that depot, and any of them could have been exposed to the virus. This has truly been a disaster.

139697.en: You won't be needed for that job after all. Several hours ago, we started receiving reports of people dying from a bizarre sickness, and already the death toll has risen sharply. Apparently the terrorists were successful in their plot. In addition to the human cost, we've had to scramble to set up quarantine and shift our resupply operations elsewhere. Dozens of vessels have come and gone from that depot, and any of them could have been exposed to the virus. This has truly been a disaster.

139700.en: No problem. Those terrorist scum won't get through on my watch.

139701.en: The terrorists have been dealt with. Here's the viral agent they were trying to spread.

139702.en: Patrol duty? I can't think of a worse way to spend my time. Find someone else to do it.

139703.en: On second thought, this job sounds awful. Find someone else to do it.

139704.en: Maybe. What's in it for me?

139705.en:
Open conflict now exists between the Gallente and Caldari empires. Both empires are fighting for the systems between them, often sending forces into the other's territory to probe for weakness, to secure forward bases and to exploit resources.

Forward bases built by one empire in the space of another are usually represented as private business concerns to avoid any conflict with Concord.

139706.en: The Situation between the Caldari and the Gallente

139707.en: How am I supposed to get that data now? I was depending on you! Failures like this will not help your reputation with {[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name}.

139708.en: Good!  I can't begin to tell you how important this mission is. Fly safe.

139709.en: We received the data.  You did well out there. We'll examine it, but in the mean time, here is your reward.

139710.en: I can't begin to tell you how important this mission was. Your refusal to carry it out disappoints me, and it doesn't help your reputation with {[npcOrganization]agentCorpID.name}.

139711.en: The opportunity to secure the data from Caldari base 464 has passed and I haven't heard from you. You disappoint me greatly.

139712.en: I can't begin to tell you how important this mission was.  I'm sorry you didn't accept it, but I am more concerned about the fact your delay in responding has caused us to miss the opportunity to gather the data.

139714.en: I didn't hear back from you!

139716.en: I have the data from station 464.

139717.en: It sounds like station 464 is too heavily fortified for me to handle.

139718.en: Station 464 is too heavily fortified for me to complete the mission. I'm sorry but you will have to give this to someone else.

139719.en: I heard you have been looking for me?

139720.en:
Some Caldari terrorists are in sympathy with the Ammarian faith. Flying out of Caldari space they attack Gallente civilian outpost and miners in an effort to terrorize those who reject the faith. They believe they are engaged in a holy war to rid New Eden of unbelievers.

This, however, is not the only brand of terrorism coming out of Caldari space. Increasingly terrorism from the state is based on intense nationalism born of hatred towards the Gallente. Some of these are thought to be followers of Tibus Heth and the national ideals he purportedly espouses.

139721.en: Caldari terrorists have been attacking miners in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. They must be destroyed, along with the bunker they are using as their base.

139723.en:
{[character]player.name} we have located a Caldari terrorist cell. They have been harassing nearby miners for some time using hit and run tactics. Now that we know where their base is it's time to take care of this problem. I want you to fly out and destroy them and the bunker they are using as their base.

I will upload the coordinates to your Neocom. Be careful out there, but teach these terrorists a lesson they will not forget!

139724.en: Sick, huh? Don't make a habit of it; I can't use pod pilots who are “sick” all the time.

139725.en: I'll get the word out to the miners. I'm sure they will be happy to know those terrorist have met a proper end. Here's your reward; just don't spend it all in one place, ok?

139726.en: I'm disappointed in you. I really thought you were the person for this job. I depend on you, but when you turn down missions it makes me think that you don't value the work I give you.

139727.en: I've been expecting to hear from you about dealing with these Caldari terrorist. According to intelligence, they have moved their base and we're back to hunting them. I'm disappointed in you. More importantly my boss is mad at me for choosing you for this mission. If I suffer, you suffer.

139728.en: I've been expecting you to accept the mission I offered you. Now the terrorist have moved their base and we're back to hunting them. I'm disappointed in you. More importantly my boss is mad at me for choosing you for this mission. If I suffer, you suffer.

139731.en: Terrorists huh? I don't like terrorists; especially Caldari terrorist. It will be a pleasure to take care of this for you.

139732.en: I've killed all the terrorists and destroyed their bunker. They will not bother the miners again.

139733.en: Terrorists? Pirates I can handle, but I don't want any part of a mission against terrorists. Find someone else to handle this.

139734.en: I'm sick so I can't complete this mission. Perhaps it's the flu or maybe just allergies.

139735.en: I need some cash. Do you have a job for me?

139736.en: An old mining site has just been rediscovered. Soon archeologists will arrive to properly explore the site, but I want you to go in and do a preliminary survey. I have uploaded the location of the site to your Neocom. Bring back anything of interest that you find.

139737.en:
A mining site that may date back millennia has been found. Soon Archeologists will arrive to properly explore the site, but I want you to go in and do a preliminary survey. I have uploaded the location of the site to your Neocom. Bring back anything of interest that you may find.

The Amarrians are exploring the area and may have found the site as well, so go in ready for combat just in case they are there already.

This mission is of upmost importance to the Federation.

139738.en: This will not look good on your record, but I'll do as you request and find someone else to do this for me.

139739.en: Good! Just remember to be careful out there.

139740.en: Ok, give me a chance to look over this map and then get back to me for another mission.

139741.en: Ok, I'll get someone else to do it.

139742.en: I can't understand why you haven't gotten back to me about the mission I sent you on. It's too late now for you to help in this matter so I will get someone else to do it.

139743.en: I can't understand why you haven't gotten back to me about the mission I offered you. It's too late now for you to help in this matter so I will get someone else to do it.

139746.en: This sounds interesting. I'll take care of it for you.

139747.en: I arrived at the site. All I found was this old map.

139748.en: I'm sorry, but I'm not an archeologist. I'll pass on this one.

139749.en: I've lost interest in your mission. You will have to find someone else to do it.

139750.en: I got your message. What can I do for you?

139751.en: The map you found led us to an old observation post. I want you to do a preliminary survey before the Amarr get there, and bring back anything of interest that you find.

139752.en:
The map you found has the location of several ancient sites on it. One in particular is circled; an old observation post. Again, archeologists will soon arrive to properly explore the site, but once again I want you to go in and do a preliminary survey. I have uploaded the location of the site to your Neocom. Bring back anything of interest that you may find.

The Amarr are still exploring the area and may have found the site as well so go in ready for combat just in case they are there already.

I want to remind you that this mission is of utmost importance to the Federation.

139753.en: This will not look good on your record, but I'll do as you request and find someone else to do this for me.

139754.en: Good! Just remember to be careful out there.

139755.en: Ok, give me a chance to look over this map in conjunction with the first one and then get back to me for another mission.

139756.en: Ok, I'll get someone else to do it.

139757.en: I can't understand why you haven't gotten back to me about the mission I sent you on. It's too late now for you to help in this matter so I will get someone else to do it. This will not look good on your permanent record.

139758.en: I can't understand why you haven't gotten back to me about the mission I offered you. It's too late now for you to help in this matter so I will get someone else to do it. This will not look good on your permanent record.

139761.en: This is getting more and more interesting; I'll take care of it for you.

139762.en: I arrived at the site, but all I found was this old map. It seems to be a second half to the other map we found.

139763.en: I'm sorry, but I'm not an archeologist. I'll pass on this one.

139764.en: I've lost interest in your mission. You will have to find someone else to do it.

139765.en: Did you find anything interesting on that old map?

139766.en: Go out to the asteroid field, confirm that the vault is there and see if it has been opened or not. If the Amarr show up, destroy them all.

139767.en:
When the two maps are put together they point to a mined out asteroid field. According to the map the field contains an ancient vault. We need to find out whether or not it has been located and opened.

I want you to go out to the asteroid field, confirm that the vault is there and see if it has been opened or not. I have uploaded the location of the site to your Neocom.

The Amarrians are exploring the area and may have found the site as well so go in ready for combat. If they are there then destroy them all lest the Amarrians should get to the vault before we do.

I want to remind you that this mission is of upmost importance to the Federation.

139768.en: This will not look good on your record, but I'll do as you request and find someone else to do this for me.

139769.en: Good! Just remember to be careful out there.

139770.en: Good work! Your part in this is done. We will have to let the archeologist take over now. Here is your reward.

139771.en: Ok, I'll get someone else to do it, but this will not look good on your permanent record.

139772.en: I can't understand why you haven't gotten back to me about the mission I sent you on. It's too late now for you to help in this matter so I will get someone else to do it. This will not look good on your permanent record.

139773.en: I can't understand why you haven't gotten back to me about the mission I offered you. It's too late now for you to help in this matter so I will get someone else to do it. You disappoint me greatly.

139776.en: I'll take care of it for you.

139777.en: I arrived at the site and the Amarr were already there. I dealt with them; and yes, the vault is there and is intact.

139778.en: I'm sorry, but I'm not an archeologist. I'll pass on this one.

139779.en: I've lost interest in your mission. You will have to find someone else to do it.

139781.en:
I recently lost contact with one of our deep cover operatives embedded in enemy space. A delay of this length can only mean one thing: that he has been discovered and killed, or worse for us, captured.

We need to find out which, and fast before he talks. We have a contact within the administrative department who we tasked with retrieving the information and have arranged a meeting with him at {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}.

Go to the co-ordinates provided, meet the contact and retrieve the information.

139782.en: Calm the hell down, I'll sort it.

139783.en: Time is of the essence, get over their now.

139784.en:
I recently lost contact with one of our deep cover operatives embedded in enemy space. A delay of this length can only mean one thing: that he has been discovered and killed, or worse for us, captured.

We need to find out which, and fast before he talks. We have a contact within the administrative department who we tasked with retrieving the information and have arranged a meeting with him at {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}.

Go to the co-ordinates provided, meet the contact and retrieve the information.

139786.en: The bad news is it was an ambush. The good news is they didn't know who they were messing with.

139787.en: That's great! I mean, it's too bad about our operative and all, but I bet they'll think twice before they try to pull that stunt again.

139788.en: Can yous say "trap?" Not doing it.

139789.en: I've had enough of this, I quit. Oh, and your guy is probably dead.

139791.en: Never let an inconvenience like death prevent you from finishing a mission.

139792.en:
I recently lost contact with one of our deep cover operatives embedded in enemy space. A delay of this length can only mean one thing: that he has been discovered and killed, or worse for us, captured.

We need to find out which, and fast before he talks. We have a contact within the administrative department who we tasked with retrieving the information and have arranged a meeting with him at {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}.

Go to the co-ordinates provided, meet the contact and retrieve the information.

139793.en: Calm the hell down, I'll sort it.

139794.en: Time is of the essence, get over their now.

139795.en:
I recently lost contact with one of our deep cover operatives embedded in enemy space. A delay of this length can only mean one thing: that he has been discovered and killed, or worse for us, captured.

We need to find out which, and fast before he talks. We have a contact within the administrative department who we tasked with retrieving the information and have arranged a meeting with him at {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}.

139857.en:
Our team has cracked the enemy communications and found the information we need. It turns out our spy is alive and under heavy guard in a detention facility in the {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} system. We had no idea they even had a facility here; I'm not sure how they managed to sneak one there without us knowing, but that's not important. The spy's last reports hinted at him getting close to something very disturbing. The information he has could prove invaluable to us.

Our limited intel on the area has revealed it to be a high security facility. They obviously consider our man a high priority. I want you to break into the detention facility, fight your way to the prison and retrieve our man. Expect some serious resistance here.

139863.en: But we were so close! I'm sure our info was good this time.

139864.en: I was all ready to rescue him, but then I thought, "Screw this. I'm going to go watch a holoreel instead."

139937.en:
There is one more task before we can bring this to a close. We have a leak. Four of our convoys have been intercepted and destroyed in the past hour. These convoys had special contents which I won't go into now, but suffice to say their route was not well publicized and only known to a few people. One of those people was our man you went to all the trouble of rescuing.

He doubtless broke under interrogation. Now the trust we invest in agents of such level has been broken. He knows too much, which makes him too dangerous to be kept alive. We have arranged him to meet you, his rescuer, at these co-ordinates under the pretense that you have the information for his next assignment.

I want you to kill this man. This is national security.

139939.en: I don't take any pleasure in this.

139940.en: That victim of fate won't be returning for the sequel.

139941.en: Man, you're one scary egger, you know that?

139943.en: So this guy was tortured, broken physically and psychologically, and now you just want me to off him? How about you go to hell?

139944.en: Oh, sure, now you have a conscience.

139946.en: How is morally questionable back-stabbery boring?

139989.en: You'll get what I promised you and not one isk more; but I do appreciate your work.

139991.en:
What gives? I expected that monument to be destroyed by now? I guess you don't care about Caldari roaming around our space.

Forget about it; I will get someone else to do the job.

139992.en: What gives? I expected that monument to be destroyed by now, and you haven't even decided if you are going to do it or not. Forget about it. I will get someone else to do the job.

139996.en: It's done. Due to the sensitivity and secrecy of what I know, I expect a large reward.

139997.en: I'm not keen on destroying any monument. Give this to someone else.

139998.en: I've thought about it and I'm not keen on destroying any sacred site.

139999.en: Hello {[character]agentID.name}; that is good because I'm looking for some work.

140000.en: Our supporters in Amarr space have managed to smuggle out some slaves. I need you to go to {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} and destroy the Amarr pursuit team.

140001.en: I have some work for you. Our supporters in Amarr space have managed to smuggle out some slaves. The Amarr are in close pursuit, and the slaves are in grave danger of being caught and returned. I need you to go to {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} and destroy the Amarr pursuit team. Be quick about it lest they catch the slaves. Show no mercy!

140002.en: That sounds a lot like prejudice to me.

140003.en: That's the spirit! Remember this mission is an important one to the Federation.

140004.en: The slaves made it to one of our outposts, but they are not safe yet. I need you to get back with me immediately for another mission.

140005.en: That sounds a lot like prejudice to me.

140006.en: Your inaction has led to the slaves being recaptured by the Amarr. We were depending on you, and you let us down.

140007.en: Your delay in getting back to me about protecting the escaped slaves has led to them being recaptured by the Amarr.

140010.en: Destroy the Amarr; right, I'll take care of it for you.

140011.en: The Amarr are dead. Did the slaves make it okay?

140012.en: I don't approve of slavery, but I'm not interested in seeing more Minmatar in the Federation. Get someone else to do this for you.

140013.en: I don't approve of slavery, but I'm not interested in seeing more Minmatar in the Federation. Get someone else to do this for you.

140014.en: You are welcome. Why did you send for me?

140015.en: The Amarr are threatening to attack the station in an effort to reclaim their slaves. I need you to transport them to another station where they will be safe should the Amarrians attack.

140016.en:
The slaves are here on the station with us. The Amarr are threatening to raid us for them. I need you to transport the slaves to another station for everyone's safety.

Some of the escaped slaves are highly skilled. The Federation is very interested in having them on our side. Take every precaution.

140017.en: That sounds a lot like prejudice to me.

140019.en: That's good, because we are going to have to deal them with as they still threaten the safety of the slaves.

140020.en: That sounds a lot like prejudice to me.

140021.en: Your inaction has led to the slaves being recaptured by the Amarr.

140022.en: Your inaction has led to the slaves being recaptured by the Amarrians.

140025.en: The slaves are safe. I'm looking forward to dealing with those Amarr.

140026.en: I don't approve of slavery, but I'm not interested in seeing more Minmatar in the Federation. Get someone else to do this for you.

140027.en: I don't approve of slavery, but I'm not interested in seeing more Minmatar in the Federation. Get someone else to do this for you.

140028.en: Ok, I'm back. What can I do for you now?

140029.en: Damn you. Get out of here.

140030.en: Get to it. We're all counting on you.

140031.en: Damn you. Get out of here.

140032.en: Your inaction has led to a bloody battle that we barely won. Thanks for leaving us to die.

140033.en: Your delay has led to a bloody battle that we barely won. Thanks for leaving us to die.

140036.en: It will be my pleasure to take care of that strike force.

140037.en: The Amarr strike force has been decimated. Where is my reward?

140038.en: Hey, the slaves are safe. The Amarr are your problem.

140039.en: Hey, the slaves are safe. The Amarr are your problem.

140041.en: The Gallente are using a radio telescope to spy on us. Destroy the Gallente telescope.  Try to avoid engaging any Gallente ships unless you are attacked.

140042.en:
As a matter of fact, I do.

We've located a nest of Gallente spies. They're using a radio telescope to keep track of our activities in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}.

I want you to go out there and destroy that radio telescope. Try to avoid hostile contact with the Gallente spies, but if they attack-- well, you do what you have to do. It'll serve them right for spying on their allies.

140043.en: I suppose I can understand your reluctance to engage our allies, even in spite of this intrusion.

140044.en: Good! Be careful out there; and remember, avoid combat with the Gallente if at all possible.

140045.en: Perhaps they'll be a little less nosy in the future.

140047.en: You've allowed the Gallente another week of spying on us. I can't wait any longer. I'll get someone else to take care of this, but in future, please to not take on missions unless you intend to complete them in a timely manner.

140048.en: This radio telescope has to be taken care of. I can't wait any longer for you to make up your mind. Your delay has allowed the Gallente another week of spying on us.

140051.en: I'll take care of this for you.

140052.en: I've destroyed the telescope. Unfortunately, I also had to destroy some Gallente.

140053.en: No thanks. They may be willing to violate the trust of their allies, but I have higher standards.

140054.en: I've reconsidered striking out against our allies. Maybe you can pull in a diplomat on this one.

140056.en: A mad scientist is attempting to clone a member of a noble family. Find and destroy him, his facility, and any who protect him. He cannot be allowed to go through with his heretical experiments.

140058.en:
I do, though it is of a most distressing nature. Recently, rumors have come to my attention that some... scientist has taken it upon himself to attempt to clone a member of a noble Amarr family.

This heretic must not be allowed to go through with his blasphemous experiments. I need you to be the instrument of God's will in this matter.

Destroy his facility completely. Let him answer to God for his actions.

140059.en: You cannot interfere with God's will.

140060.en: You will be greatly rewarded for your faith and hard work.

140061.en: I had faith that you would.

140062.en: You cannot interfere with God's will.

140063.en: You have failed to destroy this blaspheming madman and his sick experiments. I will find someone else who is willing to do God's work.

140064.en: You have waited too long to give me an answer. I will find someone else who is willing to do God's work before it is too late.

140067.en: I will take on this responsibility.

140068.en: The heretic's destruction will serve as a lesson to other blasphemers. I have done as God willed.

140069.en: I don't have time to chase after madmen. Find someone else.

140070.en: I don't have time to chase after madmen. Find someone else.

140071.en: Do you have work for me?

140072.en: The mining operations in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} have been being systematically poached. Find and destroy these intruders.

140073.en:
I do. The mining operations in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} are being systematically poached. Miners are driven from the area, or attacked if they will not leave.

These poachers must be completely and utterly destroyed. Make them an example, so that no one will dare think they can take what is rightfully ours.

140074.en: I am shocked that you will let this insult stand.

140075.en: Praises to God! I knew I could count on you to deal with those scurrilous interlopers. Here is your reward. You have truly earned it!

140076.en: I am shocked that you will let this insult stand.

140077.en: I thought I could count on you to do this task, but apparently I was wrong.

140078.en: I thought I could count on you to do this task, but apparently I was wrong.

140081.en: I will gladly do this task.

140084.en: If it's so important to you, do it yourself.

140085.en: Do you have work for me?

140086.en: We know that one of the enemy fleets in this area has copies of the data that we need. You will need to penetrate their base of operations and retrieve the tactical information sheet from the outpost there. Bring that back to me and we can get the planning for this raid underway.

140087.en:
The Amarr are still threatening to attack the station. Destroy their strike force.

We read one dreadnought with them, though she seems to be playing support. Pay her no mind. We've got a little surprise in store for her. Watch for instructions after you clean up the rest.

140088.en:
The Amarr either do not know or do not care that the slaves have been transported to another station. They are still threatening to attack. I need you to destroy the Amarr strike force.

We read one dreadnought with them, though she seems to be playing support. Pay her no mind. We've got a little surprise in store for her. Watch for instructions after you clean up the rest.

140089.en: Nukes are always fun, huh? You handled yourself well. See if those Amarr bastards try anything like that again.

140090.en: Confirm or deny the rumor of a secret Amarr base in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} , and see if your agent has further instructions.

140091.en:
I need you to do some reconnaissance work for me. There is a rumor that the Amarr have set up a secret base in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}.

I want you to go to {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} and see if you can find a base there. If you do, I'll have additional instructions.

140092.en:
I didn't think you were a quitter, but I see I'll have to reevaluate my view of you. Because you are a quitter.

Because you quit.

Quitter.

140095.en: Well, I can find scouts anywhere.

140096.en: I'm giving this to someone else.

140097.en: I can't sit around waiting for you to accept this mission.

140101.en: I took care of that base.

140102.en: This is not the kind of thing I want to be doing right now.

140103.en: I don't have the time right now to complete this mission. I quit!

140104.en: What can I do for you?

140105.en:
Right, well, that didn't go quite to plan. Looks like we're going to have to do this the hard way.

There is a relay station that our enemies think is well hidden in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. We found out about it recently and have been intercepting communication traffic from it. However, we have trouble decoding most of the traffic and we need the decoder which is held inside the communications hub, each decoder is unique and lasts for a limited time.

So the only way to get a hold of this device is to manually hack into the communications hub using a Data Analyzer. I want you to go to the co-ordinates provided, retrieve the decoder and destroy the installation.

We're still up against the clock here. Get this done.
