141868.en:
Our sources have caught wind of the situation, {[character]player.name}, though I'm glad you contacted us. We won't go public with this information yet, as that would be against our ethics as journalists. However, we will aid you in uncovering information on the missing child. Senator Ardanne has not always been kind to the media, but there's no reason to hold a grudge against him in a time like this.

We've been keeping tabs on the Pator 6 for a while now. They're mostly low-level criminals, but their name has been popping up a lot recently, especially in relation to kidnapping cases. I haven't seen them do anything this high profile, though.

Our first course of action is to see if we can plant a bug in a known Pator 6 hangout. Hodts Ergre, one of our more experienced investigative reporters, managed to acquire an access code to this place. We'd like you to place a covert recording device in their hideout. Hodts will open the gate, and you'll sneak in and plant the goods. This is a stealth operation, so it would probably be best if you fly something inconspicuous. I'm not saying you should go out there completely defenseless; as you know there are more pirates around here than just the Pator 6.

You can take any ship you want, but I highly recommend a frigate-sized vessel. A battleship will definitely tip them off that you‘re up to no good.

141869.en: Use your cloaking device as much as possible when travelling in this area. You can't get hit if you can't be seen, right? Above all, be careful out there.

141870.en: We can't keep this story under wraps for very long. Word has a tendency to spread rather quickly, and the difference between rumor and fact can get muddied. I'd hate to see something like that happen here, especially when there's a kid's life at stake. Would be a shame, you know?

141871.en: We can't keep this story under wraps for very long. Word has a tendency to spread rather quickly, and the difference between rumor and fact can get muddied. I'd hate to see something like that happen here, especially when there's a kid's life at stake. Would be a shame, you know? Especially if it involved a frightened and shamed capsuleer.

141872.en: Did you plant the covert recording device yet?

141873.en:
Hodts is dead? Oh no. No. That is tragic. He was the bravest reporter I've ever worked with.

Please give me a minute. I'm rather shocked about this news. Come back to me in a few moments.

141874.en: Veine Coructie, an editor at the Scope station in Vitrauze, has caught wind of this kidnapping business and is willing to help. I'll accompany Hodts Ergre, an investigative reporter, and plant a bug in a known Pator 6 hangout. I'm in lowsec territory, so I need to watch out for pirates and other criminals.

141875.en: Veine Coructie, an editor at the Scope station in Vitrauze, caught wind of this kidnapping business. I escorted Hodts Ergre, an investigative reporter, to a known Pator 6 hangout. We were ambushed, and Hodts was killed. He did not die in vain, however, as I managed to gain access to the hangout and place the covert recording device in their hideout.

141876.en:
The bug appears to be working well. We've been picking up a lot of messages from the Pator 6. For such a relatively small-time gang, they have quite a large network established. I don't know why we haven't noticed them earlier. We'll have to keep this bug going for a bit. There are a few breaking stories in there, or at least some info we could sell.

While the Pator 6 has a rather large foothold throughout the region, we heard one system repeated over and over again: {[location]dungeonLocationID.name}. I asked some of my sources in that system, and they sent me the coordinates of some sort of junkyard with a lot of traffic from unlicensed Minmatar pilots. I have a distinct feeling that the kid is there, or at least he was at one point...

Hang on. We just intercepted a message from our bug. Looks like the Pator 6 is expecting company soon. Time to crash the party. See who the meeting is with, and try to bring back something we can pin on the gang. We need evidence that Ralie was there if we're going to bust this case open. Gotta warn you, though: A battleship won't be much good here. From what I've seen, they have a means of keeping battleships out of their hideouts. Thus, don't take one on this mission.

141877.en: The Pator 6 is working for somebody big. A high-profile crime like this is well above their level. I don't know who could have orchestrated this, but I think we're about to find out. Either way, we need hard evidence in order to corroborate our story. That's Journalism 101, my friend.

141878.en: You'd make a terrible reporter, you know. No guts, no story.

141879.en: We were so close to the big scoop. Do you have any idea how big those ratings would have been?

141880.en: Well, who is the Pator 6 working with?

141881.en: The Syndicate? In this space? That's practically unheard of. What would they want from Senator Ardanne? At least we have proof now, hard evidence that we can use. That's some great reporting, {[character]player.name}. You know, when this is over, we could use your investigation skills. You can't teach those at any Journo School.

141882.en: The covert recording device appears to be working as planned. The Pator 6 is really busy in this region. With the information gleaned through the bug and Veine's incessant networking, the location of the gang's major headquarters was finally discovered. Or at least we think it's their HQ. A last minute message from the bug presages an important meeting between the Pator 6 and their associates. If I make it in time, I can learn who the gang is working for, or at least get some evidence of the kidnapping for use against them.

141883.en: The bug I planted worked as planned. Veine Coructie, using that device in conjunction with his massive network of contacts, managed to discover the Pator 6's headquarters. When I flew there, I witnessed a meeting between the gang and their criminal associates. Looks like the Syndicate are behind this. I don't know why they'd be involved in this region; this situation may be bigger than I imagined. Even though they attacked me, I managed to escape with some evidence that Ralie was with the Pator 6. This evidence should help in getting closer to that poor kid.

141884.en:
Truth is the fundamental goal of any good reporter, and we've uncovered enough of it to create a media storm. The power of the press is unprecedented in its ability to sway the general public, create massive sympathy for an unknown issue, and to create a massive backlash against nefarious groups. When we present this evidence on the holovids, there's no hope for the Syndicate. Their reputation will be ruined if anything happens to the kid. This is the power of the media.

We have a satellite station that we like to use for these important broadcasts. It's safely hidden in a secret location in case there's any blowback from our special reports. Take this evidence and drop it off at the station. We'll use that to raise awareness of this case, blow it right open, and turn the wrath of the unwashed masses on the Syndicate.

141885.en: Of course, we'll get plenty of good ratings, too. That's the most important thing.

141886.en: This is our chance to put the spotlight on a delicate situation and you bail out at the last minute? I'll never understand you eggers.

141887.en: This is our chance to put the spotlight on a delicate situation and you bail out at the last minute? I'll never understand you eggers.

141888.en: We need that evidence for our expose. Where is it?

141889.en: Damn Black Eagles. I don't know how they knew about our satellite location. This does not bode well for our business. Those rat bastards are no good at all. I might have to push my story on them a little earlier than expected. They'll learn how much power we really have…

141890.en: The Scope is ready to run a full expose on this kidnapping case, direct via holovid from one of their secret satellite stations. I'm supposed to deliver the evidence to the station for the report. The hope is that this will shed the spotlight on the kidnapping, forcing it into the public arena and showing the Syndicate in a terrible light. If anything happens to Ralie from here, the Syndicate will never be able to live it down.

141891.en: I delivered the evidence to the Scope station, but the Black Eagles intercepted the package shortly afterward. The Feds have stepped in and are forcing their agenda on me. I don't like the way they're handling this, but it looks like I have no choice. There's no use trusting authority.

141892.en:
That Black Eagle agent gave me the name of a TransStellar Shipping employee: Ascain Adeset. Looking in to our records, she's had a pretty nasty past, especially in the human trafficking business. She had a rather spectacular arrest about twenty years ago. Looks like she's been clean for a few years and is doing some legit business now. I'll bet that she turned rat in prison.

She's currently located in Mesybier. Best to follow the Feds and talk to her.

141893.en:
That Black Eagle agent gave me the name of a TransStellar Shipping employee: Ascain Adeset. Looking in to our records, she's had a pretty nasty past, especially in the human trafficking business. She had a rather spectacular arrest about twenty years ago. Looks like she's been clean for a few years and is doing some legit business now. I'll bet that she turned rat in prison.

Ascain's currently located in Mesybier. Best to follow the Feds and talk to her.

141894.en: Good luck. Let me know when you find the kid. I'll make sure we spread the story across all the holovids in the Federation. You'll be a national hero, {[character]player.name}.

141895.en: I don't blame you. This rat sounds untrustworthy. But think of the kid, will ya?

141896.en: You can't quit now. What'll happen to that poor boy?

141897.en: Have you talked to the Black Eagles' rat yet?

141898.en: The Black Eagles want me to talk to Ascain Adeset. She's a reformed human trafficker working for TransStellar in Mesybier. I don't trust her; she sounds like a rat for the Feds.

141899.en: The Black Eagles wanted me to talk to Ascain Adeset. She's a reformed human trafficker working for TransStellar in Mesybier. I don't trust her; she sounds like a rat for the Feds. I met up with her in Mesybier, on the border between Essence and Placid.

141901.en: Good guys. If you see this text in-game, defect it.

141902.en: Bad guys. If you see this text in-game, defect it.

141903.en: Upon the instructions of his intermediary Aursa Kunivuri, I met with Katsen Isha to discuss the possibility of future work with him and Nugoeihuvi.

141904.en: As proof to Katsen Isha of my reliability and discretion, I moved some potentially questionable cargo to the Nugoeihuvi HQ in Josameto. A biohazard team was on standby to receive the goods.

141905.en:
After hearing my story and speaking with her superiors, Arikio Kuretsu of Hyasyoda asked me to return the stolen booster formulas as proof of my sincerity. I complied and handed the formula back over. I seem to have earned her trust for doing so. She asked that I return to her when I'm ready to hear about what comes next.

My suspicions turned about to be justified, too. Arikio is claiming that Hyasyoda lost control of the research facility long ago. Her assumption is that Sukuuvestaa and Nugoeihuvi are somehow involved in the affair, since the Serpentis raiders who forced them out were too well established in the area to have been acting alone.

141906.en: I lied to Isha, telling him that I need time to think about our options for selling the formulas. In the meantime, I have taken the matter to Hyasyoda, and met with one of their representatives in Wuos. I have my doubts about Nugoeihuvi, just as I'm unsure that Hyasyoda will even hear me out, but I won't be sure of the full story until I've tried to hear both sides.

141907.en: Arikio has asked that I return to Isha, earn his trust, and do what I can to uncover the truth about the matter. I have agreed to take the task on. I've been given the formula blueprint back, which we'll use to learn more about Isha when we make a sale. A Hyasyoda counterintelligence team is now plugged into my comms systems and will be trailing me out of sight. I'm supposed to speak of this to nobody. Arikio says that if I need her, she'll be waiting in Wuos.

141908.en: The investigation team was able to make some progress after being relocated. Apparently Isha has been spotted making visits to some unknown Caldari Navy facility. Hyasyoda suspects he is involved in some kind of arms or information smuggling racket. I've been asked to gather more information about who Isha is meeting with. After returning to Isha yet again, I discovered that his friend is a highly-placed Caldari Navy official named Sinas Egassuo. This is, presumably, the same man Isha has been observed visiting.

141909.en: I met again with Hyasyoda Agent Arikio Kuretsu, who tasked me with saving the investigation team's HQ. NOH had bugged the CPF compound, but we used their own taps against them. I hacked into their surveillance software, disabled it and quickly evacuated everyone. Hyasyoda agents then detonated each one as it emptied. As far as NOH should be aware, I have completed my mission successfully. I am to report back to Arikio when I am ready to be briefed about one final assignment that Hyasyoda has for me.

141910.en: Isha somehow learned of the Hyasyoda investigation team and even uncovered the location of their headquarters. He charged me with leveling the place and killing the mercenary forces guarding it. I spoke with Arikio about the situation. Her people are coming up with a strategy to handle it.

141911.en:
After making my way to Astoh to meet Sinas, he asked for my help in making sense of something. He started by explaining that his work involves search and rescue operations, recovering Caldari P.O.Ws from Gallente Federation prison camps and similar operations. Although he can't find anyone to corroborate his claims, he seems certain that the numbers of Ishukone prisoners is frequently lower than the rest, conspicuously so.

He wants me to follow up on his hunch. My first task is to acquire a Federation Navy ID tag given out to P.O.W transports operating in Black Rise. I'll need to first secure, and then hack into a Shipyard in order to get my hands on one of these. Sinas tells me the job won't be an easy one.

141912.en: Things are starting to escalate, it seems. Sinas and Katsen have made arrangements to have the data node decoded, but it will require the knowledge of a man named Vira Mikano. This guy works for Ishukone Watch, meaning he won't help us without being coerced. The plan is to have Katsen's people “redirect” him from his office in Oipo to my personal hangar on the station. After that, my job is to get the hell out of there and back to Astoh before people realize the truth about Mikano's absence.

141913.en: Things are starting to escalate, it seems. Sinas and Katsen made arrangements to have the data node decoded, but it required the knowledge of a man named Vira Mikano; one of Ishukone Watch's senior intelligence officers. There was no chance he was going to help us without being coerced, so the plan was to have Katsen's people “redirect” him from his office in Oipo to my personal hangar on the station. After that, I just burned it back down to Astoh before anyone could even realize he'd gone missing. Now I wait, and hope that he can decipher this thing.

141914.en: I successfully delivered the stolen Serpentis formula to a Nugoeihuvi representative in the KFR-ZE system. We've made a good amount of money from the sale. Isha tells me he has someone he'd like me to meet when I'm ready.

141915.en: After making the sale in Syndicate, I contacted Katsen Isha once more. He told me that Hyasyoda had launched an investigation into our raid on the facility. I committed myself to stopping the Corporate Police Force investigation before it could uncover anything.

141916.en: I successfully delivered the stolen Serpentis formula to a Nugoeihuvi representative in the Faurulle system. We've made a decent amount of money from the sale. Isha tells me he has someone he'd like me to meet when I'm ready.

141917.en: I managed to secure the Blood Raider Facility and safely deliver the Nugoeihuvi signal operators to the Communications Tower. Isha tells me that they have already begun their work transmitting the misleading intelligence to the CPF investigation team. We should be in the clear now. He also expressed a desire for me to meet one of his friends when I am ready for more work.

141918.en: I successfully brought the Corporate Police Force investigation to an end by destroying the facility they were setting up as their base. Isha tells me it will be some weeks before they can fully resume their inquiries. He is confident that we will have dropped off the radar long before then.

141919.en: I successfully brought the Corporate Police Force investigation to an end by destroying the facility they were offsetting up for their base. Isha tells me it will be some weeks before they can fully resume their inquiries. He is confident that we will have dropped off the radar long before then.

141920.en: Things are starting to escalate, it seems. Sinas and Katsen made arrangements to have the data node decoded, but it required the knowledge of a man named Vira Mikano; one of Ishukone Watch's senior intelligence officers. There was no chance he was going to help us without being coerced, so the plan was to have Katsen's people “redirect” him from his office in Oipo to my personal hangar on the station. After that, I just burned it back down to Astoh before anyone could even realize he'd gone missing. Now I wait, and hope that he can decipher this thing.

141921.en: Things are starting to escalate, it seems. Sinas and Katsen have made arrangements to have the data node decoded, but it will require the knowledge of a man named Vira Mikano. This guy works for Ishukone Watch, meaning he won't help us without being coerced. The plan is to have Katsen's people “redirect” him from his office in Oipo to my personal hangar on the station. After that, my job is to get the hell out of there and back to Astoh before people realize the truth about Mikano's absence.

141923.en: Harkan must be dealt with immediately. His knowledge of Kor-Azor security and security codes make him a serious threat. I'll contact Kandus Sandar to get the MIO moving. Right now you need to arrest Harkan. He was granted a small fief upon his retirement. You have a good chance of catching him there.

141924.en: Be careful on this. Harkan has certainly already learned about the Rahsa trap. He is a skilled military commander and will most likely not go down without a fight.

141925.en: Harkan was too daunting for you?

141926.en: You can't let Harkan get away with this.

141927.en:
No! We were so close.

He knew we were coming for him. By killing himself before we could make an arrest, he's effectively secured his legacy before it could be tarnished. No one will sully the name of a dead hero, guilty or not.

141929.en: Commodore Harkan is an old guard of the Kor-Azor family. After multiple tours with the Imperial Navy, he became the chief security officer for House Miyan. In his decades of service, he has only had one blemish. In YC 109, he led Miyan's forces into battle against those of Lord Darabi in Fensi, a battle which he lost when Miyan surrendered. Harkan's big mistake was objecting to Miyan's surrender in public. It was not long after that Harkan retired.

141930.en: You were sent to arrest Harkan before any more damage was done, but the traitor apparently committed suicide by destroying his own home upon your arrival.

141931.en: You are to arrest Harkan before he gets away.

141932.en: You must inform Riff Hebian of Harkan's demise. He was very fond of the man, so he should be informed personally.

141935.en: Hebian is on patrol in the Palas system. Godspeed.

141936.en: In Harkan's final years, he became a vocal critic of current Amarr slavery techniques. Though still in favor of slave labor, Harkan argued that the Empire's reliance on old methods of control such as Vitoc were too limiting. His views were cemented after the Elder invasion, which saw millions of slaves violently rebelling after they were freed of their Vitoc dependency. Harkan left the public eye after an outburst against Empress Jamyl's emancipation of ninth generation slaves cost him the favor of local Holders.

141937.en: Riff Hebian was informed of Harkan's death.

141938.en: Riff Hebian must be informed of Harkan's death.

141940.en: Hebian can be found patrolling the Palas system in his battleship.

141941.en:
I have to apologize to you for my skepticism of your aims earlier. We've been increasing our security since the attack on Miyan's manor. But we never imagined one of our own was a threat. You have to understand that many of us have nothing but reverence for the Commodore. To find out he was a traitor...

But he's gone. The task of judgment is out of our hands now.

Only one task remains. With the destruction of their base and the deaths of Rahsa and now Harkan, the remaining Sansha are panicking. They're throwing a last ditch assault at one of Miyan's facilities. Lord Miyan himself is perfectly safe. Per our heightened security measures, I've sent him to a hidden safe house far from there.

The Sansha attacked my Lord and corrupted my predecessor. Annihilate them.

141942.en: I, too, am tired of the Sansha's meddling, but I have a job to do.

141943.en: I, too, am tired of the Sansha's meddling, but I have a job to do.

141945.en: God damn him! It was all a ruse!

141946.en: What was believed to be the last remnant of Rahsa's forces attacked a House Miyan outpost. After engaging the enemy the Sansha ran, revealing themselves to be a diversion.

141947.en: The last remnant of Rahsa's forces are attacking a Miyan outpost.

141948.en:
Lady Jariza is under investigation for her role in all of this, but the only charge we could actually bring is conspiracy. And accusing a noble of conspiracy is about as useful as charging a Slaverhound with indecent exposure. It's the nature of the beast.

Lord Darabi has been cleared of any wrong doing. His daughter Mina has returned to their estate and is taking a larger role in family affairs.

Lord Manik and Lord Miyan reached a gentleman's agreement after the destruction of Manik's mercenary fleet. A number of Manik's agricultural worlds have been given as a gift to House Miyan. Lord Miyan accepted the gift, and has declared a clean slate between them.

141951.en:
Harkan's not dead! He's just launched an attack on Lord Miyan's safe house! Lord Miyan is in danger!

He's already broken past the main acceleration gate. Harkan knows our systems inside out. Our automated defenses are useless. Worse, I've reports that several of our own security forces are helping him!

The safe house is in Choga. I need your help to rescue Miyan from Harkan's forces. I can't rely on my own security forces, because I don't know how many more will turn.

141952.en: Lord Miyan's safe house is besieged by Harkan's forces.

141953.en:
Find Miyan's safe house in the Choga system. Consider every Amarr ship you find a traitor.

Be careful. Harkan is a fierce military commander.

141955.en: The situation is too dire for me to waste time on a quitter.

141956.en: The situation is too dire for me to waste time on a quitter.

141957.en: Lord Harkan emerged alive after all, and launched a surprise assault on Lord Miyan's safe house. You bravely broke through the corrupted defenses and turncoats. The traitor Harkan fell to your superior flying, allowing Lord Miyan to continue his rightful rule.

141958.en:
What we require first is a supply of biomass. We cannot use standard clone-grade biomass; any common thug could acquire vats of that from the local medical station. We are looking for a variation known as “primordial biomass.” It is currently only used in controlled science labs for extremeophile research.

One of my ships will meet you at the acceleration gate. Head to the science facility and retrieve the primordial biomass. You may have to assault the facility directly. Once you have the biomass, return it to our ship at the entrance. When it has been transferred to the ship's cargo, I'll contact you with the next mission.

141959.en:
A very important flotilla carrying a command signal receiver was recently destroyed by the Amarr. This is a very specialized and controlled piece of Nation hardware.

This is the battle site. You will find the Sansha ships already destroyed, but the MIO ships are still surveying the wreckage. Eliminate the Amarr ships and find the command signal receiver. When the Amarr ships have been cleared, I will send one of my ships to pick up the device, same as before.

141960.en:
There is one more piece that is required before we make our final play. As you have likely guessed we are building a clone of Lord Miyan. There is one particular mind scan that is perfect for our use. This mind scan is kept on a planet side facility for psychiatric research. It has one vulnerable point, accessible by hacking the system's comm relay.

Find the comm relay at this location. Hack into the relay, and we can pull the mind scan directly to our server.

141961.en: Meet my ship at the entrance to Miyan's safe house. It will provide you with Lord Miyan's "replacement." Fight your way through the levels of the compound until you find his safe house. Destroy the structure and any ships present, and in the wreckage place the replacement. The Amarr forces will find him in the rubble and believe that Miyan survived. Then your work will be complete.

141963.en: Seemed like an innocent line for more work, but whatever.

141964.en: Seemed like an innocent line for more work, but whatever.

141965.en:
Hello, Capsuleer. Rahsa spoke highly of your tracking skills. You should feel proud; his praise never came easily. And do not worry about Aralin Jick. He has not betrayed his blessed ideals. The Nation has had no influence over him for many years.

Myself? I am not Sansha, though for the purposes of our business I speak for their interest. And do keep in mind it would do no good to run back to the authorities to turn me in. You will find we are quite untouchable.

On to business. My associates are engaged in a certain project that you can contribute greatly to. What we require first is a supply of biomass. We cannot use standard clone-grade biomass; any common thug could acquire vats of that from the local medical station. We are looking for a variation known as “primordial biomass.” It is currently only used in controlled science labs for extremeophile research. I have the location of one such base.

Head to this location. One of my ships will meet you at the acceleration gate. Head to the science facility and retrieve the primordial biomass. You may have to assault the facility directly. Once you have the biomass, return it to our ship at the entrance. When it has been transferred to the ship's cargo, I'll contact you with the next mission.

141967.en: It is refreshing to work with a client as reasonable as yourself.

141968.en: Does my associate's ship have the primordial biomass yet?

141971.en: Splendid. My associates will be very pleased to hear of your excellence.

141972.en: Your first mission is to retrieve a sample of primordial biomass from a secured science facility.

141973.en: You assaulted a secured science facility and obtained a large supply of primordial biomass for the Sansha plot.

141974.en: Do not worry about your identity being decoded by the Amarr authorities. While you are acting in my employ, I will be masking your ID from their registered capsuleer database. I cannot protect you if you violate the law in other activities, but in any sites I specify you may engage Amarr without fear of retribution.

141975.en:
Well, well, our friend at the MIO has been busy. We had assumed the authorities would have lost interest with the death of Rahsa, but they have proven persistent in assaulting the remaining Sansha forces.

A very important flotilla was recently destroyed by the Amarr. This particular group was carrying a very important component to our plan: a command signal receiver. This is a very specialized and controlled piece of Nation hardware. Only a rare few Sansha are implanted with one, and upon a Slave's death the device self-destructs. A number of very taught strings had to be pulled to procure this device, and we do do not want the Amarr to study the device in any detail.

This is the battle site. You will find the Sansha ships already destroyed, but the MIO ships are still surveying the wreckage. Eliminate the Amarr ships and find the command signal receiver. When the Amarr ships have been cleared, I will send one of my ships to pick up the device, same as before.

141976.en: I do so enjoy the ironies of life.

141977.en: Do you have the command signal receiver?

141978.en: Never turn down an opportunity to improve your standing.

141979.en: Never turn down an opportunity to improve your standing.

141980.en: The MIO destroyed a Sansha flotilla carrying a command signal receiver. You must destroy the Amarr ships and recover the item.

141981.en: We're one step closer to completing our project. More than that, you have earned my associate's trust.

141982.en: Kandus Sandar's men destroyed a Sansha flotilla and briefly held the command signal receiver until you took it back.

141983.en:
There is one more required piece before we make our final play. As you have likely guessed we are building a clone, a doppelganger of Lord Miyan that we control. This is an extremely complex creation, as it must be both technologically sophisticated and detection-proof. To make the illusion truly convincing, we need one final thing: a mind scan.

There is one particular mind scan that is perfect for our use. The man is long dead, executed, but the government considered his unique viewpoint still worthy of study. He was killed by the same mind scan process used by you capsuleers. This mind scan is kept on a planet side facility for psychiatric research. It has one vulnerable point, accessible by hacking the system's comm relay.

Find the comm relay at this location. Hack into the relay, and we can pull the mind scan directly to our server.

141985.en: Do not concern yourself with the mind's identity. The original personality was a close approximation for Miyan, and any variances will be overridden by our controls.

141986.en: Yes, we are receiving the data stream now.

141987.en: Do not think you can return to the authorities with our identities. Not only are we untouchable, but you are the one who attacked all those Amarr facilities. It would be a shame if those records came to light.

141988.en: Do not think you can return to the authorities with our identities. Not only are we untouchable, but you are the one who attacked all those Amarr facilities. It would be a shame if those records came to light.

141989.en: Have you hacked into the comm relay?

141990.en:
My associate is a man named Terrus Harkan. He was once the head of Lord Miyan's security forces and later an activist for slavery reform. After years of watching the Holders bicker and drag the Empire into pettiness and unrighteousness, he came to us with a fascinating plan. We are going to replace Lord Miyan with himself. Or something close.

Sansha's Nation has a solid lead in mind-body cybernetics. Using the appropriate combination of implants the Sansha can create an effective verisimilitude of a human intelligence, and that can receive directives from the Nation. With this replacement Harkan wishes to turn the Kor-Azor political landscape around and restore the honor Harkan believes it once had.

141991.en:
Now for the last step. The remaining Sansha ships are assaulting a Miyan station even as we speak. Riff Hebian believes this is the final battle against the Sansha, so he has committed the majority of his forces. While they are away, you will attack our true target: Lord Miyan's safe house.

Meet my ship at the entrance to the compound. It will provide you with Lord Miyan's "replacement." Fight your way through the levels of the compound until you find his safe house. Destroy the structure and any ships present, and in the wreckage plant the replacement. The Amarr forces will find him in the rubble and believe that Miyan survived. Then your work will be complete.

141992.en: You are to assault the safe house of Lord Miyan, destroy it, and place the replacement Miyan in the ruins.

141993.en: After this is done, our foothold in this region will be secured, and Harkan will have his revenge.

141995.en: Do not think we will forget this betrayal.

141996.en: Do not think we will forget this betrayal.

141997.en: It is done. You stormed Miyan's safe house, decimating the remaining defenders. After placing Harkan's artificial Miyan in the ruins, he was recovered by Riff Hebian. Nobody is the wiser; not that they would believe the truth. The question still remains whether Harkan or the Sansha control this new Miyan, or if anyone does.

141998.en:
Excellent! The new Miyan is awaking now. He will stand up to any medical scan and questioning. My clients can now influence this region as they see fit. The time may come when the Sansha need to be removed, but until then our position is good enough. Harkan is very pleased.

You have done well, Capsuleer. Perhaps one day my organization will make use of you again.

141999.en:
Greetings, pilot. Her Majesty's Ministry of Internal Order wants your aid.

My fellow agent, Kandus Sandar, is currently investigating Sansha activity in Kor-Azor, more specifically in the Miyan territories. Are you willing to lend help to his investigation?

142000.en: Most excellent. You will find Kandus Sandar in Nahyeen.

142001.en: You will find Kandus Sandar in Nahyeen.

142002.en: You track down those stragglers yet? They're our best shot at thecommand signal receiver.

142003.en: Interrogating Rahsa revealed that he had help within the Amarr Empire. You retrieved a Sansha command signal receiver for Aralin's plan to capture the traitor.

142004.en:
Firstly, an update on the documents you recovered from the RSS agent's compound. The Thukker and Krusual have flown in analysts to go over the copies. It may take some time to sift through the data and find the fresh leads, but I'm confident they'll find something useful in there.

In the meantime I have something else for you to do. I've made a few arrangements with the RSS and convinced them to let you continue to work on this Wildfire Khumaak business. Officially, you will be acting as the RSS liaison for the Brutor tribe, but in reality, you'll be on the front line working for the both of us to figure out what's going on. You're our go-to guy for this one and you got that job based on my recommendation. Don't make me look bad, alright?

I've been asked to point you towards Corporal Nilf Abruskur, who you can find in the system of Aldrat, Metropolis. I don't know the guy, but I do know the RSS, and my advice is not to trust them too much. In fact, part of the reason you've been recommended for this job is that I know I can rely on your judgment.

I want you to keep an eye on this RSS operation. My gut still tells me that they're keeping something secret from us.

142005.en:
Excellent, you're back. Firstly, I have an update on the documents you recovered. The Thukker and Krusual have flown in analysts to go over the copies. It may take some time to sift through the data and find the fresh leads, but I'm confident they'll find something useful in there.

In the meantime I have something else for you to do. I've made a few arrangements with the RSS and convinced them to let you continue to work on this Wildfire Khumaak business. Officially, you will be acting as the RSS liaison for the Brutor tribe, but in reality, you'll be on the front line working for the both of us to figure out what's going on. You're our go-to guy for this one and you got that job based on my recommendation. Don't make me look bad, alright?

I've been asked to point you towards Corporal Nilf Abruskur, who you can find in the system of Aldrat, Metropolis. I don't know the guy, but I do know the RSS, and my advice is not to trust them too much. In fact, part of the reason I recommended you for this job was because I know I can rely on your judgment. That, and you know how to deliver results.

I want you to keep an eye on this RSS operation. My gut still tells me that they're keeping something from us. I suppose we'll see, right?

142006.en: Well, I'll need to find someone else then, I suppose. How disappointing for us to come so far together and yet part ways now. Well, fly safe {[character]player.name}.

142007.en:
Arsten told me that the Thukker and Krusual tribes have analysts poring over all the data I recovered from the RSS agent's compound. He thinks it will be a little while until they can sort out the good leads from the dead ends, though. In the meantime, he had me report to the RSS and continue the investigation into the Wildfire Khumaak alongside them. Our aim is to figure out the historical, and perhaps cultural, significance of the Wildfire Khumaak.

Arsten has also warned me about trusting the RSS too much. He remains suspicious about their involvement in this affair. In fact, this is part of the reason why he recommended me as the Brutor tribe liaison. I've made it to Aldrat in Metropolis and reported to the RSS Corporal. The next step is to see what the RSS needs of me.

142008.en: Well, I'll need to find someone else then, I suppose. You've disappointed me, {[character]player.name}, this isn't like you.

142009.en:
Arsten tells me that the Thukker and Krusual tribes have analysts poring over all the data I recovered from the RSS agent's compound. He thinks it will be a little while until they can sort out the good leads from the dead ends. In the meantime, he wants me to report to the RSS and continue the investigation into the Wildfire Khumaak alongside them, with the aiming of figuring out its historical, and perhaps, cultural significance.

Arsten has also warned me about trusting the RSS too much. He remains suspicious about their involvement in this affair. In fact, this is part of the reason why he recommended me as the Brutor tribe liaison.

142010.en: We have reliable information that an Ammatar counteragent is about to make his escape from one of our facilities sometime in the next fifteen minutes. I want you to stay outside his station and make sure he does not get away. As soon as he emerges, terminate with extreme prejudice. Recover any data that wasn't destroyed and report back to me.

142011.en:
Greetings {[character]player.name}, I'm Corporal Nilf Abruskur, I'm glad to have you working with us. Now, we have much to discuss and little time in which to discuss it, so if you don't mind I'll get straight to the point.

You conducted yourself with skill and cunning for Agent Takalo. Due to this, and due to the fact that you're already involved in this delicate matter we have decided to enlist your services, if you will provide them.

As you've no doubt learned by now, it appears we have an intelligence asset in the Ammatar Consulate, and their handler – our agent – has disappeared under mysterious circumstances as well. It is a messy situation at the moment, but I have little doubt that we'll clean it up one way or another.

Our Ammatar asset is the priority for now; if we can find her, we will be able to make sense of the Wildfire Khumaak you have discovered. The tribes have their best people working on those documents you recovered as well, trying to glean her identity from something in there, but even though we don't know her identity, they have shown us who one of her enemies is.

The data you have recovered has strongly supported existing evidence that we have an Ammatar counteragent in our midst, and now we have their name. We believe this person has gathered information that may compromise our own source in the Ammatar government. This traitor is currently residing at one of our residential quarters with his family, completely unaware that the world is about to come crashing down on him.

We've dissolved his ship's FTL link without his knowledge, and for the past twelve hours we've run a dead-end intercept on every transmission he's tried to make out of the area. We know he's about to make an escape with his family sometime soon.

Your task is to ensure that ship does not escape the area intact. Local agents will stand down, they know the score.

142012.en: Good. His name is Lomar Vujik. As soon as he emerges, terminate with extreme prejudice. Recover any data that wasn't destroyed and then report immediately back to me.

142013.en: Very well. Do remember that what you saw here was confidential. Don't give us any reasons to come looking for you.

142014.en: Very well. Do remember that what you saw here was confidential. Don't give us any reasons to come looking for you.

142015.en: I met with an RSS agent named Nilf Abruskur. Seems an RSS spy in the Ammatar Mandate is at risk of being compromised by the Mandate's own spy in the RSS. I only have a few minutes to get to his RSS post, kill him, and bring back whatever it was he was making off with. Lomar Vujik is his name. Abruskur assured me the RSS ships in the vicinity wouldn't fire on me, as they've been cut in on the loop.

142016.en: It's good to know we're on the same page, {[character]player.name}. Our asset in Ammatar sends their thanks. They've been gathering information for us; there will be something shortly. Get back to me in a minute or two.

142018.en: I met with an RSS agent named Nilf Abruskur. An RSS spy in the Ammatar Mandate was at risk of being compromised by the Mandate's own spy in the RSS. I only had a few minutes to get to his RSS post, kill him, and bring back the things he was making off with. I did so, and the Ammatar source expressed gratitude. Apparently, they have some info on the Wildfire Khumaak.

142019.en:
Arsten told me that the Thukker and Krusual tribes have analysts poring over all the data I recovered from the RSS agent's compound. He thinks it will be a little while until they can sort out the good leads from the dead ends, though. In the meantime, he had me report to the RSS and continue the investigation into the Wildfire Khumaak alongside them. Our aim is to figure out the historical, and perhaps cultural, significance of the Wildfire Khumaak.

Arsten has also warned me about trusting the RSS too much. He remains suspicious about their involvement in this affair. In fact, this is part of the reason why he recommended me as the Brutor tribe liaison. I've made it to Aldrat in Metropolis and reported to the RSS Corporal. The next step is to see what the RSS needs of me.

142020.en:
We've had analysts from the Krusual and Thukker tribes going over the documents you recovered from our agent's private compound. They've made one promising discovery so far which we want you to follow up.

They found a recent communication from our source inside the Ammatar Consulate. It seems she sent a package of information on the Wildfire Khumaak to the system of Jark for pickup not long ago. Our guess is that due to the sensitivity of the information and the amount of attention it's attracting, our asset in the Consulate could only get it to the border, not across. This could play in our favor though. Due to its location in the San Matar constellation – the heartlands of Ammatar space - there's a good chance our agent didn't make it out there yet. We have to be careful where our operatives are seen sometimes.

The drop-off location inside Jark is a complex known as Tili's Red Light Palace. Initial intelligence is that it's just another merc R&R dive, nothing special. Once you have arrived to the area we'll forward the exact location of the cargo.

Speaking of which, I trust I needn't remind you how important those documents could be, or indeed, how sensitive. Proceed with caution, do not take any risks.

142021.en: We're sending you to the location where the Angel Cartel is keeping the Wildfire Khumaak documents they just snaked out from under us. We've set up a diversion elsewhere, so most of the force normally stationed at the base will be tied up with us. That should give you the leeway you need to bust in there, grab drive cluster EDF-285 from the data banks and get out well before they can muster any sort of reply.

142022.en:
We've had analysts from the Krusual and Thukker tribes going over the documents you recovered from our agent's private compound. They've made one more promising discovery so far which we want you to follow up.

They found a recent communication from our source inside the Ammatar Consulate. It seems she sent a package of information on the Wildfire Khumaak to the system of Jark for pickup not long ago. Our guess is that due to the sensitivity of the information and the amount of attention it's attracting, our asset in the Consulate could only get it to the border, not across. This could play in our favor though. Due to its location in the San Matar constellation – the heartlands of Ammatar space - there's a good chance our agent didn't make it out there yet. We have to be careful where our operatives are seen sometimes.

The drop-off location inside Jark is a complex known as Tili's Red Light Palace. Initial intelligence is that it's just another merc R&R dive, nothing special. Once you have arrived to the area we'll forward the exact location of the cargo.

Speaking of which, I trust I needn't remind you how important those documents could be, or indeed, how sensitive. Proceed with caution, do not take any risks.

142023.en: Excellent. You will be well rewarded for your efforts.

142024.en: Very well. Do remember that what you saw here was confidential. Don't give us any reasons to come looking for you.

142025.en: Very well. Do remember that what you saw here was confidential. Don't give us any reasons to come looking for you.

142026.en: The package must get here in one piece. Very important, {[character]player.name}.

142027.en: Well done, {[character]player.name}, thank you. We'll need a moment to go over the information here, but I imagine we'll need you again, so don't stray too far.

142028.en: Nilf Abruskur, the RSS man, gave me another mission. This time I'm supposed to head out to some merc dive pleasure complex and pick up a package from the Ammatar contact. Supposedly the package will have some information on the Wildfire Khumaak. I've been instructed to guard the artifact with my life.

142029.en: Excellent. You will be well rewarded for your efforts.

142030.en: Very well. Do remember that what you saw here was confidential. Don't give us any reasons to come looking for you.

142031.en: Very well. Do remember that what you saw here was confidential. Don't give us any reasons to come looking for you.

142032.en: The texts must get here in one piece. Very important, {[character]player.name}.

142033.en: We have a transmission from the Angels. Those god-damned slime-excreting vermin. I think you better get back here right now. We're gonna need you for this next part.

142034.en: Nilf has given me another assignment. The RSS want me to head out to a forward outpost for an archaeological dig underway near here. There I can meet some historians who supposedly have more information on these Wildfire Khumaaks.

142035.en: I was given another assignment from Nilf. The RSS wanted me to head out to a forward outpost for an archaeological dig underway near here. I was supposed to be meeting some historians who were thought to have more information on the Wildfire Khumaaks, but instead arrived to a fleet of Angel Cartel ships slaughtering everyone and everything. Whatever information was here has been taken, and the people who knew anything of value are dead or captured. After I cleared the area, the Cartel sent Nilf a message asking for a meeting. I've been asked to report back to Aldrat to be briefed on how we'll proceed from here.

142036.en: We're counting on you, {[character]player.name}, not just for the information this time, but to help us keep our reputation and morale after being dealt such a blow by those Angel bastards. The RSS is hurting right now. I need you to fire my men up. Make us proud.

142037.en: What a disappointment. I can see my initial misgivings about you were well-founded. Should have known, I suppose. You eggers are never to be trusted. In any case, do remember that what you saw here was confidential. Don't give us any reasons to come looking for you.

142038.en: What a disappointment. I can see my initial misgivings about you were well-founded. Should have known, I suppose. You eggers are never to be trusted. In any case, do remember that what you saw here was confidential. Don't give us any reasons to come looking for you.

142039.en: Please make sure the correct drive cluster reaches us, {[character]player.name}. It's of vital importance.

142040.en: Excellent work, {[character]player.name}. The Republic Security Services are in your debt.

142041.en: Nilf Abruskur, the RSS man, gave me another mission. They want me to head out to a major Angel Cartel staging outpost and snatch back the documents the Angels stole from the historians. They'll have the outpost's main defensive force tied up elsewhere, so it should be a cakewalk for me to go in there, overpower what defenses there are and get the docs. They'll be in some data banks on the underside of the station. All I need to do is hack my way in, grab drive cluster EDF-285 and get out of here.

142042.en: Nilf Abruskur, the RSS man, gave me another mission. I headed out to a major Angel Cartel staging outpost, intending to snatch back the documents the Angels stole from the historians. The outposts' defensive force was supposed to be tied up elsewhere, so this should have been a cakewalk for me. Unfortunately we had some bad intel, and the Angels showed up en masse. Regardless, I got the job done.

142044.en:
Mourmarie sent you? How sweet. She hadn't used me in a while, but this kidnapped kid is kinda big. That's why the Black Eagles have pros like me on the, er, team. I'm in the freight business, and I'm completely legit now, I swear. My specialty used to be in sentient biomass freight, if you catch my drift, but now I focus on moving livestock. Not nearly as profitable, but it's honest.

Trafficking kids is a tricky business. Yeah, they're small, but people have a soft spot for a sad child, so you gotta find places where nobody will notice them or care. I know a few of these places around these parts, but this is grasping at straws, really. The kid could be anywhere at this point.

Check out one of these places, and I'll send some of my friends to the others. Some eggers like you owe me favors. So take your pick.

142046.en: I met with Ascain Adeset, a former smuggler that focused on human trafficking. The FIO have been using her as an informant for years, and she has connections everywhere in the black market. Personally, I think the FIO are getting desperate by sending me to this rat, or they're really shaken up about the Syndicate's involvement with the kidnapping. Either way, Ascain offered me three places to visit: The Spintrix, a well-known brothel; Rattler Row, a sweatshop; and the Octomet Plantation.

142047.en: I met with Ascain Adeset, a former smuggler that focused on human trafficking. The FIO have been using her as an informant for years, and she has connections everywhere in the black market. Personally, I think the FIO are getting desperate by sending me to this rat, or they're really shaken up about the Syndicate's involvement with the kidnapping. Either way, Ascain offered me three places to visit: The Spintrix, a well-known brothel; Rattler Row, a sweatshop; and the Octomet Plantation. I made my choice and am ready to delve into New Eden's dark underbelly.

142048.en:
There's a plantation nearby called the Octomet Plantation. From what I've heard, it's connected to the Syndicate, but who knows? All I know is that if you want to hide a kid, there's no better place than a child farm. To me, all kids look alike anyway.

Take a gander around the plantation and see if Ralie is there. Seeing as he's a high profile kid, odds are he's in their mansion. I could be wrong about all this, of course. But either way, you'll be taking out some bad guys, right? You'll probably have to fly to lowsec to get to this plantation. Gotta warn you beforehand so you don't come blaming me if some pirate takes you out when you're not looking. Better fit a battlecruiser or heavy frigate. You know, something sneaky.

142049.en:
The Rattler Row sweatshop focuses on manufacturing ammunition, though it's not always the legit product. They're really a front for counterfeit ammo, which is shoddily produced and sold to rubes all over the black market. Dangerous stuff, really. Kids seem pretty adept at making ammo, though, so they keep the product available at incredibly low costs.

Ralie could be there, working on the factory floor. Explore the Rattler Row. Look for any signs of Ralie. You'll probably run into some of their guards, so take them out. It's a long shot, but it's worth a shot.

142050.en:
There's a brothel that has been known to hide some kids. Not for working there, mind you: The flesh trade can be seedy, but they're not that immoral. At least, not that ones I know of. The place is called The Spintrix. Real nasty little place. I might have frequented there in my younger days, but their standards have plummeted. The men working there are way below even my meager standards.

Go to Archavoinet and visit The Spintrix. Poke around there and see if the kid is there. You may get some aggression from their clientele – they're practically animals – so take them out. If a whore loses business, it's no skin off my back. You will have to fly through lowsec to get to this destination. It isn't far, and The Spintrix is actually in a highsec system. If you think you can run the gauntlet in your current ship, go ahead, but watch out for pirates. Don't say I didn't warn you.

142051.en:
What most people realize is that slavery exists everywhere around New Eden, not just in the Amarr Empire. Except around here we don't call it slavery; we call it farming. Children are great for the big bio-farms out in the border regions and tucked away in deadspace pockets. They can work the fields at practically no cost, and you barely have to feed them. Since they're kids, they don't get no paycheck. Plus, you can raise them like cattle. It's a great racket, if you're into that type of thing.

There's a plantation nearby called the Octomet Plantation. From what I've heard, it's connected to the Syndicate, but who knows? All I know is that if you want to hide a kid, there's no better place than a child farm. To me, all kids look alike anyway.

Take a gander around the plantation and see if Ralie is there. Seeing as he's a high profile kid, odds are he's in their mansion. I could be wrong about all this, of course. But either way, you'll be taking out some bad guys, right? You'll probably have to fly to lowsec to get to this plantation. Gotta warn you beforehand so you don't come blaming me if some pirate takes you out when you're not looking. Better fit a battlecruiser or heavy frigate. You know, something sneaky.

142052.en:
Plus, you know, we can take out some of the competition. If I were still in this business.

I mean: I really care about those poor, poor kids and that hard life they lead. Tears at the heartstrings, et cetera, et cetera, blah blah blah.

142053.en: You can do whatever you want, just so long as you make sure to tell Miss Mone that I did my part.

142054.en: You can do whatever you want, just so long as you make sure to tell Miss Mone that I did my part.

142055.en: Nothing? No kid? I got one more place to try. The Feds don't know about it because I never showed them before. But if we really need the info, it'll be there.

142057.en: The last known member of the Octomet family is Arnalen Octomet, a former executive in Quafe. He was the last member of a withering dynasty, and much like his family, he could not handle the lifestyle of a wealthy socialite. Drugs, especially Frenetix (a diluted form of the Frentix booster) took control of his life. Within a few years, all of the former Octomet properties were abandoned or foreclosed. Arnalen Octomet disappeared shortly afterward, assumed dead, though he has been spotted as a day laborer in some systems in Solitude.

142058.en: I chose to explore the Octomet Plantation, a known agricultural center that serves as a child farm. I'm not sure if Ralie is there, but of my three options, this seemed like the most likely place to hide a child. I've heard of the Octomets: They were practically a dynasty in this region. But news of them has been quiet in recent years.

142059.en: The Octomet Plantation is a child farm, a plantation dedicated to the storage and herding of unwanted, or possibly stolen, child. A truly terrible sight. The plantation had no leads, though I did manage to take out some plantation keepers while I was there. Hopefully that'll lead to freedom for those kids, though I doubt I can truly change anything.

142060.en: I remember my recruiting days. I made a lot of ISK back then. Probably my heyday, to be honest. Those were the days. I got so much because of those kids. Bless them.

142061.en: You can do whatever you want, just so long as you make sure to tell Miss Mone that I did my part.

142062.en: You can do whatever you want, just so long as you make sure to tell Miss Mone that I did my part.

142063.en: Nothing? No kid? I got one more place to try. The Feds don't know about it because I never showed them before. But if we really need the info, it'll be there.

142065.en: Technology levels vary throughout New Eden. Not every system, constellation, or even region is at the cutting edge of technology. Sometimes, factories rely on old-fashioned techniques and tried-and-true methods. Child labor is one of those methods. A child's tiny hands and little fingers are perfect tools for creating the high-end textiles of Gallente fashion, as well as reaching those hard-to-reach corners of ship armaments. Though not commonplace – or legal, for that matter – sweatshops like the Rattler Row can be found in the more backwards areas of New Eden.

142066.en: I chose to explore the Rattler Row, a sweatshop utilizing child labor. I knew places like this existed, but I never heard of one in this area. Though it doesn't surprise me: The more I hang around this area, the more I realize how close we are to the unseemly void outside the Federation. I'm hoping that Ralie is at the Row, though I am doubtful.

142067.en: I chose to explore the Rattler Row, a sweatshop utilizing child labor. I knew places like this existed, but I never heard of one in this area. Though it doesn't surprise me: The more I hang around this area, the more I realize how close we are to the unseemly void outside the Federation. My visit to the Rattler Row didn't go well. Part of the factory exploded – I have no idea how many kids died in that explosion – and Ralie was not there. I can only hope that Ascain has a better lead for me.

142068.en:

142069.en: If you see any Spintrix coins, take them. They're tokens for good times, if you catch my meaning. And then there are the Spintrixiate ones…

142074.en: The Spintrix is akin to an adult theme amusement park: Every ride costs a token, and The Spintrix has special tokens especially for their services. Spintrix coins are very difficult to come by, and they are worth a lot of money on the black market. Long time customers are said to receive a special coin that allows the access to the more exotic areas provided by this brothel.

142075.en: I chose to explore The Spintrix, a well-known brothel in the area. Ascain says that it's a common place to hide children, at least as a safehouse for them. I'm supposed to check it out and see if Ralie is somewhere inside.

142076.en: I chose to explore The Spintrix, a well-known brothel in the area. Ascain says that it's a common place to hide children, at least as a safehouse for them. I explored the brothel, but was attacked by its very loyal clientele. I fought back and took care of the situation, but it was a moot point: Ralie was nowhere to be found. I hope Ascain has some better leads for me when I see her next, because this place was a complete dead-end.

142077.en:
The Carry On is a smuggler's haven, a collection of speakeasies and underground associations devoted to human trafficking. It was a home away from home for me back in the day. I don't think I can show my face there anymore, though. Too many enemies, too many friends. But you can.

Your best course of action is to find the Carry On hub, located at the heart of the complex. You'll probably meet some of the guards there, or even some smugglers looking to protect their own. If they hit you, strike back. Smugglers are cowards at heart. Approach the hub and see what you can find there. Attack it if you must. This pains me to think about it, but it's our only choice.

142078.en:
Ok, ok. Don't tell Mourmarie, but I've been holding out on her. She's wrung me out of most of the info I have, especially some of the juicier leads from my former smuggling days. But this place is the mother lode, a veritable smorgasbord for the human traffickers in this corner of New Eden. You can't tell anyone about this place, though: A rat is only good if nobody knows she exists, if you catch my meaning.

142079.en: I have mixed feelings about this operation. It's like asking you to burn down my family home, you know? Even if some really bad things happened to me there…

142080.en: Ok, good. Keep this information to yourself, though, and don't tell Mourmarie. She'll kill me for this holding this back from her. Literally.

142081.en: Ok, good. Keep this information to yourself, though, and don't tell Mourmarie. She'll kill me for this holding this back from her. Literally.

142082.en:
Yeah, that's right. I got banned from there years ago after I got caught. Feels good to exact some revenge, though. Hope they got the message clear enough.

Anyway, I haven't heard of Studio I. I'll have to do some digging. Give me a minute while I check my sources.

142084.en: If you found the Carry On token, you may find it useful at their illicit location. Even smugglers charge admission.

142085.en: This looks like a joint operation between Impetus and the Syndicate. I don't know how close that relationship is, or how high up on the corporate chain it goes. But we know the kid is there. Get in there and get him. Destroy the Studio, too. Nothing good can come from it.

142086.en: The Pator 6 are flying to Adacyne, and they've got Ralie with them. Time for a final showdown. Go knock them out and get the kid, once and for all. I'll start working on my contacts in the Syndicate and see if there's anything that can be done from their angle. Last thing we want is to have them go after me. Or us.

142087.en: Mourmarie and Senator Ardanne have given me a rendezvous location for you. It's somewhere in Enedore. When you return the kid, you'll get your reward. I'll contact the Syndicate and let them know that the deal is off. I wouldn't expect them to take that lightly, though, so watch your back.

142088.en:
The Syndicate wants to meet you at a specific location. You'll drop the kid off, take the money – which I'll get a cut of, of course – and leave quietly in the night. They have a special gift for you in addition to the money. Some sort of Syndicate-issue something or other. I dunno.

Take the kid to the warehouse and drop him off. We'll get paid and leave this whole mess behind us. It'll be a happy ending for us, to be sure.

142089.en:
Wow. I've never heard of this before. Studio I must be a recent development among traffickers. I really don't know much about it, but something feels off about the situation. I mean, I've been a part of some really nasty enterprises in my time – trafficking for drugs, medical experiments, slavery, you name it – but something like Studio I? No way; nothing like that.

This looks like a joint operation between Impetus and the Syndicate. I don't know how close that relationship is, or how high up on the corporate chain it goes. But we know the kid is there. Get in there and get him. Destroy the Studio, too. Nothing good can come from it.

142090.en: Sure, we're a salty bunch, to say the least, and despicable by any other means. Back in my day, we had some ethics, though. I don't know what happened since then.

142091.en: This may sound hypocritical, but you're a bad person for bailing out right now.

142092.en: This may sound hypocritical, but you're a bad person for bailing out right now.

142093.en: I don't want to talk about it anymore. Just let me know when you've destroyed that studio.

142094.en: It's gone? Good. My sources tell me that the Pator 6 are flying towards Adacyne. Time to catch up!

142095.en: We've finally tracked down Ralie's location, once and for all. He's been taken to Studio I, an unlicensed film studio. Who knows what seedy activity takes place in there. Time to investigate.

142096.en: Ralie was taken to Studio I, an unlicensed studio hidden away in this area. I don't know what they film there, nor do I want to know. When I got there, the Pator 6 and the Syndicate were hanging around the studio. I think I saw some Impetus yachts there as well. The Pator 6 took Ralie, but it looks like I've caused a rift in their agreement with the Syndicate. All I have to do is chase those bastards down, and I can finally get the kid.

142097.en:
You've really pissed off some nasty bad guys, my friend. Luckily, they're starting to turn against each other as well. That studio was the lynchpin in this whole operation, it seems, and its destruction unraveled all their carefully laid plans.

The Pator 6 is flying to Adacyne, and they've got Ralie with them. Time for a final showdown. Go knock them out and get the kid, once and for all. I'll start working on my contacts in the Syndicate and see if there's anything that can be done from their angle. Last thing we want is to have them go after me. Or us.

142098.en: What are you waiting for? Go get Ralie!

142099.en: Are you kidding me? We're so close!

142100.en: Too much for a simple egger like yourself? You're weaker than I thought.

142101.en: What are you waiting for? Go get Ralie!

142102.en: You've got the kid? Great. This will sound strange, but we have options…

142103.en: Ascain found the location of the Pator 6. Time to surprise them and get the kid, once and for all.

142104.en: Ascain found the location of the Pator 6. I followed them to a junkyard. After a vicious battle against the gang leaders, Rosulf Fririk and Fardier Mante, I got Ralie and took him back to Ascain. The kid didn't look so good. Who knows what sort of nightmares he endured?

142105.en:
Mourmarie and Senator Ardanne have given me a rendezvous location for you. It's somewhere in Enedore. When you return the kid, you'll get your reward. I'll contact the Syndicate and let them know that the deal is off. I wouldn't expect them to take that lightly, though, so watch your back.

Either way, glad you got the kid back. Been nice working with you. Good luck in the future, {[character]player.name}.

142106.en: If you can do me one last favor: Don't tell Mourmarie anything. A rat needs to keep her secrets, you know.

142107.en: Wait, what? What the hell am I going to do with this kid, then? He just sits there and stares at me. It's really sad, and kinda creepy.

142108.en: Wait, what? What the hell am I going to do with this kid, then? He just sits there and stares at me. It's really sad, and kinda creepy.

142109.en: Did you take Ralie back to his dad yet?

142110.en: The Syndicate showed up? No way. I don't know who would have tipped them off.  That's terrible. Anyway, that's it for me. Good bye.

142111.en: Though it was difficult, I made my choice. I decided to return Ralie to his father. I gotta say: The money was tempting. When I dropped Ralie off, we were ambushed by the Syndicate. I don't know who tipped them off to our location, but I suspect a rat. Regardless, Ralie is safe with his father, and the Syndicate's plot was disrupted. There's bad blood in there somewhere, but where it comes from, I cannot say. All I know is that I saved a kid from a life of nightmares. Mission accomplished.

142112.en:

Take the kid to the warehouse and drop him off. We'll get paid and leave this whole mess behind us. It'll be a happy ending for us, to be sure.

142113.en: They'll give me my share once the kid is delivered. So go get me some money, and don't tell Mourmarie.

142114.en: Wait, what? What the hell am I going to do with this kid, then? He just sits there and stares at me. It's really sad, and kinda creepy.

142115.en: Wait, what? What the hell am I going to do with this kid, then? He just sits there and stares at me. It's really sad, and kinda creepy.

142116.en: Did you give the kid back to the Syndicate yet?

142117.en:
I've been in and out of this business for decades at this point. Do you know how many people I've moved? Thousands. Possibly even millions. More than I can count, anyways. And I've never been remorseful, not even once. It was all for the money, the very essence and soul of New Eden.

But I feel something now. Something uncomfortable. Is this what remorse feels like? Guilt? I don't know. I hope it was worth it. I truly do. Good luck, {[character]player.name}. Enjoy your money. Good bye.

142119.en: New Eden is a dark place, populated by killers, thieves, heroes, lowlifes, saints, sinners, and everything in between. Morality is what you make of it. But when push comes to shove, heroism and villainy are measured by one thing: ISK, the heart and soul of New Eden.

142120.en: Though it was difficult, I made my choice: I gave Ralie back to the Syndicate. Why? The money, of course. Those pirates offered way more money than the kid is worth, and I'd be a fool not to take it. I expected them to ambush me when I gave the kid away, but they didn't. Rats can be surprising sometimes. I made sure I didn't look at the kid when I gave him back. I don't want to think about the horrors he's about to face. All I want to think about is all the money I just got. It's enough to keep me happy. Mission Accomplished. Though I wonder: Was it worth it?

142121.en:
Our historians have pored over the information found on the drive cluster EDF-285. There's a lot on there, but not all of it is pertinent to the Wildfire Khumaak. I've also been in contact with a Krusual historian who has spent some time researching the Khumaak. The historians cross-referenced each other's work and stumbled upon a lead. I guess those nerds are good for something, eh?

I'm sending you to Hiva Shesha, the Krusual historian. She's taken her poor interns with her to the San Matar constellation – right in the heart of Ammatar space. I don't know what she's discovered, but I'm sure it's important. Best you get over there and talk with her. Let us know what you've uncovered, and keep your eyes peeled for our missing agent. I have a feeling that he went to seek out his Ammatar contact. There's no telling what he's up to, either.

Anyway, good luck.

142122.en:
The Ammatar “sister” that was the source of all the information was based in a nearby cathedral called the Church of the Obsidian. I've contacted the church, and she's no longer there. In fact, I have no clue where she went. She did make reference to some artifact located in the church. They've denied me access to the church grounds – those bloody lapdogs – but I think you might be able to persuade them. Get inside that church and get something called the “Blood Obsidian Orb.” I don't know what to do with it after that, but I think that's our first step.

Take this analyzer with you, and use it on the church. It should help you unearth the Blood Obsidian Orb.

142123.en:
I found this datacore inside the orb. According to the tablet, there's a church in this area called the Wildfire Life Chapel. Inside the chapel is something called the Book of St. Arzad. I think that was what you came across in those ruins: parts of this lost book. My, from the looks of it, this is heavy stuff. I haven't had the chance to piece it all together yet, but I have a feeling that this book goes beyond a simple relic like the Wildfire Khumaak and into much bigger territory.

This book must be recovered. I'm almost certain that it's in the chapel. Put the datacore in that chapel and see what comes of it. It's our only hope. See what happens.

142126.en: Have you talked to Hiva Shesha yet?

142127.en: Figures. Get out of here, egger.

142128.en: Figures. Get out of here, egger.

142129.en: The RSS is in charge of national security, not preserving its history. We leave that to the professors and academics. I'll take an autocannon over a datacore any day.

142130.en:
Do you have any idea how tough this relic is to crack? You'd think something this simple would come with a manual. We've used the Khumaak for a long time as a symbol of our defiance. But the presence of one little rock adds a whole new level of meaning.

Oh yeah. Welcome, {[character]player.name}! I take it that Nilf sent you over? You've earned a lot of trust with the Republic, and I hope we can continue that trend.

I was one of the Republic University scholars to take a look at the Wildfire Khumaak for the Brutors. I was also sent to look over the documents you recovered from the RSS. So, essentially, I've been with you from the beginning, lurking in the shadows. That's what we historians do: Skulk about in dusty corners looking for information. It's a dirty job, but somebody has to do it.

The Ammatar “sister” that was the source of all the information was based in a nearby cathedral called the Church of the Obsidian. I've contacted the church, and she's no longer there. In fact, I have no clue where she went. She did make reference to some artifact located in the church. They've denied me access to the church grounds – those bloody lapdogs – but I think you might be able to persuade them. Get inside that church and get something called the “Blood Obsidian Orb.” I don't know what to do with it after that, but I think that's our first step.

Take this analyzer with you, and use it on the church. It should help you unearth the Blood Obsidian Orb.

142131.en: Oh yeah. I may have forgot to mention that there are some armed guards there. I'm a scholar, not a fighter. Which one are you?

142132.en: Where's the orb? Is it actually an orb? I can never tell when ancient texts are being literal or not.

142133.en: You don't care that much about history, do you? I guess you're doomed to repeat it. Sharpen your focus, {[character]player.name}.

142134.en: You don't care that much about history, do you? I guess you're doomed to repeat it. Sharpen your focus, {[character]player.name}.

142135.en: You found it? Really? Well, I guess it's kind of orb-like. I have no idea what its significance is, but I'm going to find out. Hang on real quick. I must look into this further.

142136.en: I met with Hiva Shesha at her mobile research facility. Hopefully, her breakthrough will lead to our enlightenment on this relic.

142143.en:
I can't believe what you found among those ruins. This is a historian's dream come true. Now that we've got the Blood Obsidian Orb and the Blood Obsidian Tablet, I think we finally solve this mystery. We're very close to uncovering the secrets of the Wildfire Khumaak.

By the way: Did you notice anything strange there? I could have sworn I saw an RSS ship flying about those ruins. Weird.

142144.en: Hiva has another task for me while she tries to decipher the Blood Obsidian Orb. She suspects that there are more relics and information located at a nearby Ammatar ruins, the remains of a church or other holy ground. She's especially looking for a Blood Obsidian Tablet, which is supposed to correspond to the orb I uncovered for her. Hopefully it's there: I'm getting rather tired of digging through ruins at this point.

142145.en: Hiva had another task for me while she tried to decipher the Blood Obsidian Orb. She suspects that there are more relics and information located at a nearby Ammatar ruins, the remains of a church or other holy ground. I uncovered the tablet – and some unfriendly fire to boot – as well as some other documents from the site.

142146.en:
I've been a scholar and a historian for many years now, so I know how to handle ancient relics. I will confess, though, that I was about to cut right into the middle of the Blood Obsidian Orb to see what was inside. Yes, I was getting rather desperate for answers. Luckily, the tablet you uncovered was more than just mystical mumbo-jumbo and flowery metaphors. Rather, it was practically an instruction manual to open the orb. Spirits be praised!

I found this datacore inside the orb. According to the tablet, there's a church in this area called the Wildfire Life Chapel. Inside the chapel is something called the Book of St. Arzad. I think that was what you came across in those ruins: parts of this lost book. My, from the looks of it, this is heavy stuff. I haven't had the chance to piece it all together yet, but I have a feeling that this book goes beyond a simple relic like the Wildfire Khumaak and into much bigger territory.

This book must be recovered. I'm almost certain that it's in the chapel. Put the datacore in that chapel and see what comes of it. It's our only hope. See what happens.

142147.en: You know, this could all be for naught. There could be nothing there, or the book could have been swiped long ago. If you don't get the book, that's ok: We're just trying to see if this works. History has a wicked sense of humor, sometimes, so be careful.

142148.en: Oh come on, really? You're ditching me now?

142149.en: Oh come on, really? You're ditching me now?

142150.en: Well, what was in the chapel?

142151.en: Using the Blood Obsidian Tablet, Hiva Shesha deciphered the mysteries hidden inside the Blood Obsidian Orb. In fact, there was literally something hidden inside the orb: an obsidian datacore. According to the tablet, this datacore, if placed inside some holy ground, would uncover a secret history book. Hiva gave me the datacore, and the most logical place to look is the Wildfire Life Chapel, an innocuous church in the San Matar constellation. I'm getting close; I can feel it.
