500572.en: Hulls able to repair or assist other vessels in combat. Recommended as force multipliers in fleet engagements.

500574.en: Hulls capable of transporting a massive quantity of goods. Recommended for industrial or logistical purposes.

500576.en: Hulls capable of all kinds of material collecting activities. Recommended for any gathering operation.

500579.en: Hulls made to scout and chart hostile space. Recommended for any reconnaissance operation.

500581.en: Hulls capable of pinning the enemy down. Recommended to prevent the target from escaping.

500592.en: This certificate represents a level of competence in corporation holding. It is a good skill set for a CEO to increase the maximum number of corporation members and races.

500594.en: This certificate represents a level of competence in the control of all combat-related drones, including light, medium, heavy and sentry variations. The holder has learned that drones may be targeted and destroyed in combat. This is a good skillset for any combat-oriented capsuleer as many ships from all factions augment their capabilities through the use of drones.

500619.en: Starting ships given free of charge, suitable for interstellar travel.

500620.en: Excel at engagements using Energy Turrets, backed up by drones. Prioritize armor over speed.

500621.en: Favor missiles and Hybrid Turrets. Prioritize shields over speed.

500622.en: Rely on Hybrid Turrets, backed up by drones. Balance armor with speed.

500623.en: Prefer Projectile Turrets. Balance shield and armor with speed.

500624.en: Industrial backbone of New Eden. Depend on others to fight for them. Rely on shields if all else fails.

500625.en: Masters of Projectile Turrets. Favor speed.

500626.en: Specialize in electronic warfare and Energy Turrets. Prefer armor for anyone who gets too close.

500627.en: Combines missiles and drones. Uses shields to outlast opponents.

500628.en: Prefer Energy Turrets. Use strong defensive shields.

500629.en: Favor Hybrid Turrets. Combine armor with acceleration.

500630.en: Balance drones with Energy Turrets. High agility but low speed.

500633.en: This certificate represents level of competence which ship propulsion and speed enhancing modules like Afterburners, Microwarpdrives and Micro Jump Drives. The holder is aware that those modules consume a fair amount of capacitor while active. This is a critical skill set to have for any kind of operation in hazardous space.

500635.en: This certificate represents a level of competence with Gravimetric targeting systems. It certifies that the holder has some skill in target acquisition and management and can make use of a range of targeting-related modules. This is a critical skillset for any capsuleer facing combat.

500637.en: This certificate represents a level of competence with Magnetometric targeting systems. It certifies that the holder has some skill in target acquisition and management and can make use of a range of targeting-related modules. This is a critical skillset for any capsuleer facing combat.

500639.en: This certificate represents a level of competence with Ladar targeting systems. It certifies that the holder has some skill in target acquisition and management and can make use of a range of targeting-related modules. This is a critical skillset for any capsuleer facing combat.

500641.en: This certificate represents a level of competence with advanced targeting systems. It certifies that the holder can lock more than seven targets at the same time. This is a good skillset to have for any capsuleer training for specialized ships, like Logistics or Marauders.

500648.en: Small, fast but fragile vessels suited to a variety of purposes, especially tackling.

500651.en: Small, fast but fragile vessels suited to a variety of purposes, especially tackling.

500653.en: Advanced, fast frigates hard to pin down, specializing in tackling.

500655.en: Advanced frigates with improved damage and resilience, specializing in combat.

500657.en: Advanced frigates whose cloaking abilities allow them to move unseen.

500659.en: Advanced frigates that weaken and cripple targets, letting them specialize in disruption.

500661.en: Destructive, albeit fragile craft meant as anti-frigate platforms.

500663.en: Advanced destroyers whose use of warp interdiction bubbles let them specialize in tackling multiple targets.

500665.en: Craft with balanced offensive, defensive and mobility capabilities making them quite versatile.

500667.en: Craft with balanced offensive, defensive and mobility capabilities making them quite versatile.

500669.en: Advanced cruisers specialized in disruption, designed for reconnaissance operations and electronic warfare.

500671.en: Advanced cruisers specialized in combat, with improved damage and resilience.

500673.en: Advanced cruisers who use warp disruption to tackle multiple targets.

500675.en: Advanced cruisers whose remote repairs and assistance capabilities let them support allies.

500677.en: Versatile hulls that can be reconfigured for a variety of attack, combat, disruption or support roles.

500679.en: Flexible fighting vessels that bridge the gap between cruisers and battleships. May be used as command platforms.

500681.en: Advanced battlecruisers that use Command Bursts to specialize in combat and fleet boosting.

500683.en: Flexible fighting vessels that bridge the gap between cruisers and battleships. May be used as command platforms.

500685.en: Large, durable but slow vessels designed for heavy duty engagement.

500687.en: Advanced battleships that use Covert Cynosural Fields, specialized in operations behind enemy lines.

500689.en: Advanced battleships whose damage projection and resilience let them specialize in combat.

500691.en: Capital ships with high firepower and resilience, created for extended sieges of stationary installations.

500693.en: Capital ships able to remote repair and deploy advanced drones to assist allies.

500695.en: Largest supercapital vessel capable of transporting allies through space, increasing the effectiveness of allied fleets and destroying enemy capital ships.

500697.en: Small and fragile craft exclusively intended for fast traveling.

500699.en: Vessels whose large cargobays make them ideal for mass transportation of goods.

500701.en: Capital hull with massive cargoholds, intended for mass-transportation of items.

500703.en: Advanced freighters with integrated jump drives specialized in quick mass-transportation of items.

500705.en: Advanced haulers focusing on either resilience or stealth to specialize in transportation.

500707.en: Small and fast hull designed to gather materials even in hostile areas.

500709.en: Ships specialized in strip mining, good for mass-resource harvesting purposes.

500711.en: Advanced mining barges specialized in strip mining for resource harvesting operations.

500713.en: Vessel with long range tractor beams, designed for salvage retrieval.

500715.en: Medium and large vessels designed for assisting and leading group mining operations.

500717.en: Slow capital vessel capable of compressing ore, aimed at  supporting large scale resource retrieval operations.

500719.en: Large, durable but slow vessels designed for heavy duty engagement.

501918.en: This certificate represents a level of competence with ship jump drives. The holder has learned that jump drives consume fuel based on distance and allow the user to navigate without the use of Stargates. This is a critical skillset for any kind of capital or Black Ops movement.

501924.en: This certificate represents a level of competence with supercapital targeting systems. It certifies that the holder has some skill in target acquisition and management and can make use of a range of targeting-related modules. This is a critical skillset for any capsuleer facing combat.

501927.en: This certificate represents a level of competence in handling Siege Modules. The holder has learned that Siege Modules may only be used on Dreadnoughts, improving their offensive and defensive capabilities at the expense of mobility. This is a critical skillset for capsuleers specializing in Dreadnought hulls.

501929.en: This certificate represents a level of competence in handling Triage Modules. The holder has learned that Triage Modules may only be used on Carriers, improving their remote assisting capabilities at the expense of mobility. This is a critical skillset for capsuleers specializing in Carrier hulls.

501931.en: This certificate represents a level of competence in handling Capital Industrial Core modules. The holder has learned that Industrial Cores may only be used on Capital Industrial Ships, improving their resource processing abilities at the expense of mobility and enabling the use of Compression Modules. This is a good skillset for capsuleers specializing in Industrial Capital Ship hulls.

501950.en: This certificate represents a level of competence with Freighter ship propulsion. The holder has learned that those ships are slow and vulnerable when aligning to celestial objects. This is a good skillset for any capsuleer specializing in Freighter hulls.

501952.en: This certificate represents a level of competence in leadership fleet support through Information Command Bursts. The holder has learned that Information Command Bursts do not work inside a Starbase Forcefield. This is a good skillset for capsuleers specializing in Battlecruisers or Command Ships.

501954.en: This certificate represents a level of competence in leadership fleet support through Skirmish Command Bursts. The holder has learned that Skirmish Command Bursts do not work inside a Starbase Forcefield. This is a good skillset for capsuleers specializing in Battlecruisers or Command Ships.

501956.en: This certificate represents a level of competence in leadership fleet support through Shield Command Bursts. The holder has learned that Shield Command Bursts do not work inside a Starbase Forcefield. This is a good skillset for capsuleers specializing in Battlecruisers or Command Ships.

502584.en: It is in stations that capsuleers address facets of life in New Eden not pertaining to spaceflight.  Repairing and fitting ships, attending to manufacturing and industrial aspirations, conducting research, contracting missions, seeing to their medical and storage needs.  Not all stations provide each of these services and what services they do offer often decides which one a capsuleer calls *home*.<url=podGuideLink:2>Link to Outposts </url>

502585.en: Structures orbiting planets that permit capsuleers to dock.

502590.en: Although not as versatile as other stations, outposts are a testament to an alliances prowess and offer a convenience over running operations out of several different starbases.  Outposts are often focused on a particular activity such as production, research or administration.<url=podGuideLink:1>Link to Stations</url>

502591.en: Stations built by alliances of capsuleers in null security space.

502596.en: Although they cannot be docked in they provide a shield impenetrable to disallowed entities and as such serve as a safe haven.  Aside from offering potential benefits such as research and manufacturing facilities, starbases open up the possibility of mining moons.

502597.en: Capsuleer owned stations anchored to moons.

502599.en: With sovereignty structures also comes the ability to create a prosperous environment for the claiming corporation. Once claimed via a Territorial Claim Unit a corporation can build the sovereignty hub which (properly upgraded) yields military, strategic and industrial benefits.

502600.en: Capsuleer constructed structures built to claim sovereignty of a solar system.

502602.en: Mobile structures are deployed in local space for various purposes.  Some for convenience such as the Mobile Depot and the Tractor Unit, others with more nefarious purposes such as the Cynosural Inhibitor and the Siphon Unit.

502603.en: Mobile structures afford capsuleers tactical advantages, convenience and mischief in local space.

502605.en: New Eden is separated into a dense cluster of star systems  all connected to one another by a vast network of stargates.  These gates allow for near instantaneous travel between linked star systems. Be prepared to encounter all types around these important structures .

502606.en: Structures that allow capsuleers to travel between linked solar systems.

502608.en: Some specific locations of space can only be accessed via Acceleration Gates. They can propel space craft great distances without the need for a large gravitational body as an end point.  Be aware however that these access points are prime locations for defense, ambush and more.

502609.en: These structures enable Capsuleers access to unique pockets of space within star systems.

502611.en: Alliances can hold sway over vast areas of New Eden and are the largest entities controlled by capsuleers.  Alliances can (and often do) declare war on other alliances.  Every member of a corporation belonging to an alliance also belongs to that alliance.

502612.en: Corporations can form alliances to further their joint political, economic and military influence.

502614.en: Coalitions are common in null security space where lone alliances or corporations are vulnerable.  Coalitions often have specific agendas and those common goals unite them, providing safety in numbers.

502615.en: An alliance of alliances and/or corporations.

502617.en: Corporations is the premiere method of banding individual capsuleers together towards a common purpose.  Anything that requires the organization of many capsuleers is performed under the flag of a corporation; running missions, trading, resource gathering, fleet warfare, starbase management and protection.

502618.en: A capsuleer created organization grouping individuals with the aim of furthering all of their success.

502620.en: Fleets are employed for operations such as warfare or the protection of a large industrial operation.  Fleets offer encompassing tools to organize a host of capsuleers.  The structure and chain of command contained within a fleet gives a corporation (or an alliance) an unrivaled advantage over less organized capsuleers.

502621.en: Fleets are the main avenue for corporations and alliances to organize massive operations.

502623.en: The Empire's history of conquest and slavery often clashes with the image they have of themselves as the bearers of the word of a loving God. They are pioneers in exploration and colonization, whose fleet and weaponry bears the gilded tones of a race that believes itself deeply beloved by their deity.

502624.en: The Amarr Empire is an expansive, religious faction.

502626.en: Founded on the tenets of patriotism and hard work that carried its ancestors through hardships on an inhospitable homeworld, the Caldari State is today a corporate dictatorship, led by rulers who reward loyalty and devotion but are ruthless when it comes to betrayal.

502627.en: The Caldari State is a disciplined and militaristic faction run by corporate dictatorship.

502629.en: Champions of personal liberty, the Federation's principles are brotherhood, fraternity, and equal rights to all men - a stance that has occasionally led to great advances in science and culture, but more often to an unfettered, dangerous hedonism. They are renowned for their willingess to engage in diplomacy and trade with other factions, although in some corners they are notorious for their ability to insinuate themselves in the business of others.

502630.en: The Gallente Federation values personal freedom above all else, no matter the cost.

502632.en: The Republic were once enslaved by the Amarr Empire. After breaking free of the latter's shackles, they quickly established themselves as one of the most powerful factions in the entire cluster, and are capable of making something out of damn near nothing. Their multifaceted tribal culture emphasizes tenacity and strength, but has often led to internal strife amongst headstrong people.

502633.en: Once slaves, the Minmatar are a spirited, steadfast faction of freemen.

502635.en: Agents will provide you with a continuous stream of profitable assignments. While working for them, you will start building a relationship with their employing corporations, and eventually with the factions of those corporations, both of which open up avenues for greater rewards in money and equipment.

502636.en: Agents work for the various factions of New Eden. They give you assignments that may involve mining, trade, or combat.

502638.en: Aside from the four great Empires, New Eden is host to many smaller factions. Some of these, such as ORE or the Sisters of EVE, were founded around the shared ideals (profit and rescue respectively). Others are far more sinister and composed of people whose primary purpose is to take that which does not belong to them, be it possessions, power, or life itself.

502639.en: There are many minor factions in New Eden, often related to specific (and sometimes illegal) businesses.

502641.en: Spread throughout the entire cluster, planets come in greatly varying types, ranging from gas giants to churning rocks of lava. On most of them, capsuleers may build installations that extract the planet's resources and allow for the production of valuable goods.

502642.en: Planets are numerous in New Eden, and capsuleers can use them to produce various trade goods.

502644.en: Aside from their uses in defending contested territories, moons may contain valuable materials that can be extracted, stored and even processed by placing certain installations in their orbit. This is only possible in lawless low-security systems, and as a result, moon miners may need to defend their installations from attack.

502645.en: Moons in certain areas provide resources through the orbital access of complex installations

502647.en: New Eden is full of asteroid belts that can be mined for ore and ice, both of which function as the building blocks of practically everything capsuleers create and use. Belts found in lower-security regions will contain more valuable materials, and will be better protected.

502648.en: Asteroids contain many valuable raw materials.

502650.en: Wormholes in New Eden may simply lead to other known (and, of course, possibly dangerous) locations in the cluster - or they may lead to completely unknown areas, dotted with the ruins of long-dead civilizations and populated with scavengers and other hostile elements. Wormholes don't last forever - as witnessed by the crackling remainder of the one called the EVE Gate - and anyone who passes through would be very, very wise to ensure they can make it back before their passage collapses in on itself.

502651.en: Wormholes are spatial rifts that lead to the strange and unknown.

502653.en: Some specific locations in space are isolated from other areas due to surrounding natural phenomena. A brave traveller may be able to leverage ancient stargate technology to catapult themselves into these areas, though they should not to expect a warm welcome from who, or what resides in that dark isolation.

502654.en: Some areas are isolated from normal piloting tech. They can sometimes be accessed, but no one knows what they will find within.

502656.en: Cosmic anomalies may be found through various scanning functions. They are harder to pinpoint than the typical hostile hideout, but offer much greater and more unique bounty - along with much more dangerous enemies. On occasion, those enemies may leave behind clues that point a fearless capsuleer toward other anomalies bearing even greater challenges and potential rewards.

502657.en: A cosmic anomaly is a hidden site in space, guarded by hostiles, that may occasionally lead to even greater riches.

502659.en: Gas clouds may be found in specific regions and sites in New Eden. While they will at times be protected by various interested parties, a resourceful capsuleer may be able to harvest their materials for the production of various items and boosters of questionable legality.

502660.en: Found in specific parts of the cluster, gas clouds may be harvested for profit.

502662.en: System security, ranging from 1.0 to 0.0, indicates the hazards a capsuleer may encounter from various forces, along with the support that may be expected from the interstellar police (CONCORD). The safest value is 1.0, and areas down to 0.5 are all protected by CONCORD's fleet. From 0.4 down systems become progressively more dangerous and unprotected, and at 0.0 are entirely lawless.

502663.en: System security indicates how dangerous a particular system may be to capsuleers.

502665.en: Regions are the largest geographical designation. Their grouping of constellations are in most cases collectively owned by a faction, empire or alliance, an ownership that brings several advantages to the power in question.

502666.en: A region is a geographical grouping of constellations with shared properties, including ownership and services.

502668.en: Every solar system, constellation and region belongs to someone. In some cases, the owners are factions that were established a hundreds or even thousands of years ago and have no intention of relinquishing control. In other cases, particularly on the edges of known space, territory can be owned by capsuleers themselves, and may be fought over every day for the benefits it brings to the owners.

502669.en: All areas of known space are under ownership, and some may be conquered by capsuleers.

502671.en: A constellation is really not a system. A tiny number of constellations are called COSMOS and include agents who give out missions for sites in those same constellations.

502672.en: A constellation is not a system.

502674.en: Solar systems are the smallest unit of territorial space in New Eden. They are linked by stargates, which allow interstellar travel at velocities beyond the speed of light. Each may contain space stations with various capsuleer services, sites whose raw materials that may be extracted for sale or production, and potentially hostile ships that may carry bounties.

502675.en: The New Eden cluster is composed of solar systems, many of which contain interesting, useful, or profitable resources.

502778.en: *There will be neither compassion nor mercy; Nor peace, nor solace For those who bear witness to these Signs And still do not believe * - Scriptures, Book of Reclaiming

502780.en: *Our goals were noble. We went forward with pure intent; to strengthen and protect the ideals of the Federation against all our enemies. But even the noblest of goals can fall afoul of dark circumstance.* - Jacus Roden, President

502781.en: *We will submit no more, to neither despot nor nation. Let it be known from this day forth that we are a race of warriors, not slaves, and that we will fight to the last drop of blood for what we hold dear.* - Maleatu Shakor, Sanmatar

502784.en: *We welcome our passengers onboard this convoy flight to Yulai, and would like to remind everyone that stowaways may be jettisoned into the orbit of the nearest planet, whether habitable or not.*

502785.en: The moons of Amarr Prime have long been the subject of prophecy.

502786.en: *Clearing out a roid belt involves precise coordination between several ships extracting raw materials, several haulers ready to bring them back to station, and ourselves, ready to rob them blind the moment they let down their guard.*

502787.en: *Damnit! Guys, our wormhole back to k-space just collapsed. Anyone got a bookmark, or are we going to have to kill ourselves and clone jump back in?*

502788.en: You never know what will be on the other side, so the first thing you do after activating an acceleration gate is prep for getting the hell out again.

502789.en: *I just scanned down a Guristas Hub. Hoping I'll find leads to Pith's Penal Complex after I'm done murdering everyone in there.*

502790.en: *Gentlemen, I am well aware of where we are, and yes, I know crewing a capsuleer ship is an arduous and potentially lethal task with not a lot of levity at times, but just so I am absolutely clear on this, the next person to point out a porthole and humorously ask who 'let one go' is going to be unceremoniously dropped into the reactor.*

502791.en: *I don't see the big deal, I just jumped into lowsec and I'm fi-*

502792.en: Eight recently discovered regions were found to contain multitudes of valuable ore, hundreds of moons and planets that could be harvested and used for territorial control, and several hives of rogue drones who did not appreciate the company.

502793.en: *If we drop that last POS we can go for their TCU and contest sov with our own, assuming we don't get blown to pieces at some point.*

502794.en: *Turn right at the nearest COSMOS constellation*

502795.en: New Eden contains over five thousand known solar systems, with a glut of new ones having recently been discovered (discovery in this instance being defined by the ability to squeeze through both ends of a wormhole without getting killed).

504076.en:
It's often a good idea to trade items between star systems, since prices vary based on supply and demand. Star systems in New Eden are connected by stargates.

Move your minerals from the hangar to your ship's cargo hold. This is the cargo you will be selling in another star system.

Undock and look for a stargate in your Overview. You can identify it by the icon shown below, and use it to jump to another system. Use the radial menu to fly to a stargate and jump through.

504077.en: Travel to a new star system

504078.en: To use station services you will have to dock. Find the station icon in space or in your Overview. Use the radial menu to issue the dock command. Once you are close enough, the automatic docking procedure will start.

504081.en:
You will notice that ships have three layers of defenses: shields, armor and structure. Once your weapons have penetrated their shields and armor and inflict catastrophic damage to the structure, their hulls will give in and their reactors will explode. Attack your target until it's destroyed.

As these are criminals, a bounty will be processed and paid into your wallet. Then, prepare to remove the rest of our enemies infesting this area.

504086.en:
A database of Career Agents working with your school is available to you. Take a look at the fields the agents specialize in.

Open a conversation with the agent working the field that appeals to you by right clicking on their portrait and selecting Start Conversation. The Military or Industry Career Agents are good starting places.

504088.en:
Once you've completed all the requirements of a mission, return to the agent and signal your completion of the mission by opening a new conversation and letting them know of your success.

Career Agents provide a variety of missions that will give you some useful experience as a pilot in New Eden. It would be a good idea to carry on working for your chosen Career Agent. Alternatively, you could see what a different agent has to offer.

504091.en:
Your ship has a built in warp drive, an incredibly powerful engine allowing you to cross great distances within star systems in a short amount of time. You can use this drive to warp to the station in this star system.

Stations will be very important locations for you that offer capsuleers a variety of useful services that we should now explore. Warp to the station now by left clicking on its icon in the overview and selecting warp to within 0km.

504093.en:
To try buying from the market, let's acquire the Social skill, a basic skill for improving agent relations. Open the Market using the icon in the Neocom and search for "Social". Select it from the results and you will see sell orders. You can buy the Social skill by right clicking an order and selecting “Buy this”.

Note that the skill should be 20,000 ISK. Try not to pay more than that. Once you have bought the skill, open up your personal assets window on the Neocom to the left to locate your skill book. If you need to travel to station where the skill was bought, click "set destination", and the route to that station will be indicated.

504095.en:
For an item to be sold, it must be in a station hangar. You should dock in a station in this system.

Once docked, move your cargo to the hangar. Then you can right click an item you have in the station and select Sell This Item. Check the details and click Sell.

504097.en: Filters don't apply when search is active

504098.en:
Open your Character Sheet in the Neocom, by clicking on your small portrait in the top left corner.

Under the Skills tab, select a skill group, and then drag a skill in the group to the Training Queue to start training.

Try the Signature Analysis skill in the Targeting skill group. This skill will increase the speed with which you lock targets.

504100.en:
When you've docked at the station where your Career Agent is located, open a new conversation with them.

They will offer a mission that should be of interest to you, accept it and you can begin to carry out the required tasks.

505039.en: Planetary Industry (P.I.) is an industry process that takes raw materials from a planet and turns them into goods available on the market at large. Creating extractors, processors and other parts of the industry involves setting up a command center and investing ISK to set it all up. Like most industries, you must have some skills trained to get started. The Remote Sensing skill allows you to survey planets for areas rich in natural resources. Other skills are necessary for running multiple colonies or running colonies remotely. These skills are available on the market.

505046.en:
You can set a course for your ship by double clicking anywhere in space. Try double clicking near one of the hostile ships that are indicated by red icons.

Keep in mind, that if you do not stop at some point, you could be floating out there forever. You can stop your ship by clicking the minus symbol on the speedometer that is located on your ship HUD in the bottom middle of the screen.

505049.en: Once you are ready to head back into space for more action, start the undock sequence by clicking the indicated large yellow arrow.

505052.en: You will now continue building your wealth in New Eden. Your ship has a mining laser fitted to it. Mining lasers are powerful industrial tools that break up the rock and retrieve the valuable ores. The laser can be activated on your selected asteroid target by left clicking the icon for it in the HUD below.

505055.en: Find the closest asteroid and target lock it, just like you would do with an enemy. You can also hold-click the asteroid and use the radial menu to target it.

505058.en:
Before you can open fire, you will need to lock the ship's weapons system on your target. You can lock in the enemy by right clicking the ship in the overview and selecting “lock target”. Alternatively you can hold down the left mouse button over the ship to open the radial menu and select the lock command.

If the hostiles haven’t engaged you already, they certainly will once they see your gun ports open. Do not worry. You are a capsuleer and with my guidance they will be no match for you.

505061.en:
The nearby hostile ships are not controlled by capsuleers, as indicated by their icons. These individuals have chosen to live outside the bounds of civilized behavior. You should restore order by eliminating them.

The red color indicates they are hostile and legitimate targets. Select an enemy ship by clicking on it or choosing it in the overview then right click and choose to begin an orbit around the enemy ship. Orbiting a ship puts you in a good position to engage in combat with it.

505064.en: The Rogue Cloning Facility in this system is hidden in a field of asteroids, warp out there. Asteroids can also be found in asteroid belts or in anomalies shown in your sensor overlay. Find an asteroid in the area of the Rogue Cloning Facility, then use the radial menu to begin orbiting it.

505067.en:
You can safely store items and ships in hangars at any station. This is important for building your wealth in New Eden.

Open your inventory using the pictured icon, found on the Neocom bar on the left side of your screen. With the inventory open, drag items between your active ship's cargo and the item hangar.

505070.en:
Destroyed ship wrecks often contain valuable loot that you can either use or sell for hard cash.

Hold down the left mouse button over the wreck and open cargo hold on the radial menu that appears. When you have the wreck open you can select Loot All to quickly transfer the all the contents to your ship's cargo hold.

505073.en: While in a station, you can drag new modules into the slots on your ship using the fitting service, which can be opened using the icon below. What will fit on your ship depends on how many slots are available as well as how much powergrid and CPU is free on your ship.

505080.en: You can't deliver everything as there are simply too many items there already.

A corporation's CEO/Director may change this setting, subject to a 24 hour delay.

505132.en:
Your ship's armament is a short range, rapid fire turret weapon. You will want to be close to your prey for best effect. To fire your weapon left click on the weapon icon in your ships HUD, and it will begin firing at your locked target.

You can monitor the enemy ship using the target display. Notice how the damage improves as your orbit gets closer. This will not necessarily be true of all weapons but this one is optimized for close-in fighting.

The new rules will come in to effect at {[datetime]dueDate, date=full, time=short}, after which corporation members may freely attack each other.

The star map contains an enormous amount of information about New Eden, open it from the Neocom.

If you scroll in, you will notice that your route to the Career Agent is highlighted.

505391.en:
The Career Agent wants you to visit them. You can set their location as your destination by clicking the Set Destination button next to their portrait.

A route will be automatically planned towards that destination which you can see in the route info panel to the left.

505394.en:
The next stargate in your route will always have a yellow icon like the one below.

Find this gate in the Overview and jump through to move closer to your destination.

505397.en:
If you have a destination set, activating the autopilot will automatically warp and jump your ship towards your destination until it is reached. While useful, Autopilot is not as fast as manual travel.

Activate autopilot by clicking the A button in your HUD below.

505400.en:
The goal of ship fitting is to configure your ship for a certain purpose, achieved by changing the modules slotted onto your ship. To begin, let's remove a high slot module from your ship.

To try this out, open the Fitting Service and remove a module currently fitted to the ship. For instance, your current gun can be dragged it to your items hangar. You'll now have the module as an item. Don’t worry, it fits right back on.

505403.en:
Your ship's high slots are primarily used for weapons, mining lasers and probe launchers. Find a high slot module, such as a gun or a mining laser, and add it to your ship.

If you have acquired another mining laser it will come in handy. The civilian modules your ship came with are surpassed by many different variations. You should continuously seek to improve your ship's fitting so you can leave a greater mark on the world.

505406.en:
The ship’s mid slots are often fit with modules used to enhance your shield, electronic warfare and propulsion. Find a mid slot module in your cargo bay or hangar, such as an afterburner or a shield booster, and add it to your ship.

If you don't have a mid slot item, you might like to try your luck by destroying and looting the hostiles at the Rogue Cloning Facility. To do this, you would need to undock by clicking the indicated large yellow arrow, find the Rogue Cloning Station Facility in your overview and warp to it.

505409.en:
The low slots are used for armor, structure, and damage enhancing modules. Find a low slot module, such as an armor repairer or a damage control, and add it to your ship.

Again, if you don't have a low slot item, you might like to try your luck with the hostiles at the Rogue Cloning Facility. Once you've fitted some mid and low slot items, you will have a more powerful ship setup.

505412.en: Some modules require charges to be used. Weapons, capacitor injectors and probe launchers are some examples. Find a module that requires charges and load it.

505415.en: Start a conversation with a person of interest by right clicking their name. If you don't know anyone, don't be shy, simply tell them you are a rookie and that you are learning the ropes.

505418.en: The Local channel is the public chat forum for the star system you are in and it displays all capsuleers presently in it. Greet everyone in Local, or salute them with the o7 call sign.

505424.en: Wrecks can be stripped of salvage materials using a Salvager module. To use one, have it fitted to an available high slot on your ship, lock a wreck and activate the Salvager module.

505439.en: If you find a corporation that appeals to you, apply to join it and with a bit of luck you'll be accepted as a member. Alternatively, you could start your own corporation.

505445.en:
Use an installed blueprint to start a manufacturing job in a station with the Industry service. You may need to gather some materials in your station hangar to do this.

Options to gather materials include: killing hostiles and looting them, buying material from the market, or going out and mining resources.

505448.en:
Raw ore needs to be reprocessed in order to turn it into refined, usable minerals. Reprocessing can extract valuable minerals from the ore depending on how skillful you are at the process. Many items can also be reprocessed into minerals.

You can reprocess the raw ore you've collected by docking in a station and using the Reprocessing service that can be accessed by right clicking the ore.

You can set your camera viewpoint to look at objects near you, other than your own ship, such as enemies or asteroids.

Enemy ships are identified by their red icon. Right click a red icon and use the Look At command to inspect a nearby enemy vessel. This is an example of a hostile ship you will soon need to eliminate to make this system safer.

505530.en:
After looking at other ships or objects, you can always bring your viewpoint back to your ship by right clicking and selecting Look At My Ship.

Do it now and take a good look at your ship. Its capsule technology and deadly weaponry means you can deal with those criminals.

505605.en: You cannot change your ships appearance while cloaked, having a target locked, or under a disabling effect such as cynosural fields or being in ship transforming modes.

505608.en:
Congratulations, you have now taken your first step towards building an industrial empire. Now complete a finished manufacturing job to deliver your items to the hangar.

If you want to further hone your industrial skill set, it can be useful to think about what type of production pipeline will be profitable based on the market and what type of resource capabilities, such as mining or trading, you need to establish to excel at the trade.

505611.en: Not all wrecks have recoverable salvage, and the quality and quantity of salvage can vary. When successful, the Salvager module will place the recovered salvage materials into your ship's cargo hold.

505614.en: Some exploration sites register as cosmic anomalies on your sensor overlay and your warp drives will easily lock onto their location. See if you can find a cosmic anomaly in your system and warp to it.

505617.en: Corporation search lets you find corporations that might be suitable for you. Go to the Corporation interface, open Recruitment at the Search tab, and set your preferred options to search on.

505620.en: Blueprints are needed if you want to start your own production run of some item. Blueprints can be purchased from the market, the contract system or found in the wrecks of some hostile ships. If you don’t own a blueprint, try your luck with taking down some hostile ships in the Rogue Cloning Facility. The outlaws there often carry blueprints they have stolen from your empire.

505623.en: You can launch probes into space using the Probe Scanner accessed via the Scanners radial button. Try using the spread formation initially, then adjusting the formation and probe scan range as you narrow down the location of signatures.

505626.en: Scan probe results on the system map can vary visually, according to the accuracy of the returned signal. Visual indicators go from a sphere, circle, two dots to a single dot as accuracy increases. Once scan strength reaches 100%, you will be able to warp to the location.

505629.en: Many sites in New Eden are hidden and only register as faint cosmic signatures. These sites must be discovered using scanner probes. To use these you must fit a scanner probe launcher and load it with the probes.

505646.en: Jumping through a wormhole is one of the more adventurous forms of exploration. Experienced explorers can tell a lot about where a wormhole leads from its appearance but this may be a real leap into the unknown for you.

505649.en: When you've jumped through a wormhole, it is a good idea to first save the location of its exit point in the system you have just entered. Do this now and you will be able to find your way back.

505996.en: Acceleration gate technology reaches far back to the expansion era of the empires that survived the great EVE gate collapse. While their individual setup might differ in terms of ship size they can transport and whether they require a certain passkey or code to be used, all share the same fundamental function of hurling space vessels to a destination beacon within solar system boundaries.

506006.en: The Imp is an advanced Sansha's Nation Interceptor intended for use by forward parties of True Power's feared harvester squadrons. Able to penetrate even the most intense blockades, hunt down stragglers or simply hold ships while waiting for the main harvester force to arrive, the Imp is yet another case of Sansha's Nation technology improving on existing advanced hardware. Like most Sansha's Nation equipment, the few captured examples of the Imp have proven to be readily adaptable for capsuleer use.

506010.en: The Fiend was originally designed by Sansha's Nation as a Heavy Interdiction Cruiser for use by elite harvester squadrons as a means to capture and board ships typically requiring large crew complements. The advanced interdiction technology the vessel is equipped with allows it to generate warp disruption fields without impairing its flight characteristics. This allows these formidable ships to easily chase down and hold even the fastest vessels in the larger size brackets. As with other Sansha's Nation equipment, the handful of captured Fiends in commercial hands have proven to be adaptable for capsuleer use.

506150.en:
Named after Tyma Raitaru, who pioneered the development of modern day missile technology, the Raitaru Engineering Complex is a medium-sized structure from the Upwell Consortium and is specialized in manufacturing and research operations.

The Raitaru is the entry-level Engineering Complex in the Upwell Consortium’s new line of structures, and is able to use Upwell's Standup Service modules, allowing flexibility and customization of its functions. This dedicated industrial structure also provides access to Upwell’s M-Set line of rigs designed to improve productivity and optimization of various aspects of manufacturing and research.

The Raitaru provides tethering technology and has docking capabilities for subcapital ships and freighters.

506152.en:
Named after Li Azbel, a Gallente scientist who pioneered the first breakthroughs in faster than light communications, the Azbel Engineering Complex is a large-sized structure from the Upwell Consortium and is specialized in manufacturing and research operations. 

The Azbel Engineering Complex fits into the industrial major-player spot in the Upwell Consortium’s new line of structures, and is able to use Upwell's Standup Service modules, allowing flexibility and customization of its functions. This dedicated industrial structure also provides access to Upwell’s L-Set line of rigs designed to improve productivity and optimization of various aspects of manufacturing and research.

Due to its large size this engineering complex can accommodate construction of capital ships using the Standup Capital Shipyard I Service Module.

The Azbel provides tethering technology and has docking capabilities for subcapital ships and freighters.

506156.en:
Named after one of the co-creators of the first Caldari warp drive, the Sotiyo-Urbaata Drive, the Sotiyo serves as a mega-scale manufacturing and assembly site for everything from subcapital ships and modules, up to supercapital class hulls. 

The Sotiyo is the Engineering Complex fit for megacorporations in the Upwell Consortium’s new line of structures, and is able to use Upwell's Standup Service modules, allowing flexibility and customization of its functions. This dedicated industrial structure also provides access to Upwell’s XL-Set line of rigs designed to improve productivity and optimization of various aspects of manufacturing and research.

Due to its extra-large size this engineering complex can accommodate construction of supercapital ships using the Standup Supercapital Shipyard I Service Module.

The Sotiyo provides tethering technology and has docking capabilities for capital-size ships and below.

On June 14th YC125 CONCORD updated the capsuleer structure regulations to disallow the anchoring of any new XL structures in highsec space. XL structures that were anchored before this date will not be affected by this change unless they are unanchored.

506164.en:
As the entry-level product in the Upwell Consortium's Citadel range of space stations, the Astrahus has been designed as an economical option for medium-scale operations in space, such as serving as a base of operations for a small- to medium-sized corporation, or as an outpost for larger corporations or even small alliances.

The Astrahus has been built with new spaceship tethering technology as standard, and will happily accommodate ships under capital size, and even freighter-class hulls, in its internal docking bays. The Astrahus can be configured using Upwell's Standup brand service and structure modules so as to serve the specific needs of the structure operator. Further adjustment of the hardware of the Astrahus can be achieved by installed Standup M-Set rigs to optimize the specific role of the citadel.

506166.en:
Conceived as a good balance of capability and investment in the Upwell Consortium's Citadel range of space stations, the Fortizar has been designed for large-scale operations in space, such as providing a well-equipped home for large corporations and small alliances, or as a border or trade post for larger alliances.

The Fortizar has been built with new spaceship tethering technology as standard, and will readily accommodate most ships, including freighters and even capital ships, in its internal docking bays. While the docks are unable to service 'supercapital' level vessels, the defensive capabilities of the Fortizar are considerably enhanced in lower security star systems with the ability to mount area effect weapons. The Fortizar can be configured using Upwell's Standup brand service and structure modules so as to serve the specific needs of the structure operator. Further adjustment of the hardware of the Fortizar can be achieved by installed Standup L-Set rigs to optimize the specific role of the citadel.

506168.en:
Envisaged as the flagship product in the Upwell Consortium's Citadel range of space stations, the Keepstar has been designed for the most important and largest-scale of operations in space, such as providing a fully-featured home for large alliances, and even coalitions, or as a key element in the fortification of large territorial empires.

The Keepstar has been built with new spaceship tethering technology as standard, and it will accommodate all size classes of ship, including 'supercapital' vessels, in its internal docking bays. The defensive capabilities of the Keepstar are formidable and are highly enhanced in lower security star systems with the ability to mount area effect and 'doomsday' weapons. The Keepstar can be configured using Upwell's Standup brand service and structure modules so as to serve the specific needs of the structure operator. Further adjustment of the hardware of the Keepstar can be achieved by installed Standup XL-Set rigs to optimize the specific role of the citadel.

On June 14th YC125 CONCORD updated the capsuleer structure regulations to disallow the anchoring of any new XL structures in highsec space. XL structures that were anchored before this date will not be affected by this change unless they are unanchored.

506170.en: “Seen thousands of auto miners come and go. Like a bucket quarry in space. Easy to get used to. New tech's more like slicing out a volcano and bringing the whole thing up. Don’t think I’ll ever get used to it.” – Ramon Fulcan, veteran moon-mining engineer The Athanor Refinery is a medium-sized structure from the Upwell Consortium and specialized for moon-mining and reaction-based industrial operations. The Athanor is the standard refinery in the Upwell Consortium’s line of industrial structures, and is able to use Upwell's Standup Service modules, allowing flexibility and customization of its functions. This dedicated extraction and refining structure also provides access to Upwell’s M-Set line of rigs designed to improve productivity and optimization of various aspects of chemical reaction and moon-mining operations. The Athanor has docking facilities for subcapital ships and freighters. The Moon Drill Service Module can only be installed if the Refinery is deployed on the eligible moon mining position.

506172.en: “Oh yeah, I was at C0T-77 when the fusion reactor went critical and blew the side out of the Crown Seven mineworks. We got more promethium out of the debris field in a day than in a month of drilling. I guess it got someone to thinking.” – Ramon Fulcan, veteran moon-mining engineer The Tatara Refinery is a large-sized structure from the Upwell Consortium and specialized for moon-mining and reaction-based industrial operations. The Tatara is the heavy-duty, extended operations refinery in the Upwell Consortium’s line of industrial structures, and is able to use Upwell's Standup Service modules, allowing flexibility and customization of its functions. This dedicated extraction and refining structure also provides access to Upwell’s L-Set line of rigs designed to improve productivity and optimization of various aspects of chemical reaction and moon-mining operations. The Tatara has docking facilities for subcapital ships, freighters, and capital industrial ships. The Moon Drill Service Module can only be installed if the Refinery is deployed on the eligible moon mining position.

506316.en: The Standup Supercapital Shipyard I is a service module that allows the manufacturing of Capital and Supercapital Ships when installed into an Upwell technology structure. While an Upwell Structure has at least one service module online, it will enter "full power" mode and gain significantly increased shield and armor hitpoints and an extra reinforcement cycle. Standup is a proprietary system that uses a Structure Autonomous Nanoassembly Device (Upwell) containing integrated template software, a nanoassembler array and sufficient nanomass to enable the construction of a variety of service modules, structure modules and structure rigs when inserted into the appropriate slots on a structure built with Upwell technology. Note: The installation of this Service Module is restricted to the Sotiyo Engineering Complex

Note that this facility does not enable compression of Harvestable Gas Clouds and Moon Asteroids, which is only possible using on board compression modules fitted to Industrial Command Ships and Capital Industrial Command Ships.

The Standup Multirole Missile Launcher is a space superiority missile capable of efficiently intercepting and destroying targets in the sub-capital ship size classes. This launcher may be used with Standup Light, Heavy, or Cruise missiles. The Multirole Launcher system can be installed as a module in Upwell technology structures.

Standup is a proprietary system that uses a Structure Autonomous Nanoassembly Device (Upwell) containing integrated template software, a nanoassembler array and sufficient nanomass to enable the construction of a variety of service modules, structure modules and structure rigs when inserted into the appropriate slots on a structure built with Upwell technology.

506408.en:
The Standup Guided Bomb Launcher is a structure emplaced system that is capable of launching and directing area-effect bombs equipped with guidance thrusters and the necessary astrogation gear. The Guided Bomb Launcher can be installed as a module in Upwell technology structures.

Standup is a proprietary system that uses a Structure Autonomous Nanoassembly Device (Upwell) containing integrated template software, a nanoassembler array and sufficient nanomass to enable the construction of a variety of service modules, structure modules and structure rigs when inserted into the appropriate slots on a structure built with Upwell technology.

This module can be installed on large and extra-large Upwell structures.
This module does not function in high-security space.

506410.en:
The Standup XL Energy Neutralizer is superheavy capacitor warfare device capable of draining the energy reserves of extra-large ships, such as capital ships. The XL Energy Neutralizer is designed to be mounted in structure emplacements and can be installed as a module in Upwell technology structures.

Standup is a proprietary system that uses a Structure Autonomous Nanoassembly Device (Upwell) containing integrated template software, a nanoassembler array and sufficient nanomass to enable the construction of a variety of service modules, structure modules and structure rigs when inserted into the appropriate slots on a structure built with Upwell technology.

506412.en:
The Standup Heavy Energy Neutralizer is a precision capacitor warfare device capable of locking on and draining the energy reserves of all types of hostile ships. The Standup Heavy Energy Neutralizer is designed to be mounted in structure emplacements and can be installed as a module in Upwell technology structures.

Standup is a proprietary system that uses a Structure Autonomous Nanoassembly Device (Upwell) containing integrated template software, a nanoassembler array and sufficient nanomass to enable the construction of a variety of service modules, structure modules and structure rigs when inserted into the appropriate slots on a structure built with Upwell technology.

506414.en:
The Standup Point Defense Battery is a system designed to provide close point defense capability to space structures, providing area denial as required by structure operators. The Point Defense Battery is designed as an integrated PDC network and can be installed as a module in Upwell technology structures.

Standup is a proprietary system that uses a Structure Autonomous Nanoassembly Device (Upwell) containing integrated template software, a nanoassembler array and sufficient nanomass to enable the construction of a variety of service modules, structure modules and structure rigs when inserted into the appropriate slots on a structure built with Upwell technology.

This module does not function in high-security space.

506416.en:
The Standup CSP Tractor Beam mounts tractor beam arrays capable of effectively countering ship propulsion systems and will effectively allow structure operators to manage the busy navigation lanes around their properties. 507183.en:
The Assault dropsuit is a versatile frontline combat suit that combines excellent protection, good mobility, and sufficient hard points for mission-specific customizations.

A hydra-membrane graft directly integrates the suit with the wearer’s neurological system. While painful, this neuromorphic interface improves processing speed and reaction time while also allowing the suit to draw a limited, renewable supply of energy from the wearer’s body, which in turn can be applied to reinforce shield systems or augment overall power output. Aesthetics are a vital aspect of the suit’s design, because to the Amarr, aesthetics are function. Enshrined within the armor, the wearer becomes a vessel, the embodiment of God’s will and an instrument of holy wrath, unmistakable, and feared, by all who look upon him. To the Amarr, the dropsuit itself is the weapon.

Assault dropsuits are intended for standard combat operations or those in which the objectives are likely to change at a moment’s notice. Its ability to carry anything from small arms and explosives to anti-vehicle munitions and deployable support gear makes it the most adaptable direct combat suit on the battlefield.
507183.it:
L'armatura d'assalto è una versatile attrezzatura per combattimenti al fronte: combina un'eccellente protezione, una buona mobilità e un numero sufficiente di punti resistenti per personalizzazioni destinate a missioni specifiche.

La tecnologia dei nativi Minmatar favorisce soluzioni dirette, una conseguenza del passato indigente della nascente Nazione. Privata delle legature aptiche e della tecnologia dei sensori tipici dell'armatura logistica, la variante da assalto è una soluzione leggera e a bassa potenza che utilizza una combinazione di scudi e lamiere resistive che consentono di difendersi dal fuoco nemico. Il suo esoscheletro assistito idraulico e agile aumenta la velocità dei movimenti e la forza di chi lo usa, mentre la corazza reattiva dall'involucro duro protegge chi la indossa da un'ampia gamma di balistica da armi piccole. Un riciclatore mimetico conserva e reinstrada la potenza in eccesso come opportuno.

Le armature d'assalto sono destinate alle operazioni di combattimento standard o a quelle in cui è possibile che gli obiettivi cambino da un momento all'altro. La capacità di trasportare esplosivi e armi, dalle più piccole alle pesanti munizioni anti-veicolo, e l'equipaggiamento di supporto la rendono l'armatura da combattimento diretto più adattabile sul campo di battaglia.

507185.en:

A flat-coil e5000 fifth generation fusion core runs up the inside of the back plate, powering the entire suit. Its output and heat buildup are controlled by a L2 “Gatekeeper” regulator conduit, which connects directly to the sensor system at the base of the neck. Every joint is reinforced with kinetic sensors and two-way, high torque servos to enhance the soldier’s strength, balance, and resistance to impact forces. The suit’s helmet has more integrated sensor, communication, targeting, and data processing systems than most civilian vehicles. As is common with Caldari designs, armor plating is limited to vital areas, relying instead on high-power shield systems to protect the wearer.

Assault dropsuits are intended for standard combat operations or those in which the objectives are likely to change at a moment’s notice. 507187.en:
The Assault dropsuit is a versatile frontline combat suit that combines excellent protection, good mobility, and sufficient hard points for mission-specific customizations.

Gallente forces have access to some of the most advanced armor systems in the cluster. An ablative-variant solution is used to dissipate energy across available surface area with only minimal degradation of the material at the impact point resulting in armor that is efficient and durable enough to maintain operational integrity for multiple short-term engagements. Augmented ferro-fibre musculature enhances the soldier’s strength, balance, and reaction time, while quad-opsis sensors allow wide arc identification and prioritization of battlefield targets.

Assault dropsuits are intended for standard combat operations or those in which the objectives are likely to change at a moment’s notice. Its ability to carry anything from small arms and explosives to anti-vehicle munitions and deployable support gear makes it the most adaptable direct combat suit on the battlefield.

507191.en:
The Logistics dropsuit is outfitted with the latest in integrated diagnostic technology, most of which revolves around maintaining the condition and efficiency of squad mates and their equipment. As such, a soldier equipped with this class of dropsuit becomes a force multiplier, greatly improving the overall effectiveness of the unit.

The Amarr variant is a durable, combat-focused suit that provides above-average protection, allowing logistic units to operate in the middle of a firefight, actively dispersing aid and support as needed while simultaneously engaging the enemy and inflicting trauma of its own.

When deployed, a soldier equipped with a Logistics suit fills a vital tactical role in small unit operations and full-scale warfare, providing both, medical and mechanical support.
507191.it:
L'armatura logistica è equipaggiata con gli ultimi ritrovati della tecnologia diagnostica integrata, gran parte della quale riguarda il mantenimento della condizione fisica e dell'efficienza dei compagni di squadriglia e della loro attrezzatura. Un soldato munito di questo tipo di armatura diventa un moltiplicatore delle forze in campo, migliorando sensibilmente l'efficacia complessiva dell'unità.

Utilizzando una combinazione di attrezzature tecnologiche avanzate e non, gli operatori dell'armatura logistica sono in grado di effettuare riparazioni efficaci a installazioni, veicoli e persino ad altri soldati; ogni apparato richiesto per l'assistenza sul campo è disponibile e facilmente accessibile dai tasconi e dalle cartelle applicate all'armatura. L'esoscheletro idraulico-assistito consente a chi lo indossa di sollevare senza sforzo attrezzature pesanti, mentre il casco è ricco di scanner per materiali così sensibili da individuare una microfrattura nell'acciaio multistrato.

Un soldato con un'armatura logistica ricopre un ruolo tattico vitale sia nelle operazioni con unità ridotte sia nella guerra su larga scala, fornendo supporto medico e meccanico.

507193.en:
The Commando dropsuit is a variable combat unit capable of reacting to battlefield threats as they emerge. Built using a repurposed heavy frame, the suit is designed for maximum offensive flexibility. The streamlined frame does away with extraneous armor layers, using the augmented power of the exoskeleton to instead shoulder the weight and bulk of two light-class weapons.

Interlaced with subframe wiring, the Amarr variant utilizes asymmetric power distribution to intelligently reroute power to the suit’s various subsystems as needed. This improved throughput allows light-class laser weaponry to draw from the suit’s power reserves to enhance the damage dealt.

The Commando is the ultimate suppression fighter. What the suit sacrifices in tactical versatility, it more than makes up for with flexible weapon loadouts that can counter any of the myriad threats an ever-evolving battlefield may present.
507193.it:
L'armatura Commando è un'unità di combattimento variabile in grado di reagire alle minacce che sorgono sul campo di battaglia. Costruita utilizzando un telaio pesante reinventato, l'armatura è progettata per la massima flessibilità offensiva. Il telaio aerodinamico elimina gli strati dell'armatura estranei, utilizzando la potenza aumentata dell'esoscheletro per distribuire il peso e il carico di due armi di classe leggera sulle spalle.

Intrecciata con cablaggio interno, la variante Amarr utilizza una distribuzione di potenza asimmetrica per reindirizzare in modo intelligente la potenza ai sottosistemi di scudo e corazza, migliorando l'efficienza dei moduli utilizzati da questi pacchetti in uscita. 

Il Commando è il combattente massimo della soppressione. Ciò che l'armatura sacrifica in flessibilità tattica, viene compensato con accessori versatili per armi che possono contrastare la miriade di minacce che un campo di battaglia in continua evoluzione può presentare.

507207.en:
The Scout dropsuit is a lightweight suit optimized for enhanced mobility, multi-spectrum stealth, and heightened awareness. Augmented joint servo motors give every movement extra speed and flexibility, while integrated friction and impact dampening materials reduce the overall sound signature. 

Building on recent advancements in biotic technology, this suit incorporates an array of cardiovascular augmentations that are automatically administered to the user in battle, improving overall stamina and reducing fatigue. 

When missions call for speed and stealth, situations in which heavily armored suits would be more of a burden than an advantage, a scout dropsuit is the best option. The enhanced mobility it provides makes up for its relatively low protection, and when combined with stealth technology modules, the scout suit is the obvious choice for infiltration, counter-espionage, and assassination.
507207.it:
L'armatura da ricognitore è leggera e ottimizzata per migliorare la mobilità, la capacità di occultamento multi-spettro e l'attenzione. I servomotori aumentati delle giunzioni forniscono un livello extra di velocità e flessibilità a ogni movimento, mentre i materiali integrati di smorzamento delle frizioni e degli impatti riducono la rumorosità complessiva. 

Questa armatura high-tech è rivestita con una mimetizzazione adattiva: un sottile strato di membrane bio-ermetiche intrecciate a microscopici sensori ottici che controllano milioni di singoli cristalli di ferro pigmentati. Un sensore AI-53 "All Eyes" integrato è inserito all'interno del casco, che include anche un sistema di filtraggio atmosferico chimicamente trattato.

Quando una missione richiede velocità e capacità di nascondersi, cioè in situazioni in cui le armature pesantemente corazzate sono più un peso che un vantaggio, l'armatura da ricognitore rappresenta l'opzione migliore. La migliore mobilità bilancia la sua protezione relativamente bassa e, quando viene abbinata a moduli con tecnologia di occultamento, l'armatura da ricognitore è la scelta obbligata per azioni di infiltrazione, controspionaggio e assassinio.

Additionally, its power-assisted exoskeleton facilitates usage of the heaviest caliber personal weapons.

Every vital area of the wearer is protected by 25mm of composite ceramic shell or high tensile steel plates, layered with impact absorbing, compressed carbon latticework. A secondary thermal dispersion membrane channels excess heat away from the point of contact, distributing it over a larger surface area and thereby lessening the potential damage. Superconductive veins of hybrid silver coat the outer layers and connect every piece of the armor to a grounding heat sink, dampening the harmful effects of direct fire electromagnetic weaponry.

Heavy frame dropsuits lack the mobility of lighter suits, but this trade-off results in a defensive system that defies standard infantry conventions. No other classification of personal armor can claim to be able to stand toe-to-toe with enemy vehicles and survive.

Inoltre, l'esoscheletro ad alimentazione assistita facilita l'utilizzo delle armi personali con i calibri più grossi. Basata su una forte struttura esoscheletrica, l'armatura da sentinella Minmatar è capace di sopportare alcune delle più terribili condizioni della galassia. Sistemi di scudi rinforzati e modifiche della corazza migliorano la sua durata in combattimento, mentre i vari meccanismi di supporto, usati per accrescere il movimento, rendono quest'armatura seconda solo alla variante Minmatar commando in termini di velocità e mobilità generale. Alle armature pesanti manca la mobilità dei modelli più leggeri, ma ciò viene compensato da un sistema difensivo che supera le regole standard della fanteria. Nessun altro tipo di corazza personale è in grado di poter affrontare di petto un veicolo nemico e sopravvivere.

507303.en: Objective: Assist the Amarr Navy in clearing their Encampment from the Drifter invasion.
