648235.en: CONCORD's analysis has revealed only scant and confusing information about this structure. Surveys of the damaged areas of the structure reveal a series of clearly powerful but functionally mysterious elements. The structure is undoubtedly Jove in origin but it is hard to determine its exact age given the advanced nature of the materials and construction. Regardless of its age, it is safe to say the structure surpasses anything we have previously seen.

648239.en:
This Imperial Stellar Transmuter represents the Amarr Empire’s mature development of a technology it first acquired through its control of a captured Triglavian “Dazh Porevitium Transmuter” in the Arshat system. The Empire developed the first prototype Stellar Transmuters fusing Triglavian technology with known principles of stellar harvesting, and deployed three such prototypes in the contested warzone systems of Egmar, Turnur, and Vard.

Despite setbacks such as the loss of the Turnur prototype in a catastrophic stellar event that devastated the system, and the subsequent capture of the Egmar and Vard prototypes by the Minmatar Republic, the Amarr Empire learned much from its experiments and perfected its grasp of the technology. The first mature Imperial Stellar Transmuter was deployed in the Ohide system as a key element of the power and critical resource base required for operating an Imperial Interstellar Shipcaster network.

648241.en:
This Republic Stellar Transmuter is the culmination of the Minmatar Republic’s successful development of a technology it seized from the Amarr Empire in the conflict over Imperial Prototype Stellar Transmuters in the warzone systems of Egmar and Vard. With the Minmatar system of Turnur devastated by a stellar catastrophe triggered by a runaway Prototype Stellar Transmuter, the Republic’s forces put a priority on capturing, holding and deactivating the Egmar and Vard installations.

With the vital efforts of the Tribal Liberation Force militia, the Republic Fleet captured and decommissioned the installations in Egmar and Vard. From these captured transmuters, the Republic was able to develop its own fusion of Minmatar and Triglavian technology. The first mature Republic Stellar Transmuter was deployed in the Barkrik system as a key element of the power and critical resource base required for operating a Republic Interstellar Shipcaster network.

648243.en:
This State Stellar Transmuter is the result of a highly-successful technology acquisition and research program carried out by the Caldari State with the assistance of its capsuleers. Although the Caldari lacked the access to Triglavian stellar technology available to the Amarr Empire and Minmatar Republic, through a mix of statecraft, espionage, and market forces, the State was able to rapidly acquire the necessary technology and data to complete its own research efforts.

Following the successful campaign to acquire this technology, and with the State’s understanding of Triglavian transport relay technology also assured, the Caldari embarked on an effort to construct the necessary infrastructure for an Interstellar Shipcaster. The first mature State Stellar Transmuter was deployed in the Elonaya system as a key element of the power and critical resource base required for operating a State Interstellar Shipcaster network.

648245.en:
This Federation Stellar Transmuter is the product of a hard-fought effort to acquire by any means Triglavian stellar technology and develop it into a working installation. Lacking access to both Triglavian relay technology and stellar technology, Federation efforts pioneered by loyal capsuleers focused on the latter while a parallel effort made inroads on the former. Gallente loyalists engaged in espionage, recovery operations, and market efforts to acquire the needed technology and data, with success leading to a Federation construction program.

With the understanding that Triglavian transport relay technology requires the power and special resources provided by a Stellar Transmuter installation, the Federation prepared for construction of the necessary facility as they acquired the technologies. The first mature Federation Stellar Transmuter was deployed in the Gisleres system as a key element of the power and critical resource base required for operating a Federation Interstellar Shipcaster network.

648306.en:
Protracted neutron deposition from the chaotic radiations observed near Abyssal Conduits have radically morphed the mineralogical composition of this asteroid type, suspected to be formerly of the Scordite family, into a new configuration in the Rakovene group.

This asteroid is in a field that has undergone longterm exposure to Abyssal Conduits and the subtly altered spacetime environment of Pochven. Concentrations of nesosilicate-type minerals such as Neo-Jadarite can be extracted with reprocessing, alongside typical amounts of Tritanium, Isogen, and Zydrine

648307.en:
Apparently a general purpose construction component, this Triglavian mutadaptive device appears to be designed to work in concert with others of its type, and more specialized components, in order to build structures of various sizes and purposes. Its applications are presumably limited only by its inherent properties and the designs it is programmed to execute.

Large numbers of these devices are constructed in Triglavian space-industrial sites, including a number apparently farmed out to subverted drones by the Triglavians at locations with the designation "Vila Allopoiesis Nexus".

648308.en: Mutadaptive Construction Component Blueprints can be extracted from Vila Allopoiesis Nodes located within the drone-guarded Vila Allopoiesis Nexus sites in Pochven.

648310.en: This old Imperial Research Station sat abandoned in the Onnamon system for over a decade largely untouched beyond occasional intrusions from the Guristas Pirates. This tranquility ended in early YC125 when Caldari Navy forces occupied the facility and drove away the Guristas presence entirely. The State has remained tight lipped about what they hope to gain from occupying this former Imperial facility.

648312.en:
A single node of the Vila Allopoiesis Nexus receiving materials and constructing Mutadaptive Construction Components in order to serve the inscrutable purposes of the Triglavian masters of the subverted rogue drones tending it. The drones and their automated Vila Allopoiesis Nodes are ceaselessly at work churning out the general purpose Mutadaptive Construction Components that are used in the construction of many Triglavian structures and devices.

Hacking this Vila Allopoiesis Node is likely to give access to some portion of the data, materials and ancillary devices used in its functions. Care should be taken to avoid or destroy the Vila Skarbnik drone variants guarding the location, apparently the custodians and workhorses of the nexus and the asteroid fields from which the facility sources its materials.

648314.en:
Vila Skarbnik variants of Triglavian-controlled rogue drones patrol the Vila Allopoiesis Nexus sites and the Nesosilicate Rakovene fields from which the Triglavians' automated industrial facilities source much of their materials. The Anchoring Vila Skarbnik variant is equipped with warp disruptors alongside its array of destructive weapons.

Rogue drones have been encountered in large numbers in Abyssal Deadspace and Pochven. The question of how the rogue drones entered the Abyss is a mystery that remains unsolved as yet. There is considerable evidence that the Triglavians have subverted large numbers of the rogue drones, perhaps to press them into service in the Collective's conflict with the invading Drifters.

648316.en:
Vila Skarbnik variants of Triglavian-controlled rogue drones patrol the Vila Allopoiesis Nexus sites and the Nesosilicate Rakovene fields from which the Triglavians' automated industrial facilities source much of their materials. 648384.en: Zydrine Burn is a potent liquor that is loosely related to the more refined Zydrine Wine, both of these green-hued drinks being produced using rice leaves, a certain portion of the grains, and whatever additives are appropriate to the style of drink. While Zydrine Wine can be an extraordinarily delicate and subtle drink, with the finest generally held to be brewed from the rice plants of Intaki Prime, its more powerful cousin is a somewhat pungent and vividly green brew.  Rumors suggest that some versions of Zydrine Burn use as ingredients effluent from Quafe production, liquefied fedo scent glands, or even the notorious protein delicacies in powdered form. Whatever the case, a market for this harshly memorable liquor has sprung up among space workers of all kinds, and few space station bars lack a bottle or two of the stuff. Among planetary populations the brew has a more notorious reputation, popularly considered the tipple of underclasses, criminals, and ruthless capsuleer pirates.

648406.en: Zydrine Burn is a potent liquor that is loosely related to the more refined Zydrine Wine, both of these green-hued drinks being produced using rice leaves, a certain portion of the grains, and whatever additives are appropriate to the style of drink. While Zydrine Wine can be an extraordinarily delicate and subtle drink, with the finest generally held to be brewed from the rice plants of Intaki Prime, its more powerful cousin is a somewhat pungent and vividly green brew.  Rumors suggest that some versions of Zydrine Burn use as ingredients effluent from Quafe production, liquefied fedo scent glands, or even the notorious protein delicacies in powdered form. Whatever the case, a market for this harshly memorable liquor has sprung up among space workers of all kinds, and few space station bars lack a bottle or two of the stuff. Among planetary populations the brew has a more notorious reputation, popularly considered the tipple of underclasses, criminals, and ruthless capsuleer pirates.

655273.en: The Society of Conscious Thought has long been a quiet sponsor of the advancement of capsuleer technology while seeking to protect ancient technology from the abuses of criminals and warlords. The SoCT’s researches into ancient Jovian observatories are being disrupted and plundered by the Guri Malakim group of Angel Cartel and Guristas Pirates. Stop the criminals and support the SoCT’s efforts to advance the technology of New Eden and you will be handsomely rewarded.

655274.en:
The Society of Conscious Thought has long been a quiet sponsor of the advancement of capsuleer technology while seeking to protect ancient technology from the abuses of criminals and warlords. The SoCT’s researches into ancient Jovian observatories are being disrupted and plundered by the Guri Malakim group of Angel Cartel and Guristas Pirates. Stop the criminals and support the SoCT’s efforts to advance the technology of New Eden and you will be handsomely rewarded.

Look for Guri Malakim Survey Base combat sites in highsec space as well as more challenging Guri Malakim Raider Base combat sites in lowsec, nullsec, pochven, and wormhole space. These sites can be found using your ship's built-in anomaly scanner. The acceleration gates used to enter these sites allow access for all combat ships of Battlecruiser size and below (including T1/T2 Battlecruisers and T1/T2/T3 Cruisers). The SoCT recommends the use of Battlecruisers, Heavy Assault Cruisers, Strategic Cruisers, or Command Ships to defeat the hostile ships within these sites.

Guri Malakim Survey Expedition hacking sites can be probed down in highsec space, with the more secure Guri Malakim Raiding Expedition hacking sites found in lowsec, nullsec, pochven, and wormhole space. These data sites can be found using scanner probes, and a data analyzer module will be required to hack open the containers and collect the loot within.

655278.en: The Guri Malakim organization represents an alarming new joint venture between two of the most powerful criminal organizations in New Eden. Led by Guristas Pirates agent Esri Hakuzosu and Angel Cartel assault leader Rafik Zohar, this dangerous new criminal enterprise appears set on obtaining and exploiting ancient Jovian technology, and has come into conflict with the Society of Conscious Thought as a result. Assist in their operations and you will reap the rewards while thwarting the plans of the secretive and manipulative SoCT.

655279.en:
The Guri Malakim organization represents an alarming new joint venture between two of the most powerful criminal organizations in New Eden. Led by Guristas Pirates agent Esri Hakuzosu and Angel Cartel assault leader Rafik Zohar, this dangerous new criminal enterprise appears set on obtaining and exploiting ancient Jovian technology, and has come into conflict with the Society of Conscious Thought as a result. Assist in their operations and you will reap the rewards while thwarting the plans of the secretive and manipulative SoCT.

Look for SoCT Survey Expedition combat sites in highsec space as well as more challenging SoCT Retrieval Expedition combat sites in lowsec, nullsec, pochven, and wormhole space. These sites can be found using your ship's built-in anomaly scanner. The acceleration gates used to enter these sites allow access for all combat ships of Battlecruiser size and below (including T1/T2 Battlecruisers and T1/T2/T3 Cruisers). The Guri Malakim recommend the use of Battlecruisers, Heavy Assault Cruisers, Strategic Cruisers, or Command Ships to defeat the hostile ships within these sites.

SoCT Survey Outpost hacking sites can be probed down in highsec space, with the more secure SoCT Retrievals Repository hacking sites found in lowsec, nullsec, pochven, and wormhole space. These data sites can be found using scanner probes, and a data analyzer module will be required to hack open the containers and collect the loot within.

655683.en:
Capsuleers have become a ubiquitous presence in New Eden since YC105 and this special nanocoating acknowledges this achievement on Capsuleer Day XX.

The YC125 celebrations of Capsuleer Day are the 20th anniversary of the dawn of the Capsuleer Age and the opening up of New Eden's frontiers by immortal clone space pilots. Capsuleer Day XX is a time of celebration for cloned and capsuled spaceship pilots, when New Eden looks back on the achievements of capsuleers and wonders what challenges, risks and opportunities the future may hold.

656103.en: Protect the Master Controller until it can get this infestation under control.

656104.en:
Rogue drones are back under control. Nice work Captain, you’ve stopped this infestation from spreading any further. 

Here’s a payment for your troubles, and your discretion. I Look forward to crossing your path again.

656105.en:
The Master Controller is down! Time to Pull out Captain, this site is lost.

Whatever the result, I saw you giving it your all out there. I’m glad we can count on your skills... and your discretion.

656106.en:
Nothing to see here, Captain. Just an acceleration gate pointing at a perfectly functional automated factory.

If something were to go wrong though, we would appreciate having a pilot like you who understands the importance of discretion. Until then.

656107.en:
Captain, don’t go through that gate! The factory on the other side has been deemed unsafe due to hazardous materials - and for no other reason.

We always appreciate pilots like you who understand the importance of discretion. Until next time.

656108.en: Protect the Holy Mission until its defenses come online. It must not fall!

656109.en:
Well done, Captain. You have protected the Empress’s missionaries from these betrayers.

The faithful shall be rewarded, check your wallet for proof. We shall see you the next time duty calls.

656110.en:
The Holy Mission has fallen. Curse these Disciple heretics!

Their actions will be but a footnote in the history of the Empire. Our faith will endure, and the next time they attack we shall be waiting. I hope you will too.

656111.en:
Come to pay your respects, Captain? There was an attack on the Holy Mission beyond this gate, but it is safe now.

All faithful are welcome. When the next opportunity arises I will be honored to have you by our side.

656112.en:
I am afraid you are too late. The Holy Mission beyond this gate is gone and the Disciples who destroyed it have fled. 

Yet it is good to see you come to pay your respects. When the next opportunity arises I will be honoured to have your faith by our side.

656113.en: Protect the Clan Commons until its defenses come back online.

656114.en:
The Commons is safe and secure, and those Cartel thugs have been sent packing.

Excellent work Captain, if we can’t take care of our own - who will? Well-earned creds coming to you. Until next time.

656115.en:
Clan Commons is lost. Damn! 

The Republic won’t forget what they did here, or how hard you fought to stop them. Next time we make them pay. I’ll see you then.

656116.en:
You missed the fireworks. The Cartel has run off and the clan beyond this gate is safe.

Hope we can count on you against the next group of criminals who oversteps though. Until then, Captain.

656117.en:
Capsuleers have become a ubiquitous presence in New Eden since YC105 and this special nanocoating acknowledges this achievement on Capsuleer Day XX.

The YC125 celebrations of Capsuleer Day are the 20th anniversary of the dawn of the Capsuleer Age and the opening up of New Eden's frontiers by immortal clone space pilots. Capsuleer Day XX is a time of celebration for cloned and capsuled spaceship pilots, when New Eden looks back on the achievements of capsuleers and wonders what challenges, risks and opportunities the future may hold.

656118.en:
Capsuleers have become a ubiquitous presence in New Eden since YC105 and this special nanocoating acknowledges this achievement on Capsuleer Day XX.

The YC125 celebrations of Capsuleer Day are the 20th anniversary of the dawn of the Capsuleer Age and the opening up of New Eden's frontiers by immortal clone space pilots. Capsuleer Day XX is a time of celebration for cloned and capsuled spaceship pilots, when New Eden looks back on the achievements of capsuleers and wonders what challenges, risks and opportunities the future may hold.

656120.en:
I’m afraid the clan beyond this gate is already lost. Cartel scum have already come through and wiped them out.

If you are itching for payback as badly as I am, the Republic is always looking for capable hands. See you then, Captain.

656123.en: Hack the Remote Jamming Arrays, then destroy the Quantum-Override Broadcaster before the signal goes live.

656124.en:
Broadcaster down and hostiles retreating. Nice work! Those Gallente will think twice before they try and mess with the State.

We’ve transferred your reward, I look forward to serving with you again.

656125.en:
Damn, they’ve done it. Federation lies broadcasting across the system. The enemy has fled, they know we’re too late.

The State appreciates those who do their duty, even in the face of defeat. See you next operation, Captain.

656126.en:
Just too late, Captain. The enemy broadcast is already complete.

Still, the State appreciates those who answer duty’s call. We will see you for the next operation.

656127.en:
Captain, this operation has already been completed successfully and the Gallente propagandists have been sent packing.

The State appreciates those who answer duty’s call. We will see you for the next operation.

656128.en: Hack the Remote Shield Arrays, then destroy the Megafinance Siphoner before the transfer completes.

656129.en:
Take that! Siphon destroyed, transfer interrupted, day saved. The Caldari are on the run. 

We’ve sent you a reward, nice work Captain. Until next time.

656130.en:
Dammit, we’re too late! Those illegal funds are lost. Caldari forces are backing off, there’s nothing more to do here.

Nice flying out there anyway, Captain. Good to know the federation can count on you in a pinch. Until next time.

656131.en:
Just wrapping up here, the fraudulent Caldari have already been dealt with.

Good to see you ready to do your part though. Keep an eye open, the Federation will have more opportunities.

656132.en:
I’m afraid they’re already gone. The Caldari finished with their fraud and flew out of there.

Good to see you ready to do your part though. The Federation will have more opportunities for someone like you.

656133.en: Hack the Remote Armor Arrays to make the Longshot Relay vulnerable, then destroy it before the upload completes.

656134.en:
That sent them packing! Upload interrupted and their forces are retreating. 

Good work Captain, you can look forward to a reward for your service to the Empire.

656135.en:
The upload is complete, prophets forgive us. The remaining hostiles have scurried away.

The Empire appreciations your devotion in the face of such frustrations Captain. We shall see you the next time these snakes crawl out of their hole.

656136.en:
Too late, Captain. The site beyond this gate is already compromised.

The Empire appreciations your discretion on this matter. Until next time.

656137.en:
Nothing to see here Captain. There was a spot of trouble with some traitors at our base beyond this gate, but they have been dealt with. 

The Empire appreciations your discretion. Until next time.

656138.en: Hack the Remote Cloaking Arrays, then destroy the Sacred Exploiter before the virus uploads.

656139.en:
Matari ingenuity wins the day again! The Exploiter is destroyed and those imperial cowards have run. 

Nicely done, there are some creds coming your way. I look forward to our next operation.

656140.en:
Damnit! The recycler is done for. Those  Imperial scumbags are skulking away. We’re done here.

No matter the result, you fought well. Look out for the next opportunity, this isn’t the end.

656141.en:
Captain, we’ve already put a stop to the Amarrian sabotage, everything is back to being operational.

Good to see who answers when the Republic calls though. We’ll see you at the next opportunity.

656142.en:
Too late I’m afraid Captain, through this gate our recycler has been reduced to scrap.

Good to see who answers when the Republic calls though. We’ll see you at the next operation.

656143.en:
Guristas on site! 

Don’t let them stop you from retrieving that ore.

656144.en:
Not bad Captain. All ore on site has been mined.

Sell whatever you harvested to the State wherever a buy order has been issued. Additional compensation has also been transferred as a sign of our appreciation for your service to the State.

656145.en:
Asteroids have phased back to the Abyss. Damn. 

An honorable effort, Captain. The State will still purchase whatever you have wherever a buy order has been issued.

You did your duty well, that’s all Caldari can ask. See you next time.

656146.en:
Captain, this operation has already been aborted - the asteroids phased back into the Abyss. 

Good to see a pilot ready to do their duty, though. The State will have more opportunities in the future for someone like you.

656147.en:
Captain, you’re out of luck. The site beyond that gate has been depleted. 

Good to see a pilot ready to do their duty, though. The State will have more opportunities in the future for someone like you.

656148.en:
Rogue Drones incoming! 

Don’t let them stop you from mining.

656149.en:
Excellent work, Captain! All rocks have been depleted.

You can sell whatever you have to the Federation wherever we’ve posted buy orders. In addition, a payout is coming your way as a special thanks from us.

656150.en:
It’s over, the remaining rocks have phased back into the Abyss. 

It was a good effort. The Federation will still buy any ore you mined at station’s with a buy order. 

You gave it your all, and we couldn’t ask more than that. Stay frosty Captain, see you again soon.

656151.en:
Bad luck Captain, there’s nothing left to mine through that gate. 

Nice to see an enthusiastic pilot raring to go though. Keep an eye out for future opportunities, the Federation could use more like you.

656152.en:
Captain! You’re just too a little too late, those rocks have already skedaddled back to the Abyss. 

Nice to see an enthusiastic pilot raring to go though. Keep an eye out for future opportunities, the Federation could use more like you.

656153.en:
Disciples of Purity spotted. 

Don’t let those heretics stop you from mining!

656154.en:
Praise be, Captain! All ore has been stripped from this site.

Sell whatever you have to the Empire at any station where a buy order has been posted. In addition, a reward has been transferred directly to you for your aid in this holy enterprise.

656155.en:
Curses. The asteroids have returned to the Abyss. 

A formidable attempt, Captain. You may still sell anything you managed to retrieve to the Empire at any station where a buy order has been posted. 

Let us hope the Lord shines more brightly on us in our next endeavor.

656156.en:
Captain, the site through that gate has already been cleared. 

Still, the Empire appreciations your dedication. Keep your eyes open - there will other opportunities for a pilot like you.

656157.en:
Unfortunately, Captain, the asteroids have already returned to the Abyss. 

Still, the Empire appreciations your dedication. Keep your eyes open - there will other opportunities for a pilot like you.

656158.en:
Ashes of Turnur traitors on site!

Don’t let them slow down your mining.

656159.en:
Nice work Captain. That asteroid is fully depleted.

The Republic will buy whatever you harvested at any station with a buy order. We have also sent you a bonus for a job well done.

656160.en:
Damn! The asteroids have slipped back into the Abyss.

Nice moves out there anyway. The Republic has buy orders up in stations for any ore you mined.

Every attempt means valuable resources for the Republic, we’ll crack this next time.

656161.en:
Just too late I’m afraid, Captain. The site beyond that gate has been harvested. 

This won’t be our last venture and we can always use a pilot ready to chip in for the Republic, so keep a lookout for other opportunities.

656162.en:
Bad luck, Captain. The asteroids in this site have already phased back into Abyssal space.

This won’t be our last venture and we can always use a pilot ready to chip in for the Republic, so keep a lookout for other opportunities.

656163.en: Arbiter Karura on grid, boost its capacitor.

656164.en:
The UCF rebellion has been handled. That should send a message to any other agitators out there.

Nice flying out there, Captain. Your payment has been sent. Until next time.

656165.en:
Nothing to see here, Captain. There was a little dispute on the other side of this gate, but we put a stop to it.

The State always appreciates those ready to do their duty, especially against those who aren’t. Next time we will be honored to count you among us.

656166.en:
We are too late. The interstellar media has got wind of this little rebellion and we have been ordered to negotiate with these traitors.

You fought well, Captain. Next time they won’t be so lucky.

656167.en:
Captain, I am afraid things through that gate have gotten political. We’ve been ordered to stand down.

The State always appreciates those ready to do their duty, especially against those who aren’t. Next time we will be honor to count you amongst our own.

656180.en:
Mine the Admixti Mutanite asteroids to recover the artifacts inside. 

Warp interference confirmed. If you need to retreat you'll need to fly outside the asteroids' area first.

656181.en:
Mine the Admixti Mutanite asteroids to recover the artifacts inside. 

Remember, warping here won’t work. If you need to bug out, first you’re gonna have to fly outside the asteroids' area.

656182.en:
Mine the Admixti Mutanite asteroids to recover the artifacts inside. 

Remember, you cannot warp here. If you need to escape you must first fly outside the asteroids' area.

656183.en:
Mine the Admixti Mutanite asteroids to recover the artifacts inside.

A reminder, your warp drive is inoperable. If you need to get out, you’ll have to leave the asteroids' area first.

656337.en: There’s the Peacekeeper Hubris. Boost its capacitor.

656338.en:
Threat neutralized, Primacy in retreat, day saved.

I knew I could count on you, Captain. You’ve earned every iota of that reward. I’ll see you next go around.

656339.en:
Damnit! Report just in, they completed their attack. They’re scurrying away and our Hubris is needed by the relief efforts.

You fought the good fight today, Captain. Next time we’ll make sure they pay.

656340.en:
Welcome to the party, Captain. Sorry, we finished without you. The terrorist encampment that was through this gate has been shut down.

I appreciate you turning up to help though. Next time we finish this together.

656341.en:
It’s too late, Captain. The Primacy carried out their attack, then abandoned the base through this gate to run back into their ultranationalist holes.

I appreciate you turning up to help though. Next time we finish this together.

656342.en: There’s the Legatus Bane! Boost its capacitor.

656343.en:
The Blood Raider Temple has been demolished. This was a righteous victory, the holders will be pleased. 

Good work Captain. Your compensation is on its way. I pray our paths will cross again soon.

656344.en:
Our time is up, the Legatus Bane has been ordered to return by the holders. For now, the Blood Raiders have won.

Heresy will never prevail for long, Captain. Keep your ear to the stars, we shall have another chance for victory.

656345.en:
Welcome, Captain. This operation is already complete. Through this gate, the Blood Raider Temple lies in ruins. 

The Empire always appreciates the faithful. I look forward to having you by our side the next time we face these idolaters.

656346.en:
Too late, I am afraid. We have been forced to retreat.

The Empire always appreciates the faithful. Perhaps with you by our side next time things will be different.

656347.en: Verndari Valravn in sight. Boost its capacitor.

656348.en:
That will shut this little enclave down for good. 

You were a big part of that. The Republic won't forget that, and we always pay our debts. See you soon, Captain.

656349.en:
We have confirmation, the clans have transferred their creds and the Agnels are moving on. There’s nothing more for us here.

The Republic will remember your support, Captain. Next time will be different.

656350.en:
Welcome. Beyond this gate, you’ll find the wreckage of a former Angel stronghold. Now just another reminder of what happens when you try and take advantage of the Matari.

The Republic is always looking for good pilots like you though. Until next time.

656351.en:
Just too late, Captain. The thugs who were beyond this gate have already got their creds and scurried away.

The Republic is always looking for good pilots like you though. Next time they won’t get away so easily.

656352.en:
Guristas are falling back and we have the contraband secured.

Good work out there Captain. These goods will be put to much better use by the State. Your payment has been transferred. I look forward to the next time we benefit from your dedication.

656353.en:
Dammit, the Guristas have escaped with enough goods to set up again elsewhere.

The State values though who do their duty, whatever the outcome. Next time these pirates show their faces we’ll be there to put them back in their place.

656354.en:
The Black Market on the other side of this gate has already been shut down.

The State values your loyalty, Captain. Next time these pirates show their faces I hope you will be there to put them back in their place.

656355.en:
The Guristas who were operating on through this gate have cleared out to set up… well, we don't know where. Yet.

The State values your loyalty, Captain. Next time these pirates show their faces I hope to have you with us.

656356.en:
Warp scramble and destroy the Nereus Mules before they can run.

If you are in a hauler, loot the Narcotics Packages from their wrecks and transport them to the Obelisk Impound.

656357.en:
Narcotics have been impounded and the remaining Serpentis are on the run.

Nice job, Captain. Federation justice will not be denied. You have my gratitude and some extra creds. I look forward to working with you again soon.

656358.en:
Damn. We didn’t manage to grab enough, now those snakes will just set up their operation elsewhere.

Well, we tried our best, Captain. I’m glad we had you out there giving it your all. Once we get a ping on their next hidey hole I know we can count on you.

656359.en:
Just cleaning up, Captain. The Serpentis lab on the other side of this gate has already been shut down.

Good to see someone ready to lend a hand though. I hope the Federation can count on you the next time these snakes slither out of their hole.

656360.en:
The snakes that were through this gate have already slithered off I’m afraid. 

Good to see someone ready to lend a hand, Captain. I hope the Federation can count on you next time.

656361.en:
Warp scramble and destroy the Offertory Sigils before they flee.

If you are in a hauler, loot their wrecks for Warclone Vats and deposit them in the Holder Providence.

656362.en:
War clones have been retrieved and the Blood Raiders have abandoned their efforts.

Expertly done Captain, these will be valuable assets in the coming conflict.  We have transferred you some credits for your efforts. I look forward to working with you again.

656363.en:
That’s it. The idolaters have escaped with too many warclones. Those on site are retreating to some other dark recess to carry out their false worship.

The Empire appreciates your devotion regardless, Captain. I hope to see you the next time these deviants emerge.

656364.en:
Our property has already been secured beyond this gate. There is nothing more for you to do here.

The Empire appreciates your devotion regardless, Captain. I hope to see you the next time these deviants emerge.

656365.en:
The idolaters through this gate have already escaped. There is nothing more for you to do here.

The Empire appreciates your devotion regardless, Captain. I hope to see you the next time these deviants emerge.

656366.en:
Warp scramble and destroy the Plunder Wreathes before they escape. 

If you are in a hauler; loot their wrecks, grab the M.R.F. Supplies, and deposit them with the Fenrir Quartermaster.

656367.en:
Those supplies are headed back to the Republic Navy where they belong, and the Ashes are crawling back where they belong too.

Nice to work with a pilot who knows what they’re doing. Your payment has been transferred, see you next time.

656368.en:
Cowardly clanners! They’ve got enough of their stolen supplies out, now they’re making a run for it.

That was some nice flying out there Captain, next time we’ll get them for sure. Hope to see you there.

656369.en:
The Ashes beyond this gate have already been dealt with and our supplies are headed back to the front.

Good to see someone ready to fight though. I look forward to having you flying for the Republic the next time we unearth some traitors.

656370.en:
The Ashes hiding beyond this gate are gone, taking our supplies with them.

Good to see someone ready to fight though. I look forward to seeing you flying for the Republic against the next bunch of traitors we unearth.

656371.en:
Warp scramble and destroy the Badger Runners before they escape. 

If you are flying a hauler, loot the Contraband Freight from their wrecks and transfer it to the Charon Requisition.

656373.en:
An unstable form of ore, mutanite is rendered useless by any attempt to refine it with the technologies currently available in New Eden. Despite this, it is highly prized by the cluster's major factions as its unique and evershifting molecular structures hold the promise of new insights into the Abyssal environments inside which they formed.

The Amperum variant of mutanite forms in an Electrical abyssal environment and is theorized to generate a powerful electrical current, but only when inside a sealed void outside the range of any conductive or sensory apparatus.

656402.en: Use a data analyzer module to hack at least five of the Research Com Towers, Mainframes, or Databanks inside these Amarr, Minmatar, or Caldari Data Node sites. The valuable items found within can be used to reconstruct Stellar Transmuter Datacores.

656403.en: You can find these sites within the Factional Warfare warzone systems controlled by the Amarr, Minmatar, and Caldari as well as within the highsec systems in the Kisana, Ryra, Tiat, Ani, Aokinen, and Minnen constellations. Only T1 and Navy Faction frigates can enter these sites. You will need to fit a scan probe launcher to pinpoint them as well as data analyzer module to hack the structures within. Hostile vessels have been spotted within these locations so be prepared for combat. Warning: Capsuleers who activate the acceleration gate to enter these sites will incur a suspect timer and become legal targets for all other capsuleers.

656404.en: Amarr, Minmatar, and Caldari classified courier convoys have been intercepted by unknown forces. Use your onboard anomaly scanner to find these couriers, fight off the hostile ships, and salvage the remains to collect Stellar Transmuter technology.

656405.en: You can find these sites within the Factional Warfare warzone systems controlled by the Amarr, Minmatar, and Caldari as well as within the highsec systems in the Kisana, Ryra, Tiat, Ani, Aokinen, and Minnen constellations. Only T1/Faction/T2 frigates and T1/Faction destroyers can enter these sites. Hostile vessels have been spotted within these locations so be prepared for combat. You will need to equip a salvager moduleto recover the technology from the courier wrecks after you destroy the enemy ships. Due to the advanced security features of the couriers, salvage drones will not be able to salvage their wrecks. Warning: Capsuleers who activate the acceleration gate to enter these sites will incur a suspect timer and become legal targets for all other capsuleers.

656406.en: Amarr, Minmatar, and Caldari hidden research labs have been attacked by unknown forces. Use your onboard anomaly scanner to find these labs, fight off the hostile ships, and destroy the Vulnerable Research Lab structure to obtain Stellar Transmuter technology.

656407.en: You can find these sites within the Factional Warfare warzone systems controlled by the Amarr, Minmatar, and Caldari as well as within the highsec systems in the Kisana, Ryra, Tiat, Ani, Aokinen, and Minnen constellations. Only T1/Faction battlecruisers, T1/Faction/T2 cruisers, and smaller ships can enter these sites. Numerous hostile vessels have been spotted within these locations so be prepared for intense combat. The Stellar technology we are seeking can be obtained by destroying and looting the research lab structure once it becomes vulnerable. Warning: Capsuleers who activate the acceleration gate to enter these sites will incur a suspect timer and become legal targets for all other capsuleers.

656409.en: A Minmatar device designed to receive and then transmit data to a receiver light-years away, most likely all the way back in Republic space.

656411.en: Normally part of this location's defense systems, this remote armor array was placed here by the Amarr to protect the main structure in case of an attack. Instead, it has been reprogrammed by Minmatar Agents to protect their own transmitter.

657071.en: Home to a missionary service charged with providing charitable support to those who have been freed as a result of performing services for the Empire. It has come under attack by the Disciples of Purity as they oppose the slim possibility of social mobility this charity represents.

657079.en: Guristas hunters are some of the most skilled search and pursuit pilots in New Eden. Recruiting freely from across the pick of New Eden's disaffected, renegade, or simply adventurous combat pilots, the pirate organization built by Fatal and the Rabbit particularly prides itself on performance of its light combat and raiding fleets.

657081.en: The Dramiel is the most long-standing and often-used ship design in the Angel Cartel's vast repertoire of vessels. A frigate workhorse if ever there was one, this sharp-tusked, dangerous beauty can sting unimaginably hard if one is not prepared for its assault.

657083.en: Guristas hunters are some of the most skilled search and pursuit pilots in New Eden. Recruiting freely from across the pick of New Eden's disaffected, renegade, or simply adventurous combat pilots, the pirate organization built by Fatal and the Rabbit particularly prides itself on performance of its light combat and raiding fleets.

657085.en: The Cynabal was one of the earliest designs put forth by the Angel Cartel, and to this day it remains their most-used. The ship's origins are unknown, but as with most Cartel ships persistent rumors of Jovian influence continue to linger. Whether these tales have basis in reality or not, the facts are on the table: The Cynabal is one of the fastest, most powerful cruisers to be found anywhere.

657087.en: Guristas hunters are some of the most skilled search and pursuit pilots in New Eden. Recruiting freely from across the pick of New Eden's disaffected, renegade, or simply adventurous combat pilots, the pirate organization built by Fatal and the Rabbit particularly prides itself on performance of its light combat and raiding fleets.

657089.en: This ship is defending assets of the Guri Malakim, and will fire on any trespassers.

657091.en: This advanced battleship appears to be in charge of the local Guri Malakim. It should be considered extremely dangerous.

657130.en: Choose your side in the Capsuleer Day event with hacking & combat sites

657131.en: Claim daily rewards including exclusive anniversary SKINs, Skill Points, EverMarks, & more, with anniversary offers in the New Eden Store

The Capsuleers are considered an elite group across New Eden and this vibrant nanocoating marks that status on Capsuleer Day XX. The YC125 celebrations are the 20th anniversary of the dawn of the Capsuleer Age and the opening up of New Eden's frontiers by immortal clone space pilots.

Capsuleer Day XX is a moment for celebration of "The Elite" across New Eden.

657219.en:
This gilded nanocoating denotes the wealth and predatory power of the capsuleer class. Whether it can be considered a celebration of the cycle of acquisition and destruction that marks the capsuleer lifestyle or represents, rather, an ironic commentary by the designer is left to personal interpretation.

Super Kerr-Induced Nanocoatings (SKINs) are a technology that enables capsuleers to change the look of their ships at will. Individual ship SKINs are activated by integrating the special encoding into the pilot's neural interfaces, and are subsequently available to use on any suitable ship flown by the capsuleer.

657286.en: The holders in control of this system have sent this Providence to oversee the operation and reclaim their stolen warclones.

657287.en: [HF] Charge the Gun - Focused Neutralizing Spawner

657288.en: The Society of Conscious Thought has adapted the standard CONCORD observatory design for search and survey purposes using its own highly-advanced technology. The SoCT is engaged in a search for previously hidden Jove ruins, observatories, and other sites of interest involving the mysterious and vanished Jove Empire. The SoCT’s search efforts have acquired new urgency given the activities of the Guri Malakim group of Angel Cartel and Guristas Pirates, a joint criminal enterprise that is clearly aimed at uncovering the secrets of the Jove.

657289.en:
The SoCT’s Metamorphosis-class exploration frigate shares the same basic hull profile as the stripped down Apotheosis-class shuttle. The Metamorphosis is a far more capable vessel, fully able to operate as scouting and surveying vessel in the depths of unknown space. While the vessel has some combat capability for defensive purposes in potentially dangerous territory, it is more suited to its intended exploration, hacking, and archaeological surveying purpose.

In typical SoCT fashion, the Metamorphosis has a balanced module fitting layout and is capable of using a wide variety of weapons and equipment for its class. While by no means as potent as the Gnosis- and Praxis-class vessels, this handy little frigate is a remarkable transformation of the hull it is based on into an agile and swift option for explorers.

657290.en:
The Infinite Celebrations pyrotechnic charge was created to celebrate Capsuleer Day XX, marking the transition from the second decade into the third decade of independent capsuleers in New Eden.

The YC125 celebrations of Capsuleer Day are the 20th anniversary of the dawn of the Capsuleer Age and the opening up of New Eden's frontiers by immortal clone space pilots. Capsuleer Day XX is a time of celebration when New Eden looks back on the achievements of capsuleers and wonders what challenges, risks and opportunities the future may hold.

657357.en: Jamming arrays designed to stop the Broadcaster from being targettable as well as hide its point of origin from any receiving devices.

657365.en: An Imperial construct designed to transmit a virus that finds and exploits vulnerabilities in other devices, forcing them to malfunction as destructively as possible.

657367.en: This tower houses a computer running a low-level AI backed up by over a kilometer of CPUs to provide additional computational power, all dedicated to performing one task - the discreet moving of financial assets. Using encrypted accounting operations, gigalayered financing initiatives and capable of executing billions of operations a second, the Siphoner is able to move trillions of ISK while making it nearly impossible for any other device or human to discern where creds have moved from or to.

657482.en:
The structure where workers assigned to this site live, eat, perform recreation activities, and spend all their time while not working. 

It has been occupied and repainted by UCF forces protesting wartime measures brought in by the Caldari State.

657484.en: Once a part of the Federal defense network and missile response system, this decommissioned base is now being used as an operation center by the Gallentia Primacy. This terrorist group has refitted the remote launch transmitters inside the base and plans on using them to launch a deadly assault on a Federal administrative structure somewhere in this system.

657486.en: This Angel Cartel station was constructed to act as a base for their protection racketeering in the surrounding solar systems. It receives encrypted transactions to be made by local clans and houses a fleet of ships ready to attack any who fail to pay on time.

657838.en:
The scriptures tell us, “The angelic Apostles of Heaven sing praises for their children,” yet now petty heirs bicker over scraps of the profane in their stead. When heresy and madness lead the way, the righteous will not follow. For we know that, “The word of the Lord is pure” and that “we are the Chosen, Blessed above all.” Go now and teach the sinners God’s righteous will, so that they may bathe or burn in the purity of his light.

- From a speech by the newly anointed Grand Incarnate on the day of the Order’s founding.

657845.en:
Honor is what they call your chains,
Duty is the weight they bind them to,
And loyalty is the lie they tell you to make you put them on yourself.

- quote from the articles of Freedom by Sumalee Daeng

657848.en:
The dream of old Gallentia has been sullied by the soft hands of compromise and the tears of the weak. The future belongs to the Gallente, but the politicians in Callie would rather choke good and true citizens with red tape than seize it. We must grasp our destiny for ourselves, we must obliterate corruption like a supernova shining the way to a bright and new tomorrow!

- Former Senator Thibaul Tailler to members of the Press on the day of his removal from office.

657851.en: ”You, my friends, are the beating heart of this great Federation’s industrial and military might. Without you, there would be no ships for our navy of liberation and security to wield as the instruments of Gallente freedom and ultimate peace under democratic rule. My friends, I congratulate you on your hard work to date and look forward to that which is to come!“ – Former President Jacus Roden in speech to Roden Shipyards workers, May YC125 While the reach of the Federation Navy is popularly supposed to be based heavily on the use of drones and automation, the true power of the Federation’s military has long rested on one of the most powerful capital ship fleets in existence. Drones and automation are leveraged on this mighty foundation, enabling it to function and project power rapidly and precisely. To this end, the heavy-industrial powerhouse of Roden Shipyards put forward designs for an advanced dreadnought using new lance technology. Alongside an armament of hybrid turrets, the Hubris-class Lancer Dreadnought is equipped to use the new “Disruptive Lance” weaponry, a capability rumored to have been developed with the assistance of Jacus Roden’s peerless industrial espionage organization.

657854.en: “And finally the Lord’s Avengers slew the false leaders of the misguided Striking them with spears of holy light and casting them down For the Lord is the bane of all deceivers and false powers“ – The Scriptures, Book II, Apocalypse 10:47 Developed in utmost secret as a collaboration between the Imperial Navy and Royal Khanid Navy, the Bane-class Lancer Dreadnought uses all the expertise of Khanid shipwrights and weapons engineers to marry the formidable Revelation hull with highly advanced missile and directed energy weapons. Like all Lancer Dreadnoughts, the Bane is capable of using the new “Disruptive Lance” variant of lance weaponry. Heavily armored, its secondary weapons are the missile weapons favored by Khanid designers, a decision that helps alleviate the massive energy requirements of the lance weapon.

657856.en: ”The Ocean Winds drive us to extend the reach of the Caldari State by all means available, by any means necessary. To serve the Caldari people and State is the first duty of our corporate community, and we shall see it done by the Winds and Way of the Caldari!” – Mens Reppola, CEO Ishukone Corporation, speech to Combine TNR executives, January YC125 Despite the setback of a Guristas spy ring stealing Caldari capital ship development secrets in YC124, a program for an advanced dreadnought proceeded under a secret contract awarded to the Tiuunakama Nenkanavu Rymasaikkan, the “Ocean Winds Corporate Community” linking the Hyasyoda, Ishukone, and Wiyrkomi megacorporations. Hyasyoda and Wiyrkomi pooled their expertise in energy and weapons systems to complete the “Disruptive Lance” project on schedule. Pivoting from its involvement in the long-stalled “Project Dictator”, Ishukone applied itself to developing the Karura-class Lancer Dreadnought. Able to deploy the new lance weaponry, the Karura uses hybrid weapons as its secondary armament.

657858.en: Part of a convoy of ships repatriating valuable Caldari assets from outside the State, this Charon is the last survivor following an ambush by Guristas Pirates.

657860.en: ”The meaning of Turnur’s destruction is plain and needs no explanation. We have always known that the Amarr Empire and its evil religion cares not if its ultimate end is to rule over an empire of ashes, blood, and desolation. Its only object is to rule the stars be they bright or be they dark. Never, I say. Never again the long night!” – Valklear General Kril Efrit, Skarkon Tribal Resistance Army, Broadcast to Republic, March YC125 The Great Caravans of the Thukker Tribe roam ceaselessly across the space of the Republic and beyond in their Great Wildlands territories, and the tribe’s ship architects are renowned across New Eden for their ingenuity. Due to their special requirements and experience, the Thukker have long functioned as a major developer of ships for the Republic, and the secret project to bring an advanced dreadnought to fruition was an ideal task for the shipbuilding circles of the Great Caravans. Close collaboration with their allies in the Republic Security Services, together with their own extensive contacts among the underworld cartels of New Eden, gave the Thukker engineers an up-to-date understanding of the “Disruptive Lance” technology that the Valravn-class Lancer Dreadnought uses alongside its batteries of projectile weapons.

657872.en: The Master Controller is an essential element of a fully automated drone network. It monitors all software and behaviors on the system, eliminating any erroneous elements that stray outside predefined parameters. If it malfunctions or fails then more advanced AIs can drift from their programming and run the risk of a rogue infestation.

657874.en: The primary structure and heart of a Minmatar clan holding. It is a common space where the clan comes together to hold clan assemblies, work, play, share their history, and educate their children.

657876.en: Hidden from the Caldari State, the Guristas Pirates use this structure as a distribution hub to trade their ill-gotten goods. From here they sell everything they loot during raids; stolen military assets, restricted Gallente luxury goods, ration-controlled supplies, and more - all at grossly inflated prices.

657883.en:
When you have watched your home burn, it is tempting to become lost in the flames. Instead, return to the land, to the ash that was once your home. Ash cannot be bound, it is not consumed by the flames but flourishes in their aftermath. Watch it rise on the wind, unencumbered and free. Death has changed us but it has also burnt away the lies of progress, So let us be joyful, and show those who are less fortunate the lessons the fire taught us.

- from “From the Flames” by Kamí Día

658083.en:
The Minmatar Republic gives lip service to the standard claims of all ‘Big 4’ empires that it developed its own ‘Disruptive Lance’ technology independently but does not over-exert itself to insist on this point. The Republic Security Services have been highly active in acquiring any and all military intelligence, research, and technology specs available on the black market. The RSS as an organization rarely indulges itself in pretence that it operates above the dirtier side of the great game of empires. While the Thukker Tribe appears to have been developing an advanced dreadnought for some time, it is probable that intel from the RSS contributed significantly to the combination with new lance technology.

The Minmatar Republic’s ‘Atgeir’ Explosive Disruptive Lance generates a stream of protons and energy in a beam that carries specific disruptive energy patterns at ultra-high intensities. This effect means the weapon will disrupt warp and jump drives, prevent docking guidance and tethering connections, and massively inhibit the effectiveness of external repair beams. This comes at the price of an attenuated and less focused explosive destructive effect but the tactical opportunities of the weapon are considered well worth that trade.

Due to the extreme energies involved in the operation of this module, a disruptive lance can only be fired when in siege mode, and ships with this module fitted are unable to activate cloaking devices.

Note: Activating this module triggers a massive capacitor disruption wave that impacts ships in the immediate vicinity, friend or foe. After firing, you will be immobile for thirty seconds and unable to dock, tether, cloak, or activate your jump drive for 2 minutes.

658084.en: Multiple whitespace characters in sequence not allowed

658087.en:
Like the other ‘Big 4’ empires, the Amarr Empire claims to have independently developed ‘Disruptive Lance’ technology but almost certainly gained some insights from Caldari State research data available on the technology black market, and perhaps also from its own highly-effective espionage operations. Amarr weapons research and development programs have been operating at a fever pitch since the Triglavian invasions, and an advanced dreadnought program was obviously well underway regardless of the combination with the new lance modifications.

The Empire’s ‘Azmaru’ Electromagnetic Disruptive Lance uses an EM energy beam as a carrier of specific disruptive energy patterns at ultra-high intensity in order to disrupt warp and jump drives, prevent docking guidance and tethering connections, and massively inhibit the effectiveness of external repair beams. This comes at the price of an attenuated and less focused EM destructive effect but the tactical opportunities of the weapon are considered well worth that trade.

Due to the extreme energies involved in the operation of this module, a disruptive lance can only be fired when in siege mode, and ships with this module fitted are unable to activate cloaking devices.

Note: Activating this module triggers a massive capacitor disruption wave that impacts ships in the immediate vicinity, friend or foe. After firing, you will be immobile for thirty seconds and unable to dock, tether, cloak, or activate your jump drive for 2 minutes.

658089.en:
Although each of the ‘Big 4’ empires claims to have independently developed ‘Disruptive Lance’ technology, it appears likely that the Caldari were the first to combine research into wider use of lance weapons with the advanced technology of ‘Lancer Dreadnoughts’. The severe breach of security caused by the Guristas espionage ring that penetrated State capital ship research and development is believed to have given the other empires vital insights and accelerated their own advanced dreadnought programs. 

Nevertheless, the ‘Steel Yari’ Kinetic Disruptive Lance is a major achievement for State military science. The breakthrough of using a graviton energy beam as a carrier of specific disruptive energy patterns at ultra-high intensity means the weapon will disrupt warp and jump drives, prevent docking guidance and tethering connections, and massively inhibit the effectiveness of external repair beams. This comes at the price of an attenuated and less focused kinetic destructive effect but the tactical opportunities of the weapon are considered well worth that trade.

Due to the extreme energies involved in the operation of this module, a disruptive lance can only be fired when in siege mode, and ships with this module fitted are unable to activate cloaking devices.

Note: Activating this module triggers a massive capacitor disruption wave that impacts ships in the immediate vicinity, friend or foe. After firing, you will be immobile for thirty seconds and unable to dock, tether, cloak, or activate your jump drive for 2 minutes.

658091.en:
The Gallente Federation follows the other ‘Big 4’ empires in claiming that it independently developed its ‘Disruptive Lance’ technology but no doubt obtained a great deal of useful material from black market sources trading in stolen Caldari State capital research program data. Federation military-industrial efforts have been strongly focused on upgrading and expanding their already impressive capital ship fleets, perhaps to the exclusion of other areas such as Stellar Transmuter technology, and an advanced dreadnought development program was certainly already in progress.

The Federation’s ‘Sarissa’ Thermal Disruptive Lance emits a supercharged plasma energy beam as a carrier of specific disruptive energy patterns at ultra-high intensity and will disrupt warp and jump drives, prevent docking guidance and tethering connections, and massively inhibit the effectiveness of external repair beams. This comes at the price of an attenuated and less focused thermal destructive effect but the tactical opportunities of the weapon are considered well worth that trade.

Due to the extreme energies involved in the operation of this module, a disruptive lance can only be fired when in siege mode, and ships with this module fitted are unable to activate cloaking devices.

Note: Activating this module triggers a massive capacitor disruption wave that impacts ships in the immediate vicinity, friend or foe. After firing, you will be immobile for thirty seconds and unable to dock, tether, cloak, or activate your jump drive for 2 minutes.

659090.en:
An unstable form of ore, mutanite is rendered useless by any attempt to refine it with the technologies currently available in New Eden. Despite this, it is highly prized by the cluster's major factions as its unique and evershifting molecular structures hold the promise of new insights into the Abyssal weathers inside which they formed.

The Peregrinus variant of mutanite forms in Exotic abyssal weather and is the densest form of mutanite but only when completely inert in a zero-energy environment.

659092.en:
An unstable form of ore, mutanite is rendered useless by any attempt to refine it with the technologies currently available in New Eden. Despite this, it is highly prized by the cluster's major factions as its unique and evershifting molecular structures hold the promise of new insights into the Abyssal environments inside which they formed.

The Conflagrati variant of mutanite forms in a Firestorm abyssal environment and is always 0.97 degrees kelvin warmer than the environment in which it is stored, but its thermal conductivity is reduced the hotter it becomes.

659094.en:
An unstable form of ore, mutanite is rendered useless by any attempt to refine it with the technologies currently available in New Eden. The Solis variant of mutanite forms in a Gamma abyssal environment and emits trace amounts of cosmic radiation in the presence of harmonic sounds. It is hotly disputed amongst the science community as to which genre of harmonic sound produces the best results.

The Tenebraet variant of mutanite forms in a Dark abyssal environment and has a surprisingly low frictional coefficient unless exposed to photonic radiation.

659127.en:
This Imperial Interstellar Shipcaster is the fruit of the Amarr Empire’s efforts to develop Triglavian transport relay technology into a working strategic asset in the Amarr-Minmatar militia warzone. Poised in the Imperial theater HQ system of Mehatoor, this Interstellar Shipcaster is capable of linking to up to three Imperial Shipcaster Beacons anywhere in the warzone, and sending Amarr forces, including 24th Imperial Crusade militia paladins, to the designated locations.

Constructed following the Amarr Empire’s successful acquisition of Triglavian transport relay technology by the guile and coin of loyalist capsuleers, the Imperial Interstellar Shipcaster is the vital nexus of a Shipcaster network powered by an Imperial Stellar Transmuter.

Interacting with this Imperial Interstellar Shipcaster will permit capsuleers aligned to the Amarr Empire to select one of the destinations beacons currently linked as a travel destination. The Interstellar Shipcaster charges for transport to each beacon in turn before becoming active for launch of capsuleers to a destination. Interstellar Shipcaster travel is a long-range but one-way method of transport.

659128.en:
This State Interstellar Shipcaster is the product of the Caldari State’s intensive efforts to develop Triglavian transport relay technology into a working strategic asset in the Caldari-Gallente militia warzone. Positioned in the State theater HQ system of Onnamon, this Interstellar Shipcaster is capable of linking to up to three State Shipcaster Beacons anywhere in the warzone, and sending Caldari forces, including State Protectorate militia pilots, to the designated locations. 

Constructed following the Caldari State’s highly-successful campaign to acquire Triglavian stellar technology by any means necessary, the State Interstellar Shipcaster is the beating heart of a Shipcaster network powered by a State Stellar Transmuter. By constructing the first Interstellar Shipcaster network in mid-YC125, the Caldari State demonstrated its technological prowess, military resurgence, and the iron will of its loyal State capsuleers.

Interacting with this State Interstellar Shipcaster will permit capsuleers aligned to the Caldari State to select one of the destinations beacons currently linked as a travel destination. The Interstellar Shipcaster charges for transport to each beacon in turn before becoming active for launch of capsuleers to a destination. Interstellar Shipcaster travel is a long-range but one-way method of transport.

659129.en:
This Federation Interstellar Shipcaster is the result of the Gallente Federation’s efforts to develop Triglavian transport relay technology into a working strategic asset in the Caldari-Gallente militia warzone. Poised in the Federation theater HQ system of Intaki, this Interstellar Shipcaster is capable of linking to up to three Federation Shipcaster Beacons anywhere in the warzone, and sending Gallente forces, including Federal Defense Union militia fighters, to the designated locations.

Built by the Gallente Federation on the completion of its loyalist capsuleers' hard-fought efforts to make up the dramatic shortfall in Gallente understanding of Triglavian stellar and transport relay technology, the Federation Interstellar Shipcaster is the logistical core of a Shipcaster network powered by a Federation Stellar Transmuter.

Interacting with this Federation Interstellar Shipcaster will permit capsuleers aligned to the Gallente Federation to select one of the destinations beacons currently linked as a travel destination. The Interstellar Shipcaster charges for transport to each beacon in turn before becoming active for launch of capsuleers to a destination. Interstellar Shipcaster travel is a long-range but one-way method of transport.

Interstellar Shipcaster travel is a long-range but one-way method of transport.

659289.en:
Vat filled with the suspended bodies of warclones awaiting consciousness transfer.

Warclones are humans engineered for infantry combat. They are regarded as valuable biological equipment and are particularly prized by the Blood Raider Covenant, as Omir Sarikusa's infamous sect of Sani Sabik cultists consider the blood of clones to be the 'purest' possible sacramental for use in their sanguine rituals.

659295.en:
A collection of essential supplies intended for the Republic Fleet. Inside could be anything from military rations, medical supplies, ammunition, or even ship parts. 

This also contains a discreet tracking device so the Republic military can hunt down their property should it ever fall into undesirable hands.

This site is burned, we’ve got a drifter battleship on the other side of that gate.

You’ve got no chance against this much firepower, do not enter - I repeat, do not enter.

You’ve got no chance against this monster, get out of there!

660863.en:
Captain! It’s too late, retreat! Drifter battleship up ahead!

That thing will melt you like butter if you pass through this gate.

660864.en:
Red alert! We have a drifter battleship incoming!

That thing will melt you like butter, Captain, get the hell out of there!

660865.en:
Lord preserve… that’s a drifter battleship! 

There is no chance of victory, retreat before it is too late!

662068.en:
This dense and brittle material is formed from Crystalline Isogen-10 and has a molecular arrangement similar to the Triglavian product of that material known as Lattice Locked Dekaisogen. Unlike the Lattice Locked variant the molecules in Unaligned Dekaisogen have drifted and its structure has become unstable. 

Whether this is a byproduct of the lattice locking process, or a compromised version of the finished product is unclear. Either way, it provides an insight into the process making it valuable to those seeking to uncover the secrets of Triglavian tech.

662070.en:

This regulator has been damaged causing it to become unstable, but the nature of that instability could help to unlock the secrets of advanced zero-point energy manipulation - making this an extremely valuable item.

662126.en: Following reports that the Federation government had commissioned a limited run of a novel heavy assault cruiser based on the Adrestia from Duvolle Labs as prizes for the Independent Gaming Commission's Alliance Tournament XIX in YC125, the CreoDron board leveled a freedom of information claim which quickly returned a surprising volume of documents. While the majority have been fully redacted, what little can be gleaned dates the design of the Cybele to a YC120 contract authorized by the FIO for a series of joint operations with Crux Special Tasks Group and the Ostrakon Agency classified under "Project Trieste". The Cybele was developed by a provisional team under Duvolle's Advanced Manifold Theory Unit co-led by Rias Luisauir, prodigious R&D agent and engineer, and Progressive Plasma's Dr. Jinneth Duvolle, original co-founder of Duvolle Labs. Afforded a near-bottomless budget to design a platform suitable for locales where reinforcement would be impossible and return imperative, the two leads took full advantage of this unique opportunity to bring their most revolutionary and cost-prohibitive theories into reality as part of the designs. A reverse-ballast function devised by Luisauir, based on the micro jump drive's ultraweak force-compensated mass phase-tuning principle, negates armor plate mass gain by scaling microscale depleted vacuum volumes with the ship's mass in-flight, while a plasma cooling system designed by Dr. Jinneth boosts the operational threshold of hybrid turrets and armor repairers. Combined with an all-around upgrade to the Adrestia's core capabilities and electronics and the incorporation of heavy assault cruiser subsystems, the Cybele is a priceless force to be reckoned with.

662248.en:
A Punisher frigate tasked with the annihilation of high value targets seen to be supporting the Empress or her edicts. 

This vessel is piloted by masked members of the heretical Disciples of Purity. These conspirators hide their identities even from each other as they do whatever it takes to undermine the Empress and Amarr’s Heirs.

662249.en:
A Crucifier frigate fitted with ECM capabilities to shroud the actions of its secret cabal.

This vessel is piloted by masked members of the heretical Disciples of Purity. These conspirators hide their identities even from each other as they do whatever it takes to undermine the Empress and Amarr’s Heirs.

662250.en:
A Punisher frigate charged with destroying any who are working on the behalf of the Amarr Emperess or her loyal subjects.

This vessel is piloted by masked members of the heretical Disciples of Purity. These conspirators hide their identities even from each other as they do whatever it takes to undermine the Empress and Amarr’s Heirs.

662251.en:
A Crucifier frigate fitted with a neutralizer and ordered to drain the capacitor of the dreadnought sent to destroy this holy site.

Those aboard this ship are dedicated followers not only of the blood-letting rituals of Sani Sabik but the teachings of Omir Sarikusa, believing that no sacrament is more valuable than the blood of a clone.

662254.en:
A Karura dreadnought officially under orders to negotiate with the occupying UCF and arbitrate an agreement between the union and the State.

Unofficially the preference is for that negotiation to be carried out via turret over the ruins of their former housing.

662255.en:
A Valravn dreadnought assigned by the Republic Fleet to act as a rapid deployment defensive force for this region. 

The clans have traditionally maintained defensive forces of their own. However, with so many pilots enlisting for the Republic they are no longer able to field the ships to mount any meaningful resistance.

662256.en: A Hubris dreadnought operating as part of the Federations Navy’s counterterrorist rapid response team.

662257.en:
A Badger hauler assigned to the safe and discreet transportation of illegal goods.

Proud pirates and smugglers the crew aboard this ship are proven combatants dedicated to their organization and willing to take any risk to secure their success.

662258.en:
A Sigil hauler honored with bearing sacred offerings to a place of sacrifice.

Those aboard this ship are dedicated followers not only of the blood-letting rituals of Sani Sabik but the teachings of Omir Sarikusa, believing that no sacrament is more valuable than the blood of a clone.

662259.en:
A Wreather Hauler intended for the mobilization of supplies to support the roaming fleets of the Ashes.

Deserters and survivors, the crew of Ashes ships claim to be locked in a battle against the corrupting influence of the Abyss. They have abandoned the Republic to become raiders, living lives in line with their controversial vision of “Old Matar”.

662260.en:
A Nereus hauler responsible for the safe and secure delivery of Serpentis' valuable products.

Outraged that their business operations should be so interrupted, the Serpentis employees aboard this vessel consider themselves members of a pharmaceutical corporation’s security team. Their employers will likely characterize this encounter as just another example of overzealous state interference.
