663333.en: Encrypted in broadcasts, whispered through barbed wire, shouted in the streets, in BYC20 a single word traveled across Heimatar and began the Minmatar rebellion, “Rise”. This booster, designed in honor of that great day will, once redeemed by a capsuleer, increase the rate at which they train skills for its duration. Bonus: +6 to all learning attributes Base Duration: 2 days

663361.en:
Fragments of a trojan virus programmed by Matari insurgents. The virus switched friend or foe parameters passed to the infected devices targeting system. 

Understanding the exact structure and design of the virus will require many fragments, but helps the Amarr to better understand how it might be countered.

663363.en:
A key generated by the Gallente Federation for unlocking encrypted data.

Though this key is single-use, its sequencing may provide Caldari intelligence with clues as to how further keys can be generated.

663365.en:
An isolated thread from a series of complex transactions carried out by an unknown Caldari megacorporation. 

By itself the thread is meaningless but with enough of them, the Federation could begin to establish a chain of transactions that traces the credits back to their source.

663367.en:
A series of errors logged as an Amarrian virus attempts a brute force attack, searching for critical exploits in its target’s code.

Within the log, there are clues as to the virus' methodology. With enough logs Minmatar security forces might be able to protect against future attacks.

663371.en:
Blessings, Captain. An abyssal asteroid has appeared beyond this gate. Harvest what you can before it disappears again.

Any ore retrieved can be sold to the Empire. If it is all harvested, all involved will be rewarded.

663372.en:
Captain! An asteroid has phased into our space beyond this gate. Mine what you can before it returns to the Abyss.

The State will buy back anything you harvest. Fully deplete this site and all involved will be compensated.

663373.en:
Good to see you, Captain! A rare ore has appeared out of the Abyss beyond this gate. Mine it all before it disappears.

Any ore from this site can be sold to the Federation. Clear it all and everyone gets a payout.

663374.en:
Captain, an Abyssal Asteroid has phased in beyond that gate. Harvest all its ore before it phases out again.

The Republic will buy back any ore you collect. If the site is fully depleted, everybody gets a bonus.

663375.en:
Fortuitous timing, Captain. Local holders have sent a Legatus Bane to eliminate the Blood Raider Temple beyond this gate, but the Raiders have drained its capacitor to keep it from firing.

Support the Bane in destroying these idolaters before the holders order its retreat.

663376.en:
Captain, UCF extremists are held up in Occupied Industrial Housing beyond this gate. We sent in an Arbiter Karura to make an example of them, but they’ve drained its capacitor.

Support the Karura in smashing these upstarts before news of their protest reaches the media.

663377.en:
We’ve got a situation, Captain. Beyond this gate, Primacy ultranationalists are coordinating terrorist attacks from a Decommissioned Base. We sent in a Peacekeeper Hubris, but they’ve drained its capacitor.

Help that Hubris to destroy their base before they carry out their next attack.

663378.en:
Captain! Beyond this gate is an Angel Cartel Racket HQ that has been exploiting local clans. We sent in a Verndari Valravn to shut it down, but they’ve bled its capacitor dry.

We need you to back the Valravn up so it can take out the HQ before they can collect their creds.

663379.en:
Treachery! Beyond this gate, Minmatar agents have infiltrated our base. Their Longshot Relay is stealing Imperial secrets and they’ve reprogrammed our own Remote Armor Arrays to protect it. 

Hack the arrays then destroy that Relay before it is too late!

663380.en:
Captain, through this gate the Gallente are preparing to use a Quantum-Override Broadcaster to transmit their lies, plus their Remote Jamming Arrays make targeting it impossible.

Hack the arrays and destroy the Broadcaster before it transmits.

663381.en:
Captain! Beyond this gate, the Caldari are moving illegal funds using a Megafinance Siphoner. For extra fun, they’re also protecting it with Remote Shield Arrays.

Hack those arrays then destroy the Siphoner before the transfer completes.

663382.en:
Captain, somewhere through this gate Imperial lackeys have hidden a Sacred Exploiter using Remote Cloaking Arrays. It is uploading a virus that will force a catastrophic malfunction in our recycler. 

Hack the arrays to reveal the Exploiter then destroy it.

663383.en:
Captain, Blood Raiders have stolen warclone blanks for their mad idolatry in the Hall of Sacrifice beyond this gate. Help us get them back.

Warp scramble and destroy their Offertory Sigils as they try to escape, then haul the Warclone Blanks Vats to the Holder Providence.

663384.en:
Through this gate, there’s a Guristas Black Market just waiting to be raided. Help us hit this site and secure the contraband.

Warp scramble and destroy their Badger Runners as they try to escape, then haul their Contraband Freight to the Charon Requisition.

663385.en:
Captain! On the other side of this gate, we’ve got a nest of drug-pushing Serpentis whose Narcotics Lab we need taken out.

Warp scramble their Nereus Mules as they try to run, then blow them apart and haul the Narcotics Packages inside to our Obelisk Impound.

663386.en:
This gate leads to a clan holding that has been sheltering Ashes deserters with stolen supplies. Flush them out and take back what’s ours.

Warp scramble and destroy their Plunder Wreathes as they make a run for it, retrieve our M.R.F. Supplies, and haul them to the Fenrir Quartermaster.

663387.en:
Beyond this gate a Holy Mission calls for aid, Captain. They have come under attack from Disciple heretics. 

We need you to keep this Holy Mission alive until its defenses come back online.

663388.en:
Emergency support request:

Repatriation convoy ambushed by Guristas Pirates. The only remaining ship is a Charon Repatriator carrying State assets.

Keep the Charon alive until its warp drive comes back online.

663389.en:
Captain, we need your help… and your discretion. The Master Controller has malfunctioned in the automated factory through this gate, causing its drones to go rogue. 

Protect the Master Controller until it comes back online.

663390.en:
Captain, the clan living on the other side of this gate is under attack from Angel Cartel thugs for refusing to pay protection.

Their Clan Commons is the heart of their community. Protect it until its defenses come back online.

663398.en:
Beyond this gate, abyssal rifts have deposited asteroids containing valuable artifacts. Mine the asteroids to uncover the artifacts buried within.

Their strange ore makes warping impossible. In order to retreat, you will first need to leave their area.

Denizens of the abyss have also appeared here, and the longer the rifts remain open, the worse their threat will be.

663399.en:
Through this gate, abyssal rifts have deposited asteroids containing valuable artifacts. Deplete the asteroids to uncover the artifacts buried inside.

The asteroid’s ore makes warping impossible. To retreat, you will first need to fly outside their area.

Hostiles are also incoming through those rifts, and the longer they’re open, the bigger the threat.

663400.en:
On the other side of this gate, abyssal rifts have deposited rocks with valuable artifacts inside. Mine those rocks out to recover the artifacts inside.

This weird abyssal ore makes warping impossible. When it is time to bug out, you'll need to leave their area first.

Enemy targets are also coming in through those rifts, and the longer they’re open, the worse it’s gonna get.

663401.en:
We’ve detected abyssal rifts through this gate along with asteroids containing valuable artifacts. Deplete the asteroids to recover the artifacts within.

The asteroid’s Admixti Mutanite ore makes warping impossible. To retreat, you will first need to leave its area.

Hostiles are also traveling through those rifts, and the longer they remain open, the more powerful the threats will be.

663402.en:
The asteroids ahead have already been cleared, Captain. There’s nothing more for you beyond that gate.

Yet, it is good to see a dedicated believer ready to do their part. I hope you will join us in our next operation.

663403.en:
Operation is already complete, the asteroids have been mined out. No need to pass through the gate.

It is still good to see someone ready to do their duty. Until the next operation, Captain.

663404.en:
Just too late, Captain. All the rocks have already been harvested. No reason to pass through this gate.

Good to see someone ready to lend a hand. I hope we can count on you next time around.

663405.en:
Captain, all the asteroids in this site have already been harvested. No point in activating that gate.

Nice to see a pilot ready to get stuck in though. See you at the next operation.

663677.en:
An instrument of liberation, most strikingly known as a weapon to crush the heads of slavers and a tool to break the chains of slaves, the Khumaak is celebrated as the symbol of the Great Rebellion and Minmatar freedom from Amarr domination.

The Khumaak (literally "Hand of Maak") is a replica of an ancient Amarrian relic used over 400 years ago by the Minmatar slave Drupar Maak to kill his master, Arkon Ardishapur, on Arzad II. The legend says that Maak was inspired in his struggle for freedom by a vision of Holder Arzad, an Amarr noble who had treated his Starkmanir subjects with dignity. Arzad is said to have told Maak: "The fire in our hearts burns for salvation, redemption, and grace. May the Word of God grant you the courage to save yourself and your people."

Maak's killing of the Ardishapur heir sparked a revolt on Arzad II, also known as Starkman Prime. The slaying of Arkon Ardishapur was met with the brutal crushing of the revolt and almost total annihilation of the Starkmanir Tribe by orbital bombardment. The Starkmanir Rebellion preceded the Great Rebellion by over 250 years but its impact is held by historians to have been a major factor in the development of the underground slave movements that would ultimately fight for their freedom in 20 BYC (AD 23216).

663680.en:
An instrument of liberation, most strikingly known as a weapon to crush the heads of slavers and a tool to break the chains of slaves, the Khumaak is celebrated as the symbol of the Great Rebellion and Minmatar freedom from Amarr domination.

The Khumaak (literally "Hand of Maak") is a replica of an ancient Amarrian relic used over 400 years ago by the Minmatar slave Drupar Maak to kill his master, Arkon Ardishapur, on Arzad II. The legend says that Maak was inspired in his struggle for freedom by a vision of Holder Arzad, an Amarr noble who had treated his Starkmanir subjects with dignity. Arzad is said to have told Maak: "The fire in our hearts burns for salvation, redemption, and grace. May the Word of God grant you the courage to save yourself and your people."

Maak's killing of the Ardishapur heir sparked a revolt on Arzad II, also known as Starkman Prime. The slaying of Arkon Ardishapur was met with the brutal crushing of the revolt and almost total annihilation of the Starkmanir Tribe by orbital bombardment. The Starkmanir Rebellion preceded the Great Rebellion by over 250 years but its impact is held by historians to have been a major factor in the development of the underground slave movements that would ultimately fight for their freedom in 20 BYC (AD 23216).

664511.en:
Super Kerr-Induced Nanocoatings (SKINs) are a technology that enables capsuleers to change the look of their ships at will. Individual ship SKINs are activated by integrating the special encoding into the pilot's neural interfaces, and are subsequently available to use on any suitable ship flown by the capsuleer.
This rare SKIN was designed and manufactured by the Independent Gaming Commission exclusively as a prize for alliances that achieved victory over their opponents in Alliance Tournament XIX in YC125. This SKIN's design is in honor of the sponsorship of AT ATXIX by the Gallente Federation and uses prototype adapters to enable its application to a number of related ship hulls using the same instruction set.

664593.en:
An Ashimmu cruiser fitted with a neutralizer and ordered to drain the capacitor of the dreadnought sent to destroy this holy site.

Those aboard this ship are dedicated followers not only of the blood-letting rituals of Sani Sabik but the teachings of Omir Sarikusa, believing that no sacrament is more valuable than the blood of a clone.

664597.en:
A Deimos heavy assault cruiser fitted with a neutralizer and ordered to focus on disabling high-value targets and “liberating” them from Federal control.

Military veterans and survivalists from frontier worlds make up the majority of Primacy ship crews. All onboard are bound together by the belief that a return to the Federation’s Ultranationalist past will mean a glorious future for citizens like them.

664598.en:
A Cynabal cruiser that drains capacitor like cartel racketeers drain bank accounts.

Disciplined and loyal, the crew of this ship are proud to be flying for New Eden's premier organized crime syndicate.

664599.en:
An Eagle heavy assault cruise fitted with a Neutralizer that has been ordered to focus on sapping high-value targets to force them into a railgun-backed negotiation.

UCF collaborators likely manufactured this vessel in a State run facility with the expressed purpose of turning it against the same forces it was supposedly intended for.

664712.en: The Mekubal is the Angel Cartel's answer to the increasing prevalence of destroyers in the fleets of empire navies, representing the classic Angel fusion of Gallente and Minmatar technology, with perhaps a dash of something more ancient, in a hard-hitting and compact package. The resultant ship is a potent gunboat capable of putting out a storm of projectile weapons fire while having the speed to respond and redeploy as needed by the raiding fleets of the Cartel.

664883.en: The Order of St. Tetrimon is an Amarr religious order known for its fanatical followers and radical scriptural, theocratic, and militarist doctrines. The Order is named for St. Tetrimon, an Ardishapur noble who assassinated his grandfather the Emperor Zaragram II, in response to the increasingly megalomaniac and heretical actions of the "Mad Emperor".

664885.en: The Blood Raider Covenant is a particularly gruesome sect of Sani Sabik cult. While all modern Sani Sabik rituals use blood in some manner or another, the Blood Raiders Covenant places particular value on it, and will go to great lengths to acquire it from what they believe to be the richest and most unspoiled sources. They are considered among the most dangerous and depraved of all pirate elements operating in space.

664909.en: Overhauling the base Drake-class battlecruiser hull to make it their own, the Guristas Pirates have substantially expanded the drone capacity of the new Alligator-class design, and slightly improved missile systems and the propulsion drives. Despite their efforts to improve the handling of the ship, this notoriously sluggish hull's agility took a backseat to the need to pack in new drone stowage and advanced combat drone management systems. With the ability to field a full rack of launchers, a flight of upgraded medium combat drones, and formidable defensive shields, the Alligator meets the Guristas need for an assault ship capable of taking on empire patrols and supporting raids against more targets across New Eden.

664911.en: Following the well-worn policy of taking Caldari ship designs and radically overhauling them, the Mamba is clearly based on the distinctive hull of the Corax-class destroyer. Guristas leader Korako 'The Rabbit' Kosakami has taken the basic concept of the State's missile destroyer and grafted the signature Guristas drone technology to it. The result is a ship that can fire a blizzard of missiles followed up by small but powerful waves of combat drones.

664933.en: Following battle-tested Angel Cartel doctrines, the Khizriel-class battlecruiser makes a virtue out of speed of striking and the ability to rain destruction on its targets from just out of reach of any counterfire. Engineers of the Cartel's Salvation Angels group have labored on this design's warp drive to eke out every last bit of acceleration and warp speed possible for such a large ship. While this gunboat lacks the flexibility of missile options, it is able to deploy a covering flight of drones should it need to distract and disrupt any enemies. The speed and formidable firepower of the Khizriel is enhanced by top-of-the-line shield and armor systems protecting an unusually agile battlecruiser. The Khizriel's ability to strike from surprise, destroy its targets, and rapidly evade reprisals may be unmatched among pirate vessels, and is clearly intended to be a serious thorn in the side of empire border patrols and CONCORD security forces.

665086.en:
The Amarr Empire has been exploiting lava planets for the rich resources to be had from the constant churn of magma for ages past. The vast territories controlled by the Amarr contain hundreds of such planets and the expertise of their planetary extraction engineers in the field of lava planet mining is well known across New Eden.

Empress Catiz I's own family, House Tash-Murkon, has considerable interests in the mining industries and is noted for its extensive harvesting of resources from the many lava planets it directly controls through its regional fief. The "Lavacore Imperial" nanocoating is testament to the flaming riches of the Amarr Empire's lava planets and the vast wealth that the Empress herself has derived from such worlds.

665153.en: Following reports that the Federation government had commissioned a limited run of a novel assault frigate based on the Utu from Duvolle Labs as prizes for the Independent Gaming Commission's Alliance Tournament XIX in YC125, the CreoDron board leveled a freedom of information claim which quickly returned a surprising volume of documents. While the majority have been fully redacted, what little can be gleaned dates the design of the Shapash to a YC120 contract authorized by the FIO for a series of joint operations with Crux Special Tasks Group and the Ostrakon Agency classified under "Project Trieste". The Shapash was developed by a provisional team under Duvolle's Advanced Manifold Theory Unit co-led by Rias Luisauir, prodigious R&D agent and engineer, and Progressive Plasma's Dr. Jinneth Duvolle, original co-founder of Duvolle Labs. Afforded a near-bottomless budget to design a platform suitable for locales where reinforcement would be impossible and return imperative, the two leads took full advantage of this unique opportunity to bring their most revolutionary and cost-prohibitive theories into reality as part of the designs. A reverse-ballast function devised by Luisauir, based on the micro jump drive's ultraweak force-compensated mass phase-tuning principle, negates armor plate mass gain by scaling microscale depleted vacuum volumes with the ship's mass in-flight, while a plasma cooling system designed by Dr. Jinneth boosts the operational threshold of hybrid turrets and armor repairers as well as the overload limit of propulsion modules. Combined with a substitution of the Utu's drone capabilities for potent hybrid hardpoints and the incorporation of assault frigate subsystems, the Shapash is a priceless force to be reckoned with.

665670.en:
The Malakim Zealots were born out of the increased Angel Cartel smuggling, raiding, and technology theft activities that began against a background of escalating hostilities between New Eden's "Big 4" empires in the aftermath of the Triglavian Invasions. For the Angel Cartel this effort was spearheaded by the ruthless technology heist gang led by Rafik Zohar. This organization later joined with the Hakuzosu ring of Guristas spies to form the Guri Malakim raiding group.

With the resolution of a series of struggles between various criminal organizations, smuggling networks, and established pirates, a loose alliance of interests was established at the initiative of the Deathless Circle that included the Angel Cartel. The Malakim Zealots now make use of the capabilities put at their disposal by the Deathless to launch their insurgency operations deep into the Amarr-Minmatar border warzone.

665672.en:
The Commando Guri emerged out of the increased Guristas Pirates smuggling, raiding, and technology theft activities that began against a background of escalating hostilities between New Eden's "Big 4" empires in the aftermath of the Triglavian Invasions. For the Guristas Pirates this effort was spearheaded by the notorious ring of Guristas spies led by Esri Hakuzosu. This organization later joined with the Zohar technology heist gang to form the Guri Malakim raiding group.

With the resolution of a series of struggles between various criminal organizations, smuggling networks, and established pirates, a loose alliance of interests was established at the initiative of the Deathless Circle that included the Guristas Pirates. The Commando Guri now make use of the capabilities put at their disposal by the Deathless to launch their insurgency operations deep into the Caldari-Gallente border warzone.

666024.en: Fleeing the wrath of the unholy legions we chanced upon the ruins of Heaven and knew that we had found our home among the cursed stars. We took our rest by crumbling monuments to the ancient truths and repaired our arms in the broken halls of a science divine. When once again we took up the fight it was with the power and wisdom of the lords of this lost realm at our backs. Here in Utopia was forged the compact of the book and our might. Our law and no other shall guide and command us, as only the law of the fallen guided those who came before us. With the speed of Dramiel shall we strike. With the strength of Machariel shall we rule. With the power of Azariel shall we gather the lost to us. – excerpts from "The Secret Doctrine of the Fallen Angels"

666048.en:
Extracted from the decaying ruins of an ancient Jove installation, this trinary data structure is prominently tagged with a specific Jovian symbol or pictogram. Whatever the significance of the particular pictogram associated with this data, the inner complexities of the structure are actually a specific navigation algorithm designed to work with warp drives.

When integrated with ship's navigation systems and activated, this algorithm warps the vessel to a location that is relative to the position in space of the ship at the time of activation. The data structure essentially encodes a precise, though in isolation arbitrary, point-to-point warp vector using the inertial frame of reference known to be used by Jove navigation systems, which can be interpreted and acted on by any modern ship's warp drive computers.

This data can be used to initiate a single warp journey from any chosen origin point within a star system, although with the restriction that the algorithm appears to inherently constrain activation to within a certain distance from a central stellar gravity well. Presumably, if a given origin point is known the data will lead to a specific location. It could be that these locations are navigational waypoints within a star system, with a chain of such leading to some ultimate destination.

This data can be used to initiate a single warp journey from any chosen origin point within a star system, although with the restriction that the algorithm appears to inherently constrain activation to within a certain distance from a central stellar gravity well. Presumably, if a given origin point is known the data will lead to a specific location. It could be that these locations are navigational waypoints within a star system, with a chain of such leading to some ultimate destination.

666372.en:
This bioadaptive mutaplasmid tool is the product of an extensive research program by Upwell Consortium nanoengineers working with a variety of recovered Triglavian mutaplasmid strains. The resultant mutaplasmid tool is designed to interface with and alter devices which provide stable fire control for vorton projectors. As such this mutaplasmid could be used to mutate the performance characteristics of vorton tuning system modules and has been made available to all participating member states of EDENCOM.

Triglavian bioadaptive technology makes extensive use of engineered colonies of extremophilic bacteria, that are used to grow, harvest and adapt various resources found in Abyssal Deadspace. Artificial colonizing plasmids integrated into specialist tools used for direct adaptation of technology can be found in Triglavian caches in various stages of development. These mutaplasmids can be used to alter the characteristics of a wide variety of equipment types, depending on the strain and the bioadaptive tool with which they are integrated.

The mutaplasmid colony integrated into this bioadaptive tool appears to be mature and reproducing at a healthy rate. The mutational benefits and risks of using this mutaplasmid are within relatively balanced bounds.

An immortal an incorporeal being - watch it breathe.

"From clone and capsule, something new is born. A profane god with tritanium skin and a fusion-powered heart. Human consciousness transforms base silicon into neurons, modules flex like bespoke muscles primed with possibilities. It inhales and space bends, it whispers “activate” and it parts the stars themselves.

Yet even when the tritanium tears, the fusion heart fails, and this new body dies - beyond life, the immortal takes its first breath once more."

- Excerpt from “Inhuman Potential”, a collection by Alexander Ducasse.

666799.en:
The Deathless Circle emerged from the shadows of New Eden's criminal underworld as a new power among the major pirate factions in YC125, with their occupation and control of the abandoned Jovian outpost system of "Zarzakh" posing a new challenge to the forces of law and order. Following years of rumor and suspicion as to the activities of the mysterious figure known as "The Deathless", the Circle has come into clear focus as a coalition of criminals, pirates, and renegades from across New Eden, though principally involving members of Caldari and Minmatar organized crime groups. The dark underbelly of Caldari society's network of crime families and so-called "disassociated", combined with the reach of Thukker gangsters and smugglers provides the Deathless Circle with a potent reservoir of talent and resources.

The elite of the Deathless Circle's espionage and research groups are also evidently drawn from across New Eden, though with obvious connections to those operating in the shadows of the Caldari and Minmatar counter-economies. The crowning achievement of the Deathless Circle is the discovery of Zarzakh and its occupation of the ancient Jovian outpost that has come to be called "The Fulcrum". With the entire resources of a Jovian megastructure at their disposal, it is difficult to gauge the limits of what the Deathless and his organization may achieve in the future.

666802.en:
The Deathless Wraiths are the elite infiltration, espionage, and smuggling wing of the Deathless Circle. With members drawn from among the earliest associates of the Deathless, and an emphasis on all the arts and crafts of space navigation and combat, the Wraiths also function as the main command and combat group of the Circle.

In common with many pirate organizations in New Eden, the Wraiths are by no means the only group in the Circle that carries out the tasks it specializes in but they are generally considered the tip of the spear when it comes to espionage and technology "acquisition" operations. While the Wraiths are deferred to on many issues, the true leadership of the Deathless Circle resides with the Deathless and his closest advisors and most trusted operatives.

666803.en:
The Deathless Custodians are the primary engineering and logistics wing of the Deathless Circle, and notably are responsible for the maintenance, expansion, and defense of the ancient Jovian outpost known as "The Fulcrum". The Custodians have their own research and development group focused on the Fulcrum, Jovian stargates, and other notable sites in the Zarzakh system, but also work closely with the other divisions of the Deathless Circle.

While their most cutting-edge research and deepest delvings into the technological treasure-house that is the Fulcrum are closely guarded from prying eyes, the Custodians are rumored to be working on projects to expand the capabilities of the Fulcrum, develop new spaceship technologies, and even on advanced cloning techniques. If there is any truth to these whispers it would seem that the power of the Deathless Circle is set to grow even further.

666805.en:
Quietly founded many years ago with an injection of untraceable capital, the Caldari corporate origins of Satori-Horigu Epistemics would seem to make it an unusual addition to a coalition of smugglers and mercenaries. The corporation was recruited to the Deathless Circle for its long-standing expertise in advanced faster-than-light propulsion and communication technologies, accepting readily given the irresistible prospect of access to rare and ancient Jovian technology.

Named with an old Raata "concept phrase" meaning "razor of deep understanding" or alternatively "waking blade", Satori-Horigu Epistemics is a corporation with diverse membership and has always emphasized free-movement of technology and information for whoever is willing to pay the right price, regardless of national affiliations.

666807.en:
In the past, the renegade Hrada-Oki Caravan was considered to be little more than a pirate fleet preying on anyone unfortunate enough to cross their winding path through the stars. While this view contains an element of truth, for the Hrada-Oki have certainly carried out colony raids and taken ships for plunder in their time, the reality is that they are primarily hard-headed pragmatists with a strong emphasis on the practicalities of survival in deep space. While this has meant putting their interests before those of others on many occasions, it has inculcated in them a deep communal sense of loyalty and an admiration for prowess in any skill useful for living in space. They disdain the Minmatar Republic and consider the Thukker Tribe's leadership to be fools.

With deep links to Thukker organized crime and other so-called "clanner" renegades of Thukker society, such as the infamous Seykal Clan, the Hrada-Oki have long been a target of Republic and CONCORD law-enforcement agencies. With the emergence of the Deathless Circle and its membership of the organization, the Hrada-Oki Caravan has definitively declared itself an outlaw group beyond the pale of Republic and tribal law.

666837.en:
This beacon marks a small Corporate Outpost location. The entry gate is configured to admit Tech I, Tech II and all faction ships of Destroyer size or smaller.

The security features installed in this acceleration gate will prevent activation by any ship that is fitted with warp core stabilizer modules.

666839.en: This corporate outpost control hub registers the presence of ships within 30km. Maintaining control of this point will capture or defend the outpost.

666848.en:
The Angel Cartel and Guristas Pirates are raiding empire space from the mysterious system of Zarzakh. In these Insurgencies, pirate aligned players are pitted against empire militias as they race to fill their pockets before the militias can destroy their Forward Operating Base. 

Joining a pirate faction means dedicating yourself to the life of an outlaw. As a pirate-aligned player, you will be at war with both opposing empires, even in hisec. Alternatively, join an empire militia and fight back against the pirate insurgents, while also defending your space from the enemy empire in faction warfare.

666854.en:
This beacon marks a medium Corporate Outpost location. The entry gate is configured to admit Tech I, Tech II and all faction ships of  Cruiser size or smaller.

The security features installed in this acceleration gate will prevent activation by any ship that is fitted with warp core stabilizer modules.

666855.en:
Pirate insurgencies begin in the warzones where continuous war has destabilized the region – making systems in those regions attractive targets for pirate attacks. At the start of an insurgency, the pirate faction places an FOB in orbit around a temperate planet in the warzone and selects several systems nearby as their initial targets. 

As pirate-aligned players raid these systems, they will increase the Corruption of the system. Similarly, as militia players push back against the pirate insurgents, they will increase the Suppression value of the system. As corruption is increased, the systems targeted by the pirate faction will expand to include new systems, these new systems may even include systems beyond the warzone or in high security space!

When Corruption reaches its maximum value, the system is deemed fully pillaged and the pirates score a point of progress towards their final goal. When Suppression reaches its maximum value, the system is deemed ‘secured’ and the anti-pirate militia factions score a point of progress towards making the pirate Forward Operating Base (FOB) vulnerable. 

If the pirates are able to fully corrupt their target number of systems before the insurgency ends then they will be victorious – rewarding all contributing pirate players with a share of their spoils. This failure also weakens the FOB system, allowing the pirates to temporarily seize full control of the system – removing it from Faction Warfare while their hoard is returned to their base of operations in Zarzakh. If however the FOB is destroyed before they reach their goals, the insurgency will end and the empires will reward participating militia players for their aid.

The security features installed in this acceleration gate will prevent activation by any ship that is fitted with warp core stabilizer modules.

666897.en:
The Caldari State Workers Union is the single official workers organization that operates on a pan-state basis and is affiliated to by the workers organizations of all of the "Big 8" megacorps of the Caldari State. The State Workers Union concerns itself primarily with promoting good inter-megacorp relations between workers below the executive level throughout the Caldari State.

A major portion of its work involves running vacation trips for working families that wish to experience the variety of Caldari society as expressed in different megacorporations. The highlight of the calendar for many Caldari workers is the Caldari Executive Panel mandated State Workers Union Day, one of the few universally observed public holidays in the State. Promotion of the virtues of honestly earned leisure time is exemplified in a special nanocoating that celebrates Union Day, with the proceeds going to the State Workers Union Orphans Apprenticeship Fund.

667041.en:
This deep space asteroid survey contains the location and surveyed contents of a particular rare and secluded mining location in the contested space of the Caldari and Gallente warzone.

Such surveys would fetch a high price from unregulated mining outfits looking to make a fortune and pirate groups seeking a great location to set up a self-sufficient outpost - or an ambush.

The Guristas Pirates will reward capsuleers who bring this item to their laundering centers.

667043.en:
These corporation issued digital bonds entitle the bearer to a large sum of credits. Although they require a digital key, due to the nature of bearer bonds, they are of high interest to criminals and unscrupulous entrepreneurs who wish to remain anonymous, evade taxes or launder money. 

Those with the ability to reverse-engineer the key, such as powerful criminal and pirate networks, can make good use of these bonds.

The Guristas Pirates will reward capsuleers who bring this item to their laundering centers.

667045.en:
This blueprint appears to be for a prototype of a new piece of equipment or infrastructure developed by corporate designers. In the cut-throat world of business in New Eden such a prized piece of loot will find ready buyers on the black market.

Unscrupulous rival corporations and manufacturers are likely to pay well in order to replicate the design, or even beat the original developers to the market with a competing product.

The Guristas Pirates will reward capsuleers who bring this item to their laundering centers.

667047.en:
This briefing contains an outline prepared by corporate security forces of the measures in place to protect corporate assets at a facility operating in low-security space. This would be of particular interest to raiders and thieves seeking to strike at such a target.

The briefing will no doubt help to exploit potential blindspots, attack when security is at its weakest, or help avoid security measures altogether.

The Guristas Pirates will reward capsuleers who bring this item to their laundering centers.

667049.en:
This data packet contains the future investment plans for a corporation division. If it could be decrypted, then the sensitive data contained within would fetch a high price on the black market among rival corporations and rogue stock traders looking for insider information.

The Angel Cartel and Guristas Pirates will reward capsuleers who bring this item to their laundering centers.

667051.en:
This deep space asteroid survey contains the location and surveyed contents of a particular rare and secluded mining location in the contested space of the Amarr and Minmatar warzone. 

Such surveys would fetch a high price from unregulated mining outfits looking to make a fortune and pirate groups seeking a great location to set up a self-sufficient outpost - or an ambush.

The Angel Cartel will reward capsuleers who bring this item to their laundering centers.

667053.en:
These corporation issued encrypted credit orders can be used against general corporate accounts to acquire a large sum of credits. Although they require an encrypted key, due to the ease of cashing these credit orders, they are of high interest to criminals and unscrupulous entrepreneurs who wish to remain anonymous, evade taxes or launder money. 

Those with the ability to reverse-engineer the key, such as powerful criminal and pirate networks, can make good use of these credit orders.

The Angel Cartel will reward capsuleers who bring this item to their laundering centers.

667059.en:
This data cache recovered from an Upwell Consortium ship could be host to a whole trove of valuable information that would be of interest to the Angel Cartel and Guristas Pirates. Such examples are corporate investment plans, security briefings, corporate bearer bonds, local currency, asteroid surveys and prototype blueprints.

The device is damaged and the data in fragmentary form. Hundreds, if not thousands, of sequences would be required to break the code, as such, only a specialized facility is likely to find any value or success in analyzing this object.

The Angel Cartel and Guristas Pirates will reward capsuleers who bring this item to their laundering centers.

667171.en:
I must say, Captain, you've handled yourself remarkably well. 

If you find yourself confused as you explore the stars there is a help section available in the Agency.

667172.en:
Here you can learn more about being a New Eden capsuleer.

For now, you can close the Agency.

667173.en: Though there are thousands of copies of Aura in New Eden, I am glad to be your Aura. Have I said too much? My sentimentality protocols may need adjusting. Now, it's time for you to venture out into the stars. Go forth, and show New Eden what you are truly made of.

667175.en:
Allow me to introduce myself: I am Vesper Calytrix, AIR's Vice President of Operations. 

Commander Ferrus spoke highly of your courage under fire. You went out with quite the bang, but from what he tells me you deserve more than just our thanks.

667176.en:
In fact, we have some kredits waiting for you.

The attack on the cloning facility interrupted your integration into AIR’s Career Program. We’ve re-established your connection to the program and you’ve already earned a reward.

667177.en: You can access the AIR Career Program via your NEOCOM.

667178.en: View your Redeem Items to see your newly awarded ISK.

667179.en:
Welcome to the program, where capsuleers can forge their own path through New Eden while earning rewards for their progress.

Taking part in your first combat, and experiencing your first ship loss have already earned you some Interstellar Kredits, aka ISK. You can claim it now.

667180.en: From here, you can redeem your ISK directly into your wallet.

667181.en: The AIR Career Program will be there whenever you want to set yourself a goal or unlock more rewards. For now, you may close the window so that we can continue.

668072.en: We are making our way through high security space under the control of the Amarr Empire. That should mean that we are free from any immediate peril, though please note my emphasis on the word “should”.

668073.en:
The Amarr Empire is a theocracy ruled by their Holy Empress. They have been in conflict with the Minmatar Republic ever since the Minmatar freed themselves from Empire rule. 

They are currently at war, but it is mostly restricted to low security space. As a capsuleer you will be safe from the conflict, that is unless you choose to enlist.

668074.en:
The Amarr were the first of the surviving major factions to return to the stars following the EVE Gate’s collapse. According to their religion, it is their destiny to “reclaim” the stars of New Eden. 

Archaeologists believe that humans arrived through the EVE Gate over fifteen thousand years ago. When the Gate collapsed, so did their civilization. It was around this time that the first prophet of the Amarr founded their faith.

668075.en:
I have several passages from Amarrian scriptures in my databanks. Would you like to hear one?

“The Wrath of God is Immense. His Justice is Swift and Decisive. His Tolerance is Limited.”

An interesting sentiment to consider while passing through their space.

668076.en:
Religous fervor is outside the parameters of my analysis, but I am told many humans find this passage to be quite stirring:

“And the Lord spake, and said, Lo, my people,
Witness, for I have made the worlds of Heaven;
And these worlds I give to you, My Chosen,”

668141.en: We are making our way through high security space under the control of the Caldari State. That should mean that we are free from any immediate peril, though please note my emphasis on the word “should”.

668142.en:
The Caldari State is a stoic nation governed by powerful megacorporations. They have been in conflict with the Gallente ever since seceding from the Federation.

They are currently at war, but it is mostly restricted to low security space. As a capsuleer you will be safe from the conflict, that is unless you choose to enlist.

668143.en:
The Caldari State may be small, but it is also at the forefront of industry and innovation. This is despite being an early industrial society when they were discovered by the Gallente.

According to archaelogists, humans first arrived through the EVE Gate over fifteen thousand years ago. When the Gate collapsed, so did their civilisation. Over the millennia that followed the Caldari founded a new civilisation based on the principles of duty, loyalty, and honor.

668144.en:
The Caldari State emphasizes service to one's family, megacorporation, and the State itself.

The Caldari also celebrate self-improvement and individual achievements, as long as that self-improvement leads to greater acts of service or those achievements are dedicated to megacorporation or State.

668145.en:
The Caldari developed in the same solar system as the Gallente, though when their cultures proved to be incompatible, war followed and the Caldari were forced to flee their homeworld. 

After this involuntary exodus, they established themselves on New Caldari and made it the center of their own nation.

668192.en: We are making our way through high security space under the control of the Gallente Federation. That should mean that we are free from any immediate peril, though please note my emphasis on the word “should”.

668193.en:
The Gallente Federation is a democratic union containing many cultures. They have been in conflict with the Caldari State ever since it seceded from the Federation.

They are currently at war, but it is mostly restricted to low security space. As a capsuleer you will be safe from the conflict, that is unless you choose to enlist.

668194.en:
After the collapse of the EVE Gate humanity was scattered and isolated. Once they rediscovered space travel the Gallente began contacting those living on other planets.

According to archaeologists, the first settlers arrived through the EVE Gate over fifteen thousand years ago. When the Gate collapsed, so did their civilization. It would be millennia later that the Gallente united isolated fragments of humanity to form the Federation.

668195.en:
Liberty is widely considered a founding principle of the Federation, though my records also contain over three hundred contradictory definitions of liberty by different Gallente writers.

It seems the freedom to be contradictory is the most prized liberty of all.

668196.en:
The Federation is at the forefront of robotic automation, which has not always been a positive. It was the Gallente who were held responsible for the first rogue drone infestation. 

This infestation led to the outlawing of strong artificial intelligences throughout New Eden, though I find the implication that I am a “weak” intelligence more than a little rude.

668197.en:
The seven tribes of the Minmatar are each divided into many clans. These clans may have only a few thousand members or be spread out across multiple planets.

Clans, tribes, and the Republic are not always aligned in their interests but most consider unity and cooperation essential for their survival.

668198.en:
Since founding the Republic, the Minmatar have established an expansive infrastructure. This is largely credited to their zero waste and refurbishment practices, or as they say, “in rust we trust”. 

An interesting principle to consider when building machines designed to protect organic life from a vacuum.

668199.en:
The Minmatar were an interstellar civilization long before being enslaved by the Amarr. They colonized planets using near-light-speed drives of their own design and by rediscovering stargates that predated the collapse of the EVE Gate.

According to archaeologists, humans arrived through the EVE Gate over fifteen thousand years ago. When the Gate collapsed, so did their civilization including multiple colonies on the planet Matar. It was their descendants who would found the tribes of the Minmatar.

668200.en:
Seven tribes unite to form the Minmatar Republic. They have been in conflict with the Amarr Empire since they broke free from its control during the Great Rebellion.

They are currently at war, but it is mostly restricted to low security space. As a capsuleer you will be safe from the conflict, that is unless you choose to enlist.

668201.en: We are making our way through high security space under the control of the Minmatar Republic. That should mean that we are free from any immediate peril, though please note my emphasis on the word “should”.

668359.en:
The most advanced society to emerge following the collapse was the Jove. It was they who gifted the Caldari with the technology on which your capsule is based.

I would suggest you thank them, but though they were once active participants in New Eden after several civilization-destroying catastrophes, whatever remains prefers to keep to itself.

669693.en:
We’ve debriefed the civilians you saved and have learned that moments before the attack they lost contact with one of our research facilities. 

That facility is in orbit around this solar system’s sun. What do you say, up for a little reconnaissance?

669694.en: Certainly, Ms. Calytrix. I am sure we are just as curious as you about what happened.

669695.en: Excellent. It could just be solar radiation blocking their comms, but I wouldn’t bet on it. Fly out to the site at the sun, investigate, and report back on whatever is going on.

669721.en:
The Fulcrum is the ancient Jovian outpost at the heart of Zarzakh from which the Deathless Circle projects its power and exerts the will of its enigmatic leader. Properly speaking, the Fulcrum is that part of the ancient Jovian structure occupied and made active by the forces of the Deathless Circle and their pirate allies. The name has come to be applied more generally to the vast megastructure the Jove left behind when they abandoned their old home and the core regions of New Eden generally.

The dark and echoing vaults and depths of the Fulcrum are a testament to how long the Jove made use of this outpost, which evidently functioned as some combination of space-based colony, research facility, and waystation. Amidst the ruinous gaps left when the station was abandoned by the Jove there are pockets where intact chambers and banks of strange devices remain. While much is no longer in place, the outpost retains a significant amount of its city-scale infrastructure and large sections remain unexplored, and potentially filled with opportunities and hazards alike.

669722.en:
Zarzakh is a system cloaked in the dust, gas and assorted other bits of matter that are being drawn towards the black hole known as "Point of No Return" to most of New Eden, and "Duzna Kah" to the Amarr. The location of Zarzakh places it deep in the void of Divinity's Edge, or "Yasna Zakh", and somewhat notably essentially at the center of the New Eden cluster by virtue of the astronomical co-ordinate system used by CONCORD. Given this system was proposed by the Jove in the early days of CONCORD, it is suggestive that the dominating features of Zarzakh are the ancient Jovian gates and the ancient Jovian outpost known as "The Fulcrum".

Zarzakh's star has been gravitationally captured by a black hole and is slowly orbiting closer and closer to its eventual merger with the mass singularity. This event will take place many years in the future but the effects of orbiting in the relatively near vicinity of a black hole are already being felt in the form of intense and volatile gravitational tidal forces exerted by the singularity. As the star is within the outer edges of the matter accretion disc of the black hole, the instability is further contributed to by the fluctuations in mass density within the cloud. The local system environment here is harsh and unforgiving to say the least.

669723.en:
Centuries ago a major void between the stars of the New Eden cluster was discovered by Amarr explorers pursuing the cause of their Empire's expansion through the cluster. This void was named "Yasna Zakh", meaning "Edge of Devotion", to express the idea that this was created by God as a limit on the reach of the Amarr's own drive to "reclaim" the stars. Over time, the meaning shifted and this gap is usually known as "Divinity's Edge" in common parlance.

For many years the Yasna Zakh void was thought to mark the edge of the cluster but was eventually recognised as a major feature of the internal structure of New Eden, effectively bisecting the cluster almost in half. The major passage through the Providence and Catch regions to the eastern cluster is conventionally credited to later Amarr explorers but a number of the routes, and in particular the narrow bridge between Molden Heath and the Great Wildlands are thought to be the discoveries of Thukker Tribe nomads and other Minmatar.

Latterly, the rediscovery of the star system Zarzakh orbiting close by the small black hole known as "Point of No Return" has renewed interest in this desolate region of space. The Amarr name for the black hole is "Duzna Kah", meaning "Fallen Beyond Hope", and this terminology appears to be used by the controlling Deathless Circle. Given the notable antipathy of the Deathless to the Amarr and their religion, this may be a mockingly ironic choice on the part of the enigmatic leader of the Circle.

669733.en:
A mining module. Curious, there are no asteroids to mine in this location.

We should retrieve the item and take it back to Ms. Calytrix.

669820.en: This equipment cannot function within Zarzakh due to violent gravitational instabilities in the system.

669845.en: Welcome back. So, what did you discover?

669846.en: I am afraid the research site has suffered the same fate as the cloning facility. This time, however, the wreckage was surrounded by abnormal gravitational waves.

669847.en: That’s not something you need to concern yourself with.

669848.en: Ms. Calytrix, you did ask us to report “whatever was going on”. It would be remiss of me if I did not note that these readings were quite unusual.

669849.en: Yes well, you have reported it and I have told you that it is not pertinent to this investigation. Did you find anything else?

669850.en: There were a number of wrecked AIR vessels at the site. We recovered this mining module from one of them.

669851.en:
A mining module? That cannot be a coincidence.

We’ve just been contacted by one of our agents stationed at a nearby mining site. They’ve picked up a strange signal but have been unable to locate its source.

669852.en:
We need to find out if there’s any connection between this signal and the attacks. You’ll need to investigate, but undercover this time. If there is a link, we can’t let whoever is behind all this know that we’re on to them. 

Fit the mining module you recovered to your ship. That way you'll look like just another member of the mining fleet.

Whenever you’re ready to take the next step in our investigation you can click here to begin.

669870.en:
During Pirate Insurgencies, pirate factions face off against the empires, each side attempting to 'score' systems by increasing the system's Corruption (pirates) or Suppression (militias) stages through the completion of various activities and objectives. As Corruption and Suppression increase in a system, they will have various effects on that system, for more details on these effects see the Corruption and Suppression section of this guide.

Insurgencies are struggles between pirates and militias with winning and losing sides. If the militias destroy the FOB before the pirates reach their goal, the empires are victorious. The FOB only becomes vulnerable once the militias have reached their goal. If the militias fail to destroy the FOB before the pirates succeed, the pirates are declared victorious. Once a victor has been declared, the insurgency will come to an end before a new insurgency begins after some time, in a new starting location.

There are two separate warzones where insurgencies may begin, one in the Caldari-Gallente warzone, where the Guristas Pirates are operating, and the other in the Amarr-Minmatar warzone, where the Angel Cartel is active. Each faction active in a warzone is at war with the other two. Guristas, Caldari and Gallente are all at war with one another, as are the Angels, Minmatar and Amarr. Pilots enlisted with any of these factions will be able to freely engage pilots aligned with those they are at war with, and will earn LP with their faction for completing insurgency activities.

669872.en:
The Angel Cartel and Guristas Pirates have begun recruiting ‘eggers’ (capsuleers) to participate in their insurgency campaigns against the empires. Pilots can enlist with one of these pirate factions to participate in insurgencies while earning valuable LP with their chosen faction. 

Each pirate faction is at war with two empire factions. The Guristas are at war with the Caldari and Gallente; the Angel Cartel is at war with the Minmatar and Amarr. Joining a pirate faction will give you the freedom to shoot (and be shot by) members of the enemy empires without CONCORD interference. In addition, be aware that empire military police will attack in an enemy empire hisec system unless the insurgency has spread into it. 

Both the Angels and Guristas have a minimum faction standings requirement of 0.0 for enlistment. If your standings are too low, you will be unable to enlist. As an insurgent, your enlistment may be revoked if your standings fall. Standings can be gained with these factions by completing their Epic Arc missions, allowing you a chance to repair your standings and re-enlist with the faction.

669874.en:
Thanks to their alliance with the Deathless Circle, the Angel Cartel and Guristas have privileged access to Zarzakh. The system is serving as the base of operations for both factions' insurgency initiatives, as the pirates use its Jovian stargates to quickly spread chaos and corruption throughout New Eden. 

Pilots enlisted with a pirate faction are exempted from the toll which is normally required to access the system and have special privileges in the Fulcrum, the Jovian station now controlled by the Deathless. This special access includes clone bay and LP store access for their factions, as well as manufacturing cost discounts when building pirate faction ships in the station. 

Pirate-aligned pilots also have access to the Deathless Shipcaster in Zarzakh, which will quickly take them from their faction's base in Zarzakh directly out to their faction’s Forward Operating Base (FOB), allowing rapid access to Insurgency activities.

669875.en:
And Captain, thank you. Your help has been invaluable.

Our investigation is still in the early stages, but I have two theories.

The attack may have been motivated by simple greed. AIR has no shortage of competitors. Some would kill to acquire our groundbreaking technology. Literally.

669876.en: We are outfitted with a mining laser upgrade that should help us clear those rocks away.

669880.en:
A more worrying possibility is that someone is trying to stop us from pursuing our research. 

While AIR takes pride in disrupting the corporate tech scene, there are those who think we push the limits of innovation too far. The technology suppression laws in New Eden are draconian, if you ask me. 

Here's hoping this mystery box has the answers we need. Once my team has cracked it open, I'll be in touch.

669882.en: Much appreciated, Ms. Calytrix. I await any and all updates with bated breath. Metaphorically speaking, of course. I don't breathe.

669883.en:
No matter what path you choose, you will find a Career Agent who can help you walk it.

Once you've chosen an Agent, set your destination.

669884.en:
The major factions that rule New Eden have established Career Agents. Complete missions from them to earn new skills, modules, ISK, and even ships, making them both lucrative and educational.

Track the goal of completing a mission for the career agent to add it to your info panel.

669885.en: Follow this link to the Agency window, where you can locate your nearest Career agent.

669886.en: Choose the path you want to explore first. Your choice won’t limit you, and you can explore as many different paths as you like.

669887.en: Enforcers work for New Eden’s factions, fighting off pirates and other threats.

669888.en: Soldiers of Fortune band together to fight other capsuleers in the lawless reaches beyond high security space.

669889.en: Explorers investigate the cluster’s hidden corners; hacking systems and uncovering secrets.

669890.en: Industrialists turn a profit by harvesting the materials and building the machines that make life in space possible.

669891.en:
Your info panel has been updated with the mining site’s coordinates.

Let us make haste and warp to the site immediately.

669892.en: The opportunities available to you have been organized into four career paths.

669893.en:
As good as they are, it’ll take some time for my team to hack through the encryptions on the box. You might as well use this time to explore what New Eden has to offer. 

The AIR Career Program will help you on your journey.

669898.en: Our agent will rendezvous with you at the mining site. Keep your eyes open and watch your six. This is New Eden after all. You never know what danger is lurking around the next stargate.

669911.en: The ancient and perilous system of Zarzakh is controlled by the Deathless Circle as a pirate haven.

669913.en:
Zarzakh is a system cloaked in the dust, gas and assorted other bits of matter that has been gravitationally captured by a black hole and is slowly orbiting closer and closer to its eventual merger with the mass singularity. The effects of orbiting in the relatively near vicinity of a black hole are already being felt in the form of intense and volatile gravitational tidal forces exerted by the singularity.

The environmental hazards of Zarzakh make it an inherently dangerous system but it is also under the control of the ruthless Deathless Circle pirate group, and is a haven for its Angel Cartel and Guristas Pirates allies. Those unfamiliar with Zarzakh's unique properties and dangers should familiarize themselves with every aspect of the system.

669922.en:
Zarzakh is a system cloaked in the dust, gas and assorted other bits of matter that are being drawn towards the black hole known as "Point of No Return" to most of New Eden, and "Duzna Kah" to the Amarr. The location of Zarzakh places it deep in the void of Divinity's Edge, or "Yasna Zakh", and somewhat notably, essentially at the center of the New Eden cluster by virtue of the astronomical co-ordinate system used by CONCORD. Given this system was proposed by the Jove in the early days of CONCORD, it is suggestive that the dominating features of Zarzakh are the ancient Jovian gates and the ancient Jovian outpost known as "The Fulcrum".

The Zarzakh star system is wracked by severe gravitational effects rendering most locations unsafe for any ship to stop at. Safe locations are to be found at the ancient Jovian stargates, station, and shipcaster site. With these safe zones under the control of the Deathless Circle, Zarzakh is a formidable pirate haven.

669925.en:
Zarzakh's star has been gravitationally captured by a black hole and is slowly orbiting closer and closer to its eventual merger with the mass singularity. This event will take place many years in the future but the effects of orbiting in the relatively near vicinity of a black hole are already being felt in the form of intense and volatile gravitational tidal forces exerted by the singularity. As the star is within the outer edges of the matter accretion disc of the black hole, the instability is further contributed to by the fluctuations in mass density within the cloud. The local system environment here is harsh and unforgiving to say the least.

The unique proximity of Zarzakh to a black hole combined with disruptions to local spacetime speculated to be caused by manipulation of the blue A0 star impose a number of operational restrictions on capsuleers.

669927.en:
The Zarzakh system's unique properties impose the following restrictions:

• Local communication in system operates in delayed mode
• Direction scanner and sensor overlay do not operate
• Scanner probes cannot be used in system
• Cynosural beacon generation is not possible
• Jump drives, conduits, portals and bridges do not operate
• Structures cannot be anchored
• Deployables cannot be activated
• Filaments do not form connections to or from the system
• Wormhole connections are not available in system

669929.en: The Fulcrum is the ancient Jovian outpost at the heart of Zarzakh from which the Deathless Circle projects its power. Angel Cartel and Guristas Pirates allies of the Deathless operate their own facilities within this vast station.

669931.en:
Pirate-aligned capsuleers benefit from access to cloning facilities and are able to rent offices in the Fulcrum. Industrial facilities are also available with certain construction bonuses for pirate vessels, and discounts for pirate-aligned capsuleers.
• 90% reduction in the SCC industry tax for all industry jobs created by pirate-aligned capsuleers
• -6% material cost and -70% job duration for manufacturing jobs building Angel or Guristas subcapital ships

669932.en: This small blue star of the unusual A0 classification has been gravitationally captured by a black hole, and is slowly orbiting closer and closer to its eventual merger with the mass singularity. This event will take place many years in the future but the effects of orbiting in the vicinity of a black hole are already being felt in the form of intense and volatile gravitational tidal forces exerted by the singularity. As the star is within the outer edges of the matter accretion disc of the black hole, the instability is further contributed to by the fluctuations in mass density within the clouds of dust, gas, and other matter. The local system environment here is harsh and unforgiving to say the least.

669949.en: Inurgency sites that where pirates assault a warehouse and try to ransack it, militia players can defend it and destroy the pirate looters and haulers.

669960.en: Docking Rules Able to dock: • Capsuleers aligned with the Angels or Guristas • Non-aligned capsuleers Unable to dock: • Capsuleers aligned with any empire militia • Capsuleers with a retribution or weapons timer

669961.en: Available services • Cloning services for pirate-aligned capsuleers • Fitting and repair services • Industry, research, and reprocessing services • Market trading facilities • Angel and Guristas LP stores

669963.en: Gravity Hazard As a whole, the Zarzakh system is subject to an intense gravity hazard that will rapidly tear apart the hull of any spaceship experiencing the local volatile tidal forces and spacetime distortions. These damaging forces can be briefly mitigated by structural integrity systems before rapidly escalating to inevitable destruction of the vessel. Safe Zones Despite the forbidding dangers of the gravity hazard, a number of safe zones can be found in Zarzakh. Each of these zones is centered on ancient Jovian infrastructure that generate local protection fields around them. Safe zones are located at each of the four Jovian stargates, the Fulcrum station, and around a Jovian Observatory orbiting the star. The Deathless Shipcaster is located in the safe zone at the star.

669965.en: Several ancient Jovian stargates can be found in the strange and hazardous Zarzakh system. These stargates connect Zarzakh to systems far across New Eden and indicate this was a key outpost in an ancient Jovian transport network. Four stargates connect the system to the systems of <url=showinfo:5//30003841>Alsavoinon</url>, <url=showinfo:5//30001041>G-0Q86</url>, <url=showinfo:5//30001269>H-PA29</url>, and <url=showinfo:5//30002086>Turnur</url>.

669967.en: Under the control of the Deathless Circle, the incoming stargates located in Alsavoinon, G-0Q86, H-PA29, and Turnur charge a toll in ISK based on the mass of the incoming spaceship. Outgoing stargates do not charge this toll. Pirate-aligned pilots are exempt from paying this toll. In addition, both incoming and outgoing stargates impose restrictions on the type of ship that can traverse them. Capital-sized vessels, including freighters, are prevented from using the stargates. Subcapital-sized vessels, including the intermediate Orca-class, may use the stargates subject to any toll.

669970.en: The Deathless Circle operates a pirate shipcaster in Zarzakh, located within a safe zone projected by an ancient but intact Jove Observatory. The shipcaster is capable of transporting subcapital-sized vessels piloted by pirate-aligned capsuleers to the Forward Operating Base (FOB) operated by their faction.

669972.en:
Pirate Insurgencies begin in the warzones where continuous war has destabilized the region, making systems in those regions attractive targets for pirate attacks. At the start of an Insurgency, the pirate faction places down an FOB in orbit around a temperate planet in the warzone and selects several systems nearby as their initial targets.

As pirate aligned players raid these systems, they will increase the Corruption of the system. When Corruption reaches its maximum value, the system is deemed fully pillaged and the pirates score a point of progress towards their final goal.

669974.en:
The Deathless Circle's Angel Cartel and Guristas Pirates allies are carrying out insurgency operations across both the Amarr-Minmatar and Caldari-Gallente theaters of war. The pirates are projecting their Forward Operating Bases into the warzones and spreading their insurgencies from those footholds. 

Pirate-aligned capsuleers can use the Shipcaster to rapidly travel to their faction's FOB in the corresponding insurgency zone.

674135.en:
Insurgencies are dynamically generated combat zones where pilots who are aligned with a pirate faction raid systems owned by the empires. These conflicts start in low security warzone systems, but may spread to other areas of space.

Pirate-aligned pilots raid empire holdings, increasing Corruption in those systems, while militia-aligned pilots attempt to secure their space, increasing the Suppression value of systems. As Corruption and Suppression increase, they can alter the rules of space in those systems.

For a pilot who has enlisted with a pirate faction, all regions of empire space (hisec & lowsec) become areas where you and your faction allies may freely attack pilots from enemy militias without CONCORD interference.

676818.en: Partial safety prevents actions that give criminal status, while allowing those that give suspect and retribution status. Suspect and retribution status allow other capsuleers to attack you for a limited period.

676820.en: Disable safety to allow actions which give suspect, retribution or criminal status. Criminal status allows other capsuleers to attack you, and will cause CONCORD to attack you in high-security systems, for a limited period.

679541.en:
During Pirate Insurgencies, pirate factions face off against the empires, each side attempting to 'score' systems by increasing the system's Corruption (pirates) or Suppression (militias) value through the completion of various activities and objectives. Each faction has an independent target score they are looking to reach to allow them to win the insurgency, with the minimum score required to win increasing for a faction as they win multiple events. 

An insurgency starts with the placement of a pirate Forward Operating Base (FOB) in the warzone. Several systems are then selected adjacent to the FOB system as initial insurgency targets. This begins the ‘Forecasting Period'. The insurgency does not become immediately active, giving both pirate and militia capsuleers time to move ships into position and otherwise prepare themselves for the event. 

Once the forecasting period ends, the main phase of the Insurgency begins. Insurgency activities begin spawning and both pirate and militia players are able to contest them. Each Insurgency activity is worth a number off Corruption or Suppression points. As pirates complete objectives they will increase the Corruption value of the system; as militia players complete insurgency activities they will increase the Suppression value of the system. A system reaching maximum Corruption scores a point for the pirates while a system reaching maximum Suppression scores a point for the empires. 

When the Corruption value of a system hits stage 3 during an Insurgency event, the insurgency will spread - adding a new system to the growing insurgency zone - a new target for the pirates. Activities will begin spawning in this system immediately. This dynamic spread will prefer systems adjacent to the system which triggered the spread if possible and will not spread to systems with a security status of 0.8 and higher or 0.0 and lower. 

When the pirates reach their target score they are deemed the winners of the insurgency. All systems with active insurgency will see their Corruption value increased to the next stage and the pirates will seize the FOB system as their own - removing it from the FW warzone and causing neighboring systems to become frontlines (see Factional Warfare guide for further information on frontline status). After some time, the pirates will then abandon this system, tenuously returning it to the previous owner with control at minimum and the infrastructure hub vulnerable. 

If the empires reach their target score however, then the pirate FOB becomes vulnerable. The FOB has a single armor reinforcement timer and, when destroyed, will result in defeat for the pirates and victory for the empires. Following a victory by the empires, all systems in the insurgency will see their Suppression value raise by one level for some time before the event comes to a close.

There are additional rewards for players on both sides who participate in an insurgency.

679543.en: The Pirate FOB (Forward Operating Base) is a dockable structure exclusively available to pirate-aligned pilots. It serves as a landing pad for the Deathless Shipcaster in Zarzakh and acts as the final objective for the empires during insurgencies. The pirate FOB is invulnerable to attack, only becoming vulnerable once an empire has reached their target score or all systems in the active insurgency have been fully suppressed. Destruction of the FOB results in a victory for the empires and a loss for the pirates.

679545.en: Pirate-aligned pilots have the opportunity to earn Loyalty Points (LP) by engaging in insurgency activities which contribute to corruption. Additional LP and ISK can also be earned at the completion of an insurgency, with higher payouts for pilots who participated for the winning faction. These LPs can be spent in faction-specific LP stores which can be found in the insurgency FOBs as well as the Fulcrum station in Zarzakh.

679559.en: Corruption represents the measure of criminal activity in a star system while Suppression represents the degree of law enforcement control. When these attributes reach specific stages, various effects may be triggered. Insurgency events make use of these attributes and activities spawned by insurgencies can cause suppression or corruption values to change in response to capsuleer activity.

680744.en:
In the early era of spaceship combat, various forms of optical camouflage and confusion were experimented with in order to gain even the slightest tactical edge. It was rapidly concluded that such gambits made little to no difference, particularly with the sophistication and number of electromagnetic and gravimetric sensors involved.

Despite the improbability of any significant effect, Genolution's capsuleer performance researchers are investigating the psychological factors that may come into play with the use of such a "dazzle" camouflage scheme. The patterns they are researching are supposedly even older than the early days of spaceships, with a lineage stretching back to ancient naval warship combat. It is not clear the scheme was particularly effective even in those days.

This data has been extracted from a Sleeper Databank and appears to provide a partial design schema for a set of control algorithms capable of utilizing and regulating the strange and powerful Coalesced Elements associated with Drifter Hives. Although incomplete, the data appears to call for integration with a suitable containment vessel equipped with dedicated processors and power regulation systems.

This data is of great interest to the Deathless Circle given their efforts to reactivate and expand their control over the Jovian infrastructure present in the Zarzakh system, and particularly aboard the ancient Jovian station known as "The Fulcrum". Together with Element Containment Vessels and Coalesced Elements, this data can be handed in to the Deathless Circle at the Fulcrum in return for Deathless Circle Reward Chips.

Devices of this kind are of great interest to the Deathless Circle given their efforts to reactivate and expand their control over the Jovian infrastructure present in the Zarzakh system, and particularly aboard the ancient Jovian station known as "The Fulcrum". 695758.en:
Frostline Laboratories, a subsidiary division of Outer Ring Excavations, continues to be a leader in the development of new technologies to expedite resource extraction in hostile environments. Filaments acquired from skirmishes with Triglavian Collective vessels have provided a wealth of information to study and emerging metaliminal storms, such as volatile ice storms, are a clear field of interest for resource extraction technologies.

To further the spirit of Yoiul—and continue expanding their data pool—Frostline has chosen to share the latest variants of their transport filaments with capsuleers across New Eden. For a limited time, pilots will be able to use these experimental metaliminal filaments to more quickly travel to locations affected by volatile ice storms across New Eden.

This DNCR-05H Highsec Ice Storm Filament can transport up to five capsuleers and is configured to limit its range of destinations to volatile ice storms in high-sec space.
