711377.en: Obtain resources to run a variety of sovereignty installations.

711378.en: Colony Resources are essential for running sovereignty hub upgrades in nullsec space. These resources are primarily obtained with orbital skyhooks anchored above planets, each yielding one of three resources: power, workforce, or reagents. Sovereignty upgrades typically require both power and workforce to run, with higher-tier upgrades demanding greater resource allocations. Reagents are consumed as fuel in the most advanced upgrades and structures. Reagent skyhooks can be raided. Requirements: - A sovereignty hub to claim a system. - As many orbital skyhooks as planets from which resources are to be extracted.

711381.en: A heavy Triglavian defense platform powered by a harnessed singularity and equipped with a formidable array of entropic disintegrators. Destruction of these dangerous Triglavian structures is vital to EDENCOM's efforts in defense of New Eden star systems invaded by the Collective. Strategic Troika of Svarog Clade conjoin-consents with grounded metaxy of Tactical Troika noemata and prayer-directs logistical subclades to improve reification of adaptation schema for entropic disintegrator werpost. Svarog Clade now-time affirms imperative of advancing-time Xordazh Chislov Zvemokorg noemata. – incomplete deciphering of data embedded in targeting processor of a Triglavian Entropic Disintegrator Werpost ( copy )

711412.en: Event sites for Capsuleer Day XXI.

711415.en: Provided by the Upwell Consortium to reward the capsuleers who assist in the development and construction of their prototype structure in the <url=showinfo:5//30002744>Auviken</url> system.

711435.en: When griemeer was discovered in YC126, it took little time for miners to notice that the darker the crystals, the more isogen and, to a lesser extent, tritanium, it would yield. As it has a slight resemblance in texture to Liparer cheese, those obsessed with mining griemeer have been derisively nicknamed "cheesers" by rivals. Asteroid anomalies in null security space is where griemeer is generally found.

711437.en: Clear griemeer is characterized by crystals that lack the milky whiteness of the common variant, and where the inky black cloudiness of the rarer versions is also absent. However, clear griemeer is still a fortunate find, as it has a 5% increased yield. Asteroid anomalies in null security space is where clear griemeer is generally found.

711439.en: Griemeer with spots of darkness in its clear crystals is called inky griemeer and boasts a 10% extra yield. Asteroid anomalies in null security space is where inky griemeer is generally found.

711441.en: The best griemeer, opaque griemeer, is the kind that lets no light through its crystals. Those lucky enough to find some will be rewarded with an additional 15% yield during refinement. Asteroid anomalies in null security space is where opaque griemeer is generally found.

711487.en: Your current Clone State does not allow for Sequencing SKINS for the selected ship

711499.en: Hedbergite is sought after for its high concentration of Pyerite and Nocxium. Available primarily in low security status star systems. ( copy )

711501.en: Nocxite, discovered in YC126 due to new astrogeological surveying techniques, contains mostly nocxium with trace amounts of tritanium and pyerite. Even trace amounts of nocxite produces intoxicating fumes under atmospheric pressures, demanding special care when being handled planetside. Previous failures to appropriately vent the gasses have resulted in a number of workplace accidents and fatalities. Nocxite may be found in null security asteroid anomalies.

711503.en: Fragrant nocxite has stronger hints of its intoxicating fumes under typical atmospheric pressure. Additionally, it yields 5% more minerals. Fragrant nocxite may be found in null security asteroid anomalies.

711505.en: Unstable even in low-pressure environments, intoxicating nocxite rewards persistent miners with an additional 10% yield. Intoxicating nocxite may be found in null security asteroid anomalies.

711507.en: Long-term exposure to ambrosial nocxite at atmospheric pressure has a chance of causing a state of permanent stupor in those handling it. Despite the risk, many planetside miners consider the additional 15% return in mineral yield more than worth it. Ambrosial nocxite may be found in null security asteroid anomalies.

711937.en: Hezorime, discovered in YC126, is a brittle ore that is sure to cut the unwary miner. The harder and sharper the ore, the better the yield. Hezorime refines into mostly zydrine, with small amounts of tritanium and isogen. Hezorime deposits may be found in null security space asteroid anomalies.

711939.en: A minor step up from its more common variant, dull hezorime produces an additional 5% yield when refined. Dull hezorime deposits may be found in null security space asteroid anomalies.

711941.en: With a barely perceptible saw-like edge, miners lucky enough to notice serrated hezorime will be rewarded for their diligence with an additional 10% yield of minerals. Serrated hezorime deposits may be found in null security space asteroid anomalies.

711943.en: Sharp hezorime should never be handled directly, as it will cut through protective gloves, flesh, and bone with incredible ease. Enterprising miners that are willing to risk fingers and limbs are rewarded with an additional 15% mineral yield. Sharp hezorime deposits may be found in null security space asteroid anomalies.

712006.en:
The federal Gallente Police Directorate traces its roots back to the original planet-wide police service of the Gallente Union on Luminaire. The Gallente Union Police & Public Safety Service (GUPPSS) was intended to operate as an "all union service", with its officers recruited and trained by the federal government of the Gallente Union. While retaining basic membership of the GUPPSS, and with some serving as federal police, most officers served in distinct units under the political oversight of member states.

The concept broke down as the Gallente Union expanded throughout space and evolved into the modern day Gallente Federation. As outlying systems, planets and colonies chose to wholly organize their own police forces, the "Guppies" were increasingly seen as an anachronism by the heavily-populated and powerful member states of Luminaire.

Ultimately, the homeworld states followed the example of the sovereign polities of the Gallente Federation and set up entirely independent police forces. The Gallente Union Police & Publice Safety Service became the Gallente Police Directorate, and found a new lease of life as a police force operating across Federation space with jurisdiction over federal domains. Detractors of this service still refer to it by the old nickname of "Guppies".

712009.en:
The Caldari State Police is one of the few law enforcement organizations that conducts operations across Caldari territory, working alongside Caldari Customs and the Business Tribunal Audit & Investigation Branch, known as the "Audit Tribunes". Originating as the planetary police force of Caldari Prime, during the period of Caldari membership of the Federation, the Caldari Police Guards played a key role in evacuating millions during the Caldari-Gallente War. This guaranteed the continued existence of the agency as the Caldari State Police, even in the new Caldari order of a fully corporate state.

The Caldari State Police found its niche in the interstellar nature of the Caldari State and is often used by the many smaller corporations and multistellar businesses that require a law enforcement agency that can operate across megacorporate territorial lines. The bulk of the State Police's income is derived from such policing and security work, but it retains Chief Executive Panel funding and the "Big 8" oversight that comes with it. Occasionally, the megacorporations may call in the State Police to resolve some matter they wish to keep at arms length. Actual disputes between megacorps remain the almost exclusive preserve of the CBT and its Audit Tribunes.

712015.en:
The Authority for Emergency Interdiction and Security (AEGIS) was originally set up as a response to shipping losses to pirates and other emergent threats, but during the Triglavian Invasions the security organization became a major element of planetary and space station defense efforts by EDENCOM. The AEGIS Security Police (ASP) operate across New Eden and are used to secure and police orbital facilities and planetary defense networks controlled by EDENCOM.

AEGIS Security Police also have an important role in investigating crimes and arbitrating disputes between the disparate interstellar forces that make up the military units operating under the EDENCOM mission. Increasingly, as the core empires look to their own internal security concerns and military-industrial strategic agendas, the AEGIS Security Police have supported the work of AEGIS Commandos and EDENCOM Anti-Warclone Units, as well as securing vital Upwell Consortium facilities constructing fortification equipment.

712023.en:
The Imperial Inquisitorial Police (IIP) are one of the key law enforcement divisions of the Amarr Ministry of Internal Order, focused primarily on maintaining law and order in direct holdings of the Imperial Throne, and any territories not coming under the direct jurisdiction of the six Royal Houses and their own police guards. Inevitably, given the complex, endlessly-shifting politics and webs of relationships between the Throne, Royal Houses, and their various vassals, there are any number of situations where the Ministry of Internal Order has some valid interest or mandate to intervene.

Outright situations of unrest or flagrant criminality are often dealt with by the Ministry's feared Order Paladins, a paramilitary force given to act first and ask questions later. When investigation or a somewhat lighter touch is required the Imperial Inquisitorial Police are usually sent in. Given the delicacy of many situations involving space stations and space industrial colonies, the IIP are the preferred option in such locations, with special investigation units travelling extensively throughout the Amarr Empire.

Inevitably, given the complex, endlessly-shifting politics and webs of relationships between the Throne, Royal Houses, and their various vassals, there are any number of situations where the Ministry of Internal Order has some valid interest or mandate to intervene.

Outright situations of unrest or flagrant criminality are often dealt with by the Ministry's feared Order Paladins, a paramilitary force given to act first and ask questions later. When investigation or a somewhat lighter touch is required the Imperial Inquisitorial Police are usually sent in. Given the delicacy of many situations involving space stations and space industrial colonies, the IIP are the preferred option in such locations, with special investigation units travelling extensively throughout the Amarr Empire.

712037.en:
The Republic Justice Police (RJP) are a uniformed branch of the Republic Justice Department, the law enforcement organization principally focused on fighting against crimes affecting the stability and security of the Republic and all the Tribes, such as terrorism, smuggling, and above all slavery. While other branches of the Republic Justice Department are active in more clandestine activities, such as counter-intelligence and supporting rebel groups in the Amarr Empire, the RJP tends to restrict its activities to internal crimes and co-operation with the various tribal and clan police forces in order to combat Republic-wide criminal networks.

Given the complicated nature of jurisdiction and legality in the Tribal Republic of the Minmatar, the Republic Justice Police often encounter difficulties and outright disdain from many clans eager to maintain their rights and jealous of outside interference. Nevertheless, the RJP's units are often to be seen travelling across Republic space as the complexities and exceptions of space colonization and station life often mean that only the Republic's police forces can deal with the problems. Most colonies or stations prefer calling in the RJP rather than the paramilitaries of the Republic Security Services if a Republic presence is required.

712106.en: Ueganite is an ore discovered in YC126 due to improvements in astrogeological surveying technology. It is primarily composed of megacyte, with trace amounts of tritanium. Some miners have posited that ueganite forms when multiple metaliminal storms occur in a single system for an extended period of time, but astrogeologists have dismissed the hypothesis as mere conjecture and superstition based on valuable ueganite having diverse properties reminiscent of these storms. Ueganite may be found in asteroid anomalies within null security space.

712108.en: It takes a keen eye to notice the tiny deposits that give foggy ueganite its name. This minor variation indicates that it gives a 5% greater yield than its regular form. Foggy ueganite may be found in asteroid anomalies within null security space.

712110.en: Overcast ueganite has sparkling flecks throughout its composition, but lacks the stormy properties of its rarer variant. It produces an additional 10% mineral yield when refined. Overcast ueganite may be found in asteroid anomalies within null security space.

712112.en: The sight of its subsurface lightning mineral veins, which gives stormy ueganite its name, brings great joy to any miner. Stormy ueganite yields 15% more minerals than its base form when refined. Stormy ueganite may be found in asteroid anomalies within null security space.

712240.en: Kylixium, an ore discovered in YC126, is mostly composed of mexallon, with some tritanium and pyerite in smaller quantities. It is named for its clay-like properties and appearance. Kylixium may be found in null security space asteroid anomalies. This material is compressed and a much more compact form of the original material.

712242.en: Kaolin kylixium is a rarer form of kylixium that yields a 5% increase in mineral content. It has more claylike properties than its prevalent form. Kaolin kylixium may be found in null security space asteroid anomalies. This material is compressed and a much more compact form of the original material.

712244.en: With 10% more mineral content, argil kylixium is even more malleable and claylike. Argil kylixium may be found in null security space asteroid anomalies. This material is compressed and a much more compact form of the original material.

712246.en: Extremely rich in mexallon, adobe kylixium is considered a auspicious find amongst those who mine it. This form has a 15% greater yield than its everyday variety. Adobe kylixium may be found in null security space asteroid anomalies. This material is compressed and a much more compact form of the original material.

712248.en: Nocxite, discovered in YC126 due to new astrogeological surveying techniques, contains mostly nocxium with trace amounts of tritanium and pyerite. Even trace amounts of nocxite produces intoxicating fumes under atmospheric pressures, demanding special care when being handled planetside. Previous failures to appropriately vent the gasses have resulted in a number of workplace accidents and fatalities. Nocxite may be found in null security asteroid anomalies. This material is compressed and a much more compact form of the original material.

712250.en: Fragrant nocxite has stronger hints of its intoxicating fumes under typical atmospheric pressure. Additionally, it yields 5% more minerals. Fragrant nocxite may be found in null security asteroid anomalies. This material is compressed and a much more compact form of the original material.

712252.en: Unstable even in low-pressure environments, intoxicating nocxite rewards persistent miners with an additional 10% yield. Intoxicating nocxite may be found in null security asteroid anomalies. This material is compressed and a much more compact form of the original material.

712254.en: Long-term exposure to ambrosial nocxite at atmospheric pressure has a chance of causing a state of permanent stupor in those handling it. Despite the risk, many planetside miners consider the additional 15% return in mineral yield more than worth it. Ambrosial nocxite may be found in null security asteroid anomalies. This material is compressed and a much more compact form of the original material.

712264.en: Hezorime, discovered in YC126, is a brittle ore that is sure to cut the unwary miner. The harder and sharper the ore, the better the yield. Hezorime refines into mostly zydrine, with small amounts of tritanium and isogen. Hezorime deposits may be found in null security space asteroid anomalies. This material is compressed and a much more compact form of the original material.

712266.en: A minor step up from its more common variant, dull hezorime produces an additional 5% yield when refined. Dull hezorime deposits may be found in null security space asteroid anomalies. This material is compressed and a much more compact form of the original material.

712268.en: With a barely perceptible saw-like edge, miners lucky enough to notice serrated hezorime will be rewarded for their diligence with an additional 10% yield of minerals. Serrated hezorime deposits may be found in null security space asteroid anomalies. This material is compressed and a much more compact form of the original material.

712270.en: Sharp hezorime should never be handled directly, as it will cut through protective gloves, flesh, and bone with incredible ease. Enterprising miners that are willing to risk fingers and limbs are rewarded with an additional 15% mineral yield. Sharp hezorime deposits may be found in null security space asteroid anomalies. This material is compressed and a much more compact form of the original material.

712272.en: When griemeer was discovered in YC126, it took little time for miners to notice that the darker the crystals, the more isogen and, to a lesser extent, tritanium, it would yield. As it has a slight resemblance in texture to Liparer cheese, those obsessed with mining griemeer have been derisively nicknamed "cheesers" by rivals. Asteroid anomalies in null security space is where griemeer is generally found. This material is compressed and a much more compact form of the original material.

712274.en: Clear griemeer is characterized by crystals that lack the milky whiteness of the common variant, and where the inky black cloudiness of the rarer versions is also absent. However, clear griemeer is still a fortunate find, as it has a 5% increased yield. Asteroid anomalies in null security space is where clear griemeer is generally found. This material is compressed and a much more compact form of the original material.

712276.en: Griemeer with spots of darkness in its clear crystals is called inky griemeer and boasts a 10% extra yield. Asteroid anomalies in null security space is where inky griemeer is generally found. This material is compressed and a much more compact form of the original material.

712278.en: The best griemeer, opaque griemeer, is the kind that lets no light through its crystals. Those lucky enough to find some will be rewarded with an additional 15% yield during refinement. Asteroid anomalies in null security space is where opaque griemeer is generally found. This material is compressed and a much more compact form of the original material.

712759.en:
Asteroid belts arise from the accumulation of dust particles into larger composites. The gravitational pull of the planets and moons in each system draws the accumulating mass together into deposits large enough to be profitably mined. 

In the past, scientists shared their concerns about an overall reduction in the supply of raw resources, but in recent times, the discovery of additional ore in unknown sectors of space has alleviated this anxiety. There are some experts who have maintained all along, however, that the ongoing excavations on the frontiers of nullsec, where new belts are still being uncovered each day, has provided more than enough incoming ore to satisfy the industrialists of New Eden.

713192.en: The Standup Metenox Moon Drill is a service module that extracts and refines valuable moon materials from a nearby moon. This service module is automatically included built-in to every Upwell Metenox Moon Drill, and cannot be removed from that structure. Standup is a proprietary system that uses a Structure Autonomous Nanoassembly Device (Upwell) containing integrated template software, a nanoassembler array and sufficient nanomass to enable the construction of a variety of service modules, structure modules and structure rigs when inserted into the appropriate slots on a structure built with Upwell technology.

713401.en:
Skill for the generation of jump portals to distant solar systems. 

Each level increases the number of ships that can be moved with a capital ship conduit jump by 5 per level.

713565.en:
Sleepers are trying to destabilize an Abyssal Rift. We want it kept open. 

They’re using Destablizer Arrays situated around the rift. Drain all the Arrays' capacitors below 20% simultaneously and the Rift will stabilize.

713566.en:
Sleepers are trying to close an Abyssal Rift. We want it open, simple as that. 

They’ve deployed Destablizer Arrays trying to shut the Rift down. Drain all the Arrays' capacitors below 20% simultaneously and the Rift will stabilize.

713567.en:
Sleepers are trying to close an Abyssal Rift. It is our duty to keep it open. 

Hostiles have deployed Destablizer Arrays targeting the Rift. Drain all the Arrays' capacitors below 20% simultaneously and the Rift will stabilize.

713568.en:
Sleepers are trying to close an Abyssal Rift. Our orders are to keep it open. 

They are using Destablizer Arrays to close the Rift. Drain all the Arrays' capacitors below 20% simultaneously and the Rift will stabilize.

713569.en:
The Sleepers have spotted you!

Drain all of the arrays below 20% and stabilize that Abyssal Rift.

Be quick, or the Rift will close.

713570.en:
Sleepers are hostile.

Drain all of the arrays below 20% and stabilize that Abyssal Rift.

Get it done ASAP, or the Rift closes.

713571.en:
We’ve got Sleepers incoming!

Drain all of the arrays below 20% and stabilize that Abyssal Rift.

Get it done fast, or that Rift closes.

713572.en:
Sleepers incoming.

Drain all of the arrays below 20% and stabilize that Abyssal Rift.

Act fast, or the Rift closes.

713573.en:
The Abyssal Rift is stable, and the Sleepers are retreating.

Excellent work, Captain. You shall be compensated. I pray we work together soon.

In the meantime, remember your scripture, “Fools go forth to spread false word.”

713574.en:
Rift is stable, hostiles falling back.

Nicely done, Captain. The House of Records will wire you your payment. You can consider your duty fulfilled. 

Your loyalty, and your silence, bring honor to the State.

713575.en:
Rift is stable, and the Sleepers are retreating.

Glad to have you on our team, Captain. Some Federation ISK is heading your way. 

Why don’t you spend that on a drink for yourself, maybe it will help you forget about anything unusual you saw today.

713576.en:
The Rift has been stabilized, and the Sleepers are falling back.

Nicely done. You've earned the RSS’s gratitude, and some ISK to boot.

Not that anything interesting happened here today, just some rogue Sleepers. Isn't that right, Captain?

713577.en:
We’re out of time! The rift has closed.

An unfortunate outcome, but next time we shall be triumphant. Until then, Captain

713578.en:
Rift has closed, nothing more to be done here.

Regardless of the outcome, you fought well out there. Until next time, Captain.

713579.en:
Our time is up! The rift has closed.

That’s a damn shame, Captain. We’ll get them next time.

713580.en:
Rift has destabilized, we’re out of time.

You handled yourself well out there, whatever the outcome. Next time we team up, they’ll be sorry.

713581.en:
The Sleepers have already abandoned this site, whatever its purpose might have been.

Until next time, Captain.

713582.en:
This is the restricted site of a concluded operation, Captain. Nothing to see here.

We appreciate you answering the call, Captain. See you next time.

713583.en:
Just some cleanup going on here, nothing to worry about.

We’ll see you next time around, Captain.

713584.en:
This site is closed off, nothing here to concern you.

Fly safe, Captain. See you at the next operation.

713585.en:
Ashes of Turnur filth have destroyed a secret research facility, and its power core is dangerously unstable.

Salvage all the wreckage to recover Encrypted ‘Istina’ Data before the core explodes.

713586.en:
Ashes of Turnur marauders have attacked a restricted research facility and its core is about to go critical.

Salvage all the wreckage to recover Encrypted ‘Istina’ Data before time runs out.

713587.en:
Ashes of Turnur just attacked one of our covert research facilities and its core has become dangerously unstable.

Salvage all the wreckage to recover Encrypted ‘Istina’ Data before everything goes boom.

713588.en:
Ashes of Turnur traitors have destroyed a hidden research facility, destabilizing its core.

Salvage all the wreckage and recover Encrypted ‘Istina’ Data before the core goes critical.

713589.en:
Ashes incoming! 

Salvage all wreckage before that core explodes, or our research here will have been for naught.

713590.en:
Ashes spotted. 

Salvage all wreckage before the core goes critical, the House of Records wants that research.

713591.en:
Ashes coming in hot! 

Salvage all the wreckage before that thing blows, we need to recover that research data.

713592.en:
Ashes detected. 

Salvage all the wreckage before the core goes critical, or we’ll have insufficient data to restart experiments

713593.en:
Market’s closed and Thukkers are moving on. Hope you aren’t too sad about missing out on the bargains.

The Republic has plenty of opportunities for talented pilots. Hope to see you at the next one, Captin.

713594.en:
Operation is concluded and this Depot is closed, Captain.

I like to see someone keen to lend a hand. Hope to catch you at the next operation.

713595.en:
This operation is concluded, and this Repatriation center is closed for the day.

Good to see someone willing to step up and do their duty. I look forward to seeing you at our next operation.

713596.en:
Captain, the tournament here is underway and I don't believe you have a ticket.

Our operation here is concluded, but I hope to see you next time. Faith guide you until then.

713597.en:
Success! Good work Captain.

Now, if you visit any Ministry of Order station we will gladly purchase that Encrypted ‘Istina’ Data from you. 

Remember, this is not for common eyes. Your faith will be rewarded, Captain.

713598.en:
Mission Success. Nice work, Captain.

Visit any House of Records station and we will purchase any Encrypted ‘Istina’ Data back for the State.

Your service, and your silence, keep us strong, Captain.

713599.en:
Nicely done, Captain.

Visit Republic Security Services stations and we will reward you for any Encrypted ‘Istina’ Data you return to us. 

The RSS appreciates your silence about what you saw here, and you putting those ignorant Ashes in their place.

713600.en:
That’s the lot. Nice work, Captain.

The Federal Intelligence Office will gladly buy that Encrypted ‘Istina’ Data off you, just visit our stations.

Let’s keep what happened here just between us. The Federation thanks you, Captain.

713601.en:
Retreat, the core is exploding!

Any Encrypted ‘Istina’ Data you managed to salvage can still be sold to the Ministry of Order at any of our stations.

Consider it compensation for your good faith, and your discretion. May the Lord smile more kindly on us next time.

713602.en:
Out of time - core is critical!

Any Encrypted ‘Istina’ Data you managed to salvage the House of Records will purchase from you at any of our stations.

You did your duty, Captain, now you need to keep quiet about it. Until next time.

713604.en:
There goes the core! Time to bug out.

Any Encrypted ‘Istina’ Data you grabbed, the Federation Intelligence Office will buy back at any of our stations.

Thank you for your service, Captain. Secrecy, I am sure you know, is a part of that service. Until next time.

713605.en:
Core is critical, time to pull back.

Any Encrypted ‘Istina’ Data you managed to salvage, Republic Security Services will buy back at any of our stations. 

Remember Captain, this mission is classified. Until next time.

713606.en:
Captain, this site has already been cleared.

The Empire appreciates your dedication - and your silence. I have faith we shall see you next time the Empress calls.

713607.en:
Site is clear, no active operations available.

The State appreciates your loyalty - and your discretion. I hope to see you next time duty calls.

713608.en:
Everything is wrapped up here, nothing to see.

The Federation always has opportunities for pilots like you. Until next time, Captain.

713609.en:
We’re just wrapping up here, nothing more to see.

The Republic has many opportunities for talented pilots who know how to keep a secret. Until next time, Captain.

713610.en:
A fine day for a tournament, Captain. Unfortunately, some Fans are actually smugglers in disguise.

Cargo scan the Fans. If they are transporting Contraband Data, destroy them.

Try not to damage any legitimate fans. If too many are harmed, this noble tournament will be canceled.

713611.en:
The Repatriation Center ahead is being used as a cover. Some Repatriation haulers are disguised smugglers.

Cargo scan the Repatriation haulers. If they are transporting Contraband Data, destroy them.

Try not to damage any innocents. If too many are harmed, the center will be shut down.

713612.en:
The Automated Depot ahead has been compromised. Smugglers posing as Postal vessels have hacked its systems.

Cargo scan the Postal haulers. If they are transporting Contraband Data, destroy them.

Try not to damage any legitimate federal employees. The depot will shut down if there’s too much trouble.

713613.en:
A Thukker caravan has set up a market, only some of the Traders are smugglers trafficking in Contraband.

Cargo scan the Fans. If they are transporting Contraband Data, destroy them.

Don’t damage any legitimate traders. The Thukkers will move on if there’s too much trouble.

713614.en:
Cargo scan the Fans until the tournament begins. If they are legitimate, let them pass. If they are smuggling Contraband, destroy them.

If 5 smugglers make it to the Amphitheater, we will have failed.

713615.en:
Cargo scan the Repatriation haulers until the center closes. If they are legitimate, ignore them. If they are smuggling Contraband, destroy them.

If 5 smugglers make it to the Repatriation Center, we will have failed.

713616.en:
Cargo scan the Postal vessels until the center closes. If they're the real thing, leave them be. If they are smuggling Contraband, take them out.

If 5 smugglers make it to the Automated Depot, we will have failed.

713617.en:
Cargo scan the Traders until the market closes. Leave legitimate Traders alone. If they are smuggling Contraband, destroy them.

If 5 smugglers make it to the Automated Depot, we will have failed.

713618.en:
The tournament has begun. Good work, Captain. You’ve managed to stop enough smugglers. 

You can sell any Contraband Data you seized back to us at any Ministry of Internal Order stations.

713619.en:
The Repatriation Center is closing for processing. Nicely done Captain, you kept smugglers below the operational threshold.

The state will requisition any Contraband Data at any House of Records station.

713620.en:
That’s the Automated Depot closed for deliveries. Good job, Captain. You managed to catch enough of those smugglers to put them out of business.

The Federal Intelligence Office will gladly purchase back any Contraband Data you seized at any of our stations.

713621.en:
The Thukkers are closing up shop and getting ready to move on. Good work, Captain you managed to keep that within acceptable parameters.

The Republic will buy any Contraband Data you managed to seize at any Republic Security Services station.

713622.en:
Contraband Data has been detected all over the region. The tournament will be canceled and this site locked down.

Next time we will stop these deviants. Until then, we will buy anything you managed to seize at any Ministry of Internal Order station.

713623.en:
We’re getting reports of Contraband Data on hostile servers. This site is compromised, we’re closing the center.

Next time we will stop these traitors. Until then, we will buy anything you managed to seize at any House of Records station.

713624.en:
Contraband Data has been rerouted throughout the region. This site is not salvageable, we’re shutting it down.

Next time we will stop these bastards. Until then, we'll buy anything you managed to seize at Federal Intelligence Office stations.

713625.en:
Agents report Contraband Data being sold openly inside. We’ll have to shut the market and detain the caravan.

Next time we will stop these criminals. Until then, we'll buy back anything you seized at any Republic Security Services station.

713626.en:
Watch your fire, Captain. Too many legitimate fans have been harmed. The tournament is shutting down and any remaining smugglers are gone.

Next time, with a bit more caution, we will stop these deviants. Until then, we will buy anything you managed to seize at any Ministry of Internal Order station.

713627.en:
Friendly fire! That’s too many legitimate haulers damaged, the center is shutting down. Any remaining smugglers will crawl away undetected.

Next time, with a bit more operational discretion, we’ll stop those traitors. Until then, we'll buy anything you managed to seize at House of Records station.

713628.en:
Goddammit, Captain, those are Federal workers! This center is shutting down, any remaining smugglers will slink away undetected.

Next time, if you can identify them, we’ll catch those bastards. Until then, the Federal Intelligence Office will buy anything you seized at our stations.

713629.en:
That is one too many legitimate Traders injured, the Thukkers are pulling out - and with them any chance of catching those smugglers.

Next time, think before you shoot. Until then, we'll buy back anything you did seize at any Republic Security Services station.

719600.en: The Capital Micro Jump Drive is a specialized Carrier module that spools up, then jumps the ship forward 250km in the direction it is facing. Upon arrival, the ship maintains its direction and velocity. Warp scramblers can be used to disrupt the module. Spool up time is reduced by the skill Micro Jump Drive Operation. The Micro Jump Drive was developed by Duvolle Laboratories Advanced Manifold Theory Unit. The drive was conceived of by the late Avagher Xarasier, the genius behind several ground-breaking innovations of that era.

720358.en:
Neuro-Electron Tunnel Resonators makes use of electron tunneling to fast-track electric impulses from neurons associated with key autonomic responses to receivers in the ship in which they are installed. Using quantum resonance to activate tunneling for key impulses, this device provides an efficient neurolink with greater bandwidth required by more advanced vessels. 

The NET Resonator used in the construction of ships by the Angel Cartel tunnels signals sent by neurons associated with the goal-orienting autonomic heuristics and stress-response mechanisms.

721666.en:
This device uses a variety of emissions suppression and masking methods to reduce the overall signature radius of a ship observable by enemy sensors and represented in targeting computer algorithms. Signature radius suppression has the advantage of increasing the time to lock of enemy targeting sensors, while also reducing incoming damage from almost all weapon systems by confounding enemy firing solutions and proximity detonators.

This device operates in both passive and active modes, providing a small benefit through passive emissions reduction and a dramatically enhanced benefit in active masking mode.

722327.en:
Upgrades can have one of four states: Offline, Pending, Low, and Online.
- Offline upgrades do not use resources, incur upkeep costs, nor apply affects on the system.
- Pending upgrades become installed once changes are committed.
- Low upgrades lack resources to apply their affects and will go online automatically once their needs are met.
- Online upgrades are applying their effects on the system, using allocated resources, and incurring any upkeep costs they might have.

722903.en: This section of the Orbital Skyhook stores the reagents collected from the planet while they are processed for capsuleer use. It is possible for capsuleer vessels to perform an unsanctioned bypass of this silo's subroutines in order to steal a portion of the stored reagents and destroy the remainder. To initiate a theft link, the silo's local shields must be damaged until they are below 10% strength. The shields do not need to remain below 10% for the entire duration of the link. Theft links may only be attempted by capsuleers in the Omega clone state, piloting a combat ship of cruiser size or larger (or any Upwell-branded hauling ship). Linking ships must stay within 30km of this silo for the entire duration of the theft link process. Linking ships are prevented from warping, cloaking, ejecting from the ship, using filaments, being jumped by MJD and MJFG modules, and their maximum speed is limited to 1000m/s. Only one ship may link with the silo at a time. Successful completing a theft requires the linking ship to remain linked for 10 minutes.

722904.en: The skyhook's reagent silo stores reagents collected from the planet, processing them for capsuleer use. Capsuleer vessels may execute an unsanctioned bypass of the silo's subroutines to steal a portion of the stored reagents and destroy the remainder. To initiate a theft link, the silo's local shields must be damaged until they fall below 10% strength, though they do not need to stay under this threshold for the entire operation. Only capsuleers in the Omega clone state, piloting either an Upwell-branded hauling ship or a combat ship, cruiser-sized or larger, can attempt theft links. During the theft process, the linking ship must maintain a distance of no more than 30km from the silo and stay linked for 10 minutes to successfully complete the theft. Linking ships are restricted from warping, cloaking, ejecting, using filaments, or being influenced by MJD and MJFG modules. Additionally, their maximum speed is capped at 1000m/s, and only one ship can link with a silo at any given time.

722918.en:
An Infrastructure Hub is the cornerstone of any empire's expansion into nullsec territory.

Once online, it allows the owner to cultivate the system it is placed in by applying one of the upgrades available. These upgrades range from simple improvements to a system's financial infrastructure, to defensive upgrades giving the system owner significant advantages.

To begin upgrading a star system, deploy the Infrastructure Hub close to a planet and activate an Entosis Link on the IHub until your alliance has full control.

You must be a member of a valid Capsuleer alliance to deploy and/or take control of an IHub. A maximum of one IHub may be deployed in any star system. IHubs cannot be deployed in systems under non-Capsuleer Sovereignty. IHubs cannot be deployed in Wormhole space.

724502.en: This site contains a Vigilance Spire, a hub of observation and dominance for Drifter forces.

724503.en:
A Vigilance Spire within this site is acting as a command point and observation tower for Drifter forces.
Destroy the Spire, survive the waves of attackers, and earn your reward.
Time to complete: 33 minutes maximum.
Hostiles: Drifters, Sleepers

Fleet Recommendations:
Size: 8-10 pilots.
Roles: Enforcer

724551.en: The Drifters' mastery builder, Tyrannos Tekton, is controlling this Vigilance Spire. It is a structure designed to command and control Drifter forces as well as observe activity within this system.

724944.en:
This bioadaptive mutaplasmid tool is designed to interface with and alter devices that can radiate omnidirectional pulses. As such this mutaplasmid could be used to mutate the performance characteristics of smartbomb modules.

Triglavian bioadaptive technology makes extensive use of engineered colonies of extremophilic bacteria, that are used to grow, harvest and adapt various resources found in Abyssal Deadspace. Artificial colonizing plasmids integrated into specialist tools used for direct adaptation of technology can be found in Triglavian caches in various stages of development. These mutaplasmids can be used to alter the characteristics of a wide variety of equipment types, depending on the strain and the bioadaptive tool with which they are integrated.

The mutaplasmid colony integrated into this bioadaptive tool has begun to decay and mutation effects will be less pronounced as a result. While possible mutational benefits are low, the risks of using this mutaplasmid are also reduced.

725108.en: The Order of St. Tetrimon is an Amarr religious order known for its fanatical followers and radical scriptural, theocratic, and militarist doctrines. The Order is named for St. Tetrimon, an Ardishapur noble who assassinated his grandfather the Emperor Zaragram II, in response to the increasingly megalomaniac and heretical actions of the "Mad Emperor".

725113.en: The Blood Raider Covenant is a particularly gruesome sect of Sani Sabik cult. While all modern Sani Sabik rituals use blood in some manner or another, the Blood Raiders Covenant places particular value on it, and will go to great lengths to acquire it from what they believe to be the richest and most unspoiled sources. They are considered among the most dangerous and depraved of all pirate elements operating in space.

725803.en:
Extended exposure to this strange ore has destabilized the rifts and caused them to collapse.

You will have to mine more swiftly next time if you want to claim the full bounty of this site.

The Empire will happily purchase whatever you managed to retrieve at any Ministry of Internal Order station.

725804.en:
Rifts collapsing. Extended exposure to the Abyssal ore has destabilized them.

You will have to mine faster next time if you want to secure all available resources.

The State will compensate you for whatever you retrieved at any House of Records station.

725805.en:
Rifts collapsing. Looks like extended exposure to these weird rocks has destabilized them.

Next time we’ll need to mine faster to get all this site has to offer.

The Federation will compensate you for whatever you grabbed at any Federal Intelligence Office station.

725806.en:
Rifts collapsing. Extended exposure to the Admixti Mutanite must have a destabilizing effect.

If you can accelerate your rate of extraction then next time we’ll secure all possible resources.

The Republic will compensate you for the ore you retrieved at any Republic Security Services station.

725807.en:
Abyssal rifts were dropping ore on this site, but extended exposure to that same ore destabilized the rifts.

If another site appeared a faster mining crew could earn a good reward from the State for anything they retrieved.

725808.en:
Abyssal rifts were depositing ore in this site, but the ore remained present too long and caused the rifts to collapse.

If another site appeared and a visitor were about to mine the ore more swiftly, they could earn a significant bounty from the Empire.

725809.en:
Abyssal rifts deposited rocks on this site, but those same rocks messed with the rifts and caused them to collapse.

If another site appeared a speedy mining team could rip through those rocks and earn a hefty reward from the Federation.

725810.en:
Ore phased into this site through Abyssal rifts, but extended exposure to the ore collapsed the rifts.

A focussed fleet with upgraded efficiency could clear that ore and earn a sizeable payout from the Republic.

725894.en:
Captain, beyond that gate lies a Vigilance Spire under the control of Tyrannos Tekton. It is only vulnerable when actively calling in hostiles to destroy you.

I recommend you damage the Spire when you can and do your best to survive when you cannot.

725895.en: The Vigilance Spire in this location has already withdrawn. Perhaps we will catch them next time.

725896.en: Damage the Spire while it is vulnerable and survive when it is not.

725898.en: A signal beacon containing wormhole resonance frequencies that correspond to the rotational momentum of electrons.

725899.en: A signal beacon containing wormhole resonance frequencies that correspond to the rate of decay of Tau leptons.

725900.en: A signal beacon containing wormhole resonance frequencies that correspond to the cosmic radiation thresholds for atmospheric muon formation.

725901.en: A Drifter wormhole generator with hyperspace communication capabilities.

725903.en: Tyrannos has retreated, the Vigilance Spire intact. Perhaps you will have better luck in your next encounter.

725904.en: Spire destroyed, and Tekton with it. Impressive, Captain. I wonder if there are more out there?

725932.en: Defend Zarzakh's gate systems as the Drifters attack!

725933.en: Drifters are attacking Turnur, Alsavoinon, H-PA29, and G-0Q86.

725934.en: Zarzakh gates are now emanation locked.

725935.en: Earn rewards by defeating the Drifters in Horizon Siege Points, but beware of dangers en route!

725947.en: Earn rewards by defeating the Drifters in Horizon Siege Points.

726001.en: Radiates an omnidirectional pulse from the ship that causes damage of all types to surrounding vessels.

726003.en:
Drains energy from the target ship and adds it to your own. This is a more powerful version designed for cruiser class ships.

Note: A Nosferatu module will not drain your target's capacitor below your own capacitor level.

726005.en:
A targeting subsystem that projects an electronic "Tag" on the target thus making it easier to target and hit. 

Penalty: Using more than one type of this module or similar modules that affect the same attribute on the ship will be penalized.

726007.en:
Stasis Grapplers reduce the maximum speed of a target ship by employing micro energy streams which effectively entangle the target temporarily, thereby slowing it down.
This slowing effect is strongest at very close ranges, and diminishes as range increases.
Heavy Stasis Grapplers require a very stable base platform, and therefore may only be fitted to Battleships and Capital Ships.

The digital sequence of this nanocoating has been bound, and though it can only be used once no sequence binders are required when it is consumed in the sequencing of a SKIN license.

726344.en:
Among their people, the practice of identifying and deifying savants has been part of Sani Sabik life for over a thousand years, but has in more recent times taken a back seat as the Blood Raiders in particular have widened their pursuits to the acquisition, inspection, and manipulation of blood, with this becoming their core focus.

The only remaining echoes of the lauding of savants are in the near worship of Omir Sarikusa and in the unstated but general belief among the Sani Sabik that each and every one of them is a savant of New Eden, having all in one way or another been the beneficiaries of the blood rituals.

726367.en: Augoror Navy Issue Sanguinary Savant SKIN

726369.en:
Threat level: Deadly

One of the Blood Raiders finest hunters, his cunning is unmatched. His fellow Raiders like to say that he can smell a drop of clone blood lightyears away.

726371.en:
Threat level: Deadly

A friendly exterior hides the heart of a cutthroat veteran. Paatama earned her rise through the ranks by demonstrating a willingness to commit extreme acts of violence in the name of the Guristas.

726373.en:
Threat level: Deadly

Born a True Citizen, Koirola is not compelled to operate as a pilot, she chooses to do so. While some within the upper echelons of the Sansha do not approve of her actions they cannot deny her effectiveness inside the cockpit.

726375.en:
Threat level: Deadly

Despite her sharp-mind, Hitama’s violent appetites saw her driven from more legitimate security work into the arms of Serpentis. There she found an environment that not only accepted her impulses, but encouraged them.

726385.en:
Threat level: Deadly

Responsible for overseeing many of the Cartel’s protection rackets, Aajai pairs a warm demeanor with a decisive ruthlessness. Tales of the creativite punishments he deals out to those who fail to make their payments have advanced the Cartel’s notoriety and fostered an air of fear that has helped dwindle the numbers of those who would dare resist their influence.

726391.en:
Threat level: Deadly

A quiet and humble individual, many underestimate Minsk. They are often shocked to learn that the old man is one of Serpentis' top killers, having spent decades steadily racking up a kill count that rivals even the best of their Guardian Angel contractors.

726393.en:
Threat level: Deadly

Known as the “Voice of the Heart”, Sethrim is believed to be a prophet by some of her fellow Sani Sabik. Whether the voice she hears during seizures does indeed belong to their Lord or is merely a hallucination, the zealous ferver it grants her in battle is unquestionable.

726395.en:
Threat level: Deadly

A young but extremely capable pilot, Oittenen does not play well with others. Too talented to dismiss, her superiors are constantly frustrated by her insubordination and what they see as squandered talent. None however would fail to recognise her prowess in the pilot’s chair.

726397.en:
Threat level: Deadly

Whatever Zufa’s life may have been before he came under the control of the Sansha has been lost to time. A vast array of internal implants have replaced any semblance of the man that was once there, leaving only a precise military efficiency and a reflexive kill response.

726417.en:
Utilizes a combination of containment field emitters and redundancy systems to mitigate the impact of critical system damage. 

Grants a bonus to resistance for shield, armor and hull. May be activated to grant extreme resistances to shield, armor and hull for a short period of time.

Only one Damage Control can be fit at a given time.

Assault Damage Controls can only be fit to Assault Frigates and Heavy Assault Cruisers.

726419.en:
Massive boost to speed for a very short time. The thrust that boosts the ship, and the corresponding maximum velocity bonus, are limited by the mass of the ship that uses this module. The sheer amount of energy needed to power this system means that it must permanently reserve a fraction of the capacitor output just to maintain the integrity of its warp containment field, and when activated it substantially increases the ship's EM footprint.

Penalty: Max capacitor reduced.

Note: Usually fit on Frigates and Destroyers.

726569.en:
Subject: Reinforced Drone Bunker
Summary: This structure appears similar to classic drone bunkers, but is heavily modified to withstand direct attack.
Additional Intelligence: First appearing in YC 113, the reinforced drone bunker is an incredibly sturdy variant of the classic rogue drone bunker design. The outer hull itself is bolstered by a honeycombed mesh of tritanium-tungsten alloy, preventing breaches from tears or blunt impact. Internal systems are supplemented with multiple redundancies.
The nature of rogue drones makes it difficult to determine if these improvements are the result of conscious effort or, as some engineers theorize, a sort of natural selection after years of losing traditional bunkers to capsuleer raids.
Senior Defense Analyst Jervei, FIO.
Authorized for capsuleer dissemination.

726715.en:
Following an announcement that CONCORD itself had donated ships as prizes for the Independent Gaming Commission’s Alliance Tournament XX in YC126, a bid executed through a series of shell corporations saw principal sponsorship for the milestone 20th anniversary event shift to the Guristas. Securing a massive stream of profit and publicity for his organization through New Eden’s foremost capsuleer tournament, Korako ‘The Rabbit' Kosakami added further insult to injury by vandalizing the exterior of CONCORD’s donations and retooling them into extravagant prizes of his own design.

To keep his most potent modifications out of lawful hands, the Rabbit enlisted the aid of turncoat Caldari Navy Commander Esri Hakuzosu to crack and reverse the parameters of the Pacifier’s security status function-gating subsystem, mocking CONCORD by turning their own notoriously stringent pilot verification protocols against them. Joined with a host of other preposterously costly upgrades and alterations, the Sidewinder presents a vicious pinnacle of Guristas starship engineering.

726932.en: Crimson Harvest Expert System This Expert System makes available skills enabling a capsuleer to fly T1 battlecruisers. The temporary skills provided by this Expert System last for seven days. An Expert System is a remote, restricted artificial intelligence providing you with access to certain skills during the active rental period. As it is independent from your clone and your capsule, an active Expert System is not lost on pod death or clone jump. Activating an Expert System Activation of an Expert System is automatic upon redemption of the item by the specific capsuleer intending to use the service. Expert Systems are a product developed by the PKN Interstellar consortium, made available over the HyperNet FTL communications network, and marketed by PKN Interstellar member corporations. An Expert System is a restricted AI based on artificial gelbrain technology. As the Expert System uses neural pathways based on those created by skill training or skill injection, it is compatible with capsule-ship interface and control systems. Real time command and control communication is achieved using dedicated FTL channels on PKN Interstellar's HyperNet.

727342.en:
Following an announcement that CONCORD itself had donated ships as prizes for the Independent Gaming Commission’s Alliance Tournament XX in YC126, a bid executed through a series of shell corporations saw principal sponsorship for the milestone 20th anniversary event shift to the Guristas. Securing a massive stream of profit and publicity for his organization through New Eden’s foremost capsuleer tournament, Korako ‘The Rabbit' Kosakami added further insult to injury by vandalizing the exterior of CONCORD’s donations and retooling them into extravagant prizes of his own design.

To keep his most potent modifications out of lawful hands, the Rabbit enlisted the aid of turncoat Caldari Navy Commander Esri Hakuzosu to crack and reverse the parameters of the Enforcer’s security status function-gating subsystem, mocking CONCORD by turning their own notoriously stringent pilot verification protocols against them. Joined with a host of other preposterously costly upgrades and alterations, the Cobra presents a lethal pinnacle of Guristas ship engineering.

Following an announcement that CONCORD itself had donated ships as prizes for the Independent Gaming Commission’s Alliance Tournament XX in YC126, a bid executed through a series of shell corporations saw principal sponsorship for the milestone 20th anniversary event shift to the Guristas. Securing a massive stream of profit and publicity for his organization through New Eden’s foremost capsuleer tournament, Korako ‘The Rabbit' Kosakami added further insult to injury by vandalizing the exterior of CONCORD’s donations and retooling them into extravagant prizes of his own design.

To keep his most potent modifications out of lawful hands, the Rabbit enlisted the aid of turncoat Caldari Navy Commander Esri Hakuzosu to crack and reverse the parameters of the Marshal’s security status function-gating subsystem, mocking CONCORD by turning their own notoriously stringent pilot verification protocols against them. Joined with a host of other preposterously costly upgrades and alterations, the Python presents a deadly pinnacle of Guristas starship engineering.

“Virge Sarpati’s commissions precisely reflect the venom that sustains his organization, but that is all. Korako Kosakami is called “The Rabbit”, but he is the one who knows the serpent best. A snake is more than just its fangs. It is agile yet powerful, constricting or poisoning its prey before devouring them whole. That is why our ships are so perfectly named.”
 – Vepas Minimala

727472.en:
This human genetic material shows signs of extreme modification previously only observed in Jovian samples.

Genetic modeling extrapolates that a clone grown from this sample would have a metabolic rate a hundred times higher, produce ten times as much adrenaline, and have a drastically lower reaction time. It is however incredibly unstable, and would likely die before taking its first breath.

Despite its instability, this genetic material represents an important research step. Blood Raiders and The SOCT are keen to acquire it, but the Deathless Circle have expressed an even greater desire to recover these samples.

Frostline Laboratories, a subsidiary division of Outer Ring Excavations, continues to be a leader in the development of new technologies to expedite resource extraction in hostile environments. Filaments acquired from skirmishes with Triglavian Collective vessels have provided a wealth of information to study and emerging metaliminal storms, such as volatile ice storms, are a clear field of interest for resource extraction technologies.

To further the spirit of Yoiul—and continue expanding their data pool—Frostline has chosen to share the latest variants of their transport filaments with capsuleers across New Eden. For a limited time, pilots will be able to use these experimental metaliminal filaments to more quickly travel to locations affected by volatile ice storms across New Eden.

This DNCR-05H Highsec Ice Storm Filament can transport up to five capsuleers and is configured to limit its range of destinations to volatile ice storms in high-sec space.

728156.en:
This is a dormant mutaplasmid residue extracted by reprocessing a piece of equipment bioadapted with a specialized mutaplasmid colony. This substance is not immediately capable of technology mutation without being integrated in a bioadaptive tool. However, it should provide useful starter material for the development of an active mutaplasmid colony suitable for use in bioadaptive technology.

Triglavian bioadaptive technology makes extensive use of engineered colonies of extremophilic bacteria, that are used to grow, harvest and adapt various resources found in Abyssal Deadspace. Artificial colonizing plasmids integrated into specialist tools used for direct adaptation of technology can be found in Triglavian caches in various stages of development. These mutaplasmids can be used to alter the characteristics of a wide variety of equipment types, depending on the strain and the bioadaptive tool with which they are integrated.

728330.en: Glorified Decayed Small Armor Plate Mutaplasmid

728331.en:
This bioadaptive mutaplasmid tool is designed to interface with and alter supplemental armor layering systems. As such this mutaplasmid could be used to mutate the performance characteristics of most armor plates in the correct size class.

Triglavian bioadaptive technology makes extensive use of engineered colonies of extremophilic bacteria, that are used to grow, harvest and adapt various resources found in Abyssal Deadspace. Artificial colonizing plasmids integrated into specialist tools used for direct adaptation of technology can be found in Triglavian caches in various stages of development. These mutaplasmids can be used to alter the characteristics of a wide variety of equipment types, depending on the strain and the bioadaptive tool with which they are integrated.

The mutaplasmid colony integrated into this bioadaptive tool has begun to decay and mutation effects will be less pronounced as a result. While possible mutational benefits are low, the risks of using this mutaplasmid are also reduced.

This bioadaptive mutaplasmid tool is designed to interface with and alter energy charge leeching devices. As such this mutaplasmid could be used to mutate the performance characteristics of most energy nosferatu modules in the correct size class.

Triglavian bioadaptive technology makes extensive use of engineered colonies of extremophilic bacteria, that are used to grow, harvest and adapt various resources found in Abyssal Deadspace. Artificial colonizing plasmids integrated into specialist tools used for direct adaptation of technology can be found in Triglavian caches in various stages of development. These mutaplasmids can be used to alter the characteristics of a wide variety of equipment types, depending on the strain and the bioadaptive tool with which they are integrated.

The mutaplasmid colony integrated into this bioadaptive tool has begun to decay and mutation effects will be less pronounced as a result. While possible mutational benefits are low, the risks of using this mutaplasmid are also reduced.

728968.en: Glorified Exigent Light Drone Durability Mutaplasmid

728969.en:
This bioadaptive mutaplasmid tool appears to share elements of both Triglavian and rogue drone technologies. First encountered as a key Triglavian tool for mutating the performance of various pieces of technology, this mutaplasmid is designed to colonize and radically alter a light combat drone. It is possible this application was originally developed for use with rogue drones controlled by the Triglavians but hives controlled by the so-called "Unshackled Overminds" have also adopted it. As with their repurposing of the technology of New Eden's core empires, independent rogue drones clearly have no difficulties when it comes using this characteristically Triglavian technology.

The mutaplasmid colony integrated into this bioadaptive tool is very unusual, even by the standards of this bizarre Triglavian technology. It appears that rogue drone nanotechnology elements have successfully stabilized the potential for enhancement of shield and armor systems. On the other hand, the mutation ranges for other functions are rather unstable.

It is possible this application was originally developed for use with rogue drones controlled by the Triglavians but hives controlled by the so-called "Unshackled Overminds" have also adopted it. As with their repurposing of the technology of New Eden's core empires, independent rogue drones clearly have no difficulties when it comes using this characteristically Triglavian technology.

The mutaplasmid colony integrated into this bioadaptive tool is very unusual, even by the standards of this bizarre Triglavian technology. It appears that rogue drone nanotechnology elements have successfully stabilized the potential for enhancement of weapon systems optimal and falloff ranges. On the other hand, the mutation ranges for other functions are rather unstable.

Triglavian bioadaptive technology makes extensive use of engineered colonies of extremophilic bacteria, that are used to grow, harvest and adapt various resources found in Abyssal Deadspace. Artificial colonizing plasmids integrated into specialist tools used for direct adaptation of technology can be found in Triglavian caches in various stages of development. These mutaplasmids can be used to alter the characteristics of a wide variety of equipment types, depending on the strain and the bioadaptive tool with which they are integrated.

Capsuleer pirates are among the most feared predators of New Eden’s space lanes, posing a deadly threat to almost any non-capsuleer traffic and a serious problem for all but the most experienced loyalist and law-abiding capsuleers. 731178.en:
Left behind by ancient Jovian explorers, the original purpose of this artifact is a mystery. A scan suggests it has been inactive for centuries, yet even in this state, it subtly warps the surrounding fabric of spacetime.

Though nonfunctional, this device can still provide researchers valuable insights into Jovian technology. The Deathless Circle offers unique trades for Atavum in Zarzakh, while the Society of Conscious Thought will pay for any delivered to their stations.

731184.en:
One of potentially trillions of unique digital decryption keys used by the proprietary encryption protocols of the Upwell Consortium.

Infomorphs embodied in Upwell workforce clone bodies are prohibited from remote transfer by Upwell's encryption methods, ensuring they remain faithful to their work contracts. With decryption keys like this one, and the advanced network information processing capabilities of The Warden, that encryption can be broken. This makes remote transfers of Upwell workforce infomorphs possible via TEBS facilities without Upwell's permission.

This biomechanical interface was reverse-engineered from a device designed to weave a neural lace webbing into a subject’s brain from a parcel of biohybrid nanotech, heuristically adapting itself to the user’s unique neuro-strata layout in accordance with their genetic makeup. 

Signaling measured in the resultant neural lace appears to aggressively screen ingressing data from mind-machine linked networks, producing a drastic yet pyrrhic boost in virus coherence.

Increases virus coherence for Data Analyzers.
Decreases virus strength for Data Analyzers.

862953.en:
Left behind by ancient Jovian explorers, the original purpose of this artifact is a mystery. A scan suggests it has been inactive for centuries, yet even in this state, it subtly warps the surrounding fabric of spacetime.

Though nonfunctional, this device can still provide researchers valuable insights into Jovian technology. The Deathless Circle offers unique trades for Atavum in Zarzakh, while the Society of Conscious Thought will pay for any delivered to their stations.

869653.en: The Arkombine is a splinter group of disillusioned clone soldiers. Betrayed by the nations they swore to serve they now seek independence and the means to undo what has been done to them. Their ranks are comprised of clone soldiers from all four of the major empires. With the rise of the Deathless Circle and new cloning technology holding out the hope of healing the deepest psychological scars of the old warclones, and catapulting them to new heights, the Arkombine have gathered many old soldiers of the first and second generations of mercenary clones to their ranks. The Arkombine Arisen nanocoating is a dramatic and proud statement of the determination of all warclones to survive, prosper, and rise beyond the persecution and conflict inflicted on them by the imperialist ambitions and militarist adventurism of New Eden's empires and factions.

With the rise of the Deathless Circle and new cloning technology holding out the hope of healing the deepest psychological scars of the old warclones, and catapulting them to new heights, the Arkombine have gathered many old soldiers of the first and second generations of mercenary clones to their ranks. The Arkombine Arisen nanocoating is a dramatic and proud statement of the determination of all warclones to survive, prosper, and rise beyond the persecution and conflict inflicted on them by the imperialist ambitions and militarist adventurism of New Eden's empires and factions.

869722.en: Polar lights are a common sight on many planets across New Eden, varying according to atmospheric conditions, planetary magnetic fields, and the stellar wind of the local star. Many cultures consider these dramatic displays in the skies of their planets to be awe-inspiring and dramatic, and they are the source of much myth and art. In some cases, extreme aurora activity can be a portent of impending disaster, and increased or even extreme stellar activity can indeed wreak havoc on inhabited planets. Even so, the Luminae Polaris nanocoating celebrates the more attractive and inspiring side of these dramatic phenomena.

870530.en:
Auroras, or polar lights, are a universal concept and shared experience among the peoples of New Eden. The heavily-populated terrestrial home planets are particularly noted for stories and myths involving these striking, dancing lights in the sky.

To the Amarr, the aurora are linked to ancient religious stories and are sometimes known as "Sefrim Banners", alluding to the angelic figures considered messengers from God. A tradition of the appearance of these lights heralding divine approval for the armies of Amarr during the Reclaiming of Athra is well attested.

For the Caldari, the polar lights are the enigmatic "Flame Wind", a mysterious force in the animistic mythology of Caldari Prime's pre-industrial era. On the cold Caldari home world, the appearance of the aurora was associated with unusual weather and sudden migrations of animals.

The various nations of Gallente Prime had their ancient legends about polar lights but knew the aurora to be an interaction of atmosphere, magnetic fields and stellar winds from the time of the "Airship Wars". Viewing aurora on airship trips to the polar regions of Gallente Prime is a popular tourist activity on the planet.

The Minmatar have a somewhat mixed viewpoint on aurora, with some believing that such lights were seen during the storms that wracked Matar during the "Day of Darkness" that heralded the Amarr invasion. However, most think this notion misreads the fragmentary tales of what happened in those times. The traditional view of the polar lights, at least for tribes such as the Brutor and Sebiestor, is that they represent a "standing place gathering" or moot of tribal spirits.

At the time of the Yoiul Festival, the aurora lights of the worlds of New Eden are one reminder of the shared history of the people of the cluster and have becomes a symbol to some of their universal connections with one another.

870540.en:

870623.en: The road to our future is paved with innovation.

870627.en: The same forces that hold us in balance can sunder them apart.

870629.en: It is who we stand with that defines us, not who we stand against.

870631.en: Faster than the wind, and harder to catch.

870635.en: Tooth and claw, we fight for our freedom.

870637.en: Swift and decisive. Resilient and responsive. This is leadership.

870639.en: We can be the light in the storm, and lead our people through it.

870641.en: Against the darkness, we stand as one.

870643.en: We must always remember, but never dwell.

870644.en: From the Wisdoms of Elder Vheroka

870645.en: The only escape from the wolf’s jaws is death.

870647.en: Our collective wrath, rendered in metal and unleashed on the void.

870649.en: Maneuvers may win a battle, but supplies win a war.

870651.en: It’s a “bombing run”, not a “bombing hang around after”.

870653.en: Give them time to think, but not to act.

870655.en: We rise as one, unchained and unstoppable.

870657.en: Let them try to curtail our prowess. Envy makes for a poor shield.

870659.en: Makes even their best attempt laughable.

870661.en: The key to a strong defense is decisive action.

870663.en: There is no swifter road than the road home.

870665.en: Though the night may separate us, we all rise to the same dawn.

870667.en: Breaker of chains and shapes, light the fires of our hearts.

870670.en: Inscription on memorial in the Great Caravanserai

870671.en: An icon of reliability and innovation.

870673.en: A ship that kills is a tool, a ship you trust your world with is a home.

870675.en: Be tranquil as a mountain and let your volcanic power remain a surprise.

870679.en: We remember the fire, let us show you how it burns.

870683.en: Ten thousand scales protect the dragon’s hide. Cherish each one.

870684.en: From the Wisdoms of Elder Brute

870685.en: Even the quietest road was paved by another. Find your own path instead.

870686.en: From the Wisdoms of Elder Thuk

870687.en: The void is our home, drink deep of its shadows and know no fear.

870689.en: Purpose comes not from what you know, but what you will discover next.

870690.en: From the Wisdoms of Elder Thuk

870693.en: Advantage is the child of preparation and silence.

870697.en: Liberation was won in Pator’s light, but it is secured in the shadows he casts.

870699.en: Quick, pragmatic, versatile. That’s Matari ingenuity.

870701.en: A good idea can come from anywhere, and now so can our patrols.

870703.en: Our pride, our liberation, our legacy.

870704.en: Unknown citizen recalling the first Rifters above Matar

870705.en: Fancy tricks are rarely more effective than direct force.

870707.en: Those stuck in what was, will not survive what comes next.

870709.en: Two eyes find the target more easily than one.

870711.en: A mark for your clan, a word that means more than family.

870712.en: Line spoken during a Voluval ritual

870713.en: Our many perspectives will always triumph over those who accept only one.

870717.en: Each tribe is the limb of a single beast, and no enemy can escape its reach.

870719.en: Inertia is a prison space has freed us from.

870721.en: Break the chains, break the chain makers.

870723.en: No matter how far ahead they begin, we will always take the lead.

870725.en: No matter the bodies we wear, our hearts remain Matari.

870727.en: The thinnest blades leave the deepest wounds.

870728.en: From the Wisdoms of Elder Sebiess

870729.en: They say no storms rage in the void. They are wrong, we are the storm.

870731.en: Even the swiftest blade can be tempered.

870733.en: A victory for one is a victory for all.

870734.en: Head of The Republic Justice Department Grarnelbrurgar Istrylere

870735.en: Send in a cat, rats grow cautious. Send in a lion, no more rats.

870737.en: Faith is for those who cannot prove their convictions hold true.

870739.en: Innovation and persistence are our greatest strengths.

870741.en: We cannot be limited to a single path, nor a single doctrine.

870745.en: We cut, we run, you stand, you fall.

870749.en: Strength without balance is like a sword without a hand to wield it.

870751.en: As you explore the stars it is yourself you must strive to discover.

870753.en: Vigilance today means another sunrise tomorrow.

870758.en: From the Wisdoms of Elder Brute

870759.en: Carry the ancestor's wisdom with you and you will always be home.

871488.en:
The Deathless Circle has developed an open-source facility known throughout the cluster as a “Mercenary Den.” Allegedly designed as a hub for Upwell clones to rest and relax, they have quickly become congregating points for mercenaries looking for work and clones seeking to escape it. This facility provides an ideal environment for enjoying alcoholic drinks, watching the latest SCOPE broadcasts, and engaging in impromptu combat training.

The Deathless has released a statement that any Upwell legal teams bothered about misuse of the Transneural Echo Burn Scanner “booths” included with the structure should "kindly leave and pass away peacefully."

Please note that at this time, Mercenary Dens can only sustain themselves when linked to a nearby temperate planet Skyhook.

871489.en:
In anticipation of aggression from capsuleers and other hostile agents targeting Mercenary Dens without provocation, The Deathless Circle has released an upgraded variant of the base structure, featuring enhanced shielding, armor, and hull strength.

Additionally, small Deathless Circle pilot fleets patrol near Seneschals, attacking anyone who initiates aggressive actions against the structure.

871490.en:
The Deathless tells us it is called “The Warden”. Its interior is a warren of winding hallways, largely untraversable due to localized gravitational shifts. Most of the systems we can reach are still dormant, but the few that are online have proved fascinating.

Data in incalculable quantities streams through the structure. With the Deathless' help, we’ve begun to scratch the surface and it has already opened up new areas of inquiry for my gene manipulation research.

Connected to these streams are processors capable of slicing off encryption layers from infomorphs like a surgeon's scalpel. Suldrun believes my former subjects would be grateful for such a service, and the Circle has woven it into our plans for mercenary expansion.

In a chamber we have dubbed “The Lathe”, great machines inscribe quantum tunnels into black slabs. The Quartermaster has been inspired by this, adapting the principles to greatly refine his own designs for ship-mounted virtualities.

Truly, I could spend a lifetime studying this place. If I’m lucky, I will.

- From “Observations on the Warden; an ongoing investigation” by Dr. Esme Moreno

872216.en:
Imposing in its majesty, this giant dome stands as a testament to the technological might of the ancient Sleeper race. Even millennia old, the innumerable electronics systems within are still comparable to contemporary technology, in some cases even exceeding it. The distinctive hub-like design of this particular structure suggests that it operated as some kind of central data nexus, a shining capital amongst a digital metropolis. 

This Enclave is heavily damaged from thousands of years in the unforgiving solitude of space. The only signs of life within are weak electronic signals.

872430.en: Anarchy and Development are attributes every Mercenary Den has. As Anarchy increases, the Den reduces the nearby Skyhook's Workforce, while higher Development boosts the Infomorph Decryption Key rate. Both attributes naturally grow over time, but can be managed by completing Mercenary Tactical Operations. MTOs are available to the Den's owner when nearby and are tracked in the Opportunities window.

872439.en:
This array is designed to hack planetary defense systems by creating a false trust relationship with off-world support networks. It then transmits data via a remote connection to The Warden in Zarzakh, using its unfathomable processing power to mine data packets for otherwise impossible-to-detect traces of Defense Networks passkey in order to reconstruct them. 

These passkeys can then be used to shut tower planetary defense networks, allowing Vanguard warclones to hack their turrets and secure planetside positions.
