1008256.en:
An Amarr Navy Bane class Lancer Dreadnought. 

Part of local holders' joint armada, this ship has been tasked with the defense of the faithful against the Drifter blight.

1008258.en:
A Federation Navy Hubris class Lancer Dreadnought. 

A Federation military asset assigned to augment District security forces in the protection of their citizens from Drifter attacks.

1008260.en:
A Caldari Navy Karura class Lancer Dreadnought. 

This vessel has been tasked with rapid response to Drifter threats, and is onsite to protect the State, its people, and its megacorporations' assets.

1008269.en:
Captain. Ahead, one of our Research Outposts is under attack via the very Wormholes it is investigating.

Are you here to help? Protect the outpost you will receive a generous reward. If you are here instead for the valuable Hyperspace Telemetry it generates we will give you nothing.

1008270.en:
This operation is complete, but there will be others. 

I hope you will be there to aid us the next time the Circle calls.

1008271.en:
The Outpost has been destroyed. Did you fail, or are you determined to undermine the Circle? 

Either way, Bring that Hyperspace Telemetry to us and not the misguided Society or their Genolution.

1008272.en: Well done, Captain. The Outpost is secure. The Circle sends its thanks and your compensation.

1008273.en:
An Unmoored Jovian Observatory has emerged up ahead. Drifters have secured the site, the wrong move could trigger a Lockdown.

Avoid security systems and use a Relic Analyzer to retrieve artifacts from Drifter Collections.

1008274.en: The operation ahead has already concluded. The State appreciates your dedication to your duty nonetheless, Captain. As long as this Crisis continues we'll need pilots like you.

1008275.en:
We’re too late. The countdown has completed and all Drifter Collections have detonated.

Anything you did manage to collect the House of Records will gladly purchase from you. Next time, they shall not be so lucky.

1008355.en:
Through this gate, an Unmoored Jovian Observatory has emerged. The site is contaminated with Drifter devices, any missteps will trigger a Lockdown.

Steer clear of their traps and use a Relic Analyzer to retrieve their plunder from Drifter Collections.

1008356.en: This operation is already over. Yet, the Empress always has need of capable pilots. I pray we will see you at our next endeavor.

1008357.en:
Curses, the timer has completed. All Drifter Collections have been destroyed by the enemy.

Whatever you did manage to gather, the Ministry of Internal Order will gladly procure. Until next time, Captain.

1008358.en:
Captain, through that gate a Destructive Scrutinizer is tormenting those inside a Megacorp Exchange. A Response Karura has been dispatched, but Drifter-controlled Sleeper drones have drained its capacitor.

Support the Karura in shutting down this dishonorable display before our Exchange is destroyed.

1008359.en:
This operation has concluded, Captain.

The Crisis still rages on, however. I hope we can count on your strength elsewhere.

1008360.en:
It is over Captain, the Scrutinizer has finished destroying our Exchange and made itself practically invulnerable.

The battle is lost, but the war rages on. I hope you will be by our side to fight it.

1008361.en:
Heresy! A Destructive Scrutinizer is torturing the innocents within a Secluded Monastery. A Response Bane is providing aid, but Drifter-controlled Sleeper Drones have drained its capacitor.

Support the Bane in ending this blasphemy before the Monastery is destroyed.

1008362.en:
The events beyond this gate have already reached their conclusion.

Elsewhere the Drifter Crisis continues. I hope the Lord will guide you to our next operation.

1008363.en:
Tragedy! Our Monastery burns, and with its foul work complete the Scrutinizer has made itself practically invulnerable.

Do not lose faith, Captain. Next time we will make these abominations pay.

1008364.en:
Captain, a District Office is under attack by a Destructive Scrutinizer. The workers inside will be tortured to death unless you intervene. A Response Hubris is onsite, but it's been cap-drained by Drifter-controlled Sleeper drones.

Support the Hubris and free our citizens before it's too late.

1008365.en:
The situation here has been resolved, and that resolution is classified.

The Drifter Crisis, however, is far from over. I look forward to having you by our side at the next operation.

1008366.en:
It is over Captain, the Scrutinizer has finished destroying our Exchange and made itself practically invulnerable.

The battle is lost, but the war rages on. I hope you will be by our side to fight it.

1008367.en:
Captain, through that gate a Minmatar Clan is suffering at the hands of a Destructive Scrutinizer. A Response Valravn is onsite, but Drifter-controlled Sleeper Drones have drained its capacitor.

Support the Valravn, destroy the Scrutinizer, and save our people before it is too late.

1008368.en:
Here, we’re done.

The Crisis is not. See you at the next operation.

1008369.en:
Damn! It is over. The Scrutinizer has destroyed the Commons and made itself practically invulnerable.

This is not the end. Next time, we make them pay. Until then.

1008370.en:
Ahead is the focal point of Drifter activity in this system, a Vigilant Dreamer. Destroy it and put an end to the Crisis in this system. 

The Dreamer is being protected by ultra-shield arrays. Hack the arrays, make the Dreamer vulnerable, then destroy it.

1008371.en:
The Vigilant Dreamer through this gate has already been destroyed.

Elsewhere though, our duty must still be served. Until the next operation, Captain.

1008372.en:
It is done. Excellent reward, Captain. You fought honorably, the State and the people of this system owe you their thanks.

Elsewhere, the fight goes on. I know you will continue to execute your duty with honor.

1008373.en:
Ahead lies the epicenter of the Drifter blight in this system, a Vigilant Dreamer. Destroy it and save this system from this Crisis. 

The Dreamer is being protected by ultra-shield arrays. Hack the arrays, make the Dreamer vulnerable, then burn it to ash.

1008374.en:
The Vigilant Dreamer ahead has been blown to smithereens.

The war against the Drifters still rages on though, Captain. I pray you will join us on the next front.

1008375.en:
Is there any sweeter sight? Well done, Captain. Those Drifters will have to crawl back into the hell from whence they came.

Yet, the war is not over. I give the Lord my thanks we have pilots like you to fight it with us.

1008376.en:
On the other side of this gate is a Vigilant Dreamer, the heart of this system’s Crisis. Destroy it and free these citizens from the Drifters. 

The Dreamer is protected by ultra-shield arrays. Hack the arrays, make the Dreamer vulnerable, then destroy it.

1008377.en:
Up ahead the Vigilant Dreamer has already been destroyed.

But on other fronts, freedom is still under threat. I hope we see you there.

1008378.en:
Boom! Take that Drifters! For the people of this system, it is time to celebrate.

But on other fronts, freedom is still under threat. Until these Drifters are defeated I hope you will fly with us.

1008379.en:
Through this gate is this system’s Drifter hub, a Vigilant Dreamer. Destroy it and take this star back for the clans that call it home.

The Dreamer is being protected by ultra-shield arrays. Hack the arrays, make the Dreamer vulnerable, then destroy it.

1008380.en:
The operation ahead has already been completed, and the Republic is victorious.

Elsewhere, we are still mounting offensives against this threat. I will see you there.

1008381.en:
The Dreamer is gone and this system can finally return to normal. 

No rest for us though, not as long as the Republic is under threat. I’m glad the Matari can count on pilots like you.

1008382.en:
Damn! We’re too late. The timer has ended and the Drifter Collections have been destroyed.

Bring anything you grabbed to a Federal Intelligence Office station for compensation. Next time they won’t know what hit them, Captain.

1008383.en:
We need you to infiltrate an Unmoored Jovian Observatory ahead. Drifters have already secured the site, so be careful not to trigger a Lockdown.

Avoid security systems and use a Relic Analyzer to retrieve any items inside Drifter Collections.

1008384.en: The operation is concluded, but there will be others. When the time comes I hope the Republic can count on you, Captain.

1008385.en:
Time’s up, Captain! The Drifters would rather blow up their own Collections than let us have them.

Bring anything you managed to secure to us at the Republic Security Services, we’ll see you’re properly compensated. Next time they won’t be so fortunate.

1008386.en:
Captain, the State successfully completed a strike against Drifter infrastructure despite significant losses. Now our service people need extraction. Additionally, the target Drifter structure shows signs of critical instability.

Salvage the Battle Wreckage and retrieve any Military Stasis Pods before the structure explodes.

1008387.en: The operation ahead has terminated, but the Drifter Crisis is fought on many fronts. I hope we can count on you.

1008388.en:
The structure has gone critical! Those you extracted owe you their lives, and the State owes you its gratitude.

Sell us back any Military Stasis Pods you salvaged at Caldari Navy stations and we will show you that gratitude in ISK.

1008389.en:
Beyond this gate, an Imperial strike force has set a Drifter stronghold ablaze. Their triumph came at great cost, and those who survived need your help before what remains of their target explodes.

Salvage the Battle Wreckage and retrieve Military Stasis Pods before what remains of the Drifter structure explodes.

1008390.en: This operation is concluded, all we have left to offer now are our prayers — prayers of vengeance. Until the next Crisis operation, Captain.

1008391.en:
Explosion detected! Thank the Lord for any you did manage to save.

Sell us back any Military Stasis Pods you salvaged at Amarr Navy stations and the Empress' will show you her grace.

1008392.en:
Heads up, Captain! Up ahead Federation forces claimed victory against the Drifters, but at the cost of many lives. You need to rescue those lucky enough to survive, ideally before the structure they took down goes boom.

Salvage Battle Wreckage and rescue any Military Stasis Pods before that structure explodes.

1008393.en:
Nothing ahead but ghosts, Captain. 

Join us on the next Crisis Operation and we’ll show these Drifters that liberty packs a punch.

1008394.en:
There it goes! Any you saved are lucky you got here when you did, Captain.

The Federation Navy will purchase those Military Stasis Pods back from you at any of their stations.

1008395.en:
Captain. Through that gate, the Republic Fleet took out a Drifter outpost. Many died to make this happen, we need your help bringing back the few who didn’t. The outpost’s wormhole generator is about to detonate, so act fast.

Salvage the Battle Wreckage and retrieve any Military Stasis Pods before it's too late.

1008396.en:
The Operation is over, the Crisis is not.

Join us on the next operation and let's teach these Drifters not to mess with the Matari.

1008397.en:
Structure has detonated! Anyone you managed to grab has a hero's welcome waiting for them. Thank you, Captain.

Sell those Military Statis Pods back to us at any Republic Fleet station and you will be properly compensated.

1008398.en: This operation is all wrapped up. I hope we will see you at the next one though, Captain. Freedom needs its defenders.

1008399.en:
An Unmoored Jovian Observatory is just ahead. Drifters have secured the site with all kinds of traps, one wrong move and it will enter Lockdown.

Avoid their security systems and use a Relic Analyzer to get what you can from Drifter Collections.

1008525.en: Resplendent Coil Expert System This Expert System makes available skills enabling a capsuleer to fly Daredevil and Vigilant. The temporary skills provided by this Expert System last for seven days. An Expert System is a remote, restricted artificial intelligence providing you with access to certain skills during the active rental period. As it is independent from your clone and your capsule, an active Expert System is not lost on pod death or clone jump. Activating an Expert System Activation of an Expert System is automatic upon redemption of the item by the specific capsuleer intending to use the service. Expert Systems are a product developed by the PKN Interstellar consortium, made available over the HyperNet FTL communications network, and marketed by PKN Interstellar member corporations. An Expert System is a restricted AI based on artificial gelbrain technology. As the Expert System uses neural pathways based on those created by skill training or skill injection, it is compatible with capsule-ship interface and control systems. Real time command and control communication is achieved using dedicated FTL channels on PKN Interstellar's HyperNet.

Telemetry data gathered by observing wormholes related to Drifter activity. The data does not seem to concern the wormhole itself, but rather further hyperspace connections that can be observed through it

This data has not been limited in its scope and the full spectrum of the analysis has been included.

1008622.en: Protect the Wormhole Research Outpost or destroy it to recover any Hyperspace Telemetry generated.

1008629.en: Data modelling the responses of individuals observed by a Destructive Scrutinizer. The data has been structured so as to provide parameters for a detailed simulation. Such information would be valuable to scientists and intelligence groups alike.

1008637.en: An exchange point where representatives of different Caldari megacorporations can meet on neutral ground to trade and discuss joint ventures, or where children can come to learn about the other megacorporations of the Caldari.

1008640.en: One of this Federal Districts' many administration structures, it’s occupants are tasked with coordinating matters of local government, meet with ordinary citizens, or liaising with Federal authorities.

1008641.en: The primary structure and heart of a Minmatar clan holding. It is a common space where the clan comes together to hold clan assemblies, work, play, share their history, and educate their children.

1008643.en:
A sleeper corpse that has been modified so as to better serve a Drifter mind.

Like all cloned bodies used by Drifters, the vocal cords have been removed, its blood irradiated and flooded with nanites, and it relied on artificial life support systems managed by a secondary intelligence.

1008644.en:
This data packet is all that was recoverable of the copy of the Tekton Drifter mind.

While clearly synthetic rather than organic in origin, the data packet shows evidence of layered redundancy associated with a mind that has evolved or emerged from a simpler set of constructs.

The digital sequence of this nanocoating has been bound, and though it can only be used once no sequence binders are required when it is consumed in the sequencing of a SKIN license.

1008691.en: A Jovian observatory unstuck in spacetime has emerged in this location. Drifter-controlled Sleeper Drones have already secured the site and begun to recover valuable relics from inside. Evade their security measures and recover these artifacts.

1008692.en:
Hack the site’s containers and structures to recover relics.

Time to complete: 10 minutes.
Hostiles: Sleepers
Size: 1-3 pilots.
Roles: Explorer, Hacker, Enforcer
Module types: Relic Analyzer

1008696.en:
Unmoored in spacetime, this Observatory has emerged in this location for a limited duration. The spacetime instability caused by Drifter activity in this system may have inadvertently caused Its emergence, or they may have deliberately pulled it into this location using their advanced hyperspace technologies. Whether it was a deliberate act or not, the Drifters have moved quickly, deploying measures to secure its rare contents.  

How long it has been adrift for is unknown, but scans indicate it once contained valuable artifacts from a bygone era. Since its emergence, Sleeper Drones have already recovered many of those artifacts.

1008697.en: A Drifter mine, it will explode and trigger a Lockdown should any non-authorized ship come to close.

1008698.en: Built to detect any nearby motion, this Witness will trigger a Lockdown if any non-authorized ships venture to close.

1008699.en: A Drifter structure primed to deploy interdiction bubbles in the event of a site Lockdown. The ancient protocols controlling this system can be disabled with a Relic Analyzer.

1008700.en: A collection of artifacts recovered from inside the Observatory. This container can be opened with the help of a Relic Analyzer.

1008701.en:
The master device that controls this site's security systems. If any non-Drifter-controlled ships venture too close, the Authority is programmed to trigger a site Lockdown.

The ancient protocols the Authority uses can be hacked with a Relic Analyzer, aborting an active Lockdown.

1008703.en: The central datacore of a Watchful Authority. The code it runs is based on ancient Jovian principles, but its unblemished surface betrays its recent construction.

1008704.en: The central datacore of a Patient Jailer. The code it runs is based on ancient Jovian principles, but its unblemished surface betrays its recent construction.

1008705.en: In its strange journey unstuck in space and time, the observatory has still been recording its surroundings. Due to this ruined state those recordings are fragmented and incomplete, but still have some value to the scientifically astute.

1009017.en:
The rapid warp capabilities of the Sarathiel make it uniquely fast amongst dreadnoughts. Its development began under the shadow of the Drifter Crisis, and though its exterior does not look anything like a Drifter vessel, it is rumored to incorporate elements of their technology procured during those dark days. 

In addition to its outstanding warp capabilities, this Dreadnought is able to house jump field generators. It is this capability that means the sight of a Sarathiel strikes fear into the citizens of New Eden, for it is often the first sign of a devastating ambush.

1009226.en: Zydrine Burn is a potent liquor that is loosely related to the more refined Zydrine Wine, both of these green-hued drinks being produced using rice leaves, a certain portion of the grains, and whatever additives are appropriate to the style of drink. While Zydrine Wine can be an extraordinarily delicate and subtle drink, with the finest generally held to be brewed from the rice plants of Intaki Prime, its more powerful cousin is a somewhat pungent and vividly green brew. Rumors suggest that some versions of Zydrine Burn use as ingredients effluent from Quafe production, liquefied fedo scent glands, or even the notorious protein delicacies in powdered form. Whatever the case, a market for this harshly memorable liquor has sprung up among space workers of all kinds, and few space station bars lack a bottle or two of the stuff. Among planetary populations the brew has a more notorious reputation, popularly considered the tipple of underclasses, criminals, and ruthless capsuleer pirates.

1009306.en:
The Imperial Inquisitorial Police (IIP) are one of the key law enforcement divisions of the Amarr Ministry of Internal Order, focused primarily on maintaining law and order in direct holdings of the Imperial Throne, and any territories not coming under the direct jurisdiction of the six Royal Houses and their own police guards. Inevitably, given the complex, endlessly-shifting politics and webs of relationships between the Throne, Royal Houses, and their various vassals, there are any number of situations where the Ministry of Internal Order has some valid interest or mandate to intervene.

Outright situations of unrest or flagrant criminality are often dealt with by the Ministry's feared Order Paladins, a paramilitary force given to act first and ask questions later. When investigation or a somewhat lighter touch is required the Imperial Inquisitorial Police are usually sent in. Given the delicacy of many situations involving space stations and space industrial colonies, the IIP are the preferred option in such locations, with special investigation units travelling extensively throughout the Amarr Empire.

1009318.en:
The federal Gallente Police Directorate traces its roots back to the original planet-wide police service of the Gallente Union on Luminaire. The Gallente Union Police & Public Safety Service (GUPPSS) was intended to operate as an "all union service", with its officers recruited and trained by the federal government of the Gallente Union. While retaining basic membership of the GUPPSS, and with some serving as federal police, most officers served in distinct units under the political oversight of member states.

The concept broke down as the Gallente Union expanded throughout space and evolved into the modern day Gallente Federation. As outlying systems, planets and colonies chose to wholly organize their own police forces, the "Guppies" were increasingly seen as an anachronism by the heavily-populated and powerful member states of Luminaire.

Ultimately, the homeworld states followed the example of the sovereign polities of the Gallente Federation and set up entirely independent police forces. The Gallente Union Police & Publice Safety Service became the Gallente Police Directorate, and found a new lease of life as a police force operating across Federation space with jurisdiction over federal domains. Detractors of this service still refer to it by the old nickname of "Guppies".

As outlying systems, planets and colonies chose to wholly organize their own police forces, the "Guppies" were increasingly seen as an anachronism by the heavily-populated and powerful member states of Luminaire.

Ultimately, the homeworld states followed the example of the sovereign polities of the Gallente Federation and set up entirely independent police forces. The Gallente Union Police & Publice Safety Service became the Gallente Police Directorate, and found a new lease of life as a police force operating across Federation space with jurisdiction over federal domains. Detractors of this service still refer to it by the old nickname of "Guppies".

1009324.en:
The Republic Justice Police (RJP) are a uniformed branch of the Republic Justice Department, the law enforcement organization principally focused on fighting against crimes affecting the stability and security of the Republic and all the Tribes, such as terrorism, smuggling, and above all slavery. While other branches of the Republic Justice Department are active in more clandestine activities, such as counter-intelligence and supporting rebel groups in the Amarr Empire, the RJP tends to restrict its activities to internal crimes and co-operation with the various tribal and clan police forces in order to combat Republic-wide criminal networks.

Given the complicated nature of jurisdiction and legality in the Tribal Republic of the Minmatar, the Republic Justice Police often encounter difficulties and outright disdain from many clans eager to maintain their rights and jealous of outside interference. Nevertheless, the RJP's units are often to be seen travelling across Republic space as the complexities and exceptions of space colonization and station life often mean that only the Republic's police forces can deal with the problems. Most colonies or stations prefer calling in the RJP rather than the paramilitaries of the Republic Security Services if a Republic presence is required.

1009339.en:
The Caldari State Police is one of the few law enforcement organizations that conducts operations across Caldari territory, working alongside Caldari Customs and the Business Tribunal Audit & Investigation Branch, known as the "Audit Tribunes". Originating as the planetary police force of Caldari Prime, during the period of Caldari membership of the Federation, the Caldari Police Guards played a key role in evacuating millions during the Caldari-Gallente War. This guaranteed the continued existence of the agency as the Caldari State Police, even in the new Caldari order of a fully corporate state.

The Caldari State Police found its niche in the interstellar nature of the Caldari State and is often used by the many smaller corporations and multistellar businesses that require a law enforcement agency that can operate across megacorporate territorial lines. The bulk of the State Police's income is derived from such policing and security work, but it retains Chief Executive Panel funding and the "Big 8" oversight that comes with it. Occasionally, the megacorporations may call in the State Police to resolve some matter they wish to keep at arms length. Actual disputes between megacorps remain the almost exclusive preserve of the CBT and its Audit Tribunes.

1011244.en: Eleutrium is a regolith with morphological similarities to silicates and is a major building block in Drifter, Sleeper, and Jove construction materials. The mineral also appears in spectrographic analyses of the Society of Conscious Thought ship materials. Due to the unknown conditions of its formation and appearance, astrogeologists fear this may be a unique opportunity. Eleutrium is found exclusively in tyranite.

1011289.en: Appearing en masse during the Drifter Crisis of YC127, tyranite is a s-type asteroid that has been bombarded by low-level blackbody radiation for millennia, turning its silicate-like surface regolith into eleutrium. Astrogeologists claim that this process occurred prior to tyranite asteroids appearing, wholly by unknown means. Due to the unknown conditions of its formation and appearance, astrogeologists fear this may be a unique opportunity. Additionally, its special properties break down when under pressure, making it incompressible. Tyranite is the only known source of eleutrium.

1011422.en: Capsuleer Day YC127 Expert System This Expert System makes available skills enabling a capsuleer to fly T1 battlecruisers. The temporary skills provided by this Expert System last for seven days. An Expert System is a remote, restricted artificial intelligence providing you with access to certain skills during the active rental period. As it is independent from your clone and your capsule, an active Expert System is not lost on pod death or clone jump. Activating an Expert System Activation of an Expert System is automatic upon redemption of the item by the specific capsuleer intending to use the service. Expert Systems are a product developed by the PKN Interstellar consortium, made available over the HyperNet FTL communications network, and marketed by PKN Interstellar member corporations. An Expert System is a restricted AI based on artificial gelbrain technology. As the Expert System uses neural pathways based on those created by skill training or skill injection, it is compatible with capsule-ship interface and control systems. Real time command and control communication is achieved using dedicated FTL channels on PKN Interstellar's HyperNet.

1011918.en:
An electronic interface designed to augment and enhance a dreadnought's siege warfare abilities. Through a series of electromagnetic polarity field shifts, the siege module diverts energy from the ship's propulsion and warp systems to lend additional power to its offensive and defensive capabilities.

This results in a tremendous increase in damage, as well as a greatly increased rate of defensive self-sustenance. Defensive benefits include improved self-repair and shield boosting effectiveness, as well as increased resistance to most forms of electronic warfare. As a side effect of the ionic field created by the siege module, beneficial remote repair and capacitor transfer effects are ineffective against the fitted ship while the module is active.
In addition, the lack of power to locomotion systems means that neither standard propulsion nor warp travel are available to the ship nor are you allowed to dock until out of siege mode.

Notes: 
- A siege module requires Strontium clathrates to run and operate effectively. 
- Bonuses to the Shield Booster amount and duration are only applied to Capital sized boosters.
- Bonuses to the Armor Repairer amount and duration are only applied to Capital sized repairers.
- Only one siege module can be fitted to a dreadnought class ship. The increased shield boosting and armor repairing gained from the Siege Module is subject to a stacking penalty when used with other similar modules that affect the same attribute on the ship.

1012033.en:

The system was renamed to represent its purification and suitability to be ruled by the Holy Empress despite the refusal of the pre-existing Drifter population to accept that decision.

1012034.en:

It was renamed for the Drifter complex in the system, modified by the Republic’s hope to one day free the system from the Tyrannical grip of the Drifters who refuse to acknowledge their authority.

1012040.en:
This cypher opens up access to a Nexus Point within a Drifter wormhole system.

Woven together within a Labyrinth Complex, these data threads come together to describe a higher-dimensional hypercomplex manifold beyond the understanding of contemporary New Eden mathematicians.

1012041.en:
Recovered from a copy of the Ladon Drifter mind, this data packet may hold answers to the nature of the Nexus Cyphers being generated by the Labyrinth Complex.

While clearly synthetic rather than organic in origin, the data packet shows evidence of layered redundancy associated with a mind that has evolved or emerged from a simpler set of constructs.

1012042.en:
A hyper-complex recursive data loop. 

It is unsolvable, but would prove valuable to the forces occupying Drifter wormholes or their corporations back in New Eden.

1012043.en:
A confusing thread of quantum calculations that resolves to multiple contradictory conclusions.

While its results cannot all possibly be true, it would still be valuable to the forces occupying Drifter wormholes or their corporations back in New Eden.

1012044.en:
A deterministic thread of quantum calculations in which uncertainty variations have been eliminated.

It should be impossible, according to contemporary scientific theory. As such, it may provide key insights into Drifter technology. It would be highly valuable to the forces occupying Drifter wormholes or their corporations back in New Eden.

1012045.en:
These Execution Command Units are unique to the Sleeper Drones of the Labyrinth Complex. Through this unit, every action they execute links back to the Labyrinth’s superstructure, making them a part of its unfathomable operations.

The forces occupying Drifter wormholes or their corporations back in New Eden would consider them valuable.

1012046.en:
A hyper-complex data loop that has reached an nth dimensional solution terminus. 

It could provide extremely valuable insights to the forces occupying Drifter wormholes or their corporations back in New Eden.

1012047.en:
Dominance Command Units are rare even among the Sleeper Drones of the Labyrinth Complex. These computational components are directly linked into the same hyperspace network as the Labyrinth itself, granting remote intelligences the ability to make direct adjustments.

The forces occupying Drifter wormholes or their corporations back in New Eden would consider them valuable.

1012048.en:

While clearly synthetic rather than organic in origin, the data packet shows evidence of layered redundancy associated with a mind that has evolved or emerged from a simpler set of constructs.

Good luck, we are all with you.

1012078.en:
This is the Labyrinth Complex. Navigate through its connections, locate the Reckoning Hoard, and retrieve target items.

For the State.

1012079.en:
Tyrannos Strategos herself is in control of that Dreadnought! Your mission is to stop whatever she is doing with that structure.

Strike when she is vulnerable, survive when she is not.

1012080.en:
That Dread is being piloted by Tyrannos Strategos! Whatever she is doing with that structure, it can’t be good.

Attack when she is vulnerable; do your best to survive when she is not.

1012081.en:
Azdaja in forbidden dominance arrangement! Now-time extirpation is essential to halt poshlost advancement.

Violent praxis when Azdaja is exposed, prove your flow when enemy is hunkered.

1012082.en:
Tyrannos Strategos herself is on site within that Dreadnought! We may not understand that structure yet, but this can’t be good.

Open fire when she is vulnerable, stay alive when she is not.

1012083.en:
Strategos has retreated, the Nexus Point is in temporary hyperspace collapse. 

This is not the end, there will be other battles to fight. I know we can count on you to do your duty.

1012084.en:
Strategos has retreated, the Nexus Point is in temporary hyperspace collapse. 

This is not the end, there will be other battles to fight. I know we can count on you to do your duty.

1012085.en:
Ancient enemy Azdaja is now-time absent, and Nexus domain near collapse.

Recurring-time Azdaja is istina, as is glorification through their extirpation.

1012086.en:
Strategos has bugged out and this whole place will soon follow after. 

They’ll be back, and there will be other opportunities. I pray we see you when they arrive.

1012087.en:
For the State! Target eliminated.

For now, at least. Strategos will return. When she does, I know you will be ready to do your duty.

1012088.en:
Strategos is falling back, and this Nexus is in collapse. Looks like she achieved her objective.

Next time, she won’t be so lucky. I hope you’re there to help make sure that’s true.

1012089.en:
Forbidden dominance ended.

Ancient Enemy Azdaja is recurring-time threat. You have proven your flow, advanced-time glorification is assured.

1012090.en:
Threat eliminated! Oorah!

Strategos is not done yet, but I know that whenever she comes back you will be ready to send her packing once more.

1012091.en:
That’s how the Republic gets it done!

Tyrannos Strategos is off the field, but she’ll be back. I know you’ll be here to show her what we think of Tyrants.

1012092.en:
Strategos is falling back to higher-dimensions, and the Nexus is in collapse. Whatever her goal, she must have achieved it.

They’ll be back, though, and next time, we’ll make sure it counts. I hope you’re with us.

1012093.en:
Ancient enemy Azdaja departs in poshlost counter-direction, Nexus is in collapse.

Now-time fitness is wanting, advanced-time glorification remains possible.

1012094.en:
Strategos is bugging out, the Nexus is in collapse. She got what she needed, I guess. Damn it! 

Next time, she won’t be so fortunate. I know we can count on you to have our back.

1012095.en:

Hostiles: Drifters, Sleepers

Fleet Recommendations:
Size: 12-15 pilots
Roles: Enforcer

1013991.en:
Strategos is bugging out, and the Locus is collapsing. Whatever she was up to, it looks like she got it done.

Next time she tries, she won’t get so lucky. I hope we can count on you.

1013992.en:
Woooh! Target down, that’s how the Federation gets it done.

This is a victory, but she’ll be back. When she is, I know you’ll be ready.

1013993.en:
Strategos is retreating, the Locus Point is beginning to collapse.

The battle is done, but the war rages on. See you next time, Captain.

1013994.en:
Tyrannos Strategos herself is piloting that Dreadnought! Your mission is to stop her from completing whatever work she is doing on that structure.

Open fire when she is vulnerable, stay alive when she isn’t.

1013996.en:
A Drifter Dreadnought piloted by Tyrannos Strategos, leader of the Vigilant Tyrannos.

Her work within this Nexus is unclear, but she will show no mercy to any who would disrupt it.

1014538.en:
The Reactive Armor Hardener possesses an advanced nano membrane that reacts to armor layer damage by shifting between resistances over time. This makes it able to align its defenses against whichever incoming damage types are prevalent.

The module spreads 64% resistance over the four damage types, starting at 16% in each.

Only one of this module type can be fitted at a time.

1014540.en: The Micro Jump Drive is a module that spools up, then jumps the ship forward 100km in the direction it is facing. Upon arrival, the ship maintains its direction and velocity. Warp scramblers can be used to disrupt the module. Spool up time is reduced by the skill Micro Jump Drive Operation. The Micro Jump Drive was developed by Duvolle Laboratories Advanced Manifold Theory Unit. The drive was conceived by the late Avagher Xarasier, the genius behind several ground-breaking innovations of that era.

Attack her when she is vulnerable, try and survive when she is not.

Strike when she is vulnerable, survive when she is not.

That Dread is being piloted by Tyrannos Strategos! She is defending the hive; eliminate her and disable it.

Attack when she is vulnerable; do your best to survive when she is not.

1014681.en:
Strategos has withdrawn, and this Locus Point has begun to collapse into higher-dimensional space.

There will be other opportunities, I pray we see you when they arrive.

1014682.en:
Strategos has retreated, the Locus Point is in temporary hyperspace collapse.

This is not the end, there will be other battles to fight. I know we can count on you to do your duty.

1014683.en:
The tyrant has gone, and this Locus Point is collapsing up into higher-dimensional space.

They will be back, I hope you’re with us when they are.

1014684.en:
Strategos is retreating, and soon, this Locus will follow. Her task must be complete, for now at least.

The battle was lost, but the war is not. I pray you will be there to fight with us next time, Captain.

1014685.en:
Strategos is falling back, and this Hive has Locus is in collapse. Looks like she achieved her objective.

Next time, she won’t be so lucky. I hope you’re there to help make sure that’s true.

1014686.en:
Strategos is falling back to higher-dimensions, and the Locus is in collapse. Whatever her goal, she must have achieved it.

They’ll be back, though, and next time, we’ll make sure it counts. I hope you’re with us.

An Expert System is a remote, restricted artificial intelligence providing you with access to certain skills during the active 7 days rental period. As it is independent from your clone and your capsule, an active Expert System is not lost on pod death or clone jump. Activating an Expert System Activation of an Expert System is automatic upon redemption of the item by the specific capsuleer intending to use the service. Expert Systems are a product developed by the PKN Interstellar consortium, made available over the HyperNet FTL communications network, and marketed by PKN Interstellar member corporations. An Expert System is a restricted AI based on artificial gelbrain technology. As the Expert System uses neural pathways based on those created by skill training or skill injection, it is compatible with capsule-ship interface and control systems. Real time command and control communication is achieved using dedicated FTL channels on PKN Interstellar's HyperNet.

1016271.en: You snuck onto an ORE work crew to retrieve information about the missing Sarnai. The data you found points to some unique mineral isotopes. Perhaps Elias knows someone who can help.

1016272.en:
Elias' friend Sarnai is missing, presumed dead, and he wants your help finding out what happened. 

Disguise yourself as a member of Sarnai’s old ORE work crew so you can hack their mainframe and steal any data on why Sarnai went missing.

1016284.en: Incredible, together we can figure out what is going on here. I will see you at the ORE site.

1016285.en:
A close friend of mine who was working at ORE, Batya Sarnai, is missing, presumed dead. No one will tell me or her family what happened. I need your help to uncover the truth.

I’ve tracked down her old work crew and got you on their work roster. I need you to go undercover as an ORE miner, hack their mainframe, and steal any data on Sarnai.

1016286.en:
Those ORE miners will not be happy that we stole their data, but it was worth it.

The data contains the details of some unique mineral isotopes. Why Sarnai’s name is listed alongside them, I don’t know, but I may just know someone who can help us make sense of this.

1016287.en:
I cannot say I am not disappointed.

If you change your mind, come back and see me. My friend deserves justice, and I need your help to get it.

1016288.en:
Hello there, Captain. I could use your help.

A close friend of mine who was working at ORE, Batya Sarnai, is missing, presumed dead. No one will tell me or her family what happened. I need your help to uncover the truth.

I’ve tracked down her old work crew and got you on their work roster. I need you to go under cover as an ORE miner, hack their mainframe, and steal any data on Sarnai.

1016289.en: I'm disappointed, but I understand. Fly safe.

1016290.en:
Need a reminder? No problem.

A close friend of mine who was working at ORE, Batya Sarnai, is missing, presumed dead. No one will tell me or her family what happened. I need your help to uncover the truth.

I’ve tracked down her old work crew and got you on their work roster. I need you to go undercover as an ORE miner, hack their mainframe, and steal any data on Sarnai.

1016440.en: With the help of Brother Jacques Quelouse of the SOE, you were able to determine the isotopes' origin, an explosion at an unknown Upwell facility. Investigating that sight may just give Elias the answers he seeks.

1016441.en:
Elias' friend in the Sisters of EVE has agreed to help us investigate these mineral isotopes. Even better, he says he’s managed to track some of them down. The only snag is that he needs your help to investigate them.

Elias has sent the coordinates to your ship’s computer. Meet the SOE scientist at the site. Bring a mining ship and a surveyor, and help him investigate the correct isotopes.

1016442.en: I was hoping you would say that. Now, let’s go see a man about some rocks.

1016443.en:
Good news, a friend of mine in the Sisters of EVE has agreed to help us investigate these mineral isotopes. Even better, he says he’s managed to track some of them down. The only snag is that he needs our help to investigate them.

I’ve sent the coordinates to your ship’s computer. Meet him at the site with a mining ship and a surveyor, and help him investigate the correct isotopes.

1016444.en: Brother Jacques sent us the isotopes' points of origin. When you’re ready, come speak to me again, and we can finally find out the truth.

1016445.en:
Damn, without your help this data is just useless bytes.

If you change your mind, come and see me again.

1016446.en:
We’ve got the data, now we just need to know what it means.

The good news, a friend of mine in the Sisters of EVE has agreed to help us investigate the mineral isotopes mentioned alongside Sarnai in the data. Even better, he says he’s managed to track some of them down. The only snag is that he needs our help to investigate them.

I’ve sent the coordinates to your ship’s computer. Meet him at the site with a mining ship and a surveyor, and help him investigate the correct isotopes.

1016447.en: When we were so close...? Alright. Goodbye.

1016448.en:
Need a reminder? No problem.

The good news, a friend of mine in the Sisters of EVE has agreed to help us investigate the mineral isotopes mentioned alongside Sarnai in the data. Even better, he says he’s managed to track some of them down. The only snag is that he needs our help to investigate them.

I’ve sent the coordinates to your ship’s computer. Meet him at the site with a mining ship and a surveyor, and help him investigate the correct isotopes.

1016450.en: Batya Sarnai’s tale has come to an end. Elias has learned the truth and can be satisfied that he gave Sarnai’s legacy the honor it deserves.

1016451.en: Whatever happened to Sarnai happened at this abandoned Upwell site. With your help, Elias can uncover the truth and give Sarnai’s legacy the ending it deserves.

1016452.en: Time for the grand finale, let’s head out.

1016453.en: Whatever happened to Sarnai happened at this abandoned Upwell site. With your help we can uncover the truth and give Sarnai’s legacy the ending it deserves.

1016454.en:
Finally, I can put Sarnai to rest. It’s not what she deserved, she deserved to live a full life, grow old, and die in comfort. But, it’s what she would have wanted, and there’s honor in that.

Thank you, Captain, I couldn't have made it through without you.

1016455.en: What! We’re in too deep to quit now. Please, think it over, come back and talk to me. I know you’ll do the right thing.

1016456.en:
This is it.

Whatever happened to Sarnai happened at this abandoned Upwell site. With your help we can uncover the truth and give Sarnai’s legacy the ending it deserves.

As an organization with a strong interest in the development of fortification and area denial technology, EDENCOM's AEGIS organization created a variety of enhanced proximity mine designs during the Triglavian Invasions. While EDENCOM uses these static weapons extensively, AEGIS has also made these designs available to CONCORD's military and police forces.

The result was the Pioneer, a ship designed to extend the reach of the nascent miner as they build towards ever greater success.

1017430.en: Mining Destroyer Operations This Expert System makes available skills enabling the Capsuleer to fly a Mining Destroyer, such as the Pioneer class ship. The temporary skills provided by this Expert System last for seven days. An Expert System is a remote, restricted artificial intelligence providing you with access to certain skills during the active rental period. As it is independent from your clone and your capsule, an active Expert System is not lost on pod death or clone jump. Activating an Expert System Activation of an Expert System is automatic upon redemption of the item by the specific capsuleer intending to use the service. Expert Systems are a product developed by the PKN Interstellar consortium, made available over the HyperNet FTL communications network, and marketed by PKN Interstellar member corporations. An Expert System is a restricted AI based on artificial gelbrain technology. As the Expert System uses neural pathways based on those created by skill training or skill injection, it is compatible with capsule-ship interface and control systems. Real time command and control communication is achieved using dedicated FTL channels on PKN Interstellar's HyperNet.

1017827.en: This is my dream. What is yours?

1017830.en:
Following the occupation of Drifter Wormhole Systems in YC127, the Sisters of EVE were thrust into the center of interstellar diplomacy. Their new role as interlocuters between the occupiers granted them greater access to those factions than ever before.

Far away from these events, studying in a secluded Sisters of EVE cloister at the cluster’s edge, a young student named Sister Hana Casmira heard this news and was inspired to pick up her stylus. Her design spread like wildfire through the organization, eventually coming to the attention of Reverend Mother Santimona Sarpati.

What Casmira envisioned was the ultimate exploration vessel. Unbound by the conventional limits of space travel, with unprecedented technical capabilities, and the ability to indefinitely support a nomadic life for any researchers bold enough to dream of one. She named it after a belief held by some Sisters that all of humanity are lost travellers who will one day find their way back to heaven, beyond the EVE Gate.

1017965.en:
The Consortium Issue variant of the Pioneer was developed for use in ORE’s Upwell Consortium projects. It is a stronger vessel than the base hull from which it was adapted, for the tougher scenarios Upwell’s nullsec work tends to invite.

This version of the Pioneer was designed in partnership with other Upwell member corporations. Inside top-secret research sites housed in unlisted locations, top designers from multiple corporations came together to help iterate on ORE’s original design. Its combination of expanded shield defense, an expanded drone bay, and superior salvage capabilities have turned the already extremely capable Pioneer into a relentless powerhouse of industry.

1017981.en: Why gamble when you can guarantee?

1017984.en: Recognizing the dire need for a ship capable of fast operation in unsafe territories, ORE created the Venture. It was conceived as a vessel primed and ready for any capsuleer, no matter how new to the dangers of New Eden they might be, who wishes to engage in the respectable trade of mining. The Venture has amazing abilities to quickly drill through to the ores and gases it's after, harvesting them at the speed necessary for mining in hostile space, and getting out relatively unscathed.

1017986.en: Small hull designed to gather materials at longer ranges, but at the cost of speed.

1017988.en: Small and fast hull designed to gather materials even in hostile areas.

1017990.en: Advanced Destroyers that can field Command Bursts for supporting and leading group mining operations as well as Micro Jump Field Generators for rapid repositioning of nearby ships.

1017992.en: Don’t reach for your goals, fly towards them.

1017995.en:
While the majority of ORE technologies' design team worked in harmony on the Pioneer, one person refused to fall in line. Dr. Mortimer Xin insisted on pushing in a direction that, while innovative, undermined the design team's goals of reliability and accessibility. Eventually, because of the strength of his vision and the importance of his team mates sanity, Xin was reassigned to Outer Ring Development, where he was tasked with designing a new high-end sister ship to the Pioneer.

The result was the Outrider, a ship that exchanged long reach for incredible positioning, and reliability for adaptability. The result is a unique vessel that, while less accessible, is undeniable.

1017998.en:
Join the fight in space or on the ground!

Vanguard have been deployed to uncover Upwell secrets so that capsuleers can ambush Unlisted Squall convoys. The Sealed Projects Crates retrieved from those convoys can be traded at Deathless Wraith Traders to unlock rewards.

1018019.en:
The Arkombine is a splinter group of disillusioned clone soldiers. Betrayed by the nations they swore to serve they now seek independence and the means to undo what has been done to them. Their ranks are comprised of clone soldiers from all four of the major empires.

With the rise of the Deathless Circle and new cloning technology holding out the hope of healing the deepest psychological scars of the old warclones, and catapulting them to new heights, the Arkombine have gathered many old soldiers of the first and second generations of mercenary clones to their ranks. The Arkombine Arisen nanocoating is a dramatic and proud statement of the determination of all warclones to survive, prosper, and rise beyond the persecution and conflict inflicted on them by the imperialist ambitions and militarist adventurism of New Eden's empires and factions.

The Arkombine Arisen nanocoating is a dramatic and proud statement of the determination of all warclones to survive, prosper, and rise beyond the persecution and conflict inflicted on them by the imperialist ambitions and militarist adventurism of New Eden's empires and factions.

1018513.en:
The Anhinga is a battlecruiser with unprecedented firepower. Like the legendary ‘snake bird’ it’s named after, the Anhinga allows pilots to strike from the deep, catching their rivals off guard.

The Mountain faction made shocking allegations against the Hyasyoda corporation following the unveiling of the design, claiming to have proof linking Anhinga designers to Guristas pirates operating within the Caldari state. 

“This pirate infestation appears to be spread among several corporations, not just Hyasyoda,” claimed an official statement from the Home Guard.

Following a series of high-level meetings behind closed doors, Hyasyoda agreed to withdraw their bid for a Navy contract, although they protested the lack of evidence on behalf of the Mountain faction. To smooth things over, the CEP decided to award a small number of the Anhinga to New Eden’s best pilots as awards for Alliance Tournament XXI.

1018514.en: Honor is everything, and nothing is more honorable than victory.

1018517.en:
Inspired by ancient stories of a 'pirate bird,' the Skua allows pilots to unleash a barrage of long range missiles that mimic that relentlessness of its namesake.

The Mountain faction rallied against the Skua in the CEP, causing controversy. In an official statement on behalf of the Home Guard, Tanis Cheung claimed to have proof that Lai Dai had hired “allegedly former” Guristas pirates, and that the Skua was born of that “anti-Caldari” collaboration.

In response, the Skua was canceled. However, a handful of prototypes had already been manufactured. The CEP thought their power and nimbleness should be given to the best pilots in New Eden, so they were awarded to the winners of Alliance Tournament XXI.

Named after Tyma Raitaru, who pioneered the development of modern day missile technology, the Raitaru Engineering Complex is a medium-sized structure from the Upwell Consortium and is specialized in manufacturing and research operations.

The Raitaru is the entry-level Engineering Complex in the Upwell Consortium’s new line of structures, and is able to use Upwell's Standup Service modules, allowing flexibility and customization of its functions. This dedicated industrial structure also provides access to Upwell’s M-Set line of rigs designed to improve productivity and optimization of various aspects of manufacturing and research.

The Raitaru provides tethering technology and has docking capabilities for subcapital ships and freighters. ( copy )

1018866.en: Recognizing the dire need for a ship capable of fast operation in unsafe territories, ORE created the Venture. It was conceived as a vessel primed and ready for any capsuleer, no matter how new to the dangers of New Eden they might be, who wishes to engage in the respectable trade of mining. The Venture has amazing abilities to quickly drill through to the ores and gases it's after, harvesting them at the speed necessary for mining in hostile space, and getting out relatively unscathed. ( copy )

1018868.en:
When new lower-mass wormhole connections began appearing across Anoikis in late YC116, ORE tasked the engineers at its advanced Outer Ring Development labs with creating a mining foreman vessel capable of passing through these gateways and exploiting the unspoiled riches available within. Creating such a compact ship while preserving much of the utility of the larger Orca and Rorqual designs proved a significant challenge, but the end result was a ship that had great potential for capsuleer mining operations in all areas of space.

The Porpoise can use a medium industrial core to substantially increase its industrial capabilities, while empowering its defenses during deployment in a static configuration. A key element of the industrial capacity unlocked by activating an industrial core is the ability to use compressor modules, with the Porpoise also having this capability, although limited to using medium gas and asteroid ore compressors.

The Porpoise is a smaller, more mobile and more affordable mining foreman platform that is perfect for supporting mining operations in dangerous space. It is capable of providing support to its allies through mining foreman bursts, remote shield boosters and enhancing allied mining surveyors. The Porpoise also enjoys strong bonuses to mining drones, allowing it to pull in its own share of the ore in any mining operation.

1018870.en: The mining barge was designed by ORE to facilitate advancing the mining profession to a new level. Each barge was created to excel at a specific function, the Retriever's being storage. A massive ore hold allows the Retriever to operate for extended periods without requiring as much support as other barges. Mining barges are equipped with electronic subsystems specifically designed to accommodate Strip Mining and Ice Harvesting modules.

1018872.en: Recognizing the dire need for a ship capable of fast operation in unsafe territories, ORE created the Venture. It was conceived as a vessel primed and ready for any capsuleer, no matter how new to the dangers of New Eden they might be, who wishes to engage in the respectable trade of mining. The Venture has amazing abilities to quickly drill through to the ores and gases it's after, harvesting them at the speed necessary for mining in hostile space, and getting out relatively unscathed.

1019021.en: Prismaticite is an Erratic Ore. Once reprocessed, it will collapse into one of a number of different minerals. Prismaticite must be compressed in the form of Compressed Prismaticite to be used in reactions. The unique properties of this ore are a result of its fundamental dimensional instability. It was shaped in an unknowable higher-dimensional environment.

1019027.en: A Phased Asteroid containing the erratic ore, Prismaticite. It can only be mined while inside the moving Fracture, and can only be efficiently harvested while phased by a Mobile Phase Anchor. This asteroid has come to our lower dimensions from somewhere beyond normal reach. It is naturally out of phase with our spacetime. Visit the User Manual tab for more information

1019167.en:
Cold Wind’s Call was commissioned by the Chief Executive Panel in celebration of the Caldari State’s continued strength and resilience. Modern retellings of tribal mythology portray Cold Wind as a guide of the early Raata who inspired the stories of great leaders Deteaas and K’Vire by seeding strength and prosperity in the worthy and driving away all who opposed them. Believers continue to revere him as a divine force who carries the Maker’s will throughout the atmosphere of Caldari Prime and beyond.
“Cold Wind was before and will be after, the first of the Winds to blow among the Kaalakiota Peaks and the one that loves things that grow strong.”

1019331.en: The Blood Raider Covenant is a particularly gruesome sect of Sani Sabik cult. While all modern Sani Sabik rituals use blood in some manner or another, the Blood Raiders Covenant places particular value on it, and will go to great lengths to acquire it from what they believe to be the richest and most unspoiled sources. They are considered among the most dangerous and depraved of all pirate elements operating in space.

1019336.en: The Order of St. Tetrimon is an Amarr religious order known for its fanatical followers and radical scriptural, theocratic, and militarist doctrines. The Order is named for St. Tetrimon, an Ardishapur noble who assassinated his grandfather the Emperor Zaragram II, in response to the increasingly megalomaniac and heretical actions of the "Mad Emperor".

1019614.en:
After the success of the Venture mining frigate, ORE spun their growing frontier exploration, exploitation and technology divisions into new subsidiaries. One of the first projects undertaken by the newly configured ORE conglomerate was the development of a new line of Expedition frigates, designed to meet the needs of the riskiest and most lucrative harvesting operations.

The Prospect combines improved asteroid mining systems with the Venture frame whose speed and agility made its predecessor famous. It is also the first ORE ship to take advantage of Covert Ops Cloaking Devices, allowing the Prospect to warp while cloaked for movement to and from asteroid fields in even the most hostile territories.

1019622.en: Prismaticite is an Erratic Ore. Once reprocessed, it will collapse into one of a number of different minerals. This is the only type of Prismaticite that can be used in reactions. The unique properties of this ore are a result of its fundamental dimensional instability. It was shaped in an unknowable higher-dimensional environment. This material has been compressed into a much more compact form of the original material.

1019638.en:
Among their people, the practice of identifying and deifying savants has been part of Sani Sabik life for over a thousand years, but has in more recent times taken a back seat as the Blood Raiders in particular have widened their pursuits to the acquisition, inspection, and manipulation of blood, with this becoming their core focus.

The only remaining echoes of the lauding of savants are in the near worship of Omir Sarikusa and in the unstated but general belief among the Sani Sabik that each and every one of them is a savant of New Eden, having all in one way or another been the beneficiaries of the blood rituals.

1021631.en:
Deploy the Phase Anchor in range of a Phased Asteroid.
Connect with Industrial Command Ships.
Once enough ships have connected to provide the required power, the Anchor begins Phasing-In the Phased Asteroid.
Once Phased-In, the anchor disconnects and the asteroid can be mined at 100% efficiency.
Asteroid Phases-Out after several minutes.
If the Phased Anchor has activations remaining, repeat the process to Phase-In the Phased Asteroid once more.

1021633.en:
If ships disconnect, bringing power below the required threshold, phasing will fail and the Phased Asteroid remains Phased-Out.
Once the Mobile Phase Anchor has no more activations, it can no longer be used.
The Mobile Phase Anchor cannot be scooped after being deployed.

1021637.en:
Restrictions: any eligible ship can provide power, regardless of pilot affiliation.
Large asteroids may require multiple Phase Anchors to mine fully.

The modulated deep core miner is a technological marvel that combines the capacities of the commonly used Miner II with that of the deep core mining laser. Using a modular mining crystal system, it can be altered on the fly for maximum efficiency.

It's important to remember, however, that without the proper crystals this unit is only marginally useful for mining mercoxit, and highly inefficient for most anything else.

1021675.en:
An electronic interface that augments and enhances a carrier's sensors and defenses by redirecting power from the warp drive.

This results in an increase in both the range and resolution of the ship's targeting. The sensor strength of the ship, as well as its fighter squadrons, is also significantly improved. The ship's enhanced sensor suite also monitors threats, greatly improving shield boosters and armor repairer capacitor efficiency and cycle duration.

The power draw of a Integrated Sensor Array is so great that it prevents the primary warp drive from activating, as well as preventing docking, tethering, and cloaking while the module is active.

Notes: 
Only one Integrated Sensor Array can be fitted to a carrier-class ship.
The shield booster and armor repairer bonuses are only applied to capital-sized modules.
This module can only be fitted to carrier-class ships.

1021891.en:
The core technology employed by Gas Scoops dates back centuries, to a time when the extraction of material in space was still a growing industry. Originally, asteroid miners had seen the tractor beams and in-space catalytic conversions used by today's Gas Scoops as a promising new method for extracting spaceborne ore. After many unsuccessful research projects and years of fruitless experiments however, the industry decided to return its focus to laser technology, which was eventually mastered to a level that has sustained the mining profession to this day.

When the first interstellar Gas Clouds were discovered, they proved particularly challenging for industrialists to extract raw materials from. Many methods were tried, and although successful acquisition was always guaranteed, there was a need for much greater efficiency. It was not until the mining industry returned to long-abandoned projects that a solution was found. Since that time, Gas harvesting technology has slowly moved forward, giving birth to new industries and economies in the process.

1022037.en:
Ever-increasing demand for the products derived from gas cloud resources finally drove yet another breakthrough in gas harvesting technology, with the old scoop tech's integrated tractor beam and gas conversion systems massively overhauled to include broad-sweep beams and high-efficiency, multiplexed catalytic conversion arrays. The large increase in the size of the installed hardware and the power requirements of the equipment has meant that only larger ships can be contemplated as platforms for the new Gas Cloud Harvesters. Given these demands and the advantages of using dedicated mining ships, the practical module designs were soon specialized for use on mining barges and exhumers.

When the first interstellar Gas Clouds were discovered, they proved particularly challenging for industrialists to extract raw materials from. Many methods were tried, and although successful acquisition was always guaranteed, there was a need for much greater efficiency. It was not until the mining industry returned to long-abandoned projects that a solution was found. Since that time, gas harvesting technology has slowly moved forward, giving birth to new industries and economies in the process.

1022428.en:
A spacetime Fracture moves through the site over 20-40 hours. As it passes over Phased Asteroids they breach, and become available to mine. When a Phased Asteroid exits the Fracture it collapses and is no longer mineable.

As the Fracture approaches the 3rd phased asteroid, the site becomes visible on the starmap, and no longer requires scanning to access.

1022430.en: Phased Asteroids have three states: 1 - Latent: Unminable state before the Fracture reaches them. 2 - Breached: inside the Fracture. Breached Phased Asteroids are initially Phased-Out and can only mined with 10% efficiency. They can be Phased-In with a Mobile Phase Anchor to allow mining at 100% efficiency. 3 - Collapsed: Unminable state after being either depleted, or having passed out of the Fracture.

1022642.en:
Frostline Laboratories, a subsidiary division of Outer Ring Excavations, continues to be a leader in the development of new technologies to expedite resource extraction in hostile environments. Filaments acquired from skirmishes with Triglavian Collective vessels have provided a wealth of information to study and emerging metaliminal storms, such as volatile ice storms, are a clear field of interest for resource extraction technologies.

To further the spirit of Yoiul—and continue expanding their data pool—Frostline has chosen to share the latest variants of their transport filaments with capsuleers across New Eden. For a limited time, pilots will be able to use these experimental metaliminal filaments to more quickly travel to locations affected by volatile ice storms across New Eden.

This CPD-10N Nullsec Ice Storm Filament can transport up to ten capsuleers and is configured to limit its range of destinations to volatile ice storms in null-sec space.

1022754.en:
I managed to get us added to their work roster.

You mine like any other member of the crew, make your way towards their system mainframe, hack it, then get out of there.

1022756.en:
Welcome, Miner. 

Hope you’re ready to work, we’ve got a lot to clear out before the site collapses.

1022759.en:
Good, ORE has a job that needs doing, and I only have time for people capable of getting it done. 

My Rorqual and the main crew have the Phased Asteroid covered. Your job is to clear up the Veldspar floating around.

1022760.en:
[Private Comms]

Do as she says, we need these miners to think we’re just part of the crew.

1022761.en:
[Private Comms]

Go mine the asteroid over there. Get us closer to that communication array.

1022800.en: This compact bundle of active nanites can be loaded into a Mining Foreman Burst module and dispersed across allied ships to greatly enhance the precision and efficiency of their mining modules, increasing the chance of critical successes and decreasing the chance of residue for mining lasers. All mining foreman bursts also enable upgraded functionality for any integrated Mining Surveyors on affected ships

1022801.en: So you don’t know what it means any more than we do, huh?

1022802.en:
No, but together we can crack it!

Some of these asteroids contain the isotopes you identified.

1022803.en:
Look for the asteroids with the lowest density.

Bring me the ore from those asteroids, and we shall see what we see.

1022804.en:
You can identify the least dense asteroids using your mining surveyor.

The asteroids we're looking for will appear to be the same size as the others, but contain less ore.

1022805.en: This is quite unexpected; these isotopes were formed in a massive explosion.

1022806.en: How can that be possible? Phased Fields don’t explode, do they?

1022807.en:
Strange indeed. 

Based on their position, I have been able to trace the origin point of the event that created them. Perhaps you will find answers there.

1022808.en: This must be incorrect; these coordinates lead to an Upwell Consortium research base.

1022809.en: This must be incorrect; these coordinates lead to an Upwell Consortium research base.

1022810.en: The coordinates are correct; it must be your assumptions that are wrong.

1022811.en: The coordinates are correct; it must be your assumptions that are wrong.

1022812.en:
Thank you, Jacques. I owe you one. 

Captain, it seems we're done here. Come and see me again, then we can put an end to all of this.

1022815.en:
Get close to that Upwell structure, I’ll pull whatever answers I can.

Some of this debris is blocking your way and there are proximity mines that will explode if you get too close. Use your mining lasers to remove asteroids and clear a safe path.

1022816.en:
We’re here for the truth. Whatever ORE and Upwell did here, it’s the least you owe Sarnai.

How can you be so sure she wouldn't want the world to know?

1022817.en:
Because she died trying to bury it. It's dangerous information in the wrong hands.

You have to trust me. Honor her sacrifice, destroy that structure.

1022820.en:
People deserve to know, Becker.

Captain, I cannot thank you enough. Upwell has the best lawyers in the cluster, but with the evidence out there, the truth might just stand a chance. Grab the proof of transmission from the transmitter and warp out of here.

1022821.en:
Sarnai’s secrets are safe, and at least now I know what happened to her. She deserves to be remembered.

Captain, I cannot thank you enough. Grab the proof of destruction, return to the station, and let’s put this whole tragedy to rest.

1027588.en: Plagioclase is not amongst the most valuable ore types around, but it contains a large amount of Tritanium and is thus always in constant demand. It also yields some Mexallon. Available primarily in high security status star systems.

1027590.en: Spodumain is amongst the most desirable ore types around, as it contains high volumes of the most heavily demanded resource and some amounts of the more precious minerals. Huge volumes of Tritanium and moderate amounts of Isogen, Nocxium, Zydrine and Megacyte can be obtained by refining these rocks.

1027592.en: Kernite is a fairly common ore type that yields fair amounts of Mexallon and Isogen. Available primarily in low and null security status and wormhole systems.

1027594.en: Hedbergite is sought after for its high concentration of Pyerite and Nocxium. Available primarily in low security status star systems.

1027596.en: Arkonor is one of the rarest and most sought-after ores in the known universe. A sizable nugget of this can sweep anyone from rags to riches in no time. It has high amount of Megacyte, and also contains some Mexallon and Pyerite. Available primarily in null security status and wormhole systems.

1027598.en: Appearing en masse during the Drifter Crisis of YC127, tyranite is a s-type asteroid that has been bombarded by low-level blackbody radiation for millennia, turning its silicate-like surface regolith into eleutrium. Astrogeologists claim that this process occurred prior to tyranite asteroids appearing, wholly by unknown means. Due to the unknown conditions of its formation and appearance, astrogeologists fear this may be a unique opportunity. Additionally, its special properties break down when under pressure, making it incompressible. Tyranite is the only known source of eleutrium.

1027600.en: When griemeer was discovered in YC126, it took little time for miners to notice that the darker the crystals, the more isogen and, to a lesser extent, tritanium, it would yield. As it has a slight resemblance in texture to Liparer cheese, those obsessed with mining griemeer have been derisively nicknamed "cheesers" by rivals. Asteroid anomalies in null security space is where griemeer is generally found.

1027602.en: Medium-grade griemeer is characterized by clear crystals that lack the milky whiteness of the common variant, and where the inky black cloudiness of the rarer versions is also absent. However, clear griemeer is still a fortunate find, as it has a 5% increased yield. Asteroid anomalies in null security space is where clear griemeer is generally found.

1027604.en: High-grade griemeer with spots of darkness in its clear crystals is called inky griemeer and boasts a 10% extra yield. Asteroid anomalies in null security space is where inky griemeer is generally found.

1027606.en: Superior-grade griemeer, also called opaque griemeer, is the kind that lets no light through its crystals. Those lucky enough to find some will be rewarded with an additional 15% yield during refinement. Asteroid anomalies in null security space is where opaque griemeer is generally found.

1027608.en: Gneiss is a popular ore type because it holds significant volumes of three heavily used minerals, increasing its utility value. Flawed Gneiss however has the same properties as fools gold, in the sense that it looks like the original but is worth almost nothing in comparison.

1027610.en: Nocxite, discovered in YC126 due to new astrogeological surveying techniques, contains mostly nocxium with trace amounts of tritanium and pyerite. Even trace amounts of nocxite produces intoxicating fumes under atmospheric pressures, demanding special care when being handled planetside. Previous failures to appropriately vent the gasses have resulted in a number of workplace accidents and fatalities. Nocxite may be found in null security asteroid anomalies.

1027612.en: Fragrant or medium-grade nocxite has stronger hints of its intoxicating fumes under typical atmospheric pressure. Additionally, it yields 5% more minerals. Fragrant nocxite may be found in null security asteroid anomalies.

1027614.en: Unstable even in low-pressure environments, high-grade or intoxicating nocxite rewards persistent miners with an additional 10% yield. Intoxicating nocxite may be found in null security asteroid anomalies.

1027616.en: Long-term exposure to superior-grade nocxite at atmospheric pressure has a chance of causing a state of permanent stupor in those handling it akin to ambrosia. Despite the risk, many planetside miners consider the additional 15% return in mineral yield more than worth it. Ambrosial nocxite may be found in null security asteroid anomalies.

1027618.en: Scordite is amongst the most common ore types in the central regions of known universe. It has a fair bit of Tritanium and Pyerite. Good choice for those starting their mining careers. Available primarily in high security status star systems.

1027620.en: Hezorime, discovered in YC126, is a brittle ore that is sure to cut the unwary miner. The harder and sharper the ore, the better the yield. Hezorime refines into mostly zydrine, with small amounts of tritanium and isogen. Hezorime deposits may be found in null security space asteroid anomalies.

1027622.en: With a barely perceptible saw-like edge, miners lucky enough to notice high-grade, or serrated, hezorime will be rewarded for their diligence with an additional 10% yield of minerals. Serrated hezorime deposits may be found in null security space asteroid anomalies.

1027624.en: Superior-grade hezorime should never be handled directly, as it is sharp enough to cut through protective gloves, flesh, and bone with incredible ease. Enterprising miners that are willing to risk fingers and limbs are rewarded with an additional 15% mineral yield. Sharp hezorime deposits may be found in null security space asteroid anomalies.

1027626.en: Ueganite is an ore discovered in YC126 due to improvements in astrogeological surveying technology. It is primarily composed of megacyte, with trace amounts of tritanium. Some miners have posited that ueganite forms when multiple metaliminal storms occur in a single system for an extended period of time, but astrogeologists have dismissed the hypothesis as mere conjecture and superstition based on valuable ueganite having diverse properties reminiscent of these storms. Ueganite may be found in asteroid anomalies within null security space.

1027628.en: It takes a keen eye to notice the tiny deposits that give medium-grade ueganite its foggy appearance. This minor variation indicates that it gives a 5% greater yield than its regular form. Foggy ueganite may be found in asteroid anomalies within null security space.

1027630.en: Overcast ueganite, the high-grade variant of ueganite, has sparkling flecks throughout its composition, but lacks the stormy properties of its rarer variant. It produces an additional 10% mineral yield when refined. Overcast ueganite may be found in asteroid anomalies within null security space.

1027632.en: The sight of its subsurface lightning mineral veins, which gives superior-grade or stormy ueganite its name, brings great joy to any miner. Stormy ueganite yields 15% more minerals than its base form when refined. Stormy ueganite may be found in asteroid anomalies within null security space.

1027634.en: Veldspar is the most common ore type in the central regions of known universe. It is still in constant demand as it holds a large portion of the much-used Tritanium mineral. This material is compressed and a much more compact form of the original material.

1027636.en: This extremely rare and valuable variant of veldspar ore was recently discovered by ORE engineers during early field tests of new moon mining technology. Subsequent testing has confirmed that this ore produces 15% more minerals than standard veldspar when reprocessed. Veldspar is the most common ore type in the central regions of known universe. It is still in constant demand as it holds a large portion of the much-used Tritanium mineral. This material is compressed and a much more compact form of the original material.

Pyroxeres is a common ore available in all regions of space. It has fair amounts of Pyerite and Mexallon. This material is compressed and a much more compact form of the original material.

1027646.en: This extremely rare and valuable variant of pyroxeres ore was recently discovered by ORE engineers during early field tests of new moon mining technology. It has fair amounts of Pyerite and Mexallon. This material is compressed and a much more compact form of the original material.
