1039463.en:
We are passing through Exordium, a max-security space reserved for the development of new capsuleers. 

Security protocols in this region prevent capsuleers from attacking one another, and available opportunities are calibrated appropriately for new pilots.

1039469.en:
As Exordium is dedicated to the orientation of new capsuleers, a variety of jobs are available to help you acclimate to life in New Eden. 

Once you feel sufficiently prepared, you can leave this space in search of more exciting and lucrative opportunities throughout the wider New Eden cluster. 

Of course, said excitement comes with a mildly heightened risk of casualties.

1039478.en:
Exordium is governed by the CONCORD Assembly, a neutral organization in charge of policing high-security systems. 

They manage the central constellations in collaboration with AIR, while the four great empires of New Eden represent themselves in adjacent embassy constellations.

1039483.en:
You are now in the Federation Free-Zone, an embassy constellation of the Gallente Federation.

The Gallente Federation is a democratic union of many cultures governed by an elected senate and president. They are embroiled in a long-standing conflict with the Caldari State, but CONCORD protocols prevent outright war in Exordium.

1039484.en:
You are now in the Crucible, an embassy constellation for the Caldari State.

The Caldari State is a stoic nation governed by powerful megacorporations. They have been locked in war with the Gallente since their secession from the Federation, but protocols are in place to keep the greater conflict out of Exordium.

1039486.en:
You have entered Strokar, an embassy constellation for the Minmatar Republic. 

The Minmatar Republic is a confederation of seven tribes who broke free from Amarr control during the Great Rebellion. They have since stood united in conflict against the Amarr Empire, however CONCORD protocols prevent the fight from reaching Exordium.

This is Haven, an embassy constellation of the Amarr Empire.

The Amarr Empire is a theocratic monarchy ruled over by their Holy Empress. They believe their divine purpose is to spread their faith at any cost, which has resulted in a forever war with the Minmatar Republic. CONCORD protocols are in place to keep Exordium safe from the broader conflict.

1039504.en: Subcapital Operations Expert System This Expert System has been loaded with advanced ship operation skills, to mimic the experience of an Omega capsuleer. An Expert System is a remote, restricted artificial intelligence providing you with access to certain skills during the active 1 day rental period. As it is independent from your clone and your capsule, an active Expert System is not lost on pod death or clone jump. Activating an Expert System Activation of an Expert System is automatic upon redemption of the item by the specific capsuleer intending to use the service. Expert Systems are a product developed by the PKN Interstellar consortium, made available over the HyperNet FTL communications network, and marketed by PKN Interstellar member corporations. An Expert System is a restricted AI based on artificial gelbrain technology. As the Expert System uses neural pathways based on those created by skill training or skill injection, it is compatible with capsule-ship interface and control systems. Real time command and control communication is achieved using dedicated FTL channels on PKN Interstellar's HyperNet.

The Amarr were the first of the surviving major faction to return to the stars following the EVE Gate’s collapse. According to their religion, it is their destiny to “reclaim” the stars of New Eden.

1039672.en:
The Minmatar were an interstellar civilization long before being enslaved by the Amarr. They colonized planets using near-light-speed drives of their own design and by rediscovering stargates that predated the collapse of the EVE Gate.

According to archaeologists, humans arrived through the EVE Gate over fifteen thousand years ago. When the Gate collapsed, so did their civilization including multiple colonies on the planet Matar. It was their descendants who would found the tribes of the Minmatar.

1039673.en:
The Caldari state may be small, but it is also at the forefront of the industry and innovation. This is despite an early industrial society when they were discovered by Gallente.

According to archeologist, humans first arrived through the EVE Gate over fifteen thousand years ago. When the Gate collapsed, so did their civilisation. Over the millenia that followed the Caldari founded a new civilisation based on the principles of duty, loyalty and honor.

1039675.en:
After the collapse of the EVE Gate, humanity was scattered and isolated. Once they rediscovered space travel, the Gallente began contacting those living on other planets.

According to archaeologists, the first settlers arrived through the EVE Gate over fifteen thousand years ago. When the Gate collapsed, so did their civilization. It would be millennia later that the Gallente united isolated fragments of humanity to form the Federation.

1039729.en: To experience the Amarr perspective on the Great Rebellion, you entered a simulation of the Battle of Golgothan Fields. Fresh from Jovian defeat, you helped a Dreadnought get back in the fight and take on the Minmatar. Sacrificing it all to claim victory, you proved the power of Amarrian faith.

1039730.en: The Amarr have invited you to relive their historic battle with the Minmatar at the Golgothan Fields. Travel to the simulation site and follow the instructions to be a part of this historic epic.

1039731.en: Empress be praised. Make your way to the simulation site. We will discuss further once you arrive.

1039732.en:
Witness our inevitable destiny and our rightful dominion over the stars. This simulation is a pale mirror of the glorious light of that destiny, and yet it shines so bright.

Travel to the simulation site, and I shall instruct you as you feel the power of our faith.

1039737.en: In the most recent of the simulated settings, you fought alongside the Federation fleet that liberated Intaki. Taking out Caldari defenses, you helped free the people of Intaki from megacorporate control.

1039738.en: The Gallente have invited you to join them in a simulation of the Liberation of Intaki. Travel to the simulation site and follow the instructions to fight for freedom side by side with the Federation.

1039739.en: Nice. Make your way to the simulation site. I will meet you there.

1039740.en:
Fight for freedom in this simulation where you’ll learn just what it means to be on the right side of history.

Travel to the simulation sire, and let’s go on a journey of justice together.

1039741.en:
The fight for freedom is a never-ending one.

Join our campaigns and serve justice, or enlist at one of our militia offices and fight the good fight.

1039742.en: That’s your choice, and I respect it. Come back when you’re ready to fight for your freedom.

1039743.en:
The battle for freedom is a battle we must fight every day. In this simulation, you’ll learn just what it means to fight on the right side of history.

Travel to the simulation site, and let’s go on a journey of justice together.

1039744.en: That’s your choice, and I respect it. Come back when you’re ready to fight for your freedom.

1039745.en: You entered a simulation of the Caldari’s exodus from Caldari Prime. You faced down the Gallente Federation, fought alongside a hero from Caldari history, and helped the people of Caldari escape to a new home.

1039746.en: The Caldari have invited you to experience their proudest and darkest day. Make your way to the simulation site and follow the instructions to see what it was like to be a part of the Caldari Breakout.

1039748.en: Excellent. Make your way to the simulation site. I will contact you on arrival.

1039749.en:
The Caldari State invites you to experience why we fight, and why you should join us. Learn the meaning of honor, of duty, of what it means to be Caldari, as you experience our greatest loss and our most epic triumph.

Travel to the simulation site. Once you arrive, we will speak again.

1039750.en:
Now you understand what we have lost and what we fight for still.

When you are ready to earn your honor, search out our campaigns or our militia offices.

1039751.en: Understood. Return when you are ready to learn the meaning of honor.

1039752.en:
The Caldari State welcomes your interest in our history. This experience will show you why we fight, and why you should join us. Learn the meaning of honor, of duty, of what it means to be Caldari, as you experience our greatest loss and our most epic triumph.

Travel to the simulation site. Once you arrive, we will speak again.

1039753.en: Understood. Return when you are ready to learn the meaning of honor.

1039754.en: Entering a simulation of the Minmatar’s past, you took part in the Battle of Pator. You fought Imperial occupiers and faced down a supercarrier in a deadly battle. Ultimately, you defeated the Amarr and reclaimed the planet of Matar for the Matari.

1039755.en: The Minmatar have invited you to experience the Battle of Pator firsthand. Make your way to the simulation site and follow the instructions to experience the liberation of their homeworld.

1039756.en: Well chosen. Make your way to the simulation site. I will see you there.

1039757.en:
Heritage is at the heart of what it means to be Minmatar. Join us in a simulation of the day our Republic was born, the legendary Battle of Pator.

Travel to the simulation site. I will explain more once you arrive.

1039758.en:
Much has changed since that day, but much has not. We are the Matari, and this is our Republic.

If you are ready to continue the fight for liberation, keep an eye out for our campaigns or find our militia offices.

1039759.en: A shame. Matar calls, I hope you will one day see the wisdom of answering.

1039760.en:
Understanding heritage is at the heart of what it means to be Minmatar. Join us in a simulation of the day our Republic was born, the legendary Battle of Pator.

Travel to the simulation site. I will explain more once you arrive.

1039761.en: A shame. Matar calls, I hope you will one day see the wisdom of answering.

1039762.en:
Do you seek re-instruction?

The Amarr have invited you to relive their historic battle with the Minmatar at the Golgothan Fields. Travel to the simulation site and follow the instructions to be a part of this historic epic.

1039764.en:
Wait a minute, Captain. Your ship is missing modules recommended for this simulation. I suggest you fit a weapon, a Remote Armour Repairer, and an Energy Neutralizer. 

You can find some of these modules in the crate Supplies: Golgothan Fields.

1039765.en:
At the Golgothan Fields in Ennur, the faithful stood their ground against the forces of insurrection, that self-styled “Great Rebellion” of the Minmatar.

Enter the simulation and stand by their side now, know what it is to be counted amongst the righteous.

1039766.en: This simulation run has already been completed. Travel to the next agent to continue your progress through our holographic reenactments.

1039767.en:
Blessings, Captain, I guess you’re my support?

Help me get this Dreadnought repaired so we can join the fray.

1039768.en:
Wait a minute, Captain. Your ship is missing modules recommended for this simulation. I suggest you fit a weapon, a Remote Shield Booster module, and an ECM. 

You can find some of these modules in the crate Supplies: Caldari Prime Breakout.

1039769.en:
Captain, ahead you will experience the Caldari’s greatest triumph… and our most bitter loss.

Enter and understand why it is the Caldari State that deserves your loyalty.

1039771.en:
Caldari Prime, located within the system of Luminaire. Our home.

For the crime of trying to break free from Gallente Federation control, it has suffered devastating bombardment. Now our only hope of survival is to flee.

1039772.en:
Wait a minute, Captain. Your ship is missing modules recommended for this simulation. I suggest you fit a weapon, a Sensor Dampner, and load the drones provided. 

You can find some of the Sensor Dampner and drones in the crate Supplies: Liberation of Intaki.

1039773.en:
The Federation is a nation born of many peoples from many planets. We protect their equality, their rights, their freedom.

In the simulation ahead, you will see how we are willing to do whatever it takes to guarantee those freedoms.

1039775.en: Intaki Prime is in sight. Occupying forces have the planet surrounded, but they’re not ready to go up against the Gallente when there’s liberation in the air.

1039776.en:
Wait a minute, Captain. Your ship is missing modules recommended for this simulation. I suggest you fit a weapon, a Data Analyzer, and a Target Painter. 

You can find some of these modules in the crate Supplies: Battle of Pator.

1039778.en:
Captain, do you copy? Fleet is in position, hidden in the shadow of Pator IX. 

Hack those turrets, and we’ll be able to warp in.

1039779.en:
Hey there, looking for a refresh?

The Gallente have invited you to join them in a simulation of the Liberation of Intaki. Travel to the simulation site and follow the instructions to fight for freedom side by side with the Federation.

1039780.en:
We invite you to witness our greatest day, the day on which we took our planet back. 

Pass into the simulation, feel the pride of the Matari, and you would be foolish not to embrace our Republic.

1039781.en:
You have returned? So be it.

The Caldari have invited you to experience their proudest and darkest day. Make your way to the simulation site and follow the instructions to see what it was like to be a part of the Caldari Breakout.

1039782.en:
Welcome back. Need a reminder?

The Minmatar have invited you to experience the Battle of Pator firsthand. Make your way to the simulation site and follow the instructions to experience the liberation of their homeworld.

1040216.en: Curb the rise of Rogue Drones and unlock new technological frontiers by helping to build the infrastructure necessary to research these dangerous intelligences en masse.

1040217.en: President Alix Moreau has signed the Rogue Edge executive order, establishing the Federation’s most ambitious research project to date. Its goal: the mastery of Rogue Drone technology. Our President was elected on a promise to replace ignorance with intelligence. Thanks to their innovative thinking, a new research initiative in partnership with CreoDron aims to harness Rogue advancements for the good of the Federation. If we are successful, new infrastructure not possible with our current technology will become possible, such as faster travel between Intaki and Dodixie. Success will require military testing, a flood of new data, an efficient industry, and the utmost security. Together, we can build a better future and gain a unique edge over the enemies of freedom.

1040218.en: Our President, Alix Moreau, has confirmed it. Thanks to your hard work, Operation Rogue Edge has been a huge success! Those naysayers who insisted that experimenting with Rogue Drone tech would be a disaster have been put in their place, a new advanced drone has been made available thanks to your efforts. In addition, superior automated infrastructure support has allowed for the construction of even faster transit from our economic heartland to the frontlines. This is a victory for the Federation and the bold future it promises.

1040219.en: The Senate has voted to cancel Operation Rogue Edge due to insufficient results. This is a sad loss for President Moreau’s flagship policy. The politicians feel the new shorter transit route to Dodixie was far too expensive for the small infrastructure improvement it represents. To make matters worse, ORE has scooped the drone improvements that we have spent months trying to develop. But as our President said when she was elected, “every triumph and every failure has been a teacher.” Let us embrace this failure as a teacher and move into the future with greater purpose and insight. Tomorrow is a new day, and it is up to us to seize it for the Federation.

1040917.en: New gates are constructed between Renyn and Jufvitte, shortening the route between Intaki and Dodixie to 6 jumps where all the systems on this planned new path belong to the Federation. A new low-waste variant of the Excavator drone is developed and made available in the Federal Defense Union and the Federation Navy Loyalty Point Stores.

1040918.en: Only able to construct gates between Renyn and Ellmay, reducing the distance between Intaki and Dodixie to 9 jumps while still keeping the new route fully in the Federation territory. ORE beats the Federation to developing the new low-waste variant of the Excavator drone, making it available via ORE Loyalty Point Stores.

1040927.en: Bring glory to the Amarrian economy and elevate the Emperor Family Academy station in Amarr to a true home of sanctified commerce. Make it a shining light of holy prosperity envied throughout the cluster.

1040928.en: Our Holy Empress Catiz I has tasked us with bringing glory to the material lives of those who have dedicated their spirits to the Lord. It is our task to elevate the economic power of the Amarr by building a most Blessed Exchange. Our Empire requires the security of gold. Jita, that pit of profane greed, has slipped through the Caldari’s clutches. As they falter, we shall rise. The Emperor Family Academy in Amarr shall become home to a specialist Deaconry, ushering in a new age of prosperity. Through that prosperity we shall see increased military funding and the development of new modules for our Navy. All ye faithful must clear the way for this glorious work. Cast out the heretics, put our enemies to flame, explore every corner of creation, build a magnificent industry, and become our Empress' will manifest.

1040929.en: Establish the Deaconry of Economic Oversight around the Amarr VIII (Oris) - Emperor Family Academy station. 6 month 50% reduction in Taxes & Broker Fees inside Amarr VIII (Oris) - Emperor Family Academy station. New Imperial issue tackling modules become available in the Amarr Navy and 24th Imperial Crusade LP stores.

1040930.en: Incomplete Deaconry of Economic Oversight around the Amarr VIII (Oris) - Emperor Family Academy station. 3 month 50% reduction in Taxes & Broker Fees inside Amarr VIII (Oris) - Emperor Family Academy station.

1040931.en: Bask in the might of the faithful, and the manifest glory of our Lord’s intent. The Deaconry of Economic Oversight will ensure glory is brought to our Blessed Exchange, bringing prosperity to the chosen. In her great wisdom, the Empress Catiz I has granted a reprieve on taxation to all who trade within the Amarr VIII (Oris) - Emperor Family Academy station. Thanks to the new influx of wealth, our Navy has also made new modules available at Loyalty Point stores. Take to your ships and make the pilgrimage home to the system of Amarr. Partake in holy commerce and bask in the majesty of our Lord’s bounty.

1040932.en: Winter falls, and our faith must weather its coming. Our labors have not been enough to secure the prosperity our Empress deserves. In Amarr, the Deaconry lies incomplete, a testament to our shame. To alleviate the pressure placed on our industries by this endeavor, our merciful Empress has authorized a short-term reduction in taxation within the Amarr VIII (Oris) - Emperor Family Academy. These challenging times are a test placed before us by the Lord. From winter will come spring, and it is in the darkest nights that our light must shine the brightest. Smite our enemies, build back our industry, and hold true to the heavenly promise of Amarr.

1040934.en: Secure strategic control over the Syndicate region to both enable the construction of a direct stargate connection to the Caldari warzone and crush the treacherous Intaki Syndicate.

1040935.en: Nothing will stand in the way of the Caldari State when it goes to war. The Chief Executive Panel has mandated that all who are loyal to Caldari must aid in cutting a path through Syndicate so that resources can be delivered directly to the war zone. Total control over the Syndicate region is the only way to guarantee a reliable path for State Forces. The claws of the criminal Intaki Syndicate are still buried in the region they once claimed. Their dishonor can only be met with discipline; the time has come to bring the last of the treacherous Syndicate to heel. To all who hear this, it is your duty to do whatever is needed to complete this great endeavor. Harvest, build, explore, and destroy those who stand against us. You shall not accept failure, and neither shall the State.

1040936.en: New Stargates are constructed linking Ienakkamon to T-LIWS The Intaki Syndicate is dissolved, and its member corporations are absorbed into the Caldari State. Some of the Intaki Syndicate LP offers become available in the State Protectorate Loyalty Point Store.

1040937.en: New Stargates in Ienakkamon and T-LIWS remain incomplete. The Intaki Syndicate seeks refuge, and its member corporations are absorbed into the Gallente Federation. Some of the Intaki Syndicate LP offers become available in the Federal Defense Union Loyalty Point Store.

1040938.en: The corridor has opened, and through it the strength of the Caldari flows. Those loyal to the State have delivered a mastery over Syndicate and broken the organization that once rivaled us for control. Their institutions have sworn loyalty to the State and their criminal past is at an end. This region remains a dangerous place, but face that danger knowing that you have brought honor to your megacorporations and your State.

1040939.en: This outcome is… unacceptable. Syndicate remains too wild for our corridor project to be completed. The treacherous Intaki Syndicate has found refuge in the arms of the Federation. Now our greatest enemy has wormed their way into a region that is rightfully ours. Do not suffer this dishonor; wipe it clean with a hail of railgun fire. The Federation's latest lapdogs will not stand against unbreakable Caldari resolve. Carry out your duty with honor; defeat only comes to those who surrender.

1040941.en: Restore the Starkmanir to their historic worlds and boost the Republic’s Industry in the process. Reclaim Arzad and Ezzara for the Republic, returning Arzad II to its true title, Starkman Prime.

1040942.en: Before the Darkest Day, our ancestors took to the stars. The Starkmanir Tribe was so dedicated to our future that they built a new home on a distant planet. The Amarr tried to take that future, and when the Starkmanir resisted, the Empire all but destroyed them. For centuries, this crime has been allowed to stand, but no longer. The time has come to restore the Starkmanir and bring about a new age of prosperity for the Republic. If restored, their ancient knowledge could be the key to understanding the changing astral topography of New Eden. Hackers, engineers, guardians, and soldiers, the tribes of Matar call on you. Together, we shall take back our lands, erase the lie that is Arzad II, and reinstate Starkman Prime. Let the new dawn of the Starkmanir light our way to glory.

1040943.en: Rename Arzad II to Starkman Prime. The sovereignty of the Arzad and Ezzara systems will change from Amarr to Minmatar. A new Starkmanir Tribe station is constructed in Arzad. The Starkmanir uncover new Phased Fields in Minmatar high-security space.

1040944.en: The Amarr build a landmark to their control in Arzad.

1040945.en: I speak to you from the surface of Starkman Prime. This once lush world still bears the scars of the terrible crimes committed by its former occupiers. Yet, from beneath that rubble, Starkmanir archaeologists are retrieving long-lost information about New Eden. Information on how not just how this planet has changed, but how the stars and the spacetime itself around New Eden have shifted over the centuries. An age of discovery lies before us, built on ancient foundations. Be proud, children of Matar. No matter your tribe, this is our legacy, our new beginning.

1040946.en: Our past and the truths it may hold remain shrouded in darkness. We mourn, Starkman Prime has been lost anew. The Amarr have constructed a monument to our failures. They are foolish if they believe this mockery will cause the Tribes of Matar to lose heart. Look past the lie that is Arzad II. The legacy of the Starkmanir lives on in us all, and no Empire can ever conquer our spirits.

1041853.en:
Many sacrificed themselves that day, but in the end, the battle was won. 

The Minmatar rebellion would go on, but it is but a thorn in the side of our vast and glorious empire.

1041854.en: From those humble origins, we built the mighty Caldari State. Though we lost our home that day, we vowed to one day return and take back all that was ours.

1041855.en: We may come from different worlds, but we are one Gallente, and we will bring freedom to this cluster at any cost.

1041856.en:
That day changed everything. There would be other battles fought, but after the liberation of Matar, our rebellion could not be stopped.

Yet still today, not all our people are free, and our war of liberation wages on.

1041889.en: All transports entering warp. Incredible work.

1041890.en:
The full force of the Gallente fleet is on us!

Protect the megacorp transports, destroy the invaders. Surrender is not an option.

1041891.en: Use the time I have bought you well. Protect each other, destroy every Federation lakey, carve a path to our future.

1041892.en:
Glorious, practically good as new.

And within this flame, the Lord found faith renewed.

So sayeth Gheinok the First 1:3.

Follow me, Captain, we’re heading into the belly of this rebellious beast.

1041893.en:
Time to bring righteous flame to these unbelievers!

Destroy all hostiles that come our way, let us show them the might of the Lord!

1041894.en:
Swift justice delivered! Excellent work, Captain

We’ve cleared out this wing, searching for our next target.

1041899.en:
I must prepare the final assault.

I need you to head in first, neutralize their vessels to weaken their shields.

1041900.en:
This is the free people of Intaki, ready to fight alongside the Federation!

The Caldari are filling their haulers with our priceless cultural artifacts. We are pinned down by their ground troops and are helpless to stop them.

Please, stop those Megacorporation Haulers before they escape!

1041901.en:
Our Erebus-class titan vessel is en route. 

Sensor dampen those cannons to protect its approach.

1041912.en: Acceleration gate technology reaches far back to the expansion era of the empires that survived the great EVE gate collapse. While their individual setup might differ in terms of ship size they can transport and whether they require a certain passkey or code to be used, all share the same fundamental function of hurling space vessels to a destination beacon within solar system boundaries.

1042310.en: “Peace is a fragile thing, and today we held the line.” - DED Star Marshal Kjersidur Elladall

1042312.en:
The Amarr Empire has been exploiting lava planets for the rich resources to be had from the constant churn of magma for ages past. The vast territories controlled by the Amarr contain hundreds of such planets and the expertise of their planetary extraction engineers in the field of lava planet mining is well known across New Eden.

Empress Catiz I's own family, House Tash-Murkon, has considerable interests in the mining industries and is noted for its extensive harvesting of resources from the many lava planets it directly controls through its regional fief. The "Lavacore Imperial" nanocoating is testament to the flaming riches of the Amarr Empire's lava planets and the vast wealth that the Empress herself has derived from such worlds.

1042500.en: Capsuleer Day YC128 Expert System This Expert System makes available skills enabling a capsuleer to fly T2 assault frigates. The temporary skills provided by this Expert System last for seven days. An Expert System is a remote, restricted artificial intelligence providing you with access to certain skills during the active rental period. As it is independent from your clone and your capsule, an active Expert System is not lost on pod death or clone jump. Activating an Expert System Activation of an Expert System is automatic upon redemption of the item by the specific capsuleer intending to use the service. Expert Systems are a product developed by the PKN Interstellar consortium, made available over the HyperNet FTL communications network, and marketed by PKN Interstellar member corporations. An Expert System is a restricted AI based on artificial gelbrain technology. As the Expert System uses neural pathways based on those created by skill training or skill injection, it is compatible with capsule-ship interface and control systems. Real time command and control communication is achieved using dedicated FTL channels on PKN Interstellar's HyperNet.

1043144.en:
An Elite Mercenary willing to work for any faction during the Warpath conflict.

Captain Angela Babout was one of the Federation’s most decorated pilots. During the conflict of YC112 she was part of the assault that took out the titan Shiigeru above her home planet of Caldari Prime. After witnessing the devastation that its collision with the planet caused, she quit the Navy and became a Mercenary.

1043145.en:
An Elite Mercenary willing to work for any faction during the Warpath conflict.

Yoshi Rurik found himself destitute and in debt after the corp he was contracted was shuttered due to dishonorable dealings. Refusing to accept death, he fought his way out of the gutter and built a new life from blood and iron.

1043148.en:
An Elite Mercenary willing to work for any faction during the Warpath conflict.

Born in the Amarr Empire, but of Matari heritage, Orlando Oran won back his freedom through military service. Once he was free, he was not interested in tying himself to a clan he did not know or tribe he had never felt connected to. Instead, he chose the ultimate freedom of life as a freelancer.

1043149.en:
An Elite Mercenary willing to work for any faction during the Warpath conflict.

Not many Thukkers leave the Great Wildlands to enlist in the Republic Fleet, but Commander Lucan Rourke was never one to follow the herd. While at first he was seen as a daring maverick by his commanding officers, he was eventually discharged when the top brass began to see him as more of an unhinged lunatic.

1043150.en:
An Elite Mercenary willing to work for any faction during the Warpath conflict.

Commodore Julienne Ortega is something of a strategic prodigy, having graduated from the Federal Navy Academy at 17. She was assigned to intelligence analysis, but became increasingly frustrated by the lack of action and the limited thinking of her peers. Eventually, she resigned her commission and took up as a mercenary rather than remain stuck behind a desk.

1043151.en:
An Elite Mercenary willing to work for any faction during the Warpath conflict.

Rumors circulate that Kuma was raised by Storm Bears in the wilds of Caldari Prime, and this is why she cannot speak. They say that she mastered human weapons after hunters killed her adopted family and that now she accepts ISK as a means to enact her revenge on the species that took everything from her. While the rumors may be false, her deadly fury is an undeniable fact.

1043152.en:
An Elite Mercenary willing to work for any faction during the Warpath conflict.

Thomasina Razili grew up as that rarest of things, an atheist Amarr holder. When she could no longer stomach pretending that she shared her family’s faith, she stole a ship and left to build a life grounded in logic and reason. That this life ended up being structured around violence may, however, be more a result of her personal predilections than any core tenets of rational thinking.

1043153.en:
An Elite Mercenary willing to work for any faction during the Warpath conflict.

After the devastation of her home planet of Turnur, Nora Lilja became for a became a part of the Ashes of Turnur anti-technology crusade. Once her rage subsided, however, she began to clash with the group's thinking and reject its teachings. Still feeling unmoored from the Republic, she chose to go it alone, putting her skills to use for anyone with the ISK to pay for them.

1043154.en:
An Elite Mercenary willing to work for any faction during the Warpath conflict.

A former Serpentis executive, Markos Ruud joined the Federation Navy after his entire family died in an industrial accident caused by the corporation’s cavalier attitude to health and safety. An unwavering devotee to his own moral code, Ruud is not a mercenary by design, but he uses his knowledge of Serpentis vessels to earn the capital he needs to enact his revenge.

1043155.en:
An Elite Mercenary willing to work for any faction during the Warpath conflict.

Despite once being their greatest warrior, Mara Thorrun’s obsession with Angel Cartel technology ostracised her from the rest of her clan. Now she fights for ISK, but it is the chance to kill with her beloved vessels that is her real reward.

1043158.en:
An Elite Mercenary willing to work for any faction during the Warpath conflict.

Walid Talman is sure beyond a shadow of doubt that he is a true Savant of the Sani Sabik. It brings him great rage that the priests of his faith do not agree, citing his mercantile obsession with the profane as proof that he is not a chosen soul. He has left the order to prove his worthiness at any cost, ignoring the irony that this action may just prove his detractors right.

1043159.en:
An Elite Mercenary willing to work for any faction during the Warpath conflict.

Sasha Yosuke was born a True Citizen of Sansha’s Nation. After realizing the true horror of their people, they fled. Now they work as a mercenary to earn the money they need to build up their own totalitarian dictatorship “the right way”, without mind control.

An Elite Mercenary willing to work for any faction during the Warpath conflict.

Rumors circulate that Kuma was raised by Storm Bears in the wilds of Caldari Prime, and this is why she cannot speak. They say that she mastered human weapons after hunters killed her adopted family and that now she accepts ISK as a means to enact her revenge on the species that took everything from her. While the rumors may be false, her deadly fury is an undeniable fact.

1043184.en:
An Elite Mercenary willing to work for any faction during the Warpath conflict.

Commodore Julienne Ortega is something of a strategic prodigy, having graduated from the Federal Navy Academy at 17. She was assigned to intelligence analysis, but became increasingly frustrated by the lack of action and the limited thinking of her peers. Eventually, she resigned her commission and took up as a mercenary rather than remain stuck behind a desk.

1043185.en:
An Elite Mercenary willing to work for any faction during the Warpath conflict.

After the devastation of her home planet of Turnur, Nora Lilja became for a became a part of the Ashes of Turnur anti-technology crusade. Once her rage subsided, however, she began to clash with the group's thinking and reject its teachings. Still feeling unmoored from the Republic, she chose to go it alone, putting her skills to use for anyone with the ISK to pay for them.

1043186.en:
An Elite Mercenary willing to work for any faction during the Warpath conflict.

A former Serpentis executive, Markos Ruud joined the Federation Navy after his entire family died in an industrial accident caused by the corporation’s cavalier attitude to health and safety. An unwavering devotee to his own moral code, Ruud is not a mercenary by design, but he uses his knowledge of Serpentis vessels to earn the capital he needs to enact his revenge.

1043187.en:
An Elite Mercenary willing to work for any faction during the Warpath conflict.

Sasha Yosuke was born a True Citizen of Sansha’s Nation. After realizing the true horror of their people, they fled. Now they work as a mercenary to earn the money they need to build up their own totalitarian dictatorship “the right way”, without mind control.

1043190.en:
An Elite Mercenary willing to work for any faction during the Warpath conflict.

Walid Talman is sure beyond a shadow of doubt that he is a true Savant of the Sani Sabik. It brings him great rage that the priests of his faith do not agree, citing his mercantile obsession with the profane as proof that he is not a chosen soul. He has left the order to prove his worthiness at any cost, ignoring the irony that this action may just prove his detractors right.

1043200.en:
An Elite Mercenary willing to work for any faction during the Warpath conflict.

Despite once being their greatest warrior, Mara Thorrun’s obsession with Angel Cartel technology ostracized her from the rest of her clan. Now she fights for ISK, but it is the chance to kill with her beloved vessels that is her real reward.

1043207.en:
An Elite Mercenary willing to work for any faction during the Warpath conflict.

Captain Angela Babout was one of the Federation’s most decorated pilots. During the conflict of YC112 she was part of the assault that took out the titan Shiigeru above her home planet of Caldari Prime. After witnessing the devastation that its collision with the planet caused, she quit the Navy and became a Mercenary.

1043208.en:
An Elite Mercenary willing to work for any faction during the Warpath conflict.

Born in the Amarr Empire, but of Matari heritage, Orlando Oran won back his freedom through military service. Once he was free, he was not interested in tying himself to a clan he did not know or tribe he had never felt connected to. Instead, he chose the ultimate freedom of life as a freelancer.

1043209.en:
An Elite Mercenary willing to work for any faction during the Warpath conflict.

Not many Thukkers leave the Great Wildlands to enlist in the Republic Fleet, but Commander Lucan Rourke was never one to follow the herd. While at first he was seen as a daring maverick by his commanding officers, he was eventually discharged when the top brass began to see him as more of an unhinged lunatic.

1043210.en:
An Elite Mercenary willing to work for any faction during the Warpath conflict.

Yoshi Rurik found himself destitute and in debt after the corp he was contracted was shuttered due to dishonorable dealings. Refusing to accept death, he fought his way out of the gutter and built a new life from blood and iron.

1043354.en:
An electronic interface designed to augment and enhance a marauder's siege abilities. Through a series of electromagnetic polarity field shifts, the bastion module diverts energy from the ship's propulsion and warp systems to lend additional power to its defensive and offensive capabilities.

This results in a greatly increased rate of defensive self-sustenance and a boost to the ship's overall damage resistances. It also extends the reach of all the vessel's weapon systems and their rate of fire, allowing it to engage targets at farther ranges. 

As a side effect of the ionic field created by the bastion module, beneficial remote repair and capacitor transfer effects are ineffective against the fitted ship while the module is active.

In addition, the lack of power to mobility subsystems means that neither standard propulsion nor warp travel are available to the ship, nor is it allowed to dock or jump until out of bastion mode.

Note: Only one bastion module can be fitted to a marauder-class ship. The increased shield boosting and armor repairing gained from the bastion module is subject to a stacking penalty when used with other modules that affect the same attribute on the ship.

Rapid Heavy Missile Launchers are not affected by bastion modules.

1043415.en:
This Republic Interstellar Shipcaster is the result of the Minmatar Republic’s efforts to develop Triglavian transport relay technology into a working strategic asset in the Amarr-Minmatar militia warzone. Positioned in the Republic theater HQ system of Amo, this Interstellar Shipcaster is capable of linking to up to three Republic Shipcaster Beacons anywhere in the warzone, and sending Minmatar forces, including Tribal Liberation Force militia warriors, to the designated locations.

Constructed by the Minmatar Republic after a dedicated campaign by Republican loyalist capsuleers to the acquire and develop Triglavian transport relay technology, matching its already mature stellar technology development, the Republic Interstellar Shipcaster is the transport hub of a Shipcaster network powered by a Republic Stellar Transmuter. 

Interacting with this Republic Interstellar Shipcaster will permit capsuleers aligned to the Minmatar Republic to select one of the destinations beacons currently linked as a travel destination. The Interstellar Shipcaster charges for transport to each beacon in turn before becoming active for launch of capsuleers to a destination. Interstellar Shipcaster travel is a long-range but one-way method of transport. ( copy )

1043637.en:
Secure as many complexes as possible within the operational window to maximise rewards.

<u>Status Descriptions</u>
<color="#FFFF454B">Capturing</color>: Only hostile forces are present; will be lost at 0% progress.
<color="#FFF39058">Contested</color>: Both friendly and hostile forces are present; progress is stalled.
<color="#FF58A7BF">Defending</color>: Only friendly forces are present; will be secured at 100% progress.
<color="#FFFF454B">Lost</color>: Captured by hostile forces; can no longer be secured.
<color="#FF58A7BF">Secured</color>: Defended by friendly forces; can no longer be lost.
<color="#FFFFFFFF">Uncontested</color>: Neither friendly nor hostile forces are present; progress is stalled.

Note: Interact with progress bars to quickly warp between complexes.

1045646.en:
Now you understand what we have lost and what we fight for still.

When you are ready to earn your honor, search out our campaigns or our militia offices.

1045652.en:
Much has changed since that day, but much has not. We are the Matari, and this is our Republic.

If you are ready to continue the fight for liberation, keep an eye out for our campaigns or find our militia offices.

1045653.en:
You have borne witness to the true meaning of faith, the strength it grants, and the sacrifice it demands.

If you are ready to stand for our holy Empress, seek out our campaigns or enlist at one of our militia offices.

1045654.en:
The fight for freedom is a never-ending one.

Join our campaigns and serve justice, or enlist at one of our militia offices and fight the good fight.

1045655.en:
I hope you are ready to extract yourself from that den of heretics. 

I am Captain Marshal Sirdan xer Qosh, defender of the faith. Join me now in Amarr space, and we shall shine a light on whatever lies the Minmatar have told you.

1045656.en:
Welcome to the constellation of Haven, home to the missionary work of the holy Amarr Empire within Exoridum.

Feel free to bask in the sacred glory of the Empire as you make your way to me.

1045657.en:
I am Executive General Heika Torigo of the Caldari State.

AIR has alerted us that you are on your way. The State is happy to receive any honorable applicants

1045658.en:
Welcome to Crucible, the Caldari Embassy constellation in Exordium.

I have no doubt that you will be suitably impressed by the honor and discipline our megacorporations have imposed here.

1045659.en:
Capsuleer, this is Vice Admiral Foriana Revelli. We got word you are on your way over to Gallente space.

I’ll put some quafe on ice for you, see you soon.

1045660.en:
Welcome to the Federation Free-Zone, our little oasis of democracy here in Exordium.

Drop by when you’re ready, briefing room is all set up.

1045661.en:
Greetings, Captain. I am Hetman General Kanth Filmir, the tribes of the Minmatar Republic are ready to receive you.

May your journey be swift and untroubled.

1045662.en:
This is Strokar, a refuge for the clans of the Minmatar here within Exordium.

We are happy to extend the hospitality of our tribes during your visit, as long as you pay the Republic the respect it is due.

1045665.en:
Captain, confirming your arrival at Caldari Prime orbital point gamma. 

Pinging dispatch, let's get some clarity on the status of the megacorp transports near your position.

1045666.en:
Receiving your transmission, Admiral. 

Transports have suffered a warp malfunction en route to the main fleet. Repairs are underway.

1045667.en:
Hostiles on scan! Gallente en route to your position.

You need to protect those megacorp transports. Jam the invader’s sensors until the transports are able to escape.

1045668.en: Protect as many as you can; every transport defended means thousands of innocents saved.

1045669.en: You have done your duty well, Captain. Let those Federation lap dogs choke on their frustration.

1045670.en: The remaining transports are entering warp. They send you their deepest gratitude.

1045671.en: Each Caldari saved is a victory, each loss an honored sacrifice.

1045672.en: All the transports have been destroyed; no signs of life detected. Our enemy is without honor or mercy.

1045673.en: Return to the main fleet when ready. The time for our final departure is at hand.

1045674.en:
Welcome back to the fleet. 

Departure is on hold while civilian ships resupply.

1045675.en: Take a moment, enjoy the view. This may be your last chance.

1045676.en: Traitors of Luminaire VII, bow to your rightful President.

1045677.en: Of all the contemptuous powermongers to ever rule the Gallente, Luc Duvalier was the most despicable.

1045678.en:
I had thought after I bombed your planet into dust that you would give up this Caldari nonsense, but I see that your foolishness continues. 

My mercy has reached its limit. Give up your ridiculous culture or die here and now.

1045679.en: Thanks to heroes like Admiral Tovil-Toba, whatever stars we orbit, whatever planets we call home, we remain Caldari.

1045680.en:
You have surpassed my every expectation against one of the Caldari’s greatest challenges. 

Join the state and do us the honor of fighting by your side.

1045681.en: You have fought well for the State. fight alongside us, and you will only get stronger.

1045682.en:
You have seen just how hard our ancestors had to fight, and barely made it through. 

Perhaps now you can appreciate the fortitude of the Caldari people.

1045683.en: No one… no one is replying. Are they all lost?

1045684.en:
We still have transports alive out there, thanks to you, Captain.

I do not know how long they can hold on, though.

1045685.en: I don’t know how, but our transports are reading green across the board.

1045686.en:
Enemy reinforcements are arriving at regular intervals.

Focus on the survival of our people, not the death of theirs. That is your duty.

1045687.en:
Too stubborn to surrender, too stubborn to survive.

Your deaths will serve as a reminder to any others foolish enough to question the Federation.

1045689.en: If this is going to be our last stand, let us make it with honor.

1045690.en: The Fedration will pay for this.

1045691.en: As long as the Caldari live, we will never be conquered.

1045692.en: The dream of New Caldari is a glorious one, if we can just survive today.

1045693.en:
Do not lose hope, I have a plan.

I am going to teach these Gallente what it feels like when your home is attacked.

1045694.en: As all seemed lost, Admiral Yakiya Tovil-Toba prepared to make the ultimate sacrifice for all Caldari.

1045695.en: Is that madman plotting a collision course for Gallente Prime? Forget those miscreants, go after him!

1045696.en: As Admiral Tovil-Toba entered warp, the majority of the invading fleet chased after him. With most of the Gallente gone, our forces had one last chance at victory.

1045697.en:
Gallente Prime is in sight. Non-essential personnel, abandon ship.

Those who remain, the State will honor your sacrifice.

1045698.en:
Breaching the upper atmosphere, now. It has been my greatest honor to serve. My only regret is that I won’t get to see you all make landfall. 

Remember, we remain Caldari. No matter what.

[explosion sound]

1045699.en:
We made it, just. Thank you, Admiral.

No time to mourn just yet, entering warp now. See you all on the other side.

1045700.en:
Not bad out there, at least the Admiral’s death was not in vain.

No time to mourn just yet, entering warp now. See you all on the other side.

1045701.en:
Wow! You made quick work of those Federation bastards. The Admiral would be proud.

Entering Warp now. See you all on the other side.

1045702.en:
You have seen now the cost of freedom, and the struggle necessary to maintain it.

Join our fight against the Amarr, and continue the spirit of rebellion that founded our Republic.

1045703.en:
You have proved yourself and felt what it means to fight side by side with the Matari.

Join our fight against the Amarr, and continue the spirit of rebellion that founded our Republic.

1045704.en:
An elite pilot like yourself is just the kind of champion the Tribes of Matar need.

Join our fight against the Amarr, and continue the spirit of rebellion that founded our Republic.

1045705.en: You have borne witness to the trials that face the faithful. Fight by our side, and you shall see how, with faith, you can rise above them.

1045706.en:
You have proven yourself, passing through the slings and arrows of the heretics to deliver victory at any cost.

Now join us here beyond the bounds of simulation and join the glory of the chosen.

1045707.en: The Lord has clearly blessed you with great skill. Fly beneath the Lord’s banner, and that skill shall earn you the glory of the chosen.

1045708.en: Now you know just how hard we fight, and that it’s a fight worth winning. Come join the Federation, and see justice done right.

1045709.en: You did well. Care to take those skills into the real world, into a fight that really matters? Come join the Federation, and see justice done right.

1045710.en: The Federation would be proud to have a pilot like you flying with us. Put those skills to good use in the only fight that really matters, the fight for freedom.

1045712.en:
Great work, that should be enough to show these heretics a thing or two.

Follow me, Captain, we’re heading into the belly of this rebellious beast.

1045713.en:
That will have to do. Ready or not, the time to strike is now!

Follow me, Captain, we’re heading into the belly of this rebellious beast.

1045715.en:
Finally, that is the last of them.

We’ve cleared out this wing, searching for our next target.

1045716.en:
Nicely done, that’s the last of them.

We’ve cleared out this wing, searching for our next target.

1045722.en: A ship carrying Caldari civilians and the assets of Caldari megacorporations as they attempt to escape the attacks on their home planet.

1045723.en: Once loaded full of valuable Intaki artifacts, this Badger-class hauler plans to steal them for its megacorp masters.

1045724.en: No! All is lost! What will I tell my corporate overseer!

1045725.en: We may have lost the day, but with this Intaki wealth, our investment has paid off.

1045726.en: Unacceptable! Barely a pittance. The CEOs are not going to be happy.

1045727.en: You tell them the Federation says to stay away from our freedom!

1045728.en: You tell them the Federation says next time we come for them!

1045729.en: It’s the people that matter; these Caldari wouldn't understand that.

1045731.en: The titan has landed, barely a scratch on it, thanks to you!

1045732.en: The titan has landed! Thanks to you, it's fighting fit and ready to roll!

1045733.en: The titan has landed, worse for wear but still ready to fight!

1045734.en: Finally, that’s the last of their guard dogs. Get ready for liberation phase 2.

1045735.en: Nicely done, Captain. That’s the last of their guard dogs. Get ready for liberation phase 2.

1045736.en: Whoa, you made short work of those Caldari guard dogs. Get ready, liberation phase 2 is about to begin.

1045737.en: Just one will be enough to turn the tide. Self-destruct initiated. Wrap your arms around the enemy For faith is your fire And with it, burn away his evil

1045738.en: You have been weakened, now face the Lord’s judgement with me! Self-destruct initiated. Wrap your arms around the enemy For faith is your fire And with it, burn away his evil

1045739.en: You all shall be laid low before the judgment of the Lord! Self-destruct initiated Wrap your arms around the enemy For faith is your fire And with it, burn away his evil

1045773.en: Matar, in the system of Pator. For centuries, these Amarrian guns have been pointed at the population below. In their arrogance, they never expected we would break our own chains and build our own fleet.

1045774.en:
Global forces are occupying key positions and ready to engage on your mark.

We need those defenses disabled before go time, or they’ll kill every one of us.

1045775.en: Move fast; all three turrets must be disabled simultaneously or they’ll keep coming back online.

1045776.en:
Nice work, keep it up. Just one more to go.

Ground commander, are you ready to move on our mark?

1045777.en: We’ve got Mass Drivers and khumaak’s ready to unleash hell on these Imperial soldiers as soon as those defences are down.

1045778.en: Just in time, operational window is about to close. Entering Warp now.

1045779.en:
Nicely done, the turrets are down, and our fleet is warping in. 

Those Imperial bastards won’t know what hit them.

1045780.en: Expertly done, Captain. That was so fast, there’s no way they will see us coming.

1045837.en: Pioneer Expert System This Expert System makes available skills enabling the Capsuleer to fly a Mining Destroyer, such as a Pioneer. The temporary skills provided by this Expert System last for 7 days. An Expert System is a remote, restricted artificial intelligence providing you with access to certain skills during the active rental period. As it is independent from your clone and your capsule, an active Expert System is not lost on pod death or clone jump. Activating an Expert System Activation of an Expert System is automatic upon redemption of the item by the specific capsuleer intending to use the service. Expert Systems are a product developed by the PKN Interstellar consortium, made available over the HyperNet FTL communications network, and marketed by PKN Interstellar member corporations. An Expert System is a restricted AI based on artificial gelbrain technology. As the Expert System uses neural pathways based on those created by skill training or skill injection, it is compatible with capsule-ship interface and control systems. Real time command and control communication is achieved using dedicated FTL channels on PKN Interstellar's HyperNet.

Global forces are on the move, attacking major infrastructure points on every continent.

Time to take this planet back.

1046150.en: Response fleet is incoming, and it looks like the Lord Governor’s supercarrier is leading the charge.

1046151.en:
A cowardly ambush by the lowly Minmatar. No matter, it shall not last long.

Hear me, oh lord, smite these foolish rebels with your fiery wrath, make them beg for the mercy of a swift end.

1046152.en: First positions have been successfully held, but orbital fleet support has got us pinned down.

1046153.en: Guerilla forces have made a break for it across the Mioaran islands, we’re finally gaining some ground.

1046154.en:
Fighters down just in time, I don’t know if we could have held out any longer.

Battleships, time to take out the Lord Governor’s supercarrier and end this occupation.

1046155.en:
Fighters are down, not bad Captain.

Battleships, time to take out the Lord Governor’s supercarrier and end this occupation.

1046156.en:
A swift victory! I guess their Lord couldn't hear them over the sound of your turrets.

Battleships, time to take out the Lord Governor’s supercarrier and end this occupation.

1046157.en:
That took everything we had, but finally, the Lord Governor and his supercarrier have been defeated. 

The remaining fleet is routing. The day is ours! Matar is ours!

1046158.en:
The Lord Governor and his supercarrier have been defeated. A quicker death than he deserved, thanks to your expert piloting, Captain. 

The remaining fleet is routing. The day is ours! Matar is ours!

1046159.en:
A hard battle, hard fought, thanks to you, Captain. The Lord Governor and his supercarrier have been defeated.

The remaining fleet is routing. The day is ours! Matar is ours!

1046160.en: Making swift progress across the Eyniletti Plains. Half these Imperials are dead before they even know we’ve arrived!

1046162.en: Oh Lord, grant us the strength to cast down these upstarts!

1046163.en: We’ve surrounded Matar City. They’re dug in pretty deep. Looks like we’ve finally got a fight on our hands.

1046164.en: Target’s armor is at 25%, keep pushing, Captain. We can’t let our people down.

1046165.en: Lord, our Armor is failing! Will you not hear our prayers!

1046166.en:
Matar City and the Grand Caravanserai are both secured! 

The people are pulling down statues and raising tribal banners! I wish you could be here with us.

1046167.en: We’ll be celebrating soon enough, but first we have some business to finish.

1046168.en: Argh - it’s so dark… they told me there would be a light… they told me [death rattle]

1046169.en:
The cowardly Minmatar waited until our fleet was away fighting the Jovians to attack.

Our ships had to rush back to Ennur, still damaged, to try and put their rebellion down.

1046170.en:
By all the saints, hostile forces inbound!

Try to keep these insurgents under control, but don’t stop the repairs.

1046171.en: Keep it up, Captain. Remember your scripture: Always must we strive to show him our worth, For we are the Chosen, Blessed above all. From Anoyia's Exhortation to the Faithful

1046172.en: Faith is your armor And through it, the enemy will find no breach From Amarr Askura, 10:3.

1046173.en: We are receiving a message from our Emperor, praise be!

1046174.en:
To all pilots fighting against this foul rebellion, I offer you my thanks and my blessings.

This lowly rebellion cannot be tolerated, nor can its dark chaos be allowed to spread.

1046175.en: Though he has long since passed on, the wisdom of our Emperor still lingers on, as one day so will the words of our current Empress, Catiz I.

1046177.en: Find strength in your faith, and know that any sacrifice made in the name of the Lord is the greatest honor our Lord may grant.

1046178.en: For it is written, Rejoice, o chosen of God For our blood fills this Valley of Death, Proclaiming our sacrifice to God, And he shall raise it up for all time Hold true to these words and there can be no defeat.

1046179.en:
Hm, it seems the enemy flagships are threatening the frontline.

Let us make haste!

1046180.en:
What terrible destruction is this?

Dear Lord, there is no way our guns could destroy this enemy.

1046181.en: There is nothing else for it. As the scriptures teach us, We are his retribution incarnate His Angels of Vengeance

1046182.en: Our Emperor chose his scripture wisely: Proclaiming our sacrifice to God, And he shall raise it up for all time Treacherous Minmatar, are you ready to hear my proclamation?

1046183.en:
Keep it up, Captain.

Take back the power that rightfully belongs to the Almighty.

1046184.en:
Beginning my approach. 

It has been an honor to fly with you.

1046185.en: The Gallente flag flies over Intaki once more! The people of Intaki have our planet back. Thank you, Captain.

1046186.en: Attack Group Alpha, weapons free. Engage and destroy every Caldari Navy hostile you see.

1046187.en: One of the Federation’s oldest members, the Intaki have long suffered under the oppressive thumb of the Caldari State. Today, you will help these brave champions of freedom put an end to that occupation.

1046188.en:
Hostiles detected; we’re losing ships! It’s the damned Federation!

Fight all you want, we will never give up control of these valuable corporate assets.

1046189.en: They’re not assets damnit, they’re human beings!

1046190.en: Nice work out there, Captain. Don’t let up, we need these targets neutralized ASAP.

1046191.en: Hold, State security. For every ship you lose, I will personally see that the pay of all crewmembers' families is docked.

1046192.en: The security fleet has failed. Prepare the Executive Defense Cannons!

1046194.en:
People of Intaki… Federation!

Caldari… pinned down...

Stop… Megacorporation…

1046195.en:
This is the free…

…filling their… cultural...

Please, stop… escape!

1046196.en:
A message from the surface!

Intaki citizen, we read you, but the signal’s breaking up.

1046197.en: Keep it up, the Erebus is almost in range.

1046198.en: The Caldari are blocking their signal! Keep those cannons from making a mark, and our titan will solve that problem.

1046199.en:
Not on our watch, right, Captain?

Take out those Megacorporation Haulers before they bug out.

Be warned, as soon as you hit one, the others will begin to depart. I recommend using drones to help spread your damage.

1046200.en: Second one down! Now, hit that last hauler with everything you’ve got!

1046201.en:
Nicely done! 

Don’t worry, we’ll recover the stolen artifacts from the wreckage. You just keep it up.

1046202.en: With those defenses down, we can finally clear up the static on the Intaki message.

1046203.en: Our cannons are down! Begin operation plunder!

1046207.en: Once a Plundering Hauler is fired upon, all Haulers will begin to try to escape. Attacking multiple at once, for example, using drones, increases your chances of getting them all.

1046209.en: Use a Sensor Dampener on Executive Defense Cannons to stop them from firing on the approaching Federation Erebus.

1046211.en: Allowing no more than two Plundering Haulers to escape.

1046217.en: Destroy the Governor Aeon within the time limit.

1046218.en: Hack all Imperial Defense Platforms before the timer runs out.

1046219.en: Destroy all the Imperial Fighters within the time limit.

This filament can only be activated by capsuleers under 35 days old with 2 million or fewer skill points. AIR has issued this filament to celebrate the opening of Exordium, a region dedicated to new pilots. With CONCORD’s protection and AIR’s guidance, capsuleers in Exordium can learn the skills they need to face the threats of wider New Eden, and earn the rewards they offer.

1046938.en: Agents working for the Serpentis recently managed to infiltrate one of our outposts in a nearby system. We have reliable information that they did manage to find classified information about our various operations in the area. Fortunately one of the officers at the outpost managed to slip a tracking device into one of their ships before they escaped. We know they are located in {[location]dungeonLocationID.name} at this very moment. I would like you to fly over there and ambush them immediately. Return to me once their ships have been turned to dust. But be careful, they are armed and dangerous.

Activating an Expert System Activation of an Expert System is automatic upon redemption of the item by the specific capsuleer intending to use the service. An Expert System is a restricted AI based on artificial gelbrain technology. As the Expert System uses neural pathways based on those created by skill training or skill injection, it is compatible with capsule-ship interface and control systems. Real time command and control communication is achieved using dedicated FTL channels on PKN Interstellar's HyperNet.

The Arkombine is a splinter group of disillusioned clone soldiers. Betrayed by the nations they swore to serve they now seek independence and the means to undo what has been done to them. Their ranks are comprised of clone soldiers from all four of the major empires.

With the rise of the Deathless Circle and new cloning technology holding out the hope of healing the deepest psychological scars of the old warclones, and catapulting them to new heights, the Arkombine have gathered many old soldiers of the first and second generations of mercenary clones to their ranks. The Arkombine Arisen nanocoating is a dramatic and proud statement of the determination of all warclones to survive, prosper, and rise beyond the persecution and conflict inflicted on them by the imperialist ambitions and militarist adventurism of New Eden's empires and factions.

In YC128, as the stability of Pochven wavered, the Blood Raiders saw an opportunity to plunder the region for the secrets of Triglavian biotech. The Akoman was constructed to help them take advantage of that opportunity.

Facing off against an inarguably more advanced foe, the Blood Raiders needed a vessel that represented the best of their own technical prowess. This attack battlecruiser allowed Blood Raider fleets to form stronger frontline assaults as they struck at the heart of Triglavian territory.

1048566.en: Amarr Pilot Expert System This Expert System makes available skills enabling a capsuleer to fly Amarr Tech 1 and Navy frigate-type, destroyer-type, cruiser-type, battlecruiser-type and battleship-type ships along with Amarr-focused supporting skills. The temporary skills provided by this Expert System last for seven days. An Expert System is a remote, restricted artificial intelligence providing you with access to certain skills during the active rental period. As it is independent from your clone and your capsule, an active Expert System is not lost on pod death or clone jump. Activating an Expert System Activation of an Expert System is automatic upon redemption of the item by the specific capsuleer intending to use the service. Expert Systems are a product developed by the PKN Interstellar consortium, made available over the HyperNet FTL communications network, and marketed by PKN Interstellar member corporations. An Expert System is a restricted AI based on artificial gelbrain technology. As the Expert System uses neural pathways based on those created by skill training or skill injection, it is compatible with capsule-ship interface and control systems. Real time command and control communication is achieved using dedicated FTL channels on PKN Interstellar's HyperNet.

Visit your nearest IRIS and take part in Paragon's latest initiatives to unlock new emblems today.

Paragon; be more.

WARNING: Emblems are auto-injected on purchases and cannot be transferred or traded between capsuleers. The Paragon corporation accepts no liability for failed transfer attempts.

1050829.en:
Among their people, the practice of identifying and deifying savants has been part of Sani Sabik life for over a thousand years, but has in more recent times taken a back seat as the Blood Raiders in particular have widened their pursuits to the acquisition, inspection, and manipulation of blood, with this becoming their core focus.

The only remaining echoes of the lauding of savants are in the near worship of Omir Sarikusa and in the unstated but general belief among the Sani Sabik that each and every one of them is a savant of New Eden, having all in one way or another been the beneficiaries of the blood rituals.

1050869.en: Caldari Pilot Expert System This Expert System makes available skills enabling a capsuleer to fly Caldari Tech 1 and Navy frigate-type, destroyer-type, cruiser-type, battlecruiser-type and battleship-type ships along with Caldari-focused supporting skills. The temporary skills provided by this Expert System last for seven days. An Expert System is a remote, restricted artificial intelligence providing you with access to certain skills during the active rental period. As it is independent from your clone and your capsule, an active Expert System is not lost on pod death or clone jump. Activating an Expert System Activation of an Expert System is automatic upon redemption of the item by the specific capsuleer intending to use the service. Expert Systems are a product developed by the PKN Interstellar consortium, made available over the HyperNet FTL communications network, and marketed by PKN Interstellar member corporations. An Expert System is a restricted AI based on artificial gelbrain technology. As the Expert System uses neural pathways based on those created by skill training or skill injection, it is compatible with capsule-ship interface and control systems. Real time command and control communication is achieved using dedicated FTL channels on PKN Interstellar's HyperNet.

1050876.en:
Cold Wind’s Call was commissioned by the Chief Executive Panel in celebration of the Caldari State’s continued strength and resilience. Modern retellings of tribal mythology portray Cold Wind as a guide of the early Raata who inspired the stories of great leaders Deteaas and K’Vire by seeding strength and prosperity in the worthy and driving away all who opposed them. Believers continue to revere him as a divine force who carries the Maker’s will throughout the atmosphere of Caldari Prime and beyond.
“Cold Wind was before and will be after, the first of the Winds to blow among the Kaalakiota Peaks and the one that loves things that grow strong.”

1053045.en: The Capsuleer must be a member of the alliance that holds sovereignty in the system in which the jump is being initiated. Only sub-capital ships, Freighters, Jump Freighters, and the Rorqual may activate an Ansiblex. For a full list of the ships restrictions, see the Attribute tab.

1053047.en: When a jump is initiated at an Ansiblex, it consumes some of that Ansiblex’s capacitor charge. The amount consumed is equal to the ship's base Ansiblex Activation Cost multiplied by the Zone multiplier of the destination system. The destination system’s Zone is defined by its distance from the alliance’s Capital system. Zone 1: 0 to 5 ly Zone 2: 5.1 to 10 ly Zone 3: 10.1 to 15 ly Zone 4: 15.1 to 20 ly Zone 5: 20.1 ly and above The multipliers for each zone can be found in the attributes tab. A newly anchored Ansiblex’s capacitor charge starts at 0 and recharges over time.

Improves the optimal range and tracking of all drones. Improves the optimal range, falloff range, explosion radius, and explosion velocity of all fighter weapons.

Bursts of trinary interference interrupt the normal streams of binary navigational data. Whether these are helping or confusing the drone’s navigation is difficult to determine.

1053213.en:
Enhances the range and improves the tracking speed of all drones. Enhances the range, explosion radius and explosion velocity of all fighter weapons.

1053978.en: Wormhole Pilot Expert System This Expert System makes available the skills a capsuleer needs to fly a gas-harvesting Venture, all Covert Ops frigates, and use combat fittings for a Praxis ready for Class 3 wormholes. The temporary skills provided by this Expert System last for seven days. An Expert System is a remote, restricted artificial intelligence providing you with access to certain skills during the active rental period. As it is independent from your clone and your capsule, an active Expert System is not lost on pod death or clone jump. Activating an Expert System Activation of an Expert System is automatic upon redemption of the item by the specific capsuleer intending to use the service. Expert Systems are a product developed by the PKN Interstellar consortium, made available over the HyperNet FTL communications network, and marketed by PKN Interstellar member corporations. An Expert System is a restricted AI based on artificial gelbrain technology. As the Expert System uses neural pathways based on those created by skill training or skill injection, it is compatible with capsule-ship interface and control systems. Real time command and control communication is achieved using dedicated FTL channels on PKN Interstellar's HyperNet.

1053992.en: Hyperdimensional communication incoming from unknown source: Space is a lullaby, exploration a dream, but the Sleepers' song has become a nightmare. Tucked away between silent stones, ruins stir. Beware the guardians, driven mad by paradise unending. They have grown deaf to the mouthless screams of their former masters, hearing only drifting horrors. Slay fear, explore the forgotten, reclaim serenity.

1054158.en: Hyperdimensional communication incoming from unknown source: Solitude is shattered; articulated obsidian forms slide out from unfolded space. Sensors scream as they acquire their target. Can you hear the cries of their slumbering builders, or is that but a dream? You are not alone. Perhaps you never were.

1054159.en: Hyperdimensional communication incoming from unknown source: Scattered asteroids stretch towards an invisible point. Do not listen to the lies of their simple form. Beyond the constraints of your simian perception, beyond the cubes and spheroids of your limited dimensions, a river of data rushes along The Line. Take care of your camera drones, that they do not collide with a stray band of the unseen and vanish.

1054160.en: Hyperdimensional communication incoming from unknown source: Regal thermoelectric converters ascend like stairs towards a throne. Their apex remains unseen, but its weight echoes into the lower reaches of spacetime Did those who sleep imagine themselves kings of a starborn city? Were they noble souls slumbering through a dark-eyed ambush, or Tyrants climbing towards an inevitable fall? Who taught the nightmares how to dream?

1054161.en: Hyperdimensional communication incoming from unknown source: Static buzzes across your sensors. A storm breaks all around, welcoming the brave and reckless alike. Something is wrong. Before the shift there was only void, now a mountain hangs in space as if it had always been. Ripples move through the unknown.

1054162.en: Hyperdimensional communication incoming from unknown source: Dark wisps of cloud accompany invisible gravity waves, alluding to the unseen. Something is wrong. Before the shift there was only void. Now a great asteroid cleaved in two surrounds you. The force that split it evades your sensors as ripples move through the unknown.

1054163.en: Hyperdimensional communication incoming from unknown source: The dreamers forget, but their works linger still. Immortal information whispers its way through conduits and cables. Not all is serene. Unsleeping mechanicals have forsaken their builders, coveting this place in the name of dread lords newly ascendent.

1054164.en: Hyperdimensional communication incoming from unknown source: Hear the echoes a story told all across Anoikis, the story of the Sleepers' folly. Information portals proudly declare this “Enclave Cohort 27”, home to those who would dream their way to a better tomorrow. Their bodies died when the power failed. Were their minds as lucky?

1054165.en: Hyperdimensional communication incoming from unknown source: Static buzzes across your sensors. Charged particles fly across empty space as you barrel ahead. A frozen wheel spits out data. Were you here before? Subtle changes surround; can you see how truth has changed? Ripples move through the unkown.

1054167.en: Hyperdimensional communication incoming from unknown source: You feel the creaking of your ship on approach as it passes through uneven spacetime, crumpled by invisible hands. The Sleepers did not build this place, though their children haunt it. Who were the Talocan? Peer through their mirrors and see.

1054168.en: Hyperdimensional communication incoming from unknown source: Whose ruins are these? The Talocan, apex masters of creation, laid its foundations. Yet, it is the Sleepers' machines that haunt its bones. Were they left here by their makers, or the nightmares to whom they now heel? These are the enigmas you see, allow your imagination to explore the mysteries you are blind to.

1054169.en: Hyperdimensional communication incoming from unknown source: Motes of light float around you. Pure energy curled into a ball shining from a source somewhere unseen. Do not allow yourself to be distracted, for the mad guardians will pay the lights no heed. What began as a search for a cure has become a metal plague of violent machinery.

1054170.en: Hyperdimensional communication incoming from unknown source: They are not dead. Life support remains active, spinning motors buzz in empty engineering stations, lights glimmer in abandoned halls. All these systems feed with a quiet hunger. Converters collect radiation and transport it through the unseen to Sleeper colonies beyond the future-light horizon. Unconscious automation passes through bound infinity, maintaining the existence of the unwilling.

1054171.en: Hyperdimensional communication incoming from unknown source: Oruze. A lone word deciphered from the enclave's endless broadcast. The structure was redesigned long ago, the stones have shifted more recently. A newly formed resonant ring, echoing the transmission out into the infinite. What is Oruze? An architect, or a forgotten god, a warning?

1054172.en: Hyperdimensional communication incoming from unknown source: A frontier database lies deformed by collision with an emergent asteroid, pulled out of the unseen by shifts in deeper dimensions. Do not allow yourselves to be distracted by the guardian’s stings. There is much to witness here.

1054173.en: Hyperdimensional communication incoming from unknown source: Caustic monoliths pluck messages out of the unseen. Their points of origin lie beyond the limits of this waking world. Can you feel their terror? Those who dreamed of a cure for death now beg for its release.

1054412.en: Insurgent Expert System This Expert System makes available the skills a capsuleer needs to fly an effective battlecruiser in Insurgency complexes. The temporary skills provided by this Expert System last for seven days. An Expert System is a remote, restricted artificial intelligence providing you with access to certain skills during the active rental period. As it is independent from your clone and your capsule, an active Expert System is not lost on pod death or clone jump. Activating an Expert System Activation of an Expert System is automatic upon redemption of the item by the specific capsuleer intending to use the service. Expert Systems are a product developed by the PKN Interstellar consortium, made available over the HyperNet FTL communications network, and marketed by PKN Interstellar member corporations. An Expert System is a restricted AI based on artificial gelbrain technology. As the Expert System uses neural pathways based on those created by skill training or skill injection, it is compatible with capsule-ship interface and control systems. Real-time command and control communication is achieved using dedicated FTL channels on PKN Interstellar's HyperNet.
