1054619.en: An abundance of repair seams in this Sleeper drone's armor tell the story of millennia spent on duty, protecting the same unchanging area. The drone moves about with a mechanical indifference to the monotony of its task, executing each new maneuver with a flawless, unthinking precision.

1054621.en: The pristine condition of this Sleeper drone's armor suggests it has only recently been activated, perhaps even newly-manufactured. Even though it appears to be a relative newcomer to the swarm, there is little questioning that it bears the same deadly technology as its more elderly and experienced kin.

1054714.en: The Order of St. Tetrimon is an Amarr religious order known for its fanatical followers and radical scriptural, theocratic, and militarist doctrines. The Order is named for St. Tetrimon, an Ardishapur noble who assassinated his grandfather the Emperor Zaragram II, in response to the increasingly megalomaniac and heretical actions of the "Mad Emperor".

1054882.en: Inside the Criterion, the convocation of Triglav outside the struggle will determine fitness based on survival success.

1054883.en:
Inside the Criterion, the Convocation of Triglav Outside the Struggle will determine fitness based on survival success.

Access must be earned. Criterion Cipher can be earned from Crimson Harvest sites to unlock the acceleration gate. The key is consumed on use, and the gate locks behind those who enter.

The Criterion consists of three combat trials. Speed of completion determines fitness, fitness improves rewards. Challenges are dynamic. Superior capsuleer performance will lead to more dangerous encounters, but also greater rewards.

Time to complete: 15-30 minutes.
Hostiles: Triglavians.
Size: 1 pilot.
Roles: Enforcer.
Modules: Smart Bombs cannot be used within the site.
Ship Restrictions: A well-fitted battlecruiser to survive, a marauder to excel.

1054884.en: A superior Triglavian Drekavac. Fitness must be proven to realize glorification. Destructive mortification is the only alternative within the flow.

1054886.en: A superior Triglavian Leshak. Fitness must be proven to realize glorification. Destructive mortification is the only alternative within the flow.

1054887.en: Your performance has attracted the attention of Zorya Triglav, speaker for the Convocation of Triglav Outside the Struggle. Totality will not be unwoven. Lystopad phase must resolve. Glorification unfolds within the flow. Nothing can halt the flow of Vyraj.

1054889.en: Destroy this cache to unlock its contents. The reward inside is determined based on fitness.

1054900.en: A decryption key that allows access to the Fitness Criterion. It includes a message, which translates as: Ancient Domains counter-flow dissonance are in conflict with stability. Only through fitness can now-time stabilization be realized. Face the Criterion to determine istina fitness and attempt glorification.

1055315.en: Decayed Capital Remote Armor Repairer Mutaplasmid

1055316.en:
This bioadaptive mutaplasmid tool is designed to interface with and alter standard, assembler-based remote armor repair systems. As such this mutaplasmid could be used to mutate the performance characteristics of most remote armor repairers in the correct size class.

Triglavian bioadaptive technology makes extensive use of engineered colonies of extremophilic bacteria, that are used to grow, harvest and adapt various resources found in Abyssal Deadspace. Artificial colonizing plasmids integrated into specialist tools used for direct adaptation of technology can be found in Triglavian caches in various stages of development. These mutaplasmids can be used to alter the characteristics of a wide variety of equipment types, depending on the strain and the bioadaptive tool with which they are integrated.

The mutaplasmid colony integrated into this bioadaptive tool has begun to decay and mutation effects will be less pronounced as a result. While possible mutational benefits are low, the risks of using this mutaplasmid are also reduced.

1055435.en: Triglavian Pilot Expert System This Expert System makes available skills enabling a capsuleer to fly Triglavian Tech 1 frigate-type, destroyer-type, cruiser-type, battlecruiser-type and battleship-type ships along with Triglavian-focused supporting skills. The temporary skills provided by this Expert System last for seven days. An Expert System is a remote, restricted artificial intelligence providing you with access to certain skills during the active rental period. As it is independent from your clone and your capsule, an active Expert System is not lost on pod death or clone jump. Activating an Expert System Activation of an Expert System is automatic upon redemption of the item by the specific capsuleer intending to use the service. Expert Systems are a product developed by the PKN Interstellar consortium, made available over the HyperNet FTL communications network, and marketed by PKN Interstellar member corporations. An Expert System is a restricted AI based on artificial gelbrain technology. As the Expert System uses neural pathways based on those created by skill training or skill injection, it is compatible with capsule-ship interface and control systems. Real time command and control communication is achieved using dedicated FTL channels on PKN Interstellar's HyperNet.

1055700.en: The Blood Raider Covenant is a particularly gruesome sect of Sani Sabik cult. While all modern Sani Sabik rituals use blood in some manner or another, the Blood Raiders Covenant places particular value on it, and will go to great lengths to acquire it from what they believe to be the richest and most unspoiled sources. They are considered among the most dangerous and depraved of all pirate elements operating in space.

1055748.en:
Drains energy from the target ship and adds it to your own.

Note: A Nosferatu module will not drain your target's capacitor below your own capacitor level. May only be fitted to capital ships.

1055750.en:
Neutralizes a portion of the energy in the target ship's capacitor.

Note: May only be fitted to capital class ships.

1055753.en:
This extra-large Entropic Disintegrator is only seen in use on Triglavian capital ships, these massive ships being capable of managing the considerable radiation and enormous gravitational tidal forces the weapon generates. At the energy levels of this ultraheavy weapon system, the tidal forces are so powerful that even the special systems built into battleships are insufficient and only capital ships can deal with the forces involved.

Entropic Disintegrators draw on the tremendous power of the Triglavian singularity-based energy systems to convert exotic matter into a particle stream directed with locally generated entropic force. While powerful, the range of the weapon is limited by the attenuation of entropic forces, which dissipate critically beyond the optimal range. As a result this weapon has no falloff range.

The particle stream generates thermal and explosive reactions on impact, and the entropic forces resolve into a localized gravitational conduit that steadily increases the acceleration on the exotic particles. In effect, the weapon's damage potential increases to a maximum level as long as the particle stream is kept on the same target.

Requires either standard or advanced exotic plasma charge ammo types: Baryon, Meson, Tetryon, Mystic, and Occult.

1059561.en:
Among their people, the practice of identifying and deifying savants has been part of Sani Sabik life for over a thousand years, but has in more recent times taken a back seat as the Blood Raiders in particular have widened their pursuits to the acquisition, inspection, and manipulation of blood, with this becoming their core focus.

The only remaining echoes of the lauding of savants are in the near worship of Omir Sarikusa and in the unstated but general belief among the Sani Sabik that each and every one of them is a savant of New Eden, having all in one way or another been the beneficiaries of the blood rituals.
